const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };

const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;

  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }

function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}
const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };
    for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length]; if (inside(b)) { if (!inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); out.push(b); } else if (inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); } });
  return out; };

/* ---- street asphalt from real building lines (width = gap between mapped building fronts minus sidewalks) ---- */
function streetAsphalt(D, H, polys, o) {
  o = o || {}; const CS = 16, grid = new Map(), key = (i, j) => i * 100003 + j;
  polys.forEach((p, pi) => { let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, z0 = 1e9, z1 = -1e9; p.forEach(q => { x0 = Math.min(x0, q[0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, q[0]); z0 = Math.min(z0, q[1]); z1 = Math.max(z1, q[1]); });
    for (let i = Math.floor(x0 / CS); i <= Math.floor(x1 / CS); i++) for (let j = Math.floor(z0 / CS); j <= Math.floor(z1 / CS); j++) { const k = key(i, j); (grid.get(k) || grid.set(k, []).get(k)).push(pi); } });
  const inB = (x, z) => { const c = grid.get(key(Math.floor(x / CS), Math.floor(z / CS))); if (!c) return false; for (let n = 0; n < c.length; n++) if (pip(polys[c[n]], x, z)) return true; return false; };
  const CAP = { motorway: 16, trunk: 16, primary: 15, secondary: 12, tertiary: 10, minor: 7.5, service: 5 }, TYP = { motorway: 8, trunk: 8, primary: 7.5, secondary: 6, tertiary: 4.8, minor: 3.4, service: 2.6 };
  const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  const asph = lin(o.asphalt || 0x4a4d50), walk = lin(o.walk || 0xb4ab98), mark = lin(0xe6e1d3);
  D.roads.forEach(r => {
    if (r.b === "tunnel" || r.b === "bridge" || r.c === "transit") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { clipRuns(r.pts, H, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, H, 8).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.03, walk)); return; }
    const cap = CAP[r.c]; if (!cap) return; const typ = TYP[r.c] * (r.ow ? 0.8 : 1);
    clipRuns(r.pts, H, 4).forEach(q => {
      const n = q.length, aL = [], aR = [], N = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = q[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = q[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l; const nx = -dz, nz = dx; N.push([nx, nz]);
        const ray = s => { for (let d = 1; d <= cap + 2; d += 0.75) if (inB(q[i][0] + nx * s * d, q[i][1] + nz * s * d)) return d; return -1; };
        const dl = ray(1), dr = ray(-1); const side = r.c === "minor" || r.c === "service" ? 1.4 : 2.2;
        aL.push(dl < 0 ? typ : Math.max(1.6, Math.min(cap, dl - side))); aR.push(dr < 0 ? typ : Math.max(1.6, Math.min(cap, dr - side))); }
      const sm = a => a.map((v, i) => { const s = [a[Math.max(0, i - 1)], v, a[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)]].sort((x, y) => x - y); return s[1] * 0.6 + (a[Math.max(0, i - 1)] + a[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)]) * 0.2; });
      const sL = sm(aL), sR = sm(aR);
      for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { const A = [q[i][0] + N[i][0] * sL[i], q[i][1] + N[i][1] * sL[i]], B = [q[i + 1][0] + N[i + 1][0] * sL[i + 1], q[i + 1][1] + N[i + 1][1] * sL[i + 1]], C = [q[i + 1][0] - N[i + 1][0] * sR[i + 1], q[i + 1][1] - N[i + 1][1] * sR[i + 1]], Dd = [q[i][0] - N[i][0] * sR[i], q[i][1] - N[i][1] * sR[i]];
        quad(br, [A[0], 0.05, A[1]], [B[0], 0.05, B[1]], [C[0], 0.05, C[1]], [Dd[0], 0.05, Dd[1]], asph); }
      const wmean = (sL.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) + sR.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0)) / n;
      if (!r.ow && wmean >= 5.2 && (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary")) { const d = res(q, 3.2); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.16, 0.075, mark); } });
  });
}
/* ---- asphalt = free space (not within a sidewalk of any building) near an OSM road centreline or inside a seed disc; rasterised and merged into rectangles ---- */
function streetRaster(D, H, polys, o) {
  o = o || {}; const CELL = o.cell || 1, W = Math.ceil(2 * H / CELL), OX = -H, dil = Math.ceil((o.dil || 1.8) / CELL);
  const bld = new Uint8Array(W * W), roadM = new Uint8Array(W * W), free = new Uint8Array(W * W);
  polys.forEach(p => { let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, z0 = 1e9, z1 = -1e9; p.forEach(q => { x0 = Math.min(x0, q[0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, q[0]); z0 = Math.min(z0, q[1]); z1 = Math.max(z1, q[1]); });
    for (let j = Math.max(0, Math.floor((z0 - OX) / CELL)); j <= Math.min(W - 1, Math.floor((z1 - OX) / CELL)); j++) { const z = OX + (j + 0.5) * CELL; const xs = [];
      for (let a = 0, b = p.length - 1; a < p.length; b = a++) { if ((p[a][1] > z) !== (p[b][1] > z)) xs.push(p[a][0] + (z - p[a][1]) * (p[b][0] - p[a][0]) / (p[b][1] - p[a][1])); }
      xs.sort((u, v) => u - v); for (let k = 0; k + 1 < xs.length; k += 2) for (let i = Math.max(0, Math.floor((xs[k] - OX) / CELL)); i <= Math.min(W - 1, Math.floor((xs[k + 1] - OX) / CELL)); i++) bld[j * W + i] = 1; } });
  // dilate buildings by dil cells (separable)
  { const t = new Uint8Array(W * W), u = new Uint8Array(W * W);
    for (let j = 0; j < W; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) if (bld[j * W + i]) for (let d = -dil; d <= dil; d++) { const x = i + d; if (x >= 0 && x < W) t[j * W + x] = 1; }
    for (let j = 0; j < W; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) if (t[j * W + i]) for (let d = -dil; d <= dil; d++) { const y = j + d; if (y >= 0 && y < W) u[y * W + i] = 1; }
    for (let k = 0; k < W * W; k++) free[k] = u[k] ? 0 : 1; }
  const DMAX = { motorway: 16, trunk: 16, primary: 15, secondary: 12, tertiary: 11, minor: 8, service: 5 };
  const stamp = (x, z, r) => { const ci = Math.floor((x - OX) / CELL), cj = Math.floor((z - OX) / CELL), rr = Math.ceil(r / CELL); for (let dj = -rr; dj <= rr; dj++) for (let di = -rr; di <= rr; di++) { if (di * di + dj * dj > rr * rr) continue; const i = ci + di, j = cj + dj; if (i >= 0 && i < W && j >= 0 && j < W) roadM[j * W + i] = 1; } };
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel" || r.b === "bridge" || r.c === "transit" || r.c === "rail" || r.c === "path") return; const d = DMAX[r.c]; if (!d) return; res(r.pts, CELL).forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) stamp(p[0], p[1], d); }); });
  (o.seeds || []).forEach(s => { for (let a = 0; a < 1; a++) stamp(s[0], s[1], s[2]); });
  const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true), col = lin(o.asphalt || 0x4a4d50);
  let act = new Map(); let rects = 0;
  const flushRect = (r) => { quad(br, [r.x0, 0.05, r.z0], [r.x1, 0.05, r.z0], [r.x1, 0.05, r.z1], [r.x0, 0.05, r.z1], col); rects++; };
  for (let j = 0; j <= W; j++) { const runs = [];
    if (j < W) { let s = -1; for (let i = 0; i <= W; i++) { const on = i < W && free[j * W + i] && roadM[j * W + i]; if (on && s < 0) s = i; if (!on && s >= 0) { runs.push([s, i]); s = -1; } } }
    const nxt = new Map(); runs.forEach(rn => { const k = rn[0] + "|" + rn[1]; if (act.has(k)) { const r = act.get(k); r.z1 = OX + (j + 1) * CELL; nxt.set(k, r); act.delete(k); } else nxt.set(k, { x0: OX + rn[0] * CELL, x1: OX + rn[1] * CELL, z0: OX + j * CELL, z1: OX + (j + 1) * CELL }); });
    act.forEach(flushRect); act = nxt; }
  act.forEach(flushRect);
  // lane dividers (dashed) on the main roads: lane count from the real asphalt width (3.3 m per lane)
  if (o.lanes !== false) {
    const onR = (x, z) => { const i = Math.floor((x - OX) / CELL), j = Math.floor((z - OX) / CELL); return i >= 0 && i < W && j >= 0 && j < W && free[j * W + i] && roadM[j * W + i]; };
    const mk = lin(0xe6e1d3);
    D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel" || r.b === "bridge" || !(r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary" || r.c === "trunk")) return;
      const d = res(r.pts, 6); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) { const a = d[i], b = d[i + 1]; if (Math.abs(a[0]) > H - 3 || Math.abs(a[1]) > H - 3) continue;
        let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l; const nx = -dz, nz = dx; const mx = (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, mz = (a[1] + b[1]) / 2;
        if (!onR(mx, mz)) continue; let dl = 0, dr = 0; while (dl < 20 && onR(mx + nx * (dl + 0.5), mz + nz * (dl + 0.5))) dl += 0.5; while (dr < 20 && onR(mx - nx * (dr + 0.5), mz - nz * (dr + 0.5))) dr += 0.5;
        const w = dl + dr; if (w < 6.4 || (o.noLane || []).some(q => Math.hypot(mx - q[0], mz - q[1]) < q[2])) continue; const n = r.ow ? Math.min(4, Math.round(w / 3.4)) : 2; if (n < 2) continue;
        for (let k = 1; k < n; k++) { const off = -dr + k * w / n; ribbon(br, [[a[0] + nx * off, a[1] + nz * off], [b[0] + nx * off, b[1] + nz * off]], 0.16, 0.075, mk); } } });
  }
  return { bld, free, roadM, W, OX, CELL, rects };
}

    const H = 330; ROADS.trunk = ROADS.motorway;
    K.group(() => {
      K.pad([[-H, -H], [H, -H], [H, H], [-H, H]], K.mat(0xb4ab98), -1.6, 1.6);
      batch("bld", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.02 }), true);
      batch("bands", K.mat(0x4b5a66, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.2 }), false);
      batch("grass", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
      const polys = D.bld.map(b => b.p).concat(D.inf.map(b => b.p));
      streetRaster(D, H, polys, { dil: 1.8, seeds: [[8, 4, 20]], noLane: [[8, 4, 22]] });
      D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.c === "path" && r.s !== "steps" && r.s !== "corridor" && r.s !== "platform" && r.b !== "bridge" && r.b !== "tunnel") clipRuns(r.pts, H, 8).forEach(q => ribbon(BT.road, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 4 : 1.6, 0.06, lin(0xbdb4a0)));
        if (r.c === "trunk_construction" && r.b !== "bridge") clipRuns(r.pts, H, 8).forEach(q => ribbon(BT.road, q, 22, 0.045, lin(0xb7a27d))); });

const BT = {};                                                          // batches: one mesh per material
const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };
const flush = () => { Object.keys(BT).forEach(k => { const b = BT[k]; if (!b.p.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3)); if (b.vc) g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); K.mesh(g, b.mat); b.p = []; b.n = []; b.c = []; }); };

const mulc = (c, f) => [c[0] * f, c[1] * f, c[2] * f];

/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);
    const c = N[i + 1] > 0.5 ? roof : mulc(wall, 0.78 + 0.22 * Math.min(1, P[i + 1] / Math.max(h, 1))); b.c.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  if (bands && h > 8) { const sg = area2(pts) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = pts.length, bb = BT.bands;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }

function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}

function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };
    for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length]; if (inside(b)) { if (!inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); out.push(b); } else if (inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); } });
  return out; };

/* ---- shared site runner (squares) ---- */
function runSite(cfg) {
  const H = cfg.H;
  K.group(() => {
    K.pad([[-H, -H], [H, -H], [H, H], [-H, H]], K.mat(cfg.plate || 0xb3a78d), -1.6, 1.6);
    batch("bld", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.02 }), true);
    batch("bands", K.mat(0x4b5a66, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.2 }), false);
    batch("grass", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
    batch("paved", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
    (cfg.paved || []).forEach(p => { const q = clipRect(p[0], H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(BT.paved, q, p[2] || 0.03, lin(p[1] || 0xcfc4aa)); });
    drawRoads(D, { half: H, rail: cfg.rail }); drawBridges(D, H, cfg.bridgeH || 7.5);
    const gb = BT.grass, trees = [];
    const skipG = cfg.skipGrass || [];
    D.grass.forEach((g, gi) => { if (skipG.indexOf(gi) >= 0) return; if (g.pts.length >= 3 && inwin(g.pts, H)) { const gq = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (gq.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, gq, 0.09, lin(cfg.grassCol || 0x6f9a5a));
      if (g.a > 250) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = Math.min(24, Math.round(g.a / 170));
        for (let t = 0; t < 200 && n > 0; t++) { const x = x0 + hash(t, g.a) * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + hash(g.a, t + 7) * (z1 - z0); if (pip(g.pts, x, z) && Math.abs(x) < H - 4 && Math.abs(z) < H - 4) { trees.push([x, z, 0.8 + hash(x, z) * 0.6]); n--; } } } } });
    (cfg.gardens || []).forEach(g => { const gq = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (gq.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, gq, g.y || 0.1, lin(g.col || 0x6f9a5a));
      if (g.trees) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = g.trees;
        for (let t = 0; t < 400 && n > 0; t++) { const x = x0 + hash(t + 3, x0) * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + hash(z0, t + 11) * (z1 - z0); if (pip(g.pts, x, z) && !(g.hole && pip(g.hole, x, z))) { trees.push([x, z, 0.75 + hash(x, z) * 0.6]); n--; } } } });
    (cfg.waters || []).forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
    if (!cfg.noWater) D.water.forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w.pts, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
    const ovr = cfg.over || [];
    const hs = (c, b, inf) => { for (const o of ovr) if (pip(b.p, o[0], o[1])) return o[2]; if (b.h && b.h !== 5) return b.h; if (cfg.hfun) return cfg.hfun(c, b, inf); return 15 + Math.floor(hash(c[0], c[1]) * 5) * 3.3; };
    const cols = (c, b) => { const r = hash(c[0], c[1]); for (const o of ovr) if (o[3] && pip(b.p, o[0], o[1])) return [lin(o[3]), o[4] ? lin(o[4]) : ROOFS[0]]; return [WALLS[Math.floor(r * 97) % WALLS.length], ROOFS[Math.floor(r * 53) % ROOFS.length]]; };
    const skip = cfg.skipBld || [];
    D.bld.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; if (skip.some(s => b.a <= (s[2] || 1e9) && pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))) return; const cc = cols(c, b); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), hs(c, b, false), 0, cc[0], cc[1], null, !(cfg.noBands || []).some(s => pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))); });
    D.inf.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; if (skip.some(s => b.a <= (s[2] || 1e9) && pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))) return; const cc = cols(c, b); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), hs(c, b, true), 0, cc[0], cc[1], null, cfg.infBands !== false); });
    (cfg.manual || []).forEach(m => { const c = cenOf(m.p); addBuilding(clipRect(m.p, H), m.h, 0, lin(m.w || 0xdcc9a3), lin(m.r || 0xa39a88), null, true); });
    flush();
    const th = cfg.treeHoles || []; K.trees(trees.filter(t => !th.some(h => pip(h, t[0], t[1]))), cfg.treeH || 9);
    if (cfg.extra) cfg.extra();
  }, 0, 1.2, 0);
  return K.root;
}

    const P = (a) => a.map(p => [Math.round((p[0] - 700) / 2.3333 * 10) / 10, Math.round((p[1] - 700) / 2.3333 * 10) / 10]);
    const mosque = D.osm.filter(o => o.h >= 40 && o.pts[0][0] < -140 && o.pts[0][1] < -150).map(o => ({ c: cenOf(o.pts), a: o.a, h: o.h }));
    const hfun = (c, b, inf) => {
      const r = hash(c[0], c[1]);
      if (c[0] > -10 && c[1] > 50 && b.a > 500) return 44 + Math.floor(r * 5) * 3.3;          // high-rise slabs SE of the square (heights from shadow length ≈ estimated)
      if (c[0] > 60 && c[1] > 40) return 30 + Math.floor(r * 4) * 3.3;
      return (inf ? 15 : 17) + Math.floor(r * 5) * 3.3 + (b.a > 900 ? 3.3 : 0);
    };
    const halls = D.osm.filter(o => o.a > 2000 && o.h >= 28 && o.h <= 31 && o.pts[0][0] < -140).map(o => { const c = cenOf(o.pts); return [c[0], c[1], o.h, 0xdcd2b8, 0x9a9588]; });
    return runSite({ H: 280, noBands: halls, hfun, infBands: false, treeH: 8,
      over: [[56, 86, 72]].concat(halls),
      skipBld: mosque.map(m => [m.c[0], m.c[1], 400]),
      paved: [
        [P([[838, 598], [912, 556], [1000, 580], [1145, 690], [1085, 830], [990, 845], [905, 780]]), 0xc9b690, 0.06],       // sand sports ground
        [P([[370, 230], [520, 200], [540, 330], [500, 400], [430, 420], [390, 340]]), 0x6d6e6e, 0.07]                      // surface car park / bus bays
      ],
      gardens: [{ pts: P([[530, 470], [600, 455], [650, 500], [640, 545], [590, 565], [545, 540]]), col: 0x6f9a5a, trees: 7 },
                { pts: P([[696, 640], [715, 624], [736, 636], [736, 656], [716, 667], [698, 658]]), col: 0x7aa05f, y: 0.2 }],
      extra() {
        const dm = K.mat(0x93a79a, { roughness: 0.55 }), st = K.mat(0xdacfb6);
        mosque.forEach(m => {
          if (m.h === 105) K.minaret(m.c[0], m.c[1], 112, 2.5, "limestone");                       // published: two minarets of 112 m (Arab Contractors)
          else { const central = m.h === 47, r = central ? 10.5 : 9, top = central ? 50 : 44, hb = top - r;   // published: central dome Ø 21 m / 50 m, four domes Ø 18 m (top of the 4 domes = OSM 44 m)
            K.cyl(r * 0.94, r * 0.94, hb - 27.5, st, m.c[0], 27.5, m.c[1], 28); K.dome(r, dm, m.c[0], hb, m.c[1], 1, 28); K.cyl(0.18, 0.18, 3.4, K.mat(0xd9b45c), m.c[0], top - 0.2, m.c[1], 6); }
        });
        // roundabout monument (island at the foot of the flyover)
        K.cyl(3.2, 3.6, 1.1, K.mat(0xcdbfa6), 6.4, 0.1, -25.7, 20);
      } });

  }
});

}catch(e){console.error("model 1209",e)}

const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };
const flush = () => { Object.keys(BT).forEach(k => { const b = BT[k]; if (!b.p.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3)); if (b.vc) g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); K.mesh(g, b.mat); b.p = []; b.n = []; b.c = []; }); };
const lin = hex => { const c = new THREE.Color(hex); c.convertSRGBToLinear(); return [c.r, c.g, c.b]; };
const mulc = (c, f) => [c[0] * f, c[1] * f, c[2] * f];
const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);
    const c = N[i + 1] > 0.5 ? roof : mulc(wall, 0.78 + 0.22 * Math.min(1, P[i + 1] / Math.max(h, 1))); b.c.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  if (bands && h > 8) { const sg = area2(pts) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = pts.length, bb = BT.bands;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }
};
const WALLS = [0xe6d3ac, 0xd9c29a, 0xd4b583, 0xcdbfa6, 0xdcb99b, 0xd2cabb, 0xeadfc6, 0xc4a478, 0xe0c9a0, 0xd6b487].map(lin);
const ROOFS = [0xa39a88, 0xb0a590, 0x948d80, 0xb5a78f].map(lin);
const inwin = (pts, H) => pts.some(p => Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H);

const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
const flatPoly = (b, pts, y, col) => { const v = pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v, []); tri.forEach(t => pushTri(b, [pts[t[0]][0], y, pts[t[0]][1]], [pts[t[1]][0], y, pts[t[1]][1]], [pts[t[2]][0], y, pts[t[2]][1]], [0, 1, 0], col)); };
const ROADS = { motorway: [0x3f4144, 10, 10, 0.17], primary: [0x424447, 10, 16, 0.14], trunk: [0x3f4144, 10, 16, 0.15], secondary: [0x484a4d, 7.5, 12, 0.11], tertiary: [0x4e5053, 6, 9, 0.08], minor: [0x585a5c, 4.6, 5.8, 0.05], service: [0x626466, 3.8, 4.6, 0.04] };
function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}
const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };
    for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length]; if (inside(b)) { if (!inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); out.push(b); } else if (inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); } });
  return out; };

/* ---- shared site runner (squares) ---- */
function runSite(cfg) {
  const H = cfg.H;
  K.group(() => {
    K.pad([[-H, -H], [H, -H], [H, H], [-H, H]], K.mat(cfg.plate || 0xb3a78d), -1.6, 1.6);
    batch("bld", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.02 }), true);
    batch("bands", K.mat(0x4b5a66, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.2 }), false);
    batch("grass", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
    batch("paved", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
    (cfg.paved || []).forEach(p => { const q = clipRect(p[0], H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(BT.paved, q, p[2] || 0.03, lin(p[1] || 0xcfc4aa)); });
    drawRoads(D, { half: H, rail: cfg.rail }); drawBridges(D, H, cfg.bridgeH || 7.5);
    const gb = BT.grass, trees = [];
    const skipG = cfg.skipGrass || [];
    D.grass.forEach((g, gi) => { if (skipG.indexOf(gi) >= 0) return; if (g.pts.length >= 3 && inwin(g.pts, H)) { const gq = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (gq.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, gq, 0.09, lin(cfg.grassCol || 0x6f9a5a));
      if (g.a > 250) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = Math.min(24, Math.round(g.a / 170));
        for (let t = 0; t < 200 && n > 0; t++) { const x = x0 + hash(t, g.a) * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + hash(g.a, t + 7) * (z1 - z0); if (pip(g.pts, x, z) && Math.abs(x) < H - 4 && Math.abs(z) < H - 4) { trees.push([x, z, 0.8 + hash(x, z) * 0.6]); n--; } } } } });
    (cfg.gardens || []).forEach(g => { const gq = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (gq.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, gq, g.y || 0.1, lin(g.col || 0x6f9a5a));
      if (g.trees) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = g.trees;
        for (let t = 0; t < 400 && n > 0; t++) { const x = x0 + hash(t + 3, x0) * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + hash(z0, t + 11) * (z1 - z0); if (pip(g.pts, x, z) && !(g.hole && pip(g.hole, x, z))) { trees.push([x, z, 0.75 + hash(x, z) * 0.6]); n--; } } } });
    (cfg.waters || []).forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
    if (!cfg.noWater) D.water.forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w.pts, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
    const ovr = cfg.over || [];
    const hs = (c, b, inf) => { for (const o of ovr) if (pip(b.p, o[0], o[1])) return o[2]; if (b.h && b.h !== 5) return b.h; if (cfg.hfun) return cfg.hfun(c, b, inf); return 15 + Math.floor(hash(c[0], c[1]) * 5) * 3.3; };
    const cols = (c, b) => { const r = hash(c[0], c[1]); for (const o of ovr) if (o[3] && pip(b.p, o[0], o[1])) return [lin(o[3]), o[4] ? lin(o[4]) : ROOFS[0]]; return [WALLS[Math.floor(r * 97) % WALLS.length], ROOFS[Math.floor(r * 53) % ROOFS.length]]; };
    const skip = cfg.skipBld || [];
    D.bld.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; if (skip.some(s => b.a <= (s[2] || 1e9) && pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))) return; const cc = cols(c, b); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), hs(c, b, false), 0, cc[0], cc[1], null, !(cfg.noBands || []).some(s => pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))); });
    D.inf.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; if (skip.some(s => b.a <= (s[2] || 1e9) && pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))) return; const cc = cols(c, b); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), hs(c, b, true), 0, cc[0], cc[1], null, cfg.infBands !== false); });
    (cfg.manual || []).forEach(m => { const c = cenOf(m.p); addBuilding(clipRect(m.p, H), m.h, 0, lin(m.w || 0xdcc9a3), lin(m.r || 0xa39a88), null, true); });
    flush();
    const th = cfg.treeHoles || []; K.trees(trees.filter(t => !th.some(h => pip(h, t[0], t[1]))), cfg.treeH || 9);
    if (cfg.extra) cfg.extra();
  }, 0, 1.2, 0);
  return K.root;
}

    const P = (a) => a.map(p => [Math.round((p[0] - 700) / 2.3333 * 10) / 10, Math.round((p[1] - 700) / 2.3333 * 10) / 10]);
    const Q = p => [(p[0] - 700) / 2.3333, (p[1] - 700) / 2.3333];

      gardens: [{ pts: P([[120, 275], [430, 295], [470, 372], [350, 410], [150, 330]]), col: 0x6a9558, trees: 18 },

      paved: [[P([[245, 0], [362, 0], [352, 72], [278, 62]]), 0xb8654f, 0.06], [P([[135, 165], [215, 150], [235, 215], [155, 228]]), 0x4f8aa0, 0.06], [P([[205, 192], [300, 205], [292, 262], [212, 252]]), 0x4a7a52, 0.06], [P([[172, 62], [232, 55], [236, 118], [180, 128]]), 0xb8654f, 0.06],

      } });

const hash = (a, b) => { let h = (Math.imul(Math.round(a * 10), 73856093) ^ Math.imul(Math.round(b * 10), 19349663)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177) >>> 0; return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const BT = {};                                                          // batches: one mesh per material
const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };
const flush = () => { Object.keys(BT).forEach(k => { const b = BT[k]; if (!b.p.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3)); if (b.vc) g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); K.mesh(g, b.mat); b.p = []; b.n = []; b.c = []; }); };
const lin = hex => { const c = new THREE.Color(hex); c.convertSRGBToLinear(); return [c.r, c.g, c.b]; };
const mulc = (c, f) => [c[0] * f, c[1] * f, c[2] * f];
const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);
    const c = N[i + 1] > 0.5 ? roof : mulc(wall, 0.78 + 0.22 * Math.min(1, P[i + 1] / Math.max(h, 1))); b.c.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  if (bands && h > 8) { const sg = area2(pts) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = pts.length, bb = BT.bands;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }
};
const WALLS = [0xe6d3ac, 0xd9c29a, 0xd4b583, 0xcdbfa6, 0xdcb99b, 0xd2cabb, 0xeadfc6, 0xc4a478, 0xe0c9a0, 0xd6b487].map(lin);
const ROOFS = [0xa39a88, 0xb0a590, 0x948d80, 0xb5a78f].map(lin);
const inwin = (pts, H) => pts.some(p => Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H);

const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
const flatPoly = (b, pts, y, col) => { const v = pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v, []); tri.forEach(t => pushTri(b, [pts[t[0]][0], y, pts[t[0]][1]], [pts[t[1]][0], y, pts[t[1]][1]], [pts[t[2]][0], y, pts[t[2]][1]], [0, 1, 0], col)); };
const ROADS = { motorway: [0x3f4144, 10, 10, 0.17], primary: [0x424447, 10, 16, 0.14], trunk: [0x3f4144, 10, 16, 0.15], secondary: [0x484a4d, 7.5, 12, 0.11], tertiary: [0x4e5053, 6, 9, 0.08], minor: [0x585a5c, 4.6, 5.8, 0.05], service: [0x626466, 3.8, 4.6, 0.04] };
function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}
const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };
    for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length]; if (inside(b)) { if (!inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); out.push(b); } else if (inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); } });
  return out; };

/* ---- shared site runner (squares) ---- */
function runSite(cfg) {
  const H = cfg.H;
  K.group(() => {
    K.pad([[-H, -H], [H, -H], [H, H], [-H, H]], K.mat(cfg.plate || 0xb3a78d), -1.6, 1.6);
    batch("bld", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.02 }), true);
    batch("bands", K.mat(0x4b5a66, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.2 }), false);
    batch("grass", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
    batch("paved", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
    (cfg.paved || []).forEach(p => { const q = clipRect(p[0], H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(BT.paved, q, p[2] || 0.03, lin(p[1] || 0xcfc4aa)); });
    drawRoads(D, { half: H, rail: cfg.rail }); drawBridges(D, H, cfg.bridgeH || 7.5);
    const gb = BT.grass, trees = [];
    const skipG = cfg.skipGrass || [];
    D.grass.forEach((g, gi) => { if (skipG.indexOf(gi) >= 0) return; if (g.pts.length >= 3 && inwin(g.pts, H)) { const gq = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (gq.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, gq, 0.09, lin(cfg.grassCol || 0x6f9a5a));
      if (g.a > 250) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = Math.min(24, Math.round(g.a / 170));
        for (let t = 0; t < 200 && n > 0; t++) { const x = x0 + hash(t, g.a) * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + hash(g.a, t + 7) * (z1 - z0); if (pip(g.pts, x, z) && Math.abs(x) < H - 4 && Math.abs(z) < H - 4) { trees.push([x, z, 0.8 + hash(x, z) * 0.6]); n--; } } } } });
    (cfg.gardens || []).forEach(g => { const gq = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (gq.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, gq, g.y || 0.1, lin(g.col || 0x6f9a5a));
      if (g.trees) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = g.trees;
        for (let t = 0; t < 400 && n > 0; t++) { const x = x0 + hash(t + 3, x0) * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + hash(z0, t + 11) * (z1 - z0); if (pip(g.pts, x, z) && !(g.hole && pip(g.hole, x, z))) { trees.push([x, z, 0.75 + hash(x, z) * 0.6]); n--; } } } });
    (cfg.waters || []).forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
    if (!cfg.noWater) D.water.forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w.pts, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
    const ovr = cfg.over || [];
    const hs = (c, b, inf) => { for (const o of ovr) if (pip(b.p, o[0], o[1])) return o[2]; if (b.h && b.h !== 5) return b.h; if (cfg.hfun) return cfg.hfun(c, b, inf); return 15 + Math.floor(hash(c[0], c[1]) * 5) * 3.3; };
    const cols = (c, b) => { const r = hash(c[0], c[1]); for (const o of ovr) if (o[3] && pip(b.p, o[0], o[1])) return [lin(o[3]), o[4] ? lin(o[4]) : ROOFS[0]]; return [WALLS[Math.floor(r * 97) % WALLS.length], ROOFS[Math.floor(r * 53) % ROOFS.length]]; };
    const skip = cfg.skipBld || [];
    D.bld.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; if (skip.some(s => b.a <= (s[2] || 1e9) && pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))) return; const cc = cols(c, b); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), hs(c, b, false), 0, cc[0], cc[1], null, !(cfg.noBands || []).some(s => pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))); });
    D.inf.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; if (skip.some(s => b.a <= (s[2] || 1e9) && pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))) return; const cc = cols(c, b); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), hs(c, b, true), 0, cc[0], cc[1], null, cfg.infBands !== false); });
    (cfg.manual || []).forEach(m => { const c = cenOf(m.p); addBuilding(clipRect(m.p, H), m.h, 0, lin(m.w || 0xdcc9a3), lin(m.r || 0xa39a88), null, true); });
    flush();
    const th = cfg.treeHoles || []; K.trees(trees.filter(t => !th.some(h => pip(h, t[0], t[1]))), cfg.treeH || 9);
    if (cfg.extra) cfg.extra();
  }, 0, 1.2, 0);
  return K.root;
}

    const C = (a) => a.map(p => [Math.round((p[0] - 975) / 7.22 * 10) / 10, Math.round((p[1] - 520) / 7.22 * 10) / 10]);   // crop(zoom) px -> metres
    const hfun = (c, b, inf) => { const r = hash(c[0], c[1]); return (inf ? 19 : 23) + Math.floor(r * 4) * 3.5 + (b.a > 900 ? 3.5 : 0); };
    return runSite({ H: 280, hfun, infBands: false, treeH: 8, rail: false, grassCol: 0x5f8a50, plate: 0xb3a78d,
      over: [], noWater: true,
      treeHoles: [C([[400, 520], [650, 420], [780, 640], [710, 840], [510, 860], [420, 720]])],
      waters: [[[-300, -300], [240, -300], [234.5, -287.2], [166.5, -225.9], [131.3, -197.5], [66.9, -147.8], [18.4, -115.3], [-26, -89.9], [-70.5, -66.1], [-111.9, -46.3], [-153.2, -28.6], [-189.5, -14.4], [-205.8, -13.9], [-252.8, 0.8], [-299.3, 14], [-300, 14]]],
      gardens: [{ pts: C([[150, 440], [430, 390], [700, 270], [840, 300], [930, 480], [760, 640], [600, 810], [330, 990], [250, 940], [120, 700]]), col: 0x5a8a4c, trees: 30, y: 0.1, hole: C([[400, 520], [650, 420], [780, 640], [710, 840], [510, 860], [420, 720]]) }],
      paved: [[C([[500, 600], [600, 545], [670, 650], [640, 745], [560, 770], [520, 700]]), 0xd9cdb2, 0.14]],
      extra() {
        // tram tracks (OSM transit:tram) and the Saad Zaghloul monument
        const tb = batch("paved");
        D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.c === "transit") clipRuns(r.pts, 280, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(tb, q, 2.6, 0.2, lin(0x8c857a))); });
        const m = C([[580, 650]])[0], st = K.mat(0xe0d6bd), bz = K.mat(0x4d5b4a, { roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.35 });
        K.group(() => {
          K.box(22, 0.5, 15, st, 0, 0.1, 0); K.box(17, 0.5, 11.5, st, 0, 0.6, 0); K.box(12.5, 0.6, 8, st, 0, 1.1, 0);
          // pylon-shaped pedestal (Mokhtar's base is "inspired by ancient Egyptian architecture, covered in hieroglyphs"; proportions estimated)
          
          { const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.7071 * 5.0, 0.7071 * 7.4, 6.2, 4).rotateY(Math.PI / 4).translate(0, 3.1, 0); g.scale(1, 1, 0.74); K.mesh(g, st, 0, 1.7, 0); }
          K.box(6.4, 0.6, 4.8, st, 0, 7.9, 0);                                                    // cornice
          K.box(1.3, 0.5, 1.3, bz, 0, 8.5, 0); K.cyl(0.55, 0.7, 2.3, bz, 0, 8.9, 0, 10); K.sphere(0.45, bz, 0, 11.5, 0);   // standing figure ≈ 3.5 m, waving
          [-3.0, 3.0].forEach(x => { K.box(1.3, 0.4, 1.3, st, x, 1.7, 3.3); K.cyl(0.4, 0.5, 1.9, bz, x, 2.1, 3.3, 8); K.sphere(0.35, bz, x, 4.2, 3.3); });   // two lower figures
        }, m[0], 0, m[1], 0.5);
      } });

  }
});

const hash = (a, b) => { let h = (Math.imul(Math.round(a * 10), 73856093) ^ Math.imul(Math.round(b * 10), 19349663)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177) >>> 0; return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const BT = {};                                                          // batches: one mesh per material
const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };
const flush = () => { Object.keys(BT).forEach(k => { const b = BT[k]; if (!b.p.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3)); if (b.vc) g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); K.mesh(g, b.mat); b.p = []; b.n = []; b.c = []; }); };
const lin = hex => { const c = new THREE.Color(hex); c.convertSRGBToLinear(); return [c.r, c.g, c.b]; };
const mulc = (c, f) => [c[0] * f, c[1] * f, c[2] * f];
const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);
    const c = N[i + 1] > 0.5 ? roof : mulc(wall, 0.78 + 0.22 * Math.min(1, P[i + 1] / Math.max(h, 1))); b.c.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  if (bands && h > 8) { const sg = area2(pts) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = pts.length, bb = BT.bands;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }
};
const WALLS = [0xe6d3ac, 0xd9c29a, 0xd4b583, 0xcdbfa6, 0xdcb99b, 0xd2cabb, 0xeadfc6, 0xc4a478, 0xe0c9a0, 0xd6b487].map(lin);
const ROOFS = [0xa39a88, 0xb0a590, 0x948d80, 0xb5a78f].map(lin);
const inwin = (pts, H) => pts.some(p => Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H);

const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
const flatPoly = (b, pts, y, col) => { const v = pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v, []); tri.forEach(t => pushTri(b, [pts[t[0]][0], y, pts[t[0]][1]], [pts[t[1]][0], y, pts[t[1]][1]], [pts[t[2]][0], y, pts[t[2]][1]], [0, 1, 0], col)); };
const ROADS = { motorway: [0x3f4144, 10, 10, 0.17], primary: [0x424447, 10, 16, 0.14], trunk: [0x3f4144, 10, 16, 0.15], secondary: [0x484a4d, 7.5, 12, 0.11], tertiary: [0x4e5053, 6, 9, 0.08], minor: [0x585a5c, 4.6, 5.8, 0.05], service: [0x626466, 3.8, 4.6, 0.04] };
function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}
const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };
    for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length]; if (inside(b)) { if (!inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); out.push(b); } else if (inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); } });
  return out; };

/* ---- shared site runner (squares) ---- */
function runSite(cfg) {
  const H = cfg.H;
  K.group(() => {
    K.pad([[-H, -H], [H, -H], [H, H], [-H, H]], K.mat(cfg.plate || 0xb3a78d), -1.6, 1.6);
    batch("bld", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.02 }), true);
    batch("bands", K.mat(0x4b5a66, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.2 }), false);
    batch("grass", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
    batch("paved", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
    (cfg.paved || []).forEach(p => { const q = clipRect(p[0], H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(BT.paved, q, p[2] || 0.03, lin(p[1] || 0xcfc4aa)); });
    drawRoads(D, { half: H, rail: cfg.rail }); drawBridges(D, H, cfg.bridgeH || 7.5);
    const gb = BT.grass, trees = [];
    const skipG = cfg.skipGrass || [];
    D.grass.forEach((g, gi) => { if (skipG.indexOf(gi) >= 0) return; if (g.pts.length >= 3 && inwin(g.pts, H)) { const gq = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (gq.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, gq, 0.09, lin(cfg.grassCol || 0x6f9a5a));
      if (g.a > 250) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = Math.min(24, Math.round(g.a / 170));
        for (let t = 0; t < 200 && n > 0; t++) { const x = x0 + hash(t, g.a) * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + hash(g.a, t + 7) * (z1 - z0); if (pip(g.pts, x, z) && Math.abs(x) < H - 4 && Math.abs(z) < H - 4) { trees.push([x, z, 0.8 + hash(x, z) * 0.6]); n--; } } } } });
    (cfg.gardens || []).forEach(g => { const gq = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (gq.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, gq, g.y || 0.1, lin(g.col || 0x6f9a5a));
      if (g.trees) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = g.trees;
        for (let t = 0; t < 400 && n > 0; t++) { const x = x0 + hash(t + 3, x0) * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + hash(z0, t + 11) * (z1 - z0); if (pip(g.pts, x, z) && !(g.hole && pip(g.hole, x, z))) { trees.push([x, z, 0.75 + hash(x, z) * 0.6]); n--; } } } });
    (cfg.waters || []).forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
    if (!cfg.noWater) D.water.forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w.pts, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
    const ovr = cfg.over || [];
    const hs = (c, b, inf) => { for (const o of ovr) if (pip(b.p, o[0], o[1])) return o[2]; if (b.h && b.h !== 5) return b.h; if (cfg.hfun) return cfg.hfun(c, b, inf); return 15 + Math.floor(hash(c[0], c[1]) * 5) * 3.3; };
    const cols = (c, b) => { const r = hash(c[0], c[1]); for (const o of ovr) if (o[3] && pip(b.p, o[0], o[1])) return [lin(o[3]), o[4] ? lin(o[4]) : ROOFS[0]]; return [WALLS[Math.floor(r * 97) % WALLS.length], ROOFS[Math.floor(r * 53) % ROOFS.length]]; };
    const skip = cfg.skipBld || [];
    D.bld.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; if (skip.some(s => b.a <= (s[2] || 1e9) && pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))) return; const cc = cols(c, b); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), hs(c, b, false), 0, cc[0], cc[1], null, !(cfg.noBands || []).some(s => pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))); });
    D.inf.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; if (skip.some(s => b.a <= (s[2] || 1e9) && pip(b.p, s[0], s[1]))) return; const cc = cols(c, b); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), hs(c, b, true), 0, cc[0], cc[1], null, cfg.infBands !== false); });
    (cfg.manual || []).forEach(m => { const c = cenOf(m.p); addBuilding(clipRect(m.p, H), m.h, 0, lin(m.w || 0xdcc9a3), lin(m.r || 0xa39a88), null, true); });
    flush();
    const th = cfg.treeHoles || []; K.trees(trees.filter(t => !th.some(h => pip(h, t[0], t[1]))), cfg.treeH || 9);
    if (cfg.extra) cfg.extra();
  }, 0, 1.2, 0);
  return K.root;
}

    const C = (a) => a.map(p => [Math.round((p[0] - 650) / 3.25 * 10) / 10, Math.round((p[1] - 658) / 3.25 * 10) / 10]);   // zoom-crop px -> metres
    const hfun = (c, b, inf) => { const r = hash(c[0], c[1]); return (inf ? 21 : 25) + Math.floor(r * 4) * 3.3 + (b.a > 900 ? 3.3 : 0); };

                { pts: C([[650, 0], [740, 10], [745, 200], [715, 330], [670, 430], [620, 430], [640, 300], [645, 100]]), col: 0x5f8a50, trees: 22, y: 0.1 }],
      paved: [[C([[595, 640], [640, 610], [690, 640], [690, 690], [640, 715], [595, 690]]), 0xd0c4a8, 0.14]],
      extra() {
        const tb = batch("paved");
        D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.c === "transit") clipRuns(r.pts, 300, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(tb, q, 2.6, 0.2, lin(0x8c857a))); });

        }, -8, 0, 3, 0.31);
      } });

  }
