const hash = (a, b) => { let h = (Math.imul(Math.round(a * 10), 73856093) ^ Math.imul(Math.round(b * 10), 19349663)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177) >>> 0; return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const BT = {};                                                          // batches: one mesh per material
const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };
const flush = () => { Object.keys(BT).forEach(k => { const b = BT[k]; if (!b.p.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3)); if (b.vc) g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); K.mesh(g, b.mat); b.p = []; b.n = []; b.c = []; }); };

/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {

const WALLS = [0xe6d3ac, 0xd9c29a, 0xd4b583, 0xcdbfa6, 0xdcb99b, 0xd2cabb, 0xeadfc6, 0xc4a478, 0xe0c9a0, 0xd6b487].map(lin);

const inwin = (pts, H) => pts.some(p => Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H);

const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
const flatPoly = (b, pts, y, col) => { const v = pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v, []); tri.forEach(t => pushTri(b, [pts[t[0]][0], y, pts[t[0]][1]], [pts[t[1]][0], y, pts[t[1]][1]], [pts[t[2]][0], y, pts[t[2]][1]], [0, 1, 0], col)); };

function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}
const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };

const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };

const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);
    const c = N[i + 1] > 0.5 ? roof : mulc(wall, 0.78 + 0.22 * Math.min(1, P[i + 1] / Math.max(h, 1))); b.c.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  if (bands && h > 8) { const sg = area2(pts) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = pts.length, bb = BT.bands;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }
};
const WALLS = [0xe6d3ac, 0xd9c29a, 0xd4b583, 0xcdbfa6, 0xdcb99b, 0xd2cabb, 0xeadfc6, 0xc4a478, 0xe0c9a0, 0xd6b487].map(lin);

const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
const flatPoly = (b, pts, y, col) => { const v = pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v, []); tri.forEach(t => pushTri(b, [pts[t[0]][0], y, pts[t[0]][1]], [pts[t[1]][0], y, pts[t[1]][1]], [pts[t[2]][0], y, pts[t[2]][1]], [0, 1, 0], col)); };

function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;

const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };

}

const hash = (a, b) => { let h = (Math.imul(Math.round(a * 10), 73856093) ^ Math.imul(Math.round(b * 10), 19349663)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177) >>> 0; return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const BT = {};                                                          // batches: one mesh per material
const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };

const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };

const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);

      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }

function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });

const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };

  return out; };

    K.group(() => {
      const steel = K.mat(0x7f8a8d), conc = K.mat(0xb9b4a8), stoneG = K.mat(0xa59c90);
      const prof = (u) => u < HL - 6 ? YD : YD;

      [-1, 1].forEach(s => { K.box(2 * HL, 0.06, 11.0, "road", 0, YD, s * 6.35); K.box(2 * HL, 0.08, 3.8, "paving", 0, YD, s * 13.35); K.box(2 * HL, 1.0, 0.45, conc, 0, YD, s * 14.9); K.box(2 * HL, 0.4, 0.2, steel, 0, YD + 1.0, s * 14.9); });
      K.box(2 * HL, 0.22, 0.9, conc, 0, YD, 0);
      const dash = []; for (let x = -HL + 4; x < HL - 4; x += 9) [-1, 1].forEach(s => [-3.65, 3.65].forEach(o => dash.push([x, YD + 0.06, s * 6.35 + o])));

      // 5 spans, 4 river piers (ESTIMATED), haunched plate girders
      const NS = 5, SPN = 2 * HL / NS, rib = [], pier = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < NS; k++) { const xc = -HL + SPN * (k + 0.5), pts = [[-SPN / 2, 0]];

        [-12, -7.2, -2.4, 2.4, 7.2, 12].forEach(z => rib.push(H.vprof(pts, 0.5, xc, YD - 1.0, z))); }
      H.put(rib, steel);
      for (let k = 1; k < NS; k++) { const px = -HL + SPN * k; pier.push(H.ext([[-1.7, -9.5], [0, -10.8], [1.7, -9.5], [1.7, 9.5], [0, 10.8], [-1.7, 9.5]].map(p => [p[0] + px, p[1]]), YD - 1.0 - 4.2 + 1.0, -1.0)); K.box(4.2, 0.9, 25, stoneG, px, YD - 1.0 - 4.2, 0); }
      H.put(pier, stoneG);
      // abutments at the quays
      [-1, 1].forEach(s => K.box(6, YD - 0.2, WD - 1.0, stoneG, s * (HL - 3), -1.0, 0));
      // approach ramps (solid, down to street level)
      [[-1, 70], [1, 57]].forEach(([s, L]) => { const a = H.acc(), b = H.acc(), c = H.acc(), n = 8, ptsR = [], yy = [];
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const t = i / n; ptsR.push([s * (HL + L * t), 0]); yy.push(YD - (YD - YG - 0.15) * t); }
        H.ribbon(b, ptsR, WD, i => yy[i] - 0.05, i => yy[i] - YG); H.flush(b, conc);
        H.ribbon(a, ptsR, 22.9, i => yy[i] + 0.02); H.flush(a, "road");
        [-1, 1].forEach(q => { const pp = ptsR.map(p => [p[0], q * 13.35]); H.ribbon(c, pp, 3.8, i => yy[i] + 0.04); }); H.flush(c, "paving"); });
      // parapets on the ramps
      // lamp posts every 18 m on both edges
      const lp = []; for (let x = -HL + 6; x < HL; x += 18) [-1, 1].forEach(s => lp.push([x, YD + 0.1, s * 14.9]));
      K.inst(K.cylGeo(0.1, 0.16, 6.0, 6), steel, lp); K.inst(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.42, 8, 6).translate(0, 6.1, 0), "white", lp);
    }, GX, 0, GZ, TH);

    return K.root;
  }
});

    const H = {};

        let nx = uy * vz - uz * vy, ny = uz * vx - ux * vz, nz = ux * vy - uy * vx; const L = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz); if (L < 1e-9) return; nx /= L; ny /= L; nz /= L;

        if (t) { H.quad(acc, L[i], L[i + 1], LB[i + 1], LB[i], [s[0], 0, s[1]]); H.quad(acc, R[i], R[i + 1], RB[i + 1], RB[i], [-s[0], 0, -s[1]]); H.quad(acc, LB[i], RB[i], RB[i + 1], LB[i + 1], [0, -1, 0]); } }
      if (t) { const s0 = segN(0), s1 = segN(n - 2); H.quad(acc, L[0], R[0], RB[0], LB[0], [-s0[1], 0, s0[0]]); H.quad(acc, L[n - 1], R[n - 1], RB[n - 1], LB[n - 1], [s1[1], 0, -s1[0]]); } };
    /* land = window minus water rings, scanline trapezoids (z strips) */

      const iv = z => { const all = []; rings.forEach(r => { const xs = []; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { const a = r[i], b = r[(i + 1) % r.length]; if ((a[1] <= z && b[1] > z) || (b[1] <= z && a[1] > z)) xs.push(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])); }
          xs.sort((p, q) => p - q); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < xs.length; i += 2) all.push([xs[i], xs[i + 1]]); });
        all.sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]); const o = []; all.forEach(w => { if (o.length && w[0] <= o[o.length - 1][1]) o[o.length - 1][1] = Math.max(o[o.length - 1][1], w[1]); else o.push([w[0], w[1]]); }); return o; };
      const comp = W => { const out = []; let cur = xmin; W.forEach(w => { const a = Math.max(w[0], xmin), b = Math.min(w[1], xmax); if (b <= xmin || a >= xmax) return; if (a > cur) out.push([cur, a]); cur = Math.max(cur, b); }); if (cur < xmax) out.push([cur, xmax]); return out; };
      const gs = [];
      for (let z = zmin; z < zmax - 1e-6; z += dz) { const z1 = Math.min(z + dz, zmax); let A = comp(iv(z + 0.02)), B = comp(iv(z1 - 0.02)); if (A.length !== B.length) { const M = comp(iv((z + z1) / 2)); A = M; B = M; }
        for (let k = 0; k < A.length; k++) { const a = A[k], b = B[k]; if (a[1] - a[0] < 0.05 && b[1] - b[0] < 0.05) continue; gs.push(H.ext([[a[0], z], [a[1], z], [b[1], z1 + 0.1], [b[0], z1 + 0.1]], yTop - yBot, yBot)); } }
      return gs; };
    H.clip = (poly, x0, x1, z0, z1) => { let out = poly;
      const edge = (inside, inter) => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length], ia = inside(a), ib = inside(b);
        if (ia) out.push(a); if (ia !== ib) out.push(inter(a, b)); } };
      edge(p => p[0] >= x0, (a, b) => [x0, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (x0 - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])]);
      edge(p => p[0] <= x1, (a, b) => [x1, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (x1 - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])]);
      edge(p => p[1] >= z0, (a, b) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z0 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]), z0]);
      edge(p => p[1] <= z1, (a, b) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z1 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]), z1]);
      return out; };
    H.ground = (D, W, Y) => { /* buildings, grass, roads from embedded OSM data D; Y = ground top height */
      const cols = ["limestone", "sand", "stone", "concrete"], bg = [[], [], [], []];
      D.b.forEach((b, i) => { bg[Math.abs(Math.floor(i * 7 + b.p[0][0])) % 4].push(H.ext(b.p, b.h, Y)); });
      bg.forEach((g, i) => H.put(g, cols[i]));

    /* ---------- bridge deck helper: OSM bridge polylines -> ribbons with ramps, parapets and piers ---------- */
    H.inW = (x, z) => D.w.some(r => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = r.length - 1; i < r.length; j = i++) { const a = r[i], b = r[j]; if ((a[1] > z) !== (b[1] > z) && x < (b[0] - a[0]) * (z - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]) + a[0]) c = !c; } return c; });
    H.resample = (p, st) => { const o = [p[0]]; for (let i = 1; i < p.length; i++) { const a = p[i - 1], b = p[i], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / st)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) o.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return o; };
    /* o: {YG ground top, YB bottom for water piers, YD deck top, slope, th girder thickness, sp pier spacing, mats} */
    H.deck = (lines, o) => {
      const lamp = [], A = { g: H.acc(), a: H.acc(), p: H.acc(), pv: H.acc() }, pc = [], pw = [], cap = [];
      const near = (pt, self) => { for (const L of lines) { if (L === self) continue; for (const q of L.p) if (Math.hypot(q[0] - pt[0], q[1] - pt[1]) < 7) return true; } return false; };
      lines.forEach(L => {
        const pts = H.resample(L.p, 5), n = pts.length, cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1]));
        const tot = cum[n - 1], base = L.y || o.YD, g0 = !L.o0 && !near(L.p[0], L), g1 = !L.o1 && !near(L.p[L.p.length - 1], L);
        const hh = i => { let h = base; if (g0) h = Math.min(h, o.YG + 0.2 + cum[i] * o.slope); if (g1) h = Math.min(h, o.YG + 0.2 + (tot - cum[i]) * o.slope); return h; };
        const w = L.w, t = o.th, tf = i => (o.thFn ? o.thFn(pts[i][0], pts[i][1], L) : o.th);
        H.ribbon(A.g, pts, w, i => hh(i), tf);
        H.ribbon(A.a, pts, w - 1.4, i => hh(i) + 0.03, 0);
        const off = (d) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; return [p[0] - dz / l * d, p[1] + dx / l * d]; });
        if (L.c !== "rail" && L.c !== "transit") [-1, 1].forEach(s => H.ribbon(A.p, off(s * (w / 2 - 0.3)), 0.55, i => hh(i) + 0.95, 0.95));
        if (o.lamp && w >= 9 && L.c !== "rail" && L.c !== "transit") { let ac = 12; for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) { ac += cum[i] - cum[i - 1]; if (ac < o.lamp) continue; ac = 0; const q = off(L.side === undefined ? (w / 2 - 0.2) : L.side)[i]; lamp.push([q[0], hh(i) + 0.9, q[1]]); } }
        // piers
        let acc = 0; for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) { acc += cum[i] - cum[i - 1]; const p = pts[i], a = pts[i - 1], b = pts[i + 1], wat = H.inW(p[0], p[1]); let put = false;
          if (wat && o.waterX) { put = o.waterX.some(X => (a[0] - X) * (p[0] - X) <= 0 && a[0] !== p[0] && (p[0] - X) !== 0 || Math.abs(p[0] - X) < 0.01) && Math.abs(L.p[0][0] - L.p[L.p.length - 1][0]) > 150; }
          else if (acc >= (L.sp || o.sp)) put = true;
          if (!put) continue; acc = 0;
          const h = hh(i); if (h - t - o.YG < 2.2 && !wat) continue; const ry = Math.atan2(-(b[1] - a[1]), b[0] - a[0]);
          const bot = wat ? o.YB : o.YG, hgt = h - tf(i) - bot; (wat ? pw : pc).push([p[0], bot, p[1], ry, wat && o.pierT ? o.pierT / 3.0 : 1, hgt, w * (o.pierW || 0.42)]);
          if (!(wat && o.noCap)) cap.push([p[0], h - tf(i) - 0.9, p[1], ry, 1, 1, w * 0.9]); }
      });
      H.flush(A.g, o.mDeck); H.flush(A.a, "road"); H.flush(A.p, o.mPar);
      if (pc.length) K.inst(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.4, 1, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0), o.mPier, pc);

    H.deck = (lines, o) => {
      const lamp = [], A = { g: H.acc(), a: H.acc(), p: H.acc(), pv: H.acc() }, pc = [], pw = [], cap = [];
      const near = (pt, self) => { for (const L of lines) { if (L === self) continue; for (const q of L.p) if (Math.hypot(q[0] - pt[0], q[1] - pt[1]) < 7) return true; } return false; };
      lines.forEach(L => {
        const pts = H.resample(L.p, 5), n = pts.length, cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1]));
        const tot = cum[n - 1], base = L.y || o.YD, g0 = !L.o0 && !near(L.p[0], L), g1 = !L.o1 && !near(L.p[L.p.length - 1], L);
        const hh = i => { let h = base; if (g0) h = Math.min(h, o.YG + 0.2 + cum[i] * o.slope); if (g1) h = Math.min(h, o.YG + 0.2 + (tot - cum[i]) * o.slope); return h; };
        const w = L.w, t = o.th, tf = i => (o.thFn ? o.thFn(pts[i][0], pts[i][1], L) : o.th);
        H.ribbon(A.g, pts, w, i => hh(i), tf);
        H.ribbon(A.a, pts, w - 1.4, i => hh(i) + 0.03, 0);
        const off = (d) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; return [p[0] - dz / l * d, p[1] + dx / l * d]; });
        if (L.c !== "rail" && L.c !== "transit") [-1, 1].forEach(s => H.ribbon(A.p, off(s * (w / 2 - 0.3)), 0.55, i => hh(i) + 0.95, 0.95));
        if (o.lamp && w >= 9 && L.c !== "rail" && L.c !== "transit") { let ac = 12; for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) { ac += cum[i] - cum[i - 1]; if (ac < o.lamp) continue; ac = 0; const q = off(L.side === undefined ? (w / 2 - 0.2) : L.side)[i]; lamp.push([q[0], hh(i) + 0.9, q[1]]); } }
        // piers
        let acc = 0; for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) { acc += cum[i] - cum[i - 1]; const p = pts[i], a = pts[i - 1], b = pts[i + 1], wat = H.inW(p[0], p[1]); let put = false;
          if (wat && o.waterX) { put = o.waterX.some(X => (a[0] - X) * (p[0] - X) <= 0 && a[0] !== p[0] && (p[0] - X) !== 0 || Math.abs(p[0] - X) < 0.01) && Math.abs(L.p[0][0] - L.p[L.p.length - 1][0]) > 150; }
          else if (acc >= (L.sp || o.sp)) put = true;
          if (!put) continue; acc = 0;
          const h = hh(i); if (h - t - o.YG < 2.2 && !wat) continue; const ry = Math.atan2(-(b[1] - a[1]), b[0] - a[0]);
          const bot = wat ? o.YB : o.YG, hgt = h - tf(i) - bot; (wat ? pw : pc).push([p[0], bot, p[1], ry, wat && o.pierT ? o.pierT / 3.0 : 1, hgt, w * (o.pierW || 0.42)]);
          if (!(wat && o.noCap)) cap.push([p[0], h - tf(i) - 0.9, p[1], ry, 1, 1, w * 0.9]); }
      });
      H.flush(A.g, o.mDeck); H.flush(A.a, "road"); H.flush(A.p, o.mPar);
      if (pc.length) K.inst(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.4, 1, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0), o.mPier, pc);
      if (pw.length) K.inst(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.0, 1, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0), o.mPierW, pw);
      if (lamp.length) { K.inst(K.cylGeo(0.1, 0.14, 6.5, 6), "steel", lamp); K.inst(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.35, 8, 6).translate(0, 6.7, 0), "white", lamp); }
      if (cap.length) K.inst(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.0, 0.9, 1).translate(0, 0.45, 0), o.mDeck, cap);
    };

      gs.forEach(g => { pa.set(g.attributes.position.array, o); na.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o); o += g.attributes.position.array.length; });
      const r = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); r.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pa, 3)); r.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(na, 3)); return r; };
    H.put = (gs, m) => gs.length ? K.mesh(H.merge(gs), m, 0, 0, 0) : null;
    H.acc = () => ({ p: [], n: [] });
    H.quad = (acc, a, b, c, d, want) => {
      const tri = (p, q, r) => { const ux = q[0] - p[0], uy = q[1] - p[1], uz = q[2] - p[2], vx = r[0] - p[0], vy = r[1] - p[1], vz = r[2] - p[2];
        let nx = uy * vz - uz * vy, ny = uz * vx - ux * vz, nz = ux * vy - uy * vx; const L = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz); if (L < 1e-9) return; nx /= L; ny /= L; nz /= L;
        if (nx * want[0] + ny * want[1] + nz * want[2] < 0) { const t = q; q = r; r = t; nx = -nx; ny = -ny; nz = -nz; }
        acc.p.push(p[0], p[1], p[2], q[0], q[1], q[2], r[0], r[1], r[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) acc.n.push(nx, ny, nz); };
      tri(a, b, c); tri(a, c, d); };
    H.flush = (acc, m) => { if (!acc.p.length) return null; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(acc.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(acc.n, 3)); return K.mesh(g, m, 0, 0, 0); };
    /* ribbon along a 2D polyline [[x,z]...]; w = width (number|fn(i)), y = top height (number|fn(i)), t = thickness (number|fn(i)|0 = top face only) */
    H.ribbon = (acc, pts, w, y, t) => {
      const n = pts.length, F = (v, i) => (typeof v === "function" ? v(i) : v), L = [], R = [], LB = [], RB = [], N = [];
      const segN = i => { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; return [-dz / l, dx / l]; };
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { let a = i > 0 ? segN(i - 1) : segN(0), b = i < n - 1 ? segN(i) : segN(n - 2); let mx = a[0] + b[0], mz = a[1] + b[1]; const ml = Math.hypot(mx, mz) || 1; mx /= ml; mz /= ml;
        const dot = Math.max(0.55, mx * b[0] + mz * b[1]), hw = F(w, i) / 2 / dot, yy = F(y, i), tt = t ? F(t, i) : 0, p = pts[i];
        L.push([p[0] + mx * hw, yy, p[1] + mz * hw]); R.push([p[0] - mx * hw, yy, p[1] - mz * hw]); LB.push([p[0] + mx * hw, yy - tt, p[1] + mz * hw]); RB.push([p[0] - mx * hw, yy - tt, p[1] - mz * hw]); }
      for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { const s = segN(i); H.quad(acc, L[i], R[i], R[i + 1], L[i + 1], [0, 1, 0]);
        if (t) { H.quad(acc, L[i], L[i + 1], LB[i + 1], LB[i], [s[0], 0, s[1]]); H.quad(acc, R[i], R[i + 1], RB[i + 1], RB[i], [-s[0], 0, -s[1]]); H.quad(acc, LB[i], RB[i], RB[i + 1], LB[i + 1], [0, -1, 0]); } }
      if (t) { const s0 = segN(0), s1 = segN(n - 2); H.quad(acc, L[0], R[0], RB[0], LB[0], [-s0[1], 0, s0[0]]); H.quad(acc, L[n - 1], R[n - 1], RB[n - 1], LB[n - 1], [s1[1], 0, -s1[0]]); } };
    /* land = window minus water rings, scanline trapezoids (z strips) */
    H.land = (rings, xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax, yTop, yBot, dz) => {
      const iv = z => { const all = []; rings.forEach(r => { const xs = []; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { const a = r[i], b = r[(i + 1) % r.length]; if ((a[1] <= z && b[1] > z) || (b[1] <= z && a[1] > z)) xs.push(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])); }
          xs.sort((p, q) => p - q); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < xs.length; i += 2) all.push([xs[i], xs[i + 1]]); });
        all.sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]); const o = []; all.forEach(w => { if (o.length && w[0] <= o[o.length - 1][1]) o[o.length - 1][1] = Math.max(o[o.length - 1][1], w[1]); else o.push([w[0], w[1]]); }); return o; };
      const comp = W => { const out = []; let cur = xmin; W.forEach(w => { const a = Math.max(w[0], xmin), b = Math.min(w[1], xmax); if (b <= xmin || a >= xmax) return; if (a > cur) out.push([cur, a]); cur = Math.max(cur, b); }); if (cur < xmax) out.push([cur, xmax]); return out; };
      const gs = [];
      for (let z = zmin; z < zmax - 1e-6; z += dz) { const z1 = Math.min(z + dz, zmax); let A = comp(iv(z + 0.02)), B = comp(iv(z1 - 0.02)); if (A.length !== B.length) { const M = comp(iv((z + z1) / 2)); A = M; B = M; }
        for (let k = 0; k < A.length; k++) { const a = A[k], b = B[k]; if (a[1] - a[0] < 0.05 && b[1] - b[0] < 0.05) continue; gs.push(H.ext([[a[0], z], [a[1], z], [b[1], z1 + 0.1], [b[0], z1 + 0.1]], yTop - yBot, yBot)); } }
      return gs; };
    H.clip = (poly, x0, x1, z0, z1) => { let out = poly;
      const edge = (inside, inter) => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length], ia = inside(a), ib = inside(b);
        if (ia) out.push(a); if (ia !== ib) out.push(inter(a, b)); } };
      edge(p => p[0] >= x0, (a, b) => [x0, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (x0 - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])]);
      edge(p => p[0] <= x1, (a, b) => [x1, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (x1 - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])]);
      edge(p => p[1] >= z0, (a, b) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z0 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]), z0]);
      edge(p => p[1] <= z1, (a, b) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z1 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]), z1]);
      return out; };
    H.ground = (D, W, Y) => { /* buildings, grass, roads from embedded OSM data D; Y = ground top height */
      const cols = ["limestone", "sand", "stone", "concrete"], bg = [[], [], [], []];
      D.b.forEach((b, i) => { bg[Math.abs(Math.floor(i * 7 + b.p[0][0])) % 4].push(H.ext(b.p, b.h, Y)); });
      bg.forEach((g, i) => H.put(g, cols[i]));
      const gr = []; D.g.forEach(p => gr.push(H.ext(p, 0.12, Y))); H.put(gr, K.mat(0x6f9a63));
      const acc = H.acc(); D.r.forEach(r => H.ribbon(acc, r.p, r.w, Y + 0.06)); H.flush(acc, K.mat(0x4d5c66, {}));
      const pv = H.acc(); (D.pv || []).forEach(r => H.ribbon(pv, r.p, r.w, Y + 0.1)); H.flush(pv, "paving"); };

    /* ---------- extra helpers: tapered boxes, lofted decks, cables ---------- */
    /* tapered box between two axis-aligned rectangles (centre x,z; size w along x, d along z) at heights y0 and y1 */
    H.tb = (acc, a, b) => { // a,b = [cx, y, cz, w, d]
      const c = (r, i) => { const sx = i & 1 ? 1 : -1, sz = i & 2 ? 1 : -1; return [r[0] + sx * r[3] / 2, r[1], r[2] + sz * r[4] / 2]; };
      const A = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => c(a, i)), B = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => c(b, i)), mid = [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, (a[2] + b[2]) / 2];
      const faces = [[0, 1, 3, 2]]; // ring order around: 0(-,-) 1(+,-) 3(+,+) 2(-,+)
      const ring = [0, 1, 3, 2];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const p = ring[i], q = ring[(i + 1) % 4]; const q4 = [A[p], A[q], B[q], B[p]]; const cx = (q4[0][0] + q4[2][0]) / 2 - mid[0], cz = (q4[0][2] + q4[2][2]) / 2 - mid[2]; H.quad(acc, q4[0], q4[1], q4[2], q4[3], [cx, 0, cz]); }
      H.quad(acc, A[0], A[1], A[3], A[2], [0, -1, 0]); H.quad(acc, B[0], B[1], B[3], B[2], [0, 1, 0]); };
    /* loft a closed profile prof=[[z,dy],..] along sections secs=[[s, y],..] (x = s). */
    H.loft = (acc, secs, prof, zo) => {
      zo = zo || 0; const PR = typeof prof === "function" ? prof : () => prof; const n = PR(secs[0]).length;
      const P = (sc, k) => { const pp = PR(sc); return [sc[0], sc[1] + pp[k][1], zo + pp[k][0]]; };
      const cen = sc => { const pp = PR(sc); let cz = 0, cy = 0; pp.forEach(p => { cz += p[0]; cy += p[1]; }); return [sc[0], sc[1] + cy / n, zo + cz / n]; };
      for (let i = 0; i < secs.length - 1; i++) { const A = secs[i], B = secs[i + 1];
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const k2 = (k + 1) % n; const a = P(A, k), b = P(A, k2), c = P(B, k2), d = P(B, k); const ce = cen([(A[0] + B[0]) / 2, (A[1] + B[1]) / 2]);
          H.quad(acc, a, b, c, d, [0, (a[1] + c[1]) / 2 - ce[1], (a[2] + c[2]) / 2 - ce[2]]); } }
      const capf = (sc, dir) => { const c0 = P(sc, 0); for (let k = 1; k < n - 1; k++) H.quad(acc, c0, P(sc, k), P(sc, k + 1), P(sc, k + 1), [dir, 0, 0]); };
      capf(secs[0], -1); capf(secs[secs.length - 1], 1); };
    H.cab = (a, b, t) => { const A = new THREE.Vector3(...a), B = new THREE.Vector3(...b), L = A.distanceTo(B); const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(t, L, t);
      g.applyMatrix4(new THREE.Matrix4().compose(A.clone().add(B).multiplyScalar(0.5), new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), B.clone().sub(A).normalize()), new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1))); return g; };
    H.box = (w, h, d, x, y, z) => new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d).translate(x, y + h / 2, z);
    /* curved loft: secs = [{x,z,h,y,d}] (h = heading angle of the tangent in the x/z plane), prof = [[u,dy],..] (u = lateral, + = right/south), off = lateral offset */
    H.loftC = (acc, secs, prof, off) => {
      off = off || 0; const PR = typeof prof === "function" ? prof : () => prof; const n = PR(secs[0]).length;
      const P = (sc, k) => { const pp = PR(sc), u = off + pp[k][0], nx = -Math.sin(sc.h), nz = Math.cos(sc.h); return [sc.x + u * nx, sc.y + pp[k][1], sc.z + u * nz]; };
      const cen = sc => { const pp = PR(sc); let cu = 0, cy = 0; pp.forEach(p => { cu += p[0]; cy += p[1]; }); cu = off + cu / n; return [sc.x - cu * Math.sin(sc.h), sc.y + cy / n, sc.z + cu * Math.cos(sc.h)]; };
      for (let i = 0; i < secs.length - 1; i++) { const A = secs[i], B = secs[i + 1], ca = cen(A), cb = cen(B), cc = [(ca[0] + cb[0]) / 2, (ca[1] + cb[1]) / 2, (ca[2] + cb[2]) / 2];
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const k2 = (k + 1) % n; const a = P(A, k), b = P(A, k2), c = P(B, k2), d = P(B, k);
          H.quad(acc, a, b, c, d, [(a[0] + c[0]) / 2 - cc[0], (a[1] + c[1]) / 2 - cc[1], (a[2] + c[2]) / 2 - cc[2]]); } }
      const capf = (sc, dir) => { const c0 = P(sc, 0); const w = [dir * Math.cos(sc.h), 0, dir * Math.sin(sc.h)]; for (let k = 1; k < n - 1; k++) H.quad(acc, c0, P(sc, k), P(sc, k + 1), P(sc, k + 1), w); };
      capf(secs[0], -1); capf(secs[secs.length - 1], 1); };
    H.rbox = (w, h, d, x, y, z, ry) => { const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d).translate(0, h / 2, 0); g.rotateY(ry || 0); g.translate(x, y, z); return g; };

    H.acc = () => ({ p: [], n: [] });
    H.quad = (acc, a, b, c, d, want) => {
      const tri = (p, q, r) => { const ux = q[0] - p[0], uy = q[1] - p[1], uz = q[2] - p[2], vx = r[0] - p[0], vy = r[1] - p[1], vz = r[2] - p[2];
        let nx = uy * vz - uz * vy, ny = uz * vx - ux * vz, nz = ux * vy - uy * vx; const L = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz); if (L < 1e-9) return; nx /= L; ny /= L; nz /= L;
        if (nx * want[0] + ny * want[1] + nz * want[2] < 0) { const t = q; q = r; r = t; nx = -nx; ny = -ny; nz = -nz; }
        acc.p.push(p[0], p[1], p[2], q[0], q[1], q[2], r[0], r[1], r[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) acc.n.push(nx, ny, nz); };

    H.ribbon = (acc, pts, w, y, t) => {
      const n = pts.length, F = (v, i) => (typeof v === "function" ? v(i) : v), L = [], R = [], LB = [], RB = [], N = [];
      const segN = i => { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; return [-dz / l, dx / l]; };

        const dot = Math.max(0.55, mx * b[0] + mz * b[1]), hw = F(w, i) / 2 / dot, yy = F(y, i), tt = t ? F(t, i) : 0, p = pts[i];
        L.push([p[0] + mx * hw, yy, p[1] + mz * hw]); R.push([p[0] - mx * hw, yy, p[1] - mz * hw]); LB.push([p[0] + mx * hw, yy - tt, p[1] + mz * hw]); RB.push([p[0] - mx * hw, yy - tt, p[1] - mz * hw]); }

        if (t) { H.quad(acc, L[i], L[i + 1], LB[i + 1], LB[i], [s[0], 0, s[1]]); H.quad(acc, R[i], R[i + 1], RB[i + 1], RB[i], [-s[0], 0, -s[1]]); H.quad(acc, LB[i], RB[i], RB[i + 1], LB[i + 1], [0, -1, 0]); } }
      if (t) { const s0 = segN(0), s1 = segN(n - 2); H.quad(acc, L[0], R[0], RB[0], LB[0], [-s0[1], 0, s0[0]]); H.quad(acc, L[n - 1], R[n - 1], RB[n - 1], LB[n - 1], [s1[1], 0, -s1[0]]); } };
    /* land = window minus water rings, scanline trapezoids (z strips) */
    H.land = (rings, xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax, yTop, yBot, dz) => {
      const iv = z => { const all = []; rings.forEach(r => { const xs = []; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { const a = r[i], b = r[(i + 1) % r.length]; if ((a[1] <= z && b[1] > z) || (b[1] <= z && a[1] > z)) xs.push(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])); }

        all.sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]); const o = []; all.forEach(w => { if (o.length && w[0] <= o[o.length - 1][1]) o[o.length - 1][1] = Math.max(o[o.length - 1][1], w[1]); else o.push([w[0], w[1]]); }); return o; };
      const comp = W => { const out = []; let cur = xmin; W.forEach(w => { const a = Math.max(w[0], xmin), b = Math.min(w[1], xmax); if (b <= xmin || a >= xmax) return; if (a > cur) out.push([cur, a]); cur = Math.max(cur, b); }); if (cur < xmax) out.push([cur, xmax]); return out; };

        for (let k = 0; k < A.length; k++) { const a = A[k], b = B[k]; if (a[1] - a[0] < 0.05 && b[1] - b[0] < 0.05) continue; gs.push(H.ext([[a[0], z], [a[1], z], [b[1], z1 + 0.1], [b[0], z1 + 0.1]], yTop - yBot, yBot)); } }
      return gs; };
    H.clip = (poly, x0, x1, z0, z1) => { let out = poly;
      const edge = (inside, inter) => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length], ia = inside(a), ib = inside(b);
        if (ia) out.push(a); if (ia !== ib) out.push(inter(a, b)); } };
      edge(p => p[0] >= x0, (a, b) => [x0, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (x0 - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])]);
      edge(p => p[0] <= x1, (a, b) => [x1, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (x1 - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])]);
      edge(p => p[1] >= z0, (a, b) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z0 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]), z0]);
      edge(p => p[1] <= z1, (a, b) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z1 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]), z1]);
      return out; };

      const W = (X, Y) => { const l = L(X, Y); return [C[0] + l[0] * cs + l[1] * sn, C[1] - l[0] * sn + l[1] * cs]; };

        box: (key, XA, YA, XB, YB, h, y) => { const a = L(XA, YA), b = L(XB, YB); const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(b[0] - a[0], h, b[1] - a[1]); g.translate((a[0] + b[0]) / 2, h / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2); push(key, place(g, y)); },

        poly: (key, pts, h, y, holes) => { push(key, place(extG(pts.map(p => L(p[0], p[1])), h, 0, (holes || []).map(q => q.map(p => L(p[0], p[1])))), y)); },

    const flat = (key, L, w, y) => { for (let i = 0; i < L.length - 1; i++) { const a = L[i], b = L[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (len < 0.5) continue;
        const ux = dx / len * w * 0.25, uz = dz / len * w * 0.25, nx = -dz / len * w / 2, nz = dx / len * w / 2, A = [a[0] - ux, a[1] - uz], Bp = [b[0] + ux, b[1] + uz];
        const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); const v = [A[0] + nx, y, A[1] + nz, Bp[0] + nx, y, Bp[1] + nz, Bp[0] - nx, y, Bp[1] - nz, A[0] + nx, y, A[1] + nz, Bp[0] - nx, y, Bp[1] - nz, A[0] - nx, y, A[1] - nz];

    flush(M);
    K.trees(trees.slice(0, 100), 6);
    if (palms.length) K.palms(palms.slice(0, 250), 9);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;
  }
});

    /* ---- merged-geometry helpers: one draw call per material bucket ---- */
    const B = {};

        box(key, len + w * 0.5, t || 0.25, w, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, -Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0])); } };

    /* rounded rectangle outline (centre cx,cz; w along x, d along z; corner radius r; rotated ry) */
    const rr = (cx, cz, w, d, r, ry, n) => { n = n || 6; const pts = []; const cs = [[1, -1, -Math.PI / 2], [1, 1, 0], [-1, 1, Math.PI / 2], [-1, -1, Math.PI]];

      if (nn.y < 0) for (let i = 0; i < idx.length; i += 3) { const t = idx[i + 1]; idx[i + 1] = idx[i + 2]; idx[i + 2] = t; }
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setIndex(idx); g.computeVertexNormals(); push(key, g); };
    const inPoly = (P, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = P.length - 1; i < P.length; j = i++) { if ((P[i][1] > z) !== (P[j][1] > z) && x < (P[j][0] - P[i][0]) * (z - P[i][1]) / (P[j][1] - P[i][1]) + P[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
    const scatter = (P, n, seed, minGap) => { let s = Math.abs(Math.floor(seed || 7)) % 2147483646 + 1; const rnd = () => (s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647; let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, z0 = 1e9, z1 = -1e9;
      P.forEach(p => { x0 = Math.min(x0, p[0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, p[0]); z0 = Math.min(z0, p[1]); z1 = Math.max(z1, p[1]); }); const out = []; let tries = 0;
      while (out.length < n && tries++ < n * 40) { const x = x0 + rnd() * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + rnd() * (z1 - z0); if (inPoly(P, x, z) && out.every(q => Math.hypot(q[0] - x, q[1] - z) > (minGap || 4))) out.push([x, z, 0.8 + rnd() * 0.5]); } return out; };
    /* closed wall ribbon round a polygon */
    const wallRing = (key, P, h, t, y) => { for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { const a = P[i], b = P[(i + 1) % P.length], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); box(key, len + t, h, t, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y || 0, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, -Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0])); } };
    /* miter offset of a footprint polygon by d metres (d > 0 outward) */
    const off = (P, d) => { const n = P.length; let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const q = P[(i + 1) % n]; a += P[i][0] * q[1] - q[0] * P[i][1]; } const s = a > 0 ? 1 : -1;
      return P.map((p, i) => { const p0 = P[(i - 1 + n) % n], p1 = P[(i + 1) % n];
        let ax = p[0] - p0[0], az = p[1] - p0[1], bx = p1[0] - p[0], bz = p1[1] - p[1]; const la = Math.hypot(ax, az) || 1, lb = Math.hypot(bx, bz) || 1; ax /= la; az /= la; bx /= lb; bz /= lb;
        const n0 = [az * s, -ax * s], n1 = [bz * s, -bx * s]; const k = Math.max(0.35, 1 + n0[0] * n1[0] + n0[1] * n1[1]);
        return [p[0] + (n0[0] + n1[0]) / k * d, p[1] + (n0[1] + n1[1]) / k * d]; }); };
    /* building from a footprint: walls + glazed ribbon bands + cornice + roof slab */
    const bld = (P, h, wall, o) => { o = o || {}; const y0 = o.y || 0, fl = o.fl || 4; ext(wall, P, h, y0);

    const rect = (x0, z0, x1, z1) => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x0, z1]];
    /* rectangle with individual corner radii [tl, tr, br, bl] (x right, z down) */
    const rrr = (x0, z0, x1, z1, R, n) => { n = n || 6; const out = []; const cs = [[x0, z0, R[0], 1, 1, Math.PI], [x1, z0, R[1], -1, 1, -Math.PI / 2], [x1, z1, R[2], -1, -1, 0], [x0, z1, R[3], 1, -1, Math.PI / 2]];

    /* points along a polyline every `step` metres, offset sideways by `o` (positive = right of travel direction in x-z plane) */
    const along = (L, step, o) => { const out = []; let carry = 0; for (let i = 0; i < L.length - 1; i++) { const a = L[i], b = L[i + 1], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), dx = (b[0] - a[0]) / len, dz = (b[1] - a[1]) / len;
        for (let d = carry; d < len; d += step) out.push([a[0] + dx * d - dz * (o || 0), a[1] + dz * d + dx * (o || 0)]); carry = ((carry - len) % step + step) % step; } return out; };

    const M = {
      sand: K.mat(0xcdbb95), plate: K.mat(0xbfae88), pave: K.mat(0xd2c8b0), asph: K.mat(0x55595c), road: K.mat(0x4c5154), mark: K.mat(0xe6e3d8), median: K.mat(0x5d7f45),

    K.group(() => {

      const V = i => new THREE.Vector3(pos[i * 3], pos[i * 3 + 1], pos[i * 3 + 2]); const nn = V(idx[1]).sub(V(idx[0])).cross(V(idx[2]).sub(V(idx[0])));

    const scatter = (P, n, seed, minGap) => { let s = Math.abs(Math.floor(seed || 7)) % 2147483646 + 1; const rnd = () => (s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647; let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, z0 = 1e9, z1 = -1e9;
      P.forEach(p => { x0 = Math.min(x0, p[0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, p[0]); z0 = Math.min(z0, p[1]); z1 = Math.max(z1, p[1]); }); const out = []; let tries = 0;
      while (out.length < n && tries++ < n * 40) { const x = x0 + rnd() * (x1 - x0), z = z0 + rnd() * (z1 - z0); if (inPoly(P, x, z) && out.every(q => Math.hypot(q[0] - x, q[1] - z) > (minGap || 4))) out.push([x, z, 0.8 + rnd() * 0.5]); } return out; };
    /* closed wall ribbon round a polygon */
    const wallRing = (key, P, h, t, y) => { for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { const a = P[i], b = P[(i + 1) % P.length], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); box(key, len + t, h, t, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y || 0, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, -Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0])); } };
    /* miter offset of a footprint polygon by d metres (d > 0 outward) */
    const off = (P, d) => { const n = P.length; let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const q = P[(i + 1) % n]; a += P[i][0] * q[1] - q[0] * P[i][1]; } const s = a > 0 ? 1 : -1;

        return [p[0] + (n0[0] + n1[0]) / k * d, p[1] + (n0[1] + n1[1]) / k * d]; }); };

      ext(o.trim || wall, off(P, 0.4), 0.6, y0 + h - 0.1); ext(o.roof || "conc", off(P, -0.8), 0.3, y0 + h + 0.4); };
    const rect = (x0, z0, x1, z1) => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x0, z1]];
    /* rectangle with individual corner radii [tl, tr, br, bl] (x right, z down) */
    const rrr = (x0, z0, x1, z1, R, n) => { n = n || 6; const out = []; const cs = [[x0, z0, R[0], 1, 1, Math.PI], [x1, z0, R[1], -1, 1, -Math.PI / 2], [x1, z1, R[2], -1, -1, 0], [x0, z1, R[3], 1, -1, Math.PI / 2]];
      cs.forEach(c => { const r = c[2] || 0.01, cx = c[0] + c[3] * r, cz = c[1] + c[4] * r; for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const a = c[5] + (Math.PI / 2) * i / n; out.push([cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cz + Math.sin(a) * r]); } }); return out; };
    /* points along a polyline every `step` metres, offset sideways by `o` (positive = right of travel direction in x-z plane) */
    const along = (L, step, o) => { const out = []; let carry = 0; for (let i = 0; i < L.length - 1; i++) { const a = L[i], b = L[i + 1], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), dx = (b[0] - a[0]) / len, dz = (b[1] - a[1]) / len;
        for (let d = carry; d < len; d += step) out.push([a[0] + dx * d - dz * (o || 0), a[1] + dz * d + dx * (o || 0)]); carry = ((carry - len) % step + step) % step; } return out; };

    const px = (x, y) => [(x - 700) / 3.182, (y - 700) / 3.182], PP = L => L.map(p => px(p[0], p[1]));

      dark: K.mat(0x40454a), white: K.mat(0xf1efe8), mark: K.mat(0xe9e7df), trim: K.mat(0xb9b2a4), pitch: K.mat(0x6aa04c), cab: K.mat(0xd9d4c6)

  build(K) {
    /* ---- local helpers: merged geometry buckets (one draw call per material) ---- */
    const B = {};

    const extG = (P, h, y) => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); P.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));

    const mats = {

    const B = {};

   OSM has NO building footprints here (only a residential landuse), so the plan is traced from Google/Esri aerial imagery (zoom 20 grid, 4.67 px/m); roads were
   checked against OSM lines (they agree within a few metres, so no registration shift was applied). The estate: 5 tall blocks along the main road (4 with rooftop tank
   clusters), ~25 lower blocks in courtyards, a small domed mosque/service building in the centre, perimeter wall and the diagonal rail/road embankment beside the Ibrahimia canal.
   The big shed roofs east of the estate (poultry/greenhouse sheds) are not part of the project; they are shown as plain low volumes because they are visible.
   Roof outlines were shifted ≈ 3 m south for building lean (estimated). Completed project: no frame/cranes.
   IMPROVEMENT PASS: (1) overlay of the model on Google z19 imagery: all 32 blocks sit on their roofs within ≈ 1–2 m. (2) Heights re-derived from imagery: the south facades of the 5 tall blocks show ≈ 4–5 balcony/window bands (≈ 15.5 m, kept); shadow widths (8.7–10 m for the tall blocks, 4.6–5.1 m for the others, a clean 2 : 1) and the visible south-facade strips (≈ 5.3 m vs ≈ 2.9 m at the same camera angle) give the lower blocks ≈ 0.5–0.6 of the tall ones, so they were lowered from 12.5 m to ≈ 9.8 m (3 floors). Check against the published 1,018 units: tall blocks 7,300 m² × 5 floors + 32 lower blocks 16,800 m² × 3 floors ≈ 87,000 m² gross (≈ 75 m² gross per flat after wells/overhang) ≈ 1,000–1,150 flats — consistent with 1,018 (with 12.5 m / 4 floors the sum would be ≈ 20 % too high). (3) The small domed building in the centre is a mosque (flat roof, shallow dome on a square base, skylights, no minaret) — z20 imagery. (4) Wayback: construction frames 2014-02, whole estate standing and plastered in 2017–2019 tiles. (5) The long east sheds exist in the 2017 tile (greenhouse/poultry type) and are not housing: shown as plain volumes.
*/

        box(key, len + w * 0.5, t || 0.2, w, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y || 0, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, -Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0])); } };
    const rect = (x0, z0, x1, z1) => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x0, z1]];

        P.forEach(p => { const a = (p[0] - c[0]) * u[0] + (p[1] - c[1]) * u[1], b = (p[0] - c[0]) * v[0] + (p[1] - c[1]) * v[1]; mn = Math.min(mn, a); mx = Math.max(mx, a); wn = Math.min(wn, b); wx = Math.max(wx, b); });
        const Ld = mx - mn, Wd = wx - wn, m = [c[0] + u[0] * (mx + mn) / 2 + v[0] * (wx + wn) / 2, c[1] + u[1] * (mx + mn) / 2 + v[1] * (wx + wn) / 2];
        return { u, v, Ld, Wd, m, ba };
      };
      /* module = one stair-core entrance bay (~22 m on imagery: the 67 m slab shows 3 roof clusters, the 64 m investment slabs 2). Roof layout per module is the "I" seen
         on the 2025 near-nadir Esri frame: a block of cylindrical water tanks (2 columns) flanked by 4 sunken light-well pits staggered on both sides. */
      const bays = (P, key) => {
        /* stair-core strips: a lighter recessed-looking strip with small windows and dark joints at the centre of every ~22 m bay of every facade (seen on the south end faces) */
        const c = cen(P), n = P.length;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = P[i], b = P[(i + 1) % n], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (len < 14) continue;
          const ux = (b[0] - a[0]) / len, uz = (b[1] - a[1]) / len; let nx = uz, nz = -ux; const mx = (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, mz = (a[1] + b[1]) / 2; if ((mx - c[0]) * nx + (mz - c[1]) * nz < 0) { nx = -nx; nz = -nz; }
          const m = Math.max(1, Math.round(len / 22)), ang = -Math.atan2(uz, ux);
          for (let k = 0; k < m; k++) { const f = (k + 0.5) / m * len, px = a[0] + ux * f + nx * 0.36, pz = a[1] + uz * f + nz * 0.36;
            box(key, 4.6, H - 3.2, 0.12, px, 2.2, pz, ang);
            [-2.45, 2.45].forEach(o => box("lw", 0.35, H - 3.2, 0.2, px + ux * o, 2.2, pz + uz * o, ang));
            for (let y = 3.4; y < H - 2; y += FLOOR) for (let w = -1; w <= 1; w += 2) box("lw", 1.05, 1.0, 0.1, px + ux * w * 1.15 + nx * 0.07, y, pz + uz * w * 1.15 + nz * 0.07, ang); } }
      };
      const own = (P, muted) => {
        const wk = muted ? "ctx" : "wall";
        ext(wk, P, H, 0.1); const Q = off(P, 0.15); for (let y = 2.6; y < H - 1; y += FLOOR) ext("band", Q, 1.15, y);
        ext(muted ? "ctx2" : "trim", off(P, 0.3), 0.55, H - 0.4); ext("roof", off(P, -0.5), 0.3, H + 0.15);
        if (!muted) bays(P, "trim");
        const t = tower(P, H);
        /* modules along the long axis; local frame for each module: s = along u, w = across v (module long axis = across/along whichever is longer) */
        const nm = muted ? 2 : Math.max(1, Math.round(t.Ld / (t.Wd > 20 && t.Ld < 40 ? 40 : 22))), ml = t.Ld / nm;
        for (let k = 0; k < nm; k++) { const cu = (k - (nm - 1) / 2) * ml;
          const modLong = Math.max(ml, t.Wd), modShort = Math.min(ml, t.Wd), alongU = ml >= t.Wd;
          /* build a local mapper: (a = along module long axis, b = across) -> world */
          const mp = (a, b) => alongU ? [t.m[0] + t.u[0] * (cu + a) + t.v[0] * b, t.m[1] + t.u[1] * (cu + a) + t.v[1] * b] : [t.m[0] + t.u[0] * (cu + b) + t.v[0] * a, t.m[1] + t.u[1] * (cu + b) + t.v[1] * a];
          const rot = alongU ? -t.ba : -t.ba - Math.PI / 2;
          const small = modLong < 20;
          if (small) { for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) { const p = mp((i - 0.5) * 2.4, (j - 0.5) * 2.4); cyl(muted ? "ctx2" : "tank", 0.9, 0.9, 1.5, p[0], H + 0.45, p[1], 10); } continue; }
          const big = modLong >= 26, rows = big ? 5 : 4, sp = big ? 2.55 : 2.3;
          for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) { const p = mp((i - (rows - 1) / 2) * sp, (j - 0.5) * 2.4); cyl(muted ? "ctx2" : "tank", 0.9, 0.9, 1.5, p[0], H + 0.45, p[1], 10); }
          const pits = big ? [[-8.6, -1.3, 5.4, 3.4], [-9.6, 2.6, 5.4, 3.2], [7.4, -2.4, 4.6, 3.2], [5.0, 6.0, 3.6, 4.4]] : [[-5.6, -0.6, 4.6, 3.0], [-6.3, 3.3, 4.6, 2.8], [5.2, -1.6, 4.0, 2.8], [3.6, 4.8, 3.2, 3.6]];
          pits.forEach(q => { const p = mp(q[0], q[1]); box(muted ? "ctx2" : "lw", q[2], 0.12, q[3], p[0], H + 0.45, p[1], rot); });
        }
      };
      const ctx = (P) => own(P, true);
      OWN.forEach(P => own(P, false)); OTH.forEach(ctx);
      /* mosque of the Awqaf housing (roof square traced from imagery; dome ≈ 11 m) */
      ext("moq", MOSQ, 9, 0.1); ext("trim", off(MOSQ, 0.25), 0.5, 8.8); { cyl("moq", 4.9, 4.9, 1.2, 128, 9.0, -35.4, 24); sph("dome", 4.5, 128, 10.2, -35.4, 1.05); }
      flush(mats);
      /* minaret at the north corner of the prayer hall (visible on Google/Esri imagery; base ≈ (133, -44), height ≈ 26 m — estimated) */
      K.minaret(133, -44, 26, 1.3, K.mat(0xd9ceb0));
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;
  }
});

      const rs = resample(w.pts, STEP), P = rs.p, n = P.length, L = rs.L; const e0 = cl[w.n0].e, e1 = cl[w.n1].e;
      const rail = w.c === "rail", transit = w.c === "transit"; const soilRoad = UNF && isCons(w);
      let y = new Array(n).fill(0);
      if (street || rail || (soilRoad && w.b <= 0)) y = y.fill(0);
      else if (w.b > 0) y = y.map(() => HB[w.b] || HB[1]);
      else if (w.b < 0) { y = y.map((_, i) => { const s = rs.s[i], m = Math.min(s, L - s); return -Math.min(CFG.tunnelDepth || 6, m * 0.08); }); }
      else { const hi = e0 >= e1, E0 = hi ? e0 : e1, E1 = hi ? e1 : e0; const gr = Math.max(GRADE, Math.abs(E0 - E1) / Math.max(L, 1));
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const s = hi ? rs.s[i] : L - rs.s[i]; y[i] = E0 - Math.min(E0 - E1, gr * s); } }
      for (let it = 0; it < 3; it++) { const z = y.slice(); for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) z[i] = (y[i - 1] + 2 * y[i] + y[i + 1]) / 4; y = z; }
      const base = (prio[w.c] || 0.05) + (w.r ? 0.02 : 0) + (wi % 7) * 0.003;
      const hw = w.w / 2, thick = CFG.thick || 1.7;
      const Lp = [], Rp = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = P[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = P[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
        Lp.push([P[i][0] - dz * hw, P[i][1] + dx * hw, dx, dz]); Rp.push([P[i][0] + dz * hw, P[i][1] - dx * hw, dx, dz]); }
      const mk = rail ? "ballast" : transit ? "conc" : soilRoad ? "soil" : street ? "street" : (w.r ? "ramp" : "road");
      const up = [0, 1, 0];
      const V = (q, yy) => [q[0], yy, q[1]];
      if (CFG.median && w.c === "motorway") {
        const partner = roadWays.find((o, oi) => oi > wi && o.c === "motorway" && o.b === w.b && o.pts.some(p => Math.hypot(p[0] - w.pts[0][0], p[1] - w.pts[0][1]) < 40 || true) && (() => { const mid = w.pts[Math.floor(w.pts.length / 2)]; return o.pts.some((p, k) => k && (() => { const a = o.pts[k - 1]; const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((mid[0] - a[0]) * (p[0] - a[0]) + (mid[1] - a[1]) * (p[1] - a[1])) / (((p[0] - a[0]) ** 2 + (p[1] - a[1]) ** 2) || 1))); return Math.hypot(mid[0] - a[0] - t * (p[0] - a[0]), mid[1] - a[1] - t * (p[1] - a[1])) < 30; })()); })());
        if (partner) { const nearest = (pt) => { let best = null, bd = 1e9; for (let k = 1; k < partner.pts.length; k++) { const a = partner.pts[k - 1], b = partner.pts[k]; const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((pt[0] - a[0]) * (b[0] - a[0]) + (pt[1] - a[1]) * (b[1] - a[1])) / (((b[0] - a[0]) ** 2 + (b[1] - a[1]) ** 2) || 1))); const q = [a[0] + t * (b[0] - a[0]), a[1] + t * (b[1] - a[1])]; const d = Math.hypot(pt[0] - q[0], pt[1] - q[1]); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = q; } } return [best, bd]; };
          const inn = P.map(pt => { const [q, d] = nearest(pt); if (d > 30 || d < (w.w + partner.w) / 2 + 0.3) return null; const ux = (q[0] - pt[0]) / d, uz = (q[1] - pt[1]) / d; return [[pt[0] + ux * w.w / 2, pt[1] + uz * w.w / 2], [q[0] - ux * partner.w / 2, q[1] - uz * partner.w / 2]]; });
          for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { if (!inn[i] || !inn[i + 1]) continue; const yy0 = y[i] + base - 0.04, yy1 = y[i + 1] + base - 0.04; quad("median", [inn[i][0][0], yy0, inn[i][0][1]], [inn[i][1][0], yy0, inn[i][1][1]], [inn[i + 1][1][0], yy1, inn[i + 1][1][1]], [inn[i + 1][0][0], yy1, inn[i + 1][0][1]], [0, 1, 0]); } } }
      for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        const t0 = y[i] + base, t1 = y[i + 1] + base; const elev = (y[i] + y[i + 1]) / 2;
        quad(mk, V(Lp[i], t0), V(Rp[i], t0), V(Rp[i + 1], t1), V(Lp[i + 1], t1), up);
        if (elev > 0.6) {
          const bot0 = w.b > 0 ? y[i] - thick : 0, bot1 = w.b > 0 ? y[i + 1] - thick : 0;
          [[Lp, 1], [Rp, -1]].forEach(([E, sg]) => {
            const ox = i2 => -E[i2][3] * sg, oz = i2 => E[i2][2] * sg;      // outward unit normal at sample i2
            const outH = [ox(i), 0, oz(i)], inH = [-ox(i), 0, -oz(i)];
            const a0 = V(E[i], bot0 + base), a1 = V(E[i + 1], bot1 + base), b0 = V(E[i], y[i] + base + 1.05), b1 = V(E[i + 1], y[i + 1] + base + 1.05);
            if (CFG.slope && !(w.b > 0)) { const sl = CFG.slope; const f0 = V([E[i][0] + ox(i) * y[i] * sl, E[i][1] + oz(i) * y[i] * sl], 0.0), f1 = V([E[i + 1][0] + ox(i + 1) * y[i + 1] * sl, E[i + 1][1] + oz(i + 1) * y[i + 1] * sl], 0.0); quad("embank", V(E[i], y[i] + base), V(E[i + 1], y[i + 1] + base), f1, f0, [outH[0], 1, outH[2]]); return; }
            quad("conc", a0, a1, b1, b0, outH);
            const inn = (i2) => [E[i2][0] - ox(i2) * 0.45, E[i2][1] - oz(i2) * 0.45];
            const c0 = V(inn(i), y[i] + base + 1.05), c1 = V(inn(i + 1), y[i + 1] + base + 1.05), d0 = V(inn(i), y[i] + base), d1 = V(inn(i + 1), y[i + 1] + base);
            quad("conc", b0, b1, c1, c0, up);
          });
        }
        if (rail) { const sx = P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0], sz = P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1], sl = Math.hypot(sx, sz) || 1, ux = sx / sl, uz = sz / sl;
          [-0.72, 0.72].forEach(off => { const nx = -uz, nz = ux; const q0 = [P[i][0] + nx * off, P[i][1] + nz * off], q1 = [P[i + 1][0] + nx * off, P[i + 1][1] + nz * off]; const hx = nx * 0.1, hz = nz * 0.1;
            quad("railm", [q0[0] - hx, 0.22, q0[1] - hz], [q0[0] + hx, 0.22, q0[1] + hz], [q1[0] + hx, 0.22, q1[1] + hz], [q1[0] - hx, 0.22, q1[1] - hz], up); }); }
        /* lane markings */
        if (w.o && w.w >= 5.5 && !(elev < -0.5)) {
          const ln = Math.max(1, Math.round((w.w - 1.2) / (CFG.laneW || 3.5))); const lw = (w.w - 1.0) / ln; const yy0 = y[i] + base + 0.1, yy1 = y[i + 1] + base + 0.1;
          for (let k = 1; k < ln; k++) { if ((i % 3) >= 1) break; const off = -w.w / 2 + 0.5 + lw * k; const f = o => { const A = P[i], B = P[i + 1]; const q0 = Lp[i], q1 = Lp[i + 1]; const dx = Rp[i][0] - Lp[i][0], dz = Rp[i][1] - Lp[i][1]; const u = (off + w.w / 2) / w.w; return [[q0[0] + dx * u, q0[1] + dz * u], [q1[0] + (Rp[i + 1][0] - Lp[i + 1][0]) * u, q1[1] + (Rp[i + 1][1] - Lp[i + 1][1]) * u]]; };
            const c = f(); const nx = -(c[1][1] - c[0][1]), nz = (c[1][0] - c[0][0]); const nl = Math.hypot(nx, nz) || 1; const hx = nx / nl * 0.09, hz = nz / nl * 0.09;
            quad("mark", [c[0][0] - hx, yy0, c[0][1] - hz], [c[0][0] + hx, yy0, c[0][1] + hz], [c[1][0] + hx, yy1, c[1][1] + hz], [c[1][0] - hx, yy1, c[1][1] - hz], up); }
          [0.45, w.w - 0.45].forEach((u0, ei) => { const u = u0 / w.w; const c0 = [Lp[i][0] + (Rp[i][0] - Lp[i][0]) * u, Lp[i][1] + (Rp[i][1] - Lp[i][1]) * u], c1 = [Lp[i + 1][0] + (Rp[i + 1][0] - Lp[i + 1][0]) * u, Lp[i + 1][1] + (Rp[i + 1][1] - Lp[i + 1][1]) * u];
            const nx = -(c1[1] - c0[1]), nz = (c1[0] - c0[0]); const nl = Math.hypot(nx, nz) || 1; const hx = nx / nl * 0.1, hz = nz / nl * 0.1;
            quad(ei ? "mark" : "markY", [c0[0] - hx, yy0, c0[1] - hz], [c0[0] + hx, yy0, c0[1] + hz], [c1[0] + hx, yy1, c1[1] + hz], [c1[0] - hx, yy1, c1[1] - hz], up); });
        }
      }
      /* piers under bridge decks */
      if (w.b > 0 && !street && !rail) { const sp = CFG.pierSpan || 32; const nP = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / sp));
        for (let k = 0; k <= nP; k++) { const s = L * k / nP; let i = 0; while (i < n - 2 && rs.s[i + 1] < s) i++; const f = (s - rs.s[i]) / Math.max(rs.s[i + 1] - rs.s[i], 0.01); const px = P[i][0] + (P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0]) * f, pz = P[i][1] + (P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1]) * f; const yy = y[i] + (y[i + 1] - y[i]) * f - thick; if (yy < 2.5) continue;
          const dx = P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0], dz = P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1]; const ry = -Math.atan2(dz, dx);
          if (w.w >= 15) { const tx = dx / (Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1), tz = dz / (Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1); [-1, 1].forEach(sg => { const o = sg * w.w * 0.25; piers.push([px - tz * o, 0, pz + tx * o, ry, 1, yy, 1]); }); caps.push([px, yy - 1.2, pz, ry, w.w * 0.82, 1, 1]); }
          else { piers.push([px, 0, pz, ry, 1, yy, 1]); caps.push([px, yy - 1.2, pz, ry, w.w * 0.7, 1, 1]); } } }
    });
    /* unfinished viaduct ways: bare piers + pier caps only (no deck) */
    pierWays.forEach(w => { const rs = resample(w.pts, 6), P = rs.p, n = P.length, L = rs.L; const yy = (HB[w.b > 0 ? w.b : 1] || 7.5) - (CFG.thick || 1.7); const nP = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / (CFG.pierSpan || 30)));
      for (let k = 0; k <= nP; k++) { const s0 = L * k / nP; let i = 0; while (i < n - 2 && rs.s[i + 1] < s0) i++; const f = (s0 - rs.s[i]) / Math.max(rs.s[i + 1] - rs.s[i], 0.01); const px = P[i][0] + (P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0]) * f, pz = P[i][1] + (P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1]) * f; const ry = -Math.atan2(P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1], P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0]);
        piers.push([px, 0, pz, ry, 1, yy, 1]); caps.push([px, yy - 1.2, pz, ry, w.w * 0.7, 1, 1]); } });
    /* ground plate */
    const hw0 = D.hw, hd0 = D.hd;
    K.mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(hw0 * 2, 1.6, hd0 * 2).translate(0, -0.8, 0), M.ground, 0, 0, 0);
    /* water (mapped polygons / canal lines) */
    const cx = v => Math.max(-hw0 + 1, Math.min(hw0 - 1, v)), cz = v => Math.max(-hd0 + 1, Math.min(hd0 - 1, v));
    D.water.forEach(wt => { if (wt.pts) { const s = new THREE.Shape(); wt.pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(cx(p[0]), -cz(p[1])) : s.moveTo(cx(p[0]), -cz(p[1])))); const g = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, CFG.waterY || 0.06, 0); K.mesh(g, M.water, 0, 0, 0); } });
    D.water.forEach(wt => { if (!wt.line || wt.t) return; const rs = resample(wt.line, 12), P = rs.p, n = P.length, hw = (wt.w || 10) / 2, Q = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = P[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = P[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l; Q.push([[P[i][0] - dz * hw, P[i][1] + dx * hw], [P[i][0] + dz * hw, P[i][1] - dx * hw]]); }
      for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { const y0 = CFG.waterY || 0.06; quad("water", [Q[i][0][0], y0, Q[i][0][1]], [Q[i][1][0], y0, Q[i][1][1]], [Q[i + 1][1][0], y0, Q[i + 1][1][1]], [Q[i + 1][0][0], y0, Q[i + 1][0][1]], [0, 1, 0]); } });
    /* Imbaba fabric west of the axis (no buildings mapped in OSM there): 16 m colour-class map of the Google z18 roofs (flat tone only — NOT individual buildings) */
