      for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) r.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return r; };
    const smooth = (L, it) => { let P = L; for (let k = 0; k < it; k++) { const Q = [P[0]]; for (let i = 1; i < P.length - 1; i++) Q.push([(P[i - 1][0] + 2 * P[i][0] + P[i + 1][0]) / 4, (P[i - 1][1] + 2 * P[i][1] + P[i + 1][1]) / 4]); Q.push(P[P.length - 1]); P = Q; } return P; };
    const frames = (P) => P.map((p, i) => { const a = P[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = P[Math.min(P.length - 1, i + 1)]; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], h = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; return [-dz / h, dx / h]; });
    /* ribbon band along a path between lateral offsets ua..ub with heights ya(h)..yb(h); hF(i,p) = formation height at sample i */
    const band = (key, P, hF, ua, ya, ub, yb) => { const N = frames(P), pos = []; const U = (u, h) => (typeof u === "function" ? u(h) : u), Y = (y, h) => (typeof y === "function" ? y(h) : y);
      const pt = (i, u, y) => { const h = hF(i, P[i]); return [Math.max(WX0, Math.min(WX1, P[i][0] + N[i][0] * U(u, h))), Y(y, h), Math.max(Z0, Math.min(Z1, P[i][1] + N[i][1] * U(u, h)))]; };
      for (let i = 0; i < P.length - 1; i++) { const a = pt(i, ua, ya), b = pt(i, ub, yb), c = pt(i + 1, ub, yb), d = pt(i + 1, ua, ya);
        [[a, b, c], [a, c, d]].forEach(t => { const v1 = new THREE.Vector3(t[1][0] - t[0][0], t[1][1] - t[0][1], t[1][2] - t[0][2]), v2 = new THREE.Vector3(t[2][0] - t[0][0], t[2][1] - t[0][1], t[2][2] - t[0][2]);
          const n = v1.clone().cross(v2); if (n.lengthSq() < 1e-9) return; if (n.y < 0) t = [t[0], t[2], t[1]]; t.forEach(q => pos.push(q[0], q[1], q[2])); }); }
      if (!pos.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(pos), 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); push(key, g); };
    const offPath = (P, u) => { const N = frames(P); return P.map((p, i) => [p[0] + N[i][0] * u, p[1] + N[i][1] * u]); };
    /* embankment cross-section: apron / concrete slope / shoulder / ballast */
    const embank = (P, hF, w) => { const H = (h) => h, rr = w.slope;
      band("sand", P, hF, -w.apron, 0.05, h => -(w.shoulder + rr * h), 0.05); band("sand", P, hF, h => (w.shoulder + rr * h), 0.05, w.apron, 0.05);
      band("conc", P, hF, h => -(w.shoulder + rr * h), 0.06, -w.shoulder, h => h); band("conc", P, hF, w.shoulder, h => h, h => (w.shoulder + rr * h), 0.06);
      band("sand2", P, hF, -w.shoulder, h => h, -w.bed, h => h); band("sand2", P, hF, w.bed, h => h, w.shoulder, h => h);
      band("ballast", P, hF, -w.bed - 0.7, h => h, -w.bed + 0.6, h => h + 0.45); band("ballast", P, hF, -w.bed + 0.6, h => h + 0.45, w.bed - 0.6, h => h + 0.45); band("ballast", P, hF, w.bed - 0.6, h => h + 0.45, w.bed + 0.7, h => h); };
    const track = (P, hF, u) => { const Q = u ? offPath(P, u) : P;
      band("sleeper", Q, hF, -1.35, h => h + 0.47, 1.35, h => h + 0.47);
      [-0.7175, 0.7175].forEach(o => { const R = offPath(Q, o); band("rail", R, hF, -0.07, h => h + 0.62, 0.07, h => h + 0.62); band("rail", R, hF, -0.07, h => h + 0.62, -0.07, h => h + 0.47); band("rail", R, hF, 0.07, h => h + 0.47, 0.07, h => h + 0.62); }); };

    const mats = { sand: K.mat(0xbfae8b), sand2: K.mat(0xb59f79), conc: K.mat(0xc6bda6), ballast: K.mat(0x6d685f), sleeper: K.mat(0x4b4842), rail: K.mat(0x9a9c9c, { metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.4 }),
      road: K.mat(0x4a4d50), pale: K.mat(0x9b9a92), dirt: K.mat(0xb7a47f), water: K.mat(0x2a5560, { roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.05 }), steel: K.mat(0x8fa0aa, { metalness: 0.55, roughness: 0.45 }), steel2: K.mat(0x6f7f89, { metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.5 }),
      pier: K.mat(0xb9b6ab), deck: K.mat(0x55585a), blk: K.mat(0xd9ceb4), blk2: K.mat(0xc7b99b), blk3: K.mat(0xe3dac4), oldbal: K.mat(0x7d756a) };
    K.pad([[WX0, Z0], [WX1, Z0], [WX1, Z1], [WX0, Z1]], K.mat(0x6b6247), -0.4, 1.6);
    K.group(() => {
      /* ---------- land-cover map (10 m cells coloured by imagery class, merged into rectangles) ---------- */
      { const pos = [], col = [], lin = D.pal.map(c => c.map(v => Math.pow(v / 255, 2.2) * 1.0)); const cs = 8 * S;
        D.rects.forEach(r => { const x0 = WX0 + r[0] * cs, z0 = Z0 + r[1] * cs, x1 = x0 + r[2] * cs, z1 = z0 + r[3] * cs, c = lin[r[4]], y = 0.03;
          [[x0, z0], [x1, z1], [x1, z0], [x0, z0], [x0, z1], [x1, z1]].forEach(p => { pos.push(p[0], y, p[1]); col.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }); });
        const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(pos), 3)); g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(col), 3));
        const nrm = new Float32Array(pos.length); for (let i = 1; i < nrm.length; i += 3) nrm[i] = 1; g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
        K.mesh(g, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.95, metalness: 0 })); }
      /* ---------- canal (Rayah Nasery): traced outline ---------- */
      D.water.forEach(w => ext("water", w.map(p => [Math.max(WX0, Math.min(WX1, p[0])), Math.max(Z0, Math.min(Z1, p[1]))]), 0.05, 0.06));
      /* ---------- roads and field tracks (OSM) ---------- */
      const flat = () => 0;
      const cutNear = (L, lines, dmin) => { const P = res(L, 5), out = []; let cur = [];
        const near = p => lines.some(Q => { for (let i = 0; i < Q.length - 1; i++) { const a = Q[i], b = Q[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p[0] - a[0]) * dx + (p[1] - a[1]) * dz) / (dx * dx + dz * dz))); if (Math.hypot(p[0] - a[0] - t * dx, p[1] - a[1] - t * dz) < dmin) return true; } return false; });
        P.forEach(p => { if (near(p)) { if (cur.length > 1) out.push(cur); cur = []; } else cur.push(p); }); if (cur.length > 1) out.push(cur); return out; };
      const FORM = [D.trunk.filter(p => p[0] > -690).concat([]), D.north, D.south], OLD = [D.main];
      D.roads.forEach(r => { const w = r.c === "R" ? 6.4 : r.c === "P" ? 4.6 : 2.8, key = r.c === "R" ? "road" : r.c === "P" ? "pale" : "dirt", y = r.c === "R" ? 0.11 : r.c === "P" ? 0.095 : 0.08;
        const pieces = cutNear(r.p, FORM.concat(OLD), 27).flatMap(pc => (pc[0][0] < -690 ? [pc] : [pc]));
        pieces.forEach(pc => { const P = clipPath(smooth(pc, 1)); if (P.length > 1) band(key, P, flat, -w / 2, y, w / 2, y); }); });
      /* ---------- existing Cairo–Alexandria line (single track, low embankment) ---------- */
      { const P = clipPath(res(D.main, 12)); const hM = () => 0.9; embank(P, hM, { apron: 8, shoulder: 2.9, slope: 2, bed: 2.45 }); track(P, hM, 0); }
      /* ---------- new formation: trunk (2 tracks) + north / south arms (1 track each) ---------- */
      const tr = D.trunk, brA = [-860.8, 136.0], brB = [-710.8, 83.9];
      const hT = (i, p) => { const x = p[0]; if (x < -711) return 5.4 - Math.max(0, (-711 - x) / 190) * 0.6; return Math.max(2.6, 5.4 - (x + 711) * (2.8 / 260)); };
      const west = clipPath(res([tr[0], brA], 10)), east = res(smooth([brB, tr[3], tr[4], tr[5], tr[6], tr[7], tr[8], tr[9], tr[10], tr[11]], 2), 12);
      const W = { apron: 24, shoulder: 8.5, slope: 3.3, bed: 7.0 };
      [[west, hT], [east, hT]].forEach(([P, hf]) => { embank(P, hf, W); track(P, hf, -2.25); track(P, hf, 2.25); });
      const arm = (L, dy) => { const P = clipPath(res(smooth(L, 3), 12)); const hf = () => 2.6 + dy; const Wa = { apron: 21, shoulder: 7.4, slope: 3.3, bed: 5.6 }; embank(P, hf, Wa); track(P, hf, 0); };
      arm(D.north, 0.08); arm(D.south, 0.16);
      /* ---------- steel truss bridge over the canal ---------- */
      { const dx = brB[0] - brA[0], dz = brB[1] - brA[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz), ux = dx / L, uz = dz / L, cx = -uz, cz = ux, hb = 5.4, ang = -Math.atan2(dz, dx);
        const at = (s, c, y) => [brA[0] + ux * s + cx * c, y, brA[1] + uz * s + cz * c];
        const TS = [[53.6, 94.6], [113.4, 145.0]];   // through-truss spans measured on Google z20 (41 m over the canal, 32 m over the canal-bank road); plain girder deck elsewhere
        // deck girder + ballast bed
        { const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(L, 1.1, 9.8); g.rotateY(ang); g.translate((brA[0] + brB[0]) / 2, hb - 1.1 + 0.55, (brA[1] + brB[1]) / 2); push("deck", g); }
        { const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(L, 0.45, 8.0); g.rotateY(ang); g.translate((brA[0] + brB[0]) / 2, hb + 0.225, (brA[1] + brB[1]) / 2); push("ballast", g); }
        const bP = [brA, brB], hb2 = () => hb; track(bP, hb2, -2.25); track(bP, hb2, 2.25);
        // trusses: Warren panels in each span, both sides
        for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) { const s0 = TS[k][0], s1 = TS[k][1], n = Math.round((s1 - s0) / 2.1), ds = (s1 - s0) / n, yb = hb + 0.3, yt = hb + 7.4;
          [-5.15, 5.15].forEach(c => { bar("steel", at(s0, c, yb), at(s1, c, yb), 0.7, 0.55); bar("steel", at(s0, c, yt), at(s1, c, yt), 0.7, 0.55);
            for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const s = s0 + ds * i; bar("steel2", at(s, c, yb), at(s, c, yt), 0.34, 0.34); if (i < n) { const up = i % 2 === 0; bar("steel2", at(s, c, up ? yb : yt), at(s + ds, c, up ? yt : yb), 0.3, 0.3); } } });
          for (let i = 0; i <= n; i += 2) { const s = s0 + ds * i; bar("steel2", at(s, -5.15, yt), at(s, 5.15, yt), 0.3, 0.3); } }
        // piers in the canal and abutments
        [TS[0][0], TS[0][1]].forEach(s => { const p = at(s, 0, -1.2); const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.6, hb - 1.1 + 1.2, 8.6); g.rotateY(ang); g.translate(p[0], -1.2 + (hb - 1.1 + 1.2) / 2, p[2]); push("pier", g); });
        [0.8, TS[1][0], TS[1][1], L - 0.8].forEach(s => { const p = at(s, 0, 0); const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.2, hb - 0.2, 10.4); g.rotateY(ang); g.translate(p[0], (hb - 0.2) / 2, p[2]); push("pier", g); }); }
      /* ---------- village houses (10 m cells traced from roof-coloured pixels, heights estimated) ---------- */
      { let s = 7; const rnd = () => (s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647;
        D.bld.forEach(p => { if (p[0] < WX0 + 6 || p[0] > WX1 - 6 || p[1] < Z0 + 6 || p[1] > Z1 - 6) return; const h = 5.5 + Math.floor(rnd() * 4) * 1.6, w = 8 + rnd() * 2.5, d = 8 + rnd() * 2.5, k = rnd();
          box(k < 0.45 ? "blk" : k < 0.8 ? "blk2" : "blk3", w, h, d, p[0], 0.03, p[1]); }); }
      flush(mats);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;
  }
});

    const bar = (key, a, b, t, t2) => { const d = new THREE.Vector3(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]), L = d.length(); const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(L, t, t2 || t);

    /* ribbon band along a path between lateral offsets ua..ub with heights ya(h)..yb(h); hF(i,p) = formation height at sample i */
    const band = (key, P, hF, ua, ya, ub, yb) => { const N = frames(P), pos = []; const U = (u, h) => (typeof u === "function" ? u(h) : u), Y = (y, h) => (typeof y === "function" ? y(h) : y);

      if (!pos.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(pos), 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); push(key, g); };
    const offPath = (P, u) => { const N = frames(P); return P.map((p, i) => [p[0] + N[i][0] * u, p[1] + N[i][1] * u]); };

      band("conc", P, hF, h => -(w.shoulder + rr * h), 0.06, -w.shoulder, h => h); band("conc", P, hF, w.shoulder, h => h, h => (w.shoulder + rr * h), 0.06);

    const mats = { sand: K.mat(0xcdbd9c), sand2: K.mat(0xc2ae88), ballast: K.mat(0x6d685f), sleeper: K.mat(0x4b4842), rail: K.mat(0x9a9c9c, { metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.4 }),

            const c = f(); const nx = -(c[1][1] - c[0][1]), nz = (c[1][0] - c[0][0]); const nl = Math.hypot(nx, nz) || 1; const hx = nx / nl * 0.09, hz = nz / nl * 0.09;
            quad("mark", [c[0][0] - hx, yy0, c[0][1] - hz], [c[0][0] + hx, yy0, c[0][1] + hz], [c[1][0] + hx, yy1, c[1][1] + hz], [c[1][0] - hx, yy1, c[1][1] - hz], up); }
          [0.45, w.w - 0.45].forEach((u0, ei) => { const u = u0 / w.w; const c0 = [Lp[i][0] + (Rp[i][0] - Lp[i][0]) * u, Lp[i][1] + (Rp[i][1] - Lp[i][1]) * u], c1 = [Lp[i + 1][0] + (Rp[i + 1][0] - Lp[i + 1][0]) * u, Lp[i + 1][1] + (Rp[i + 1][1] - Lp[i + 1][1]) * u];
            const nx = -(c1[1] - c0[1]), nz = (c1[0] - c0[0]); const nl = Math.hypot(nx, nz) || 1; const hx = nx / nl * 0.1, hz = nz / nl * 0.1;
            quad(ei ? "mark" : "markY", [c0[0] - hx, yy0, c0[1] - hz], [c0[0] + hx, yy0, c0[1] + hz], [c1[0] + hx, yy1, c1[1] + hz], [c1[0] - hx, yy1, c1[1] - hz], up); });
        }
      }
      /* piers under bridge decks */
      if (w.b > 0 && !street && !rail) { const sp = CFG.pierSpan || 32; const nP = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / sp));
        for (let k = 0; k <= nP; k++) { const s = L * k / nP; let i = 0; while (i < n - 2 && rs.s[i + 1] < s) i++; const f = (s - rs.s[i]) / Math.max(rs.s[i + 1] - rs.s[i], 0.01); const px = P[i][0] + (P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0]) * f, pz = P[i][1] + (P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1]) * f; const yy = y[i] + (y[i + 1] - y[i]) * f - thick; if (yy < 2.5) continue;
          const dx = P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0], dz = P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1]; const ry = -Math.atan2(dz, dx);
          if (w.w >= 15) { const tx = dx / (Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1), tz = dz / (Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1); [-1, 1].forEach(sg => { const o = sg * w.w * 0.25; piers.push([px - tz * o, 0, pz + tx * o, ry, 1, yy, 1]); }); caps.push([px, yy - 1.2, pz, ry, w.w * 0.82, 1, 1]); }
          else { piers.push([px, 0, pz, ry, 1, yy, 1]); caps.push([px, yy - 1.2, pz, ry, w.w * 0.7, 1, 1]); } } }
    });
    /* unfinished viaduct ways: bare piers + pier caps only (no deck) */
    pierWays.forEach(w => { const rs = resample(w.pts, 6), P = rs.p, n = P.length, L = rs.L; const yy = (HB[w.b > 0 ? w.b : 1] || 7.5) - (CFG.thick || 1.7); const nP = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / (CFG.pierSpan || 30)));
      for (let k = 0; k <= nP; k++) { const s0 = L * k / nP; let i = 0; while (i < n - 2 && rs.s[i + 1] < s0) i++; const f = (s0 - rs.s[i]) / Math.max(rs.s[i + 1] - rs.s[i], 0.01); const px = P[i][0] + (P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0]) * f, pz = P[i][1] + (P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1]) * f; const ry = -Math.atan2(P[i + 1][1] - P[i][1], P[i + 1][0] - P[i][0]);
        piers.push([px, 0, pz, ry, 1, yy, 1]); caps.push([px, yy - 1.2, pz, ry, w.w * 0.7, 1, 1]); } });
    /* ground plate */
    const hw0 = D.hw, hd0 = D.hd;
    K.mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(hw0 * 2, 1.6, hd0 * 2).translate(0, -0.8, 0), M.ground, 0, 0, 0);
    /* water (mapped polygons / canal lines) */
    const cx = v => Math.max(-hw0 + 1, Math.min(hw0 - 1, v)), cz = v => Math.max(-hd0 + 1, Math.min(hd0 - 1, v));
    D.water.forEach(wt => { if (wt.pts) { const s = new THREE.Shape(); wt.pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(cx(p[0]), -cz(p[1])) : s.moveTo(cx(p[0]), -cz(p[1])))); const g = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, CFG.waterY || 0.06, 0); K.mesh(g, M.water, 0, 0, 0); } });
    D.water.forEach(wt => { if (!wt.line || wt.t) return; const rs = resample(wt.line, 12), P = rs.p, n = P.length, hw = (wt.w || 10) / 2, Q = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = P[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = P[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l; Q.push([[P[i][0] - dz * hw, P[i][1] + dx * hw], [P[i][0] + dz * hw, P[i][1] - dx * hw]]); }
      for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { const y0 = CFG.waterY || 0.06; quad("water", [Q[i][0][0], y0, Q[i][0][1]], [Q[i][1][0], y0, Q[i][1][1]], [Q[i + 1][1][0], y0, Q[i + 1][1][1]], [Q[i + 1][0][0], y0, Q[i + 1][0][1]], [0, 1, 0]); } });
    const hashN = (x, z) => { const v = Math.sin(x * 12.9898 + z * 78.233) * 43758.5453; return v - Math.floor(v); };

    const B = {};
    const push = (key, g) => { (B[key] = B[key] || []).push(g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g); };
    const area = P => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { const q = P[(i + 1) % P.length]; a += P[i][0] * q[1] - q[0] * P[i][1]; } return a / 2; };

      const mk = (pts, ccw) => { let L = pts.map(p => [p[0], -p[1]]); if ((area(L) > 0) !== ccw) L = L.reverse(); return L; };

        const n0 = [az * s, -ax * s], n1 = [bz * s, -bx * s]; const k = Math.max(0.35, 1 + n0[0] * n1[0] + n0[1] * n1[1]);
        return [p[0] + (n0[0] + n1[0]) / k * d, p[1] + (n0[1] + n1[1]) / k * d]; }); };

    const B = {};
    const push = (key, g) => { (B[key] = B[key] || []).push(g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g); };
    const sarea = P => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { const q = P[(i + 1) % P.length]; a += P[i][0] * q[1] - q[0] * P[i][1]; } return a; };

      (holes || []).forEach(hp => { const hh = new THREE.Path(); const H = (sarea(hp) * sarea(P) > 0) ? hp.slice().reverse() : hp; H.forEach((p, i) => (i ? hh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : hh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); s.holes.push(hh); });

      const m = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); m.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); m.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); K.mesh(m, mats[key]); });

    const rect = (x0, z0, x1, z1) => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x0, z1]];

    const inPoly = (p, P) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = P.length - 1; i < P.length; j = i++) { const a = P[i], b = P[j]; if (((a[1] > p[1]) !== (b[1] > p[1])) && (p[0] < (b[0] - a[0]) * (p[1] - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]) + a[0])) c = !c; } return c; };
    const M = { desert: K.mat(0xd2b48a), soil: K.mat(0xc19f74), track: K.mat(0xdcc29f), rowM: K.mat(0x4f6a3f, { roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), rowY: K.mat(0x9aa56b, { roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }),
      rim: K.mat(0xd9d3c4), water: K.mat(0x14304d, { roughness: 0.08, metalness: 0.35 }), wall: K.mat(0xeee9dc), roof: K.mat(0xcfc9ba), pv: K.mat(0x1f3f6e, { roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.6 }), fence: K.mat(0xbdb6a6), plant: K.mat(0xaeb3b6) };
    const OUT = [[-145,-950],[124,-978],[187,-940],[391,-957],[542,-969],[1072,-164],[684,71],[432,190],[-905,1026],[-1254,468],[-169,-252],[-370,-610],[-77,-776]], TRACKS = [[[-1271,440],[-900,1034]],[[-1055,306],[-684,899]],[[-831,165],[-460,759]],[[-602,22],[-231,616]],[[-379,-117],[-9,477]],[[-147,-262],[224,332]],[[67,-395],[438,198]],[[-1082,759],[275,-89]],[[-943,472],[-494,191]],[[157,-943],[187,-881],[235,-777],[295,-680],[352,-525],[404,-439],[425,-421]],[[382,-950],[482,-796],[560,-664],[629,-543],[763,-304],[850,-170]],[[-311,-519],[-17,-660]],[[1,-671],[198,-772]],[[295,-680],[482,-790],[594,-855]],[[425,-428],[620,-543],[759,-622]],[[560,-183],[763,-302]],[[122,-420],[347,-525]],[[275,-89],[393,-163]]], YOUNG = [[[-370,-610],[-77,-776],[122,-420],[-168,-252]],[[157,-941],[542,-969],[1072,-164],[684,71],[560,-110],[420,-300],[425,-421]]], BASINS = [[[425.4,87.2],[384.2,10.2],[415.9,-6.7],[457,70.3]],[[544.4,74.8],[470.2,-55.2],[545.4,-98.2],[619.7,31.7]],[[463.1,-64.7],[388.3,-196.2],[466,-240.4],[540.9,-109]],[[383,-205.2],[308,-336.4],[385.5,-380.7],[460.5,-249.4]]], PUMP = [[346,-164,27,12,6.5],[362,-127,52,15,7.5],[376,-135,40,8,6],[386,-92,40,14,7],[405,-58,50,14,7],[400,-75,30,8,5.5]], PV = {"cx":350,"cz":-113,"L":38,"W":22};
    const TH = 32 * Math.PI / 180, DV = [Math.sin(TH), Math.cos(TH)], NU = [Math.cos(TH), -Math.sin(TH)];   // rows run along DV (across the strip), offsets along NU
    // ground
    ext("desert", off(OUT, 120), 1.6, -1.6);
    ext("soil", OUT, 0.3, 0);
    TRACKS.forEach(t => ribbon("track", t, 7, 0.3, 0.08));
    ribbon("track", OUT.concat([OUT[0]]), 6, 0.3, 0.08);
    // exclusion zones for rows: basin banks and the pump compound
    const EXC = BASINS.map(b => off(b, 14)).concat([[[322, -205], [372, -200], [445, -80], [440, -30], [385, -30], [328, -150]]]);
    // rows: clipped to the plantation outline, cut at every track and excluded zone
    const hits = (P, s) => { const r = []; const p0 = [s * NU[0], s * NU[1]];
      for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { const a = P[i], b = P[(i + 1) % P.length]; const ex = b[0] - a[0], ez = b[1] - a[1];
        const den = DV[0] * ez - DV[1] * ex; if (Math.abs(den) < 1e-9) continue;
        const t = ((a[0] - p0[0]) * ez - (a[1] - p0[1]) * ex) / den, w = ((a[0] - p0[0]) * DV[1] - (a[1] - p0[1]) * DV[0]) / den;
        if (w >= 0 && w < 1) r.push(t); } return r.sort((x, y) => x - y); };
    const cutAt = (iv, a, b) => { const r = []; iv.forEach(q => { if (b <= q[0] || a >= q[1]) r.push(q); else { if (a > q[0]) r.push([q[0], a]); if (b < q[1]) r.push([b, q[1]]); } }); return r; };
    let smin = 1e9, smax = -1e9; OUT.forEach(p => { const s = p[0] * NU[0] + p[1] * NU[1]; smin = Math.min(smin, s); smax = Math.max(smax, s); });
    const rows = { rowM: [], rowY: [] };
    for (let s = Math.ceil(smin / 7) * 7 + 3; s < smax; s += 7) {
      const h = hits(OUT, s); let iv = []; for (let i = 0; i + 1 < h.length; i += 2) iv.push([h[i] + 2, h[i + 1] - 2]);
      const p0 = [s * NU[0], s * NU[1]];
      TRACKS.forEach(T => { for (let i = 0; i + 1 < T.length; i++) { const a = T[i], b = T[i + 1], ex = b[0] - a[0], ez = b[1] - a[1], den = DV[0] * ez - DV[1] * ex; if (Math.abs(den) < 1e-9) continue;
          const t = ((a[0] - p0[0]) * ez - (a[1] - p0[1]) * ex) / den, w = ((a[0] - p0[0]) * DV[1] - (a[1] - p0[1]) * DV[0]) / den;
          if (w >= 0 && w <= 1) { const gap = 4.5 / Math.max(0.3, Math.abs(den) / Math.hypot(ex, ez)); iv = cutAt(iv, t - gap, t + gap); } } });
      EXC.forEach(E => { const hh = hits(E, s); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < hh.length; i += 2) iv = cutAt(iv, hh[i], hh[i + 1]); });
      iv.forEach(q => { if (q[1] - q[0] < 14) return; const t0 = q[0], t1 = q[1], mid = (t0 + t1) / 2, mp = [p0[0] + DV[0] * mid, p0[1] + DV[1] * mid];
        const y = YOUNG.some(P => inPoly(mp, P)); (y ? rows.rowY : rows.rowM).push([p0[0] + DV[0] * t0, p0[1] + DV[1] * t0, p0[0] + DV[0] * t1, p0[1] + DV[1] * t1]); }); }
    const strip = (key, list, w, h) => list.forEach(r => { const dx = r[2] - r[0], dz = r[3] - r[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz), ux = dx / L, uz = dz / L, vx = -uz, vz = ux, hw = w / 2;
      const P = (a, o, y) => [r[0] + ux * a + vx * o, y, r[1] + uz * a + vz * o]; const q = (a, b, c) => [].concat(a, b, c);
      const v = [].concat(q(P(0, -hw, 0.3), P(L, -hw, 0.3), P(L, 0, 0.3 + h)), q(P(0, -hw, 0.3), P(L, 0, 0.3 + h), P(0, 0, 0.3 + h)), q(P(0, hw, 0.3), P(L, 0, 0.3 + h), P(L, hw, 0.3)), q(P(0, hw, 0.3), P(0, 0, 0.3 + h), P(L, 0, 0.3 + h)));
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(v), 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); push(key, g); });
    strip("rowM", rows.rowM, 3.2, 1.7); strip("rowY", rows.rowY, 2.4, 0.8);
    // storage basins: raised banks with a lined (pale) rim, dark water below the crest
    BASINS.forEach(b => { ext("rim", off(b, 5), 2.2, 0.3, [b]); ext("water", b, 0.2, 0.5); });
    // pump compound: pump houses (long axis along the plantation cross tracks), PV / sub-station yard
    const RY = -Math.atan2(DV[1], DV[0]);
    PUMP.forEach(p => { box("wall", p[2], p[4], p[3], p[0], 0.3, p[1], RY); box("roof", p[2] + 0.8, 0.5, p[3] + 0.8, p[0], 0.3 + p[4], p[1], RY); });
    box("fence", PV.L, 0.6, PV.W, PV.cx, 0.3, PV.cz, RY);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { const lx = (i - 1.5) * 6.2, lz = (k - 1) * 4.2; box("pv", 5.2, 0.5, 3.4, PV.cx + lx * DV[0] - lz * DV[1] * 0.0 + lz * NU[0], 1.8, PV.cz + lx * DV[1] + lz * NU[1], RY); }
    box("plant", 4, 3, 3, PV.cx - 12 * DV[0] + 6 * NU[0], 0.9, PV.cz - 12 * DV[1] + 6 * NU[1], RY);
    // windbreak trees: along the compound's west side and along the outer boundary (narrow evergreen cones)
    const trees = []; const line = (a, b, step) => { const L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / step)); for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) trees.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * i / n, 0.3, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * i / n]); };
    line([359, -181], [432, -58], 5);
    OUT.forEach((p, i) => { const q = OUT[(i + 1) % OUT.length]; line([p[0] + 0, p[1]], [q[0], q[1]], 14); });
    flush(M);
    K.inst(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.9, 7, 5).translate(0, 3.5, 0), 0x2f5a35, trees);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;
  }
});

  build(K) {
    const B = {};
    const push = (key, g) => { (B[key] = B[key] || []).push(g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g); };
    const sa = P => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { const q = P[(i + 1) % P.length]; a += P[i][0] * q[1] - q[0] * P[i][1]; } return a; };
    const shapeOf = (P, holes) => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); P.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      (holes || []).forEach(hp => { let H = hp; if (sa(H) * sa(P) > 0) H = H.slice().reverse(); const hh = new THREE.Path(); H.forEach((p, i) => (i ? hh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : hh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); s.holes.push(hh); }); return s; };
    const ext = (key, P, h, y, holes) => { const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shapeOf(P, holes), { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y || 0, 0); push(key, g); };
    const box = (key, w, h, d, x, y, z, ry) => { const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d); g.translate(0, h / 2, 0); if (ry) g.rotateY(ry); g.translate(x, y || 0, z); push(key, g); };
    const cyl = (key, rt, rb, h, x, y, z, seg) => { const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, h, seg || 12); g.translate(x, (y || 0) + h / 2, z); push(key, g); };
    const ribbon = (key, L, w, y, t) => { for (let i = 0; i < L.length - 1; i++) { const a = L[i], b = L[i + 1], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (len < 0.3) continue;
        box(key, len + w * 0.5, t || 0.2, w, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, -Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0])); } };
    const flush = (mats) => Object.keys(B).forEach(key => { const gs = B[key]; let n = 0; gs.forEach(g => (n += g.attributes.position.count));
      const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), nor = new Float32Array(n * 3); let o = 0; gs.forEach(g => { pos.set(g.attributes.position.array, o); nor.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o); o += g.attributes.position.count * 3; });

    const PX = (x, y) => [+((x - 700) * 0.1857 - 18.5).toFixed(1), +((y - 705) * 0.1857 - 3.3).toFixed(1)];
    const PL = L => L.map(p => PX(p[0], p[1]));
    const off = (P, d) => { const n = P.length, s = sa(P) > 0 ? 1 : -1; return P.map((p, i) => { const p0 = P[(i - 1 + n) % n], p1 = P[(i + 1) % n];
        let ax = p[0] - p0[0], az = p[1] - p0[1], bx = p1[0] - p[0], bz = p1[1] - p[1]; const la = Math.hypot(ax, az) || 1, lb = Math.hypot(bx, bz) || 1; ax /= la; az /= la; bx /= lb; bz /= lb;
        const n0 = [az * s, -ax * s], n1 = [bz * s, -bx * s]; const k = Math.max(0.35, 1 + n0[0] * n1[0] + n0[1] * n1[1]);
        return [p[0] + (n0[0] + n1[0]) / k * d, p[1] + (n0[1] + n1[1]) / k * d]; }); };
    const inside = (pt, P) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = P.length - 1; i < P.length; j = i++) { if ((P[i][1] > pt[1]) !== (P[j][1] > pt[1]) && pt[0] < (P[j][0] - P[i][0]) * (pt[1] - P[i][1]) / (P[j][1] - P[i][1]) + P[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
    const dseg = (p, a, b) => { const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p[0] - a[0]) * dx + (p[1] - a[1]) * dz) / (dx * dx + dz * dz || 1))); return Math.hypot(p[0] - a[0] - dx * t, p[1] - a[1] - dz * t); };
    const dline = (p, L) => { let d = 1e9; for (let i = 0; i < L.length - 1; i++) d = Math.min(d, dseg(p, L[i], L[i + 1])); return d; };

      wall: K.mat(0xe8dfc9), roofY: K.mat(0xe6e79a), white: K.mat(0xf2f0ea), dark: K.mat(0x2f3d4c), blue: K.mat(0x2f5b8f), steel: K.mat(0x8c999e), pipe: K.mat(0x6f8088)

    const chanN = PL([[660, 448], [661, 300], [662, 150], [664, 0]]);

    function ext(pts, h, y) {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y || 0, 0); return g;
    }
    function bx(w, h, d, x, y, z) { const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d); g.translate(x, y + h / 2, z); return g; }
    function seg(a, b, w, h, y) {
      const L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (L < 0.05) return null;
      const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(L, h, w).translate(0, h / 2, 0); g.rotateY(-Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0]));
      g.translate((a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2); return g;
    }
    function clipSeg(a, b, r) {
      let t0 = 0, t1 = 1; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1];
      const P = [-dx, dx, -dz, dz], Q = [a[0] - r[0], r[2] - a[0], a[1] - r[1], r[3] - a[1]];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { if (P[i] === 0) { if (Q[i] < 0) return null; } else { const t = Q[i] / P[i]; if (P[i] < 0) { if (t > t1) return null; if (t > t0) t0 = t; } else { if (t < t0) return null; if (t < t1) t1 = t; } } }
      return [[a[0] + t0 * dx, a[1] + t0 * dz], [a[0] + t1 * dx, a[1] + t1 * dz]];
    }
    function ribbon(pts, w, h, y, out) { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const c = clipSeg(pts[i], pts[i + 1], RECT); if (!c) continue; const g = seg(c[0], c[1], w, h, y); if (g) out.push(g); } }
    /* triangular prism: base on y, spans x0..x1 (ridge along x) and z0..z1; vertical face on the north (z0) side when saw, else symmetric gable */
    function prismX(x0, x1, z0, z1, h, y, saw) {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); const w = z1 - z0;
      if (saw) { s.moveTo(w, 0); s.lineTo(0, 0); s.lineTo(w, h); } else { s.moveTo(0, 0); s.lineTo(w, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, h); }
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: x1 - x0, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateY(Math.PI / 2); g.translate(x0, y, z0 + w); return g;
    }
    function prismZ(x0, x1, z0, z1, h, y) {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); const w = x1 - x0; s.moveTo(0, 0); s.lineTo(w, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, h);
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: z1 - z0, bevelEnabled: false }); g.translate(x0, y, z0); return g;
    }

    /* ---- ground ---- */
    const plate = [[RECT[0], RECT[1]], [RECT[2], RECT[1]], [RECT[2], RECT[3]], [RECT[0], RECT[3]]];
    K.pad(plate, 0x6d8c5a, -0.4, 1.6);                         // farmland round the compound, top at y = 1.2
    K.group(() => {
      K.pad(FENCE, 0xb39e78, 0, 0.12);                          // compound ground (bare earth)
      const cw = []; DATA.canal.forEach(l => ribbon(l, 15, 0.1, 0, cw)); if (cw.length) K.mesh(merge(cw), K.mat('water', { doubleSide: true }), 0, 0.02, 0);
      const rd = []; const WID = { service: 5, minor: 5, track: 4, path: 2.5, tertiary: 7 };
      DATA.roads.forEach(r => ribbon(r.p, WID[r.c] || 4, 0.14, 0.02, rd)); if (rd.length) K.mesh(merge(rd), 'road', 0, 0, 0);
      const wl = []; for (let i = 0; i < FENCE.length; i++) { const g = seg(FENCE[i], FENCE[(i + 1) % FENCE.length], 0.6, 2.8, 0); if (g) wl.push(g); } K.mesh(merge(wl), K.mat(0xf2f0ea), 0, 0, 0);

      /* ---- buildings ---- */
      const walls = [], flatRoofs = [], hallFlat = [], hallWalls = [], gables = [], saws = [], sawFace = [], hi = [], parapet = [], pv = [], vents = [], upper = [];
      DATA.b.forEach((b, bi) => {
        const hall = b.a >= 1000, mid = b.a >= 400;
        const eave = HM[bi] !== undefined ? HM[bi] : (b.a >= 3000 ? 9 : b.a >= 1000 ? 7.5 : b.a >= 400 ? 6 : b.a >= 150 ? 4.6 : 3.2);
        const xs = b.p.map(p => p[0]), zs = b.p.map(p => p[1]); const bb = [Math.min(...xs), Math.max(...xs), Math.min(...zs), Math.max(...zs)];
        if (bi === 0) {                       /* battery-line hall: main roof x −12…79, z 230…272 in four low bays; two-storey blocks on the north side */
          hallWalls.push(ext(b.p, eave, 0));
          const zb = [230, 239.3, 252.5, 263.2, 272], rise = [1.5, 1.8, 1.8, 1.5];
          for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) (HI ? hi : gables).push(prismX(-12, 79, zb[k], zb[k + 1], rise[k], eave));
          hallFlat.push(ext(b.p, 0.5, eave)); upper.push(bx(29, 1.5, 12, -11.5, eave, 231.5));      // two-storey NW service block (x −26…3, z 226…238) raised to ≈ 9.5 m
          upper.push(bx(31, 1.0, 12, 41.5, eave, 218));          // long north block (x 26…57, z 212…224)
          [[38.9, 236.2], [45.1, 235.5], [48.7, 233], [47.7, 238.4], [50, 241.6], [46.6, 243.8], [51.8, 252.5]].forEach(v => vents.push([v[0], eave + 1.6, v[1]]));
          return;
        }
        if (SAW[bi]) {

    function ext(pts, h, y) {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y || 0, 0); return g;
    }
    function bx(w, h, d, x, y, z) { const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d); g.translate(x, y + h / 2, z); return g; }
    function seg(a, b, w, h, y) {
      const L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (L < 0.05) return null;
      const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(L, h, w).translate(0, h / 2, 0); g.rotateY(-Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0]));
      g.translate((a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2); return g;
    }
    function clipSeg(a, b, r) {
      let t0 = 0, t1 = 1; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1];
      const P = [-dx, dx, -dz, dz], Q = [a[0] - r[0], r[2] - a[0], a[1] - r[1], r[3] - a[1]];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { if (P[i] === 0) { if (Q[i] < 0) return null; } else { const t = Q[i] / P[i]; if (P[i] < 0) { if (t > t1) return null; if (t > t0) t0 = t; } else { if (t < t0) return null; if (t < t1) t1 = t; } } }
      return [[a[0] + t0 * dx, a[1] + t0 * dz], [a[0] + t1 * dx, a[1] + t1 * dz]];
    }
    function ribbon(pts, w, h, y, out) { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const c = clipSeg(pts[i], pts[i + 1], RECT); if (!c) continue; const g = seg(c[0], c[1], w, h, y); if (g) out.push(g); } }
    /* triangular prism: base on y, spans x0..x1 (ridge along x) and z0..z1; vertical face on the north (z0) side when saw, else symmetric gable */
    function prismX(x0, x1, z0, z1, h, y, saw) {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); const w = z1 - z0;
      if (saw) { s.moveTo(w, 0); s.lineTo(0, 0); s.lineTo(w, h); } else { s.moveTo(0, 0); s.lineTo(w, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, h); }
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: x1 - x0, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateY(Math.PI / 2); g.translate(x0, y, z0 + w); return g;
    }
    function prismZ(x0, x1, z0, z1, h, y) {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); const w = x1 - x0; s.moveTo(0, 0); s.lineTo(w, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, h);
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: z1 - z0, bevelEnabled: false }); g.translate(x0, y, z0); return g;
    }

    /* ---- ground ---- */
    const plate = [[RECT[0], RECT[1]], [RECT[2], RECT[1]], [RECT[2], RECT[3]], [RECT[0], RECT[3]]];
    K.pad(plate, 0x6d8c5a, -0.4, 1.6);                         // farmland round the compound, top at y = 1.2
    K.group(() => {
      K.pad(FENCE, 0xb39e78, 0, 0.12);                          // compound ground (bare earth)
      const cw = []; DATA.canal.forEach(l => ribbon(l, 15, 0.1, 0, cw)); if (cw.length) K.mesh(merge(cw), K.mat('water', { doubleSide: true }), 0, 0.02, 0);
      const rd = []; const WID = { service: 5, minor: 5, track: 4, path: 2.5, tertiary: 7 };
      DATA.roads.forEach(r => ribbon(r.p, WID[r.c] || 4, 0.14, 0.02, rd)); if (rd.length) K.mesh(merge(rd), 'road', 0, 0, 0);
      const wl = []; for (let i = 0; i < FENCE.length; i++) { const g = seg(FENCE[i], FENCE[(i + 1) % FENCE.length], 0.6, 2.8, 0); if (g) wl.push(g); } K.mesh(merge(wl), K.mat(0xf2f0ea), 0, 0, 0);

      /* ---- buildings ---- */
      const walls = [], flatRoofs = [], hallFlat = [], hallWalls = [], gables = [], saws = [], sawFace = [], hi = [], parapet = [], pv = [], vents = [], upper = [];
      DATA.b.forEach((b, bi) => {
        const hall = b.a >= 1000, mid = b.a >= 400;
        const eave = HM[bi] !== undefined ? HM[bi] : (b.a >= 3000 ? 9 : b.a >= 1000 ? 7.5 : b.a >= 400 ? 6 : b.a >= 150 ? 4.6 : 3.2);
        const xs = b.p.map(p => p[0]), zs = b.p.map(p => p[1]); const bb = [Math.min(...xs), Math.max(...xs), Math.min(...zs), Math.max(...zs)];
        if (bi === 0) {                       /* battery-line hall: main roof x −12…79, z 230…272 in four low bays; two-storey blocks on the north side */
          hallWalls.push(ext(b.p, eave, 0));
          const zb = [230, 239.3, 252.5, 263.2, 272], rise = [1.5, 1.8, 1.8, 1.5];
          for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) (HI ? hi : gables).push(prismX(-12, 79, zb[k], zb[k + 1], rise[k], eave));
          hallFlat.push(ext(b.p, 0.5, eave)); upper.push(bx(29, 1.5, 12, -11.5, eave, 231.5));      // two-storey NW service block (x −26…3, z 226…238) raised to ≈ 9.5 m
          upper.push(bx(31, 1.0, 12, 41.5, eave, 218));          // long north block (x 26…57, z 212…224)
          [[38.9, 236.2], [45.1, 235.5], [48.7, 233], [47.7, 238.4], [50, 241.6], [46.6, 243.8], [51.8, 252.5]].forEach(v => vents.push([v[0], eave + 1.6, v[1]]));
          return;
        }
        if (SAW[bi]) {
          const n = SAW[bi][0], axis = SAW[bi][1];
          hallWalls.push(ext(b.p, eave, 0));
          const x0 = bb[0] + 0.5, x1 = bb[1] - 0.5, z0 = bb[2] + 0.5, z1 = bb[3] - 0.5;
          if (axis === 'x') { const w = (z1 - z0) / n; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) saws.push(prismX(x0, x1, z0 + k * w, z0 + (k + 1) * w, 2.4, eave, true)); }
          else { const w = (x1 - x0) / n; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) gables.push(prismZ(x0 + k * w, x0 + (k + 1) * w, z0, z1, 1.6, eave)); }
          return;
        }
        if (bi === 3) {                      /* flat-roofed hall with two raised skylight monitors */
          hallWalls.push(ext(b.p, eave, 0)); hallFlat.push(ext(b.p, 0.5, eave));
          [[11, -276.5], [27, -276.5]].forEach(m => upper.push(bx(5.5, 1.8, 11, m[0], eave + 0.5, m[1]))); return;
        }
        if (hall && b.r > 0.8) {
          hallWalls.push(ext(b.p, eave, 0));
          const rise = Math.min(2.4, b.W * 0.07), s = new THREE.Shape(); s.moveTo(-b.W / 2, 0); s.lineTo(b.W / 2, 0); s.lineTo(0, rise);
          const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: b.L, bevelEnabled: false }); g.translate(0, 0, -b.L / 2); g.rotateY(b.ry); g.translate(b.c[0], eave, b.c[1]); gables.push(g);
        } else if (hall) { hallWalls.push(ext(b.p, eave, 0)); hallFlat.push(ext(b.p, 0.5, eave)); }
        else { walls.push(ext(b.p, eave, 0)); flatRoofs.push(ext(b.p, 0.45, eave)); if (bi === 26) pv.push(bx(34.5, 0.3, 12.4, 26.5, eave + 0.45, 85.5)); if (bi === 82) pv.push(bx(7, 0.3, 6.5, 60, eave + 0.45, 82)); }
      });
      K.mesh(merge(walls), K.mat(0xf0e8d6), 0, 0, 0);
      K.mesh(merge(hallWalls), K.mat(0xf4eee0), 0, 0, 0);
      K.mesh(merge(flatRoofs), K.mat(0x8f8a80), 0, 0, 0);
      K.mesh(merge(hallFlat), K.mat(0xc2b393), 0, 0, 0);
      K.mesh(merge(gables), K.mat(0xcdbb9a, { doubleSide: true }), 0, 0, 0);
      if (saws.length) K.mesh(merge(saws), K.mat(0xc9b998, { doubleSide: true }), 0, 0, 0);
      if (hi.length) K.mesh(merge(hi), K.mat(0x8aa68f, { doubleSide: true }), 0, 0, 0);      // battery hall roof (id 147)
      if (upper.length) K.mesh(merge(upper), K.mat(0xe6dcc4), 0, 0, 0);
      if (pv.length) K.mesh(merge(pv), K.mat(0x2f5a96, { roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.4 }), 0, 0, 0);
      if (vents.length) K.inst(K.cylGeo(0.55, 0.55, 1.4, 8), K.mat(0x6f716f), vents.map(v => [v[0], v[1] - 1.4, v[2]]));

      /* ---- octagonal garden roundabout (centre ≈ 69.5, 6.7), small tanks and reservoirs seen in the imagery ---- */
      const oct = []; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) oct.push([69.5 + Math.cos(k * Math.PI / 4 + Math.PI / 8) * 7.5, 6.7 + Math.sin(k * Math.PI / 4 + Math.PI / 8) * 7.5]);
      K.pad(oct, 0x6f8a54, 0.14, 0.18);
      K.inst(K.cylGeo(1.05, 1.05, 2.6, 12), K.mat(0xf2f0ea), [[-196.8, 0, -198.5], [-196.8, 0, -196.3], [-196.8, 0, -194.2], [-196.8, 0, -192]]);
      K.inst(K.cylGeo(3.5, 3.5, 2.4, 20), K.mat(0xc9c5b8), [[-202, 0, -178], [-191.7, 0, -153.6]]);

      /* ---- tree crowns (vegetation mask of the imagery) + the east fence tree line ---- */
      const tl = []; for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) { const t = i / 33; tl.push([85 + 80 * t + 4, 45 + 410 * t, 0.8 + (i % 3) * 0.12]); }
      const cr = TREES.map(t => [t[0], 3.4 * t[2], t[1], 0, 1.05 * t[2], 1.35 * t[2], 1.05 * t[2]]);
      K.inst(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(2.4, 0), K.mat(0x5c7a45), cr);
      K.trees(tl, 8);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;
  }

    function shapeGeo(pts, holes, h, y) {
      const s = new T.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));

    }
    function merge(list) {
      let n = 0; list.forEach(g => (n += g.attributes.position.count));

    }

    function bands(p, h, step) {

        const nx = sgn * tz / L, nz = -sgn * tx / L, o = 0.14;
        for (let y = 1.0; y + 1.5 < h; y += step) {

    }

          const q = [[o[0] + ux * r0 - uz * wd, o[1] + uz * r0 + ux * wd], [o[0] + ux * r1 - uz * wd, o[1] + uz * r1 + ux * wd], [o[0] + ux * r1 + uz * wd, o[1] + uz * r1 - ux * wd], [o[0] + ux * r0 + uz * wd, o[1] + uz * r0 - ux * wd]];
          add("oct", shapeGeo(q, null, 12.5, 0.12)); add("cap", shapeGeo(q, null, 0.5, 12.62)); });
        [outer, inner, core].forEach((pp, i) => { const g = bands(pp, [16, 5.5, 12.5][i], 3.5); if (g) { g.translate(0, 0.12, 0); winl.push(g); } });
      });
      Object.keys(acc).forEach(k => { const m = k === "cap" || k === "capShed" ? MT[k] : MT[k]; K.mesh(merge(acc[k]), m); });
      if (winl.length) K.mesh(merge(winl), MT.win);
      if (postl.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(0.35, 4.4, 0.35), MT.post, postl.map(p => [p[0], p[1], p[2]]));
      if (D.gh && D.gh.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), MT.gh, D.gh.map(g => [g[0], 0.12, g[1], g[2], g[3], 4.2, g[4]]));
      /* mosque / prayer-room domes (small round buildings) */
      if (D.dome.length) {
        K.inst(new T.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 20).translate(0, 0.5, 0), MT.ward, D.dome.map(d => [d.c[0], 0.12, d.c[1], 0, d.r, 6.5, d.r]));
        K.inst(new T.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 10, 0, PI * 2, 0, PI / 2), MT.dome, D.dome.map(d => [d.c[0], 6.62, d.c[1], 0, d.r * 0.92, d.r * 0.92, d.r * 0.92]));
      }
      /* garden trees round the central building */
      if (CFG.trees) { const tl = []; for (let i = 0; i < CFG.trees; i++) { const a = rnd() * PI * 2, r = 20 + rnd() * (CFG.gardenR - 30); tl.push([Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 0.7 + rnd() * 0.5]); } K.trees(tl.map(t => [t[0], t[1], t[2]]), 6); }
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);

  }

    const WALL = [0xf1e9d6, 0xd2d4d0, 0x434a50, 0xdfe2de, 0xd8cfba, 0x8d8a6e, 0x26343a];
    /* merge many extruded footprints into ONE geometry per material class */
    function extrudeMerged(list) {
      const pos = [], nor = [];
      list.forEach(([c, h, f]) => {
        const s = new T.Shape(); for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i += 2) (i ? s.lineTo(f[i], -f[i + 1]) : s.moveTo(f[i], -f[i + 1]));
        const g = new T.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
        pos.push(g.attributes.position.array); nor.push(g.attributes.normal.array); g.dispose();
      });
      const n = pos.reduce((a, p) => a + p.length, 0), P = new Float32Array(n), N = new Float32Array(n); let o = 0;
      pos.forEach((p, i) => { P.set(p, o); N.set(nor[i], o); o += p.length; });
      const G = new T.BufferGeometry(); G.setAttribute('position', new T.BufferAttribute(P, 3)); G.setAttribute('normal', new T.BufferAttribute(N, 3)); return G;
    }
    const lay = (n) => ({ polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -n, polygonOffsetUnits: -n });
    function flatPoly(pts, col, y, n) { const s = new T.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      const g = new T.ShapeGeometry(s, 4); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); return K.mesh(g, K.mat(col, lay(n)), 0, y, 0); }
    function disc(r, col, y, n, seg) { return K.mesh(new T.CircleGeometry(r, seg || 96).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), K.mat(col, lay(n)), 0, y, 0); }
    function ring(r0, r1, col, y, n) { return K.mesh(new T.RingGeometry(r0, r1, 120, 1).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), K.mat(col, lay(n)), 0, y, 0); }
    function strip(a, w, r0, r1, col, y, n) { // radial road, angle a in degrees measured from +x towards +z (south)
      const t = a * Math.PI / 180, dx = Math.cos(t), dz = Math.sin(t), nx = -dz * w / 2, nz = dx * w / 2;
      return flatPoly([[dx * r0 + nx, dz * r0 + nz], [dx * r1 + nx, dz * r1 + nz], [dx * r1 - nx, dz * r1 - nz], [dx * r0 - nx, dz * r0 - nz]], col, y, n); }
    return K.group(() => {
      const C = CFG.col;
      /* ---- site plate + ground ---- */
      const plate = CFG.site.map(p => p), cxs = plate.reduce((a, p) => a + p[0], 0) / 4, czs = plate.reduce((a, p) => a + p[1], 0) / 4;
      const grow = plate.map(p => { const dx = p[0] - cxs, dz = p[1] - czs, l = Math.hypot(dx, dz); return [p[0] + dx / l * 9, p[1] + dz / l * 9]; });
      { const s = new T.Shape(); grow.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
        const g = new T.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 1.6, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); K.mesh(g, K.mat(C.plate), 0, -1.6, 0); }
      flatPoly(CFG.site, C.ground, 0.0, 1);
      if (EX.outer) flatPoly(EX.outer, C.outer, 0.04, 2);
      disc(378, C.ward, 0.08, 3); ring(100, 146, C.coreRoad, 0.12, 4); disc(97, C.core, 0.12, 4, 72);
      ring(378, 402, C.ringRoad, 0.12, 4);
      CFG.spokes.forEach(a => strip(a, 9, 146, 380, C.ringRoad, 0.14, 5));
      strip(CFG.axis.a, CFG.axis.w, CFG.axis.r0, CFG.axis.r1, C.ringRoad, 0.14, 5);
      if (EX.plots) EX.plots.forEach(p => flatPoly(p, 0xb59f66, 0.1, 5));
      if (EX.fields) { EX.fields.forEach(f => K.mesh(new T.CircleGeometry(f[2], 48).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), K.mat(0xc9b794, lay(5)), f[0], 0.1, f[1]));
        const tl = []; EX.fields.forEach(f => { for (let x = -f[2] + 7; x < f[2] - 5; x += 13) for (let z = -f[2] + 7; z < f[2] - 5; z += 13) if (Math.hypot(x, z) < f[2] - 7) tl.push([f[0] + x, 0.1, f[1] + z, 0, 1.6, 1.6, 1.6]); });
        K.inst(new T.ConeGeometry(1.5, 3.4, 5).translate(0, 1.7, 0), 0x77834f, tl); }
      /* ---- buildings: one merged mesh per material ---- */
      [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].forEach(c => { const l = D.filter(d => d[0] === c); if (l.length) K.mesh(extrudeMerged(l), K.mat(WALL[c], c === 3 ? { roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.25 } : {}), 0, 0.05, 0); });
      /* floor bands (window strips) + roof parapet on the multi-storey blocks: offset rings of the real footprints */
      function offs(f, d) { const n = f.length / 2, P = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P.push([f[2 * i], f[2 * i + 1]]);
        let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = P[i], q = P[(i + 1) % n]; a += p[0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[1]; } const sg = a > 0 ? 1 : -1, O = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p0 = P[(i + n - 1) % n], p1 = P[i], p2 = P[(i + 1) % n];
          let e1 = [p1[0] - p0[0], p1[1] - p0[1]], e2 = [p2[0] - p1[0], p2[1] - p1[1]]; const l1 = Math.hypot(...e1) || 1, l2 = Math.hypot(...e2) || 1;
          const n1 = [e1[1] / l1 * sg, -e1[0] / l1 * sg], n2 = [e2[1] / l2 * sg, -e2[0] / l2 * sg]; const k = 1 + n1[0] * n2[0] + n1[1] * n2[1];
          const m = Math.min(2.5, 1 / Math.max(k, 0.4)); O.push([p1[0] + (n1[0] + n2[0]) * d * m, p1[1] + (n1[1] + n2[1]) * d * m]); } return O; }
      function ringGeo(f, d, y, hh) { const O = offs(f, d), s = new T.Shape(); O.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
        const hole = new T.Path(); for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i += 2) (i ? hole.lineTo(f[i], -f[i + 1]) : hole.moveTo(f[i], -f[i + 1])); s.holes.push(hole);
        const g = new T.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: hh, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 2 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y, 0); return g; }
      const bandG = [], capG = [];
      D.forEach(([c, h, f]) => { if (c !== 0 || h < 8.5 || h > 14) return;
        for (let y = 3.0; y < h - 1.8; y += 3.3) bandG.push(ringGeo(f, 0.22, y + 0.05, 1.3)); capG.push(ringGeo(f, 0.35, h - 0.4, 0.9)); });
      function mergeG(gs) { const n = gs.reduce((a, g) => a + g.attributes.position.array.length, 0), P = new Float32Array(n), N = new Float32Array(n); let o = 0;
        gs.forEach(g => { P.set(g.attributes.position.array, o); N.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o); o += g.attributes.position.array.length; g.dispose(); });
        const G = new T.BufferGeometry(); G.setAttribute('position', new T.BufferAttribute(P, 3)); G.setAttribute('normal', new T.BufferAttribute(N, 3)); return G; }
      if (bandG.length) K.mesh(mergeG(bandG), K.mat(0x3c5d6a, { roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.4 }), 0, 0, 0);
      if (capG.length) K.mesh(mergeG(capG), K.mat(0xc9c0aa), 0, 0, 0);
      /* core: round tower of the administration building */
      K.cyl(CFG.tower[2], CFG.tower[2], CFG.tower[3], 0xe9e0cc, CFG.tower[0], 0.05, CFG.tower[1], 40);
      K.cyl(CFG.tower[2] + 0.6, CFG.tower[2] + 0.6, 0.8, 0xcfc6b0, CFG.tower[0], CFG.tower[3] + 0.05, CFG.tower[1], 40);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
  }
});

    const WALL = [0xf1e9d6, 0xd2d4d0, 0x434a50, 0xdfe2de, 0xd8cfba, 0x8d8a6e, 0x26343a];
    /* merge many extruded footprints into ONE geometry per material class */
    function extrudeMerged(list) {
      const pos = [], nor = [];
      list.forEach(([c, h, f]) => {
        const s = new T.Shape(); for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i += 2) (i ? s.lineTo(f[i], -f[i + 1]) : s.moveTo(f[i], -f[i + 1]));
        const g = new T.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
        pos.push(g.attributes.position.array); nor.push(g.attributes.normal.array); g.dispose();
      });
      const n = pos.reduce((a, p) => a + p.length, 0), P = new Float32Array(n), N = new Float32Array(n); let o = 0;
      pos.forEach((p, i) => { P.set(p, o); N.set(nor[i], o); o += p.length; });
      const G = new T.BufferGeometry(); G.setAttribute('position', new T.BufferAttribute(P, 3)); G.setAttribute('normal', new T.BufferAttribute(N, 3)); return G;
    }
    const lay = (n) => ({ polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -n, polygonOffsetUnits: -n });
    function flatPoly(pts, col, y, n) { const s = new T.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      const g = new T.ShapeGeometry(s, 4); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); return K.mesh(g, K.mat(col, lay(n)), 0, y, 0); }
    function disc(r, col, y, n, seg) { return K.mesh(new T.CircleGeometry(r, seg || 96).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), K.mat(col, lay(n)), 0, y, 0); }
    function ring(r0, r1, col, y, n) { return K.mesh(new T.RingGeometry(r0, r1, 120, 1).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), K.mat(col, lay(n)), 0, y, 0); }
    function strip(a, w, r0, r1, col, y, n) { // radial road, angle a in degrees measured from +x towards +z (south)
      const t = a * Math.PI / 180, dx = Math.cos(t), dz = Math.sin(t), nx = -dz * w / 2, nz = dx * w / 2;
      return flatPoly([[dx * r0 + nx, dz * r0 + nz], [dx * r1 + nx, dz * r1 + nz], [dx * r1 - nx, dz * r1 - nz], [dx * r0 - nx, dz * r0 - nz]], col, y, n); }
    return K.group(() => {
      const C = CFG.col;
      /* ---- site plate + ground ---- */
      const plate = CFG.site.map(p => p), cxs = plate.reduce((a, p) => a + p[0], 0) / 4, czs = plate.reduce((a, p) => a + p[1], 0) / 4;
      const grow = plate.map(p => { const dx = p[0] - cxs, dz = p[1] - czs, l = Math.hypot(dx, dz); return [p[0] + dx / l * 9, p[1] + dz / l * 9]; });
      { const s = new T.Shape(); grow.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
        const g = new T.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 1.6, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); K.mesh(g, K.mat(C.plate), 0, -1.6, 0); }
      flatPoly(CFG.site, C.ground, 0.0, 1);
      if (EX.outer) flatPoly(EX.outer, C.outer, 0.04, 2);
      disc(378, C.ward, 0.08, 3); ring(100, 146, C.coreRoad, 0.12, 4); disc(97, C.core, 0.12, 4, 72);
      ring(378, 402, C.ringRoad, 0.12, 4);
      CFG.spokes.forEach(a => strip(a, 9, 146, 380, C.ringRoad, 0.14, 5));
      strip(CFG.axis.a, CFG.axis.w, CFG.axis.r0, CFG.axis.r1, C.ringRoad, 0.14, 5);
      if (EX.plots) EX.plots.forEach(p => flatPoly(p, 0xb59f66, 0.1, 5));
      if (EX.fields) { EX.fields.forEach(f => K.mesh(new T.CircleGeometry(f[2], 48).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), K.mat(0xc9b794, lay(5)), f[0], 0.1, f[1]));
        const tl = []; EX.fields.forEach(f => { for (let x = -f[2] + 7; x < f[2] - 5; x += 13) for (let z = -f[2] + 7; z < f[2] - 5; z += 13) if (Math.hypot(x, z) < f[2] - 7) tl.push([f[0] + x, 0.1, f[1] + z, 0, 1.6, 1.6, 1.6]); });
        K.inst(new T.ConeGeometry(1.5, 3.4, 5).translate(0, 1.7, 0), 0x77834f, tl); }
      /* ---- buildings: one merged mesh per material ---- */
      [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].forEach(c => { const l = D.filter(d => d[0] === c); if (l.length) K.mesh(extrudeMerged(l), K.mat(WALL[c], c === 3 ? { roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.25 } : {}), 0, 0.05, 0); });
      /* floor bands (window strips) + roof parapet on the multi-storey blocks: offset rings of the real footprints */
      function offs(f, d) { const n = f.length / 2, P = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P.push([f[2 * i], f[2 * i + 1]]);
        let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = P[i], q = P[(i + 1) % n]; a += p[0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[1]; } const sg = a > 0 ? 1 : -1, O = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p0 = P[(i + n - 1) % n], p1 = P[i], p2 = P[(i + 1) % n];
          let e1 = [p1[0] - p0[0], p1[1] - p0[1]], e2 = [p2[0] - p1[0], p2[1] - p1[1]]; const l1 = Math.hypot(...e1) || 1, l2 = Math.hypot(...e2) || 1;
          const n1 = [e1[1] / l1 * sg, -e1[0] / l1 * sg], n2 = [e2[1] / l2 * sg, -e2[0] / l2 * sg]; const k = 1 + n1[0] * n2[0] + n1[1] * n2[1];
          const m = Math.min(2.5, 1 / Math.max(k, 0.4)); O.push([p1[0] + (n1[0] + n2[0]) * d * m, p1[1] + (n1[1] + n2[1]) * d * m]); } return O; }

    }, 0, 0, 0);

try{
/* 385 — مديرية أمن الأقصر بمدينة طيبة الجديدة
   Origin = 25.749988, 32.778529  (compound centre; model x = east, -z = north; the whole model is turned -67° from the grid, as the real compound is)
   Location proven by: (1) Google Maps place «مدرية أمن الأقصر الجديدة» (PQXH+XFQ, 25.749968 N 32.778733 E, New Tiba) at the compound;
   (2) Esri Wayback + Google aerial history of the plot: empty plot (2021) -> structure with roof works (2022) -> complete building (2024).
   Compound is turned -67° from the grid (it follows the NE-SW highway on its east side); the whole model is turned the same way.
   Footprint traced on Google z20 imagery, which is near-nadir at this site (no façade visible), so roof outline = façade foot within ≈ 3 m.
   Wave 3: perimeter wall, 14 pyramid-roof bays (north strip + east block) and 4 glass space-frame pyramids added from the same tile (re-rotated by -67° so the
   compound axes are screen axes, 5.385 px/m); north palm row moved to the real verge (z = -79). Storeys/heights still estimated: sun azimuth ≈ 135° is clear from the
   shadows but the capture time is unknown, so shadow lengths cannot be converted to heights.
   Exterior massing only; storeys/heights estimated; no OSM building outline exists for this site; roof plant read on the aerial image.
*/
/* ---- shared builder (inlined in every model file) ---- */
function buildSite(K, S) {
  const T = THREE, acc = {};
  const add = (m, g) => { (acc[m] = acc[m] || []).push(g); };
  const area = p => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { const q = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; a += p[i][0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[i][1]; } return a / 2; };
  const inset = (p, d) => {
    const s = area(p) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = p.length, L = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = p[i], b = p[(i + 1) % n], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (len < 1e-6) continue;
      L.push({ x: a[0] - dz / len * s * d, z: a[1] + dx / len * s * d, dx: dx / len, dz: dz / len }); }
    const o = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { const A = L[(i + L.length - 1) % L.length], B = L[i], cr = A.dx * B.dz - A.dz * B.dx;
      if (Math.abs(cr) < 1e-6) { o.push([B.x, B.z]); continue; }
      const t = ((B.x - A.x) * B.dz - (B.z - A.z) * B.dx) / cr; o.push([A.x + A.dx * t, A.z + A.dz * t]); }
    return o;
  };
  const gExt = (pts, h, y, holes) => {
    const s = new T.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
    (holes || []).forEach(hp => { const hh = new T.Path(); hp.forEach((p, i) => (i ? hh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : hh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); s.holes.push(hh); });
    const g = new T.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 10 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y || 0, 0); return g;
  };
  const rect = (x0, z0, x1, z1) => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x0, z1]];
  const gBox = (x0, z0, x1, z1, h, y) => gExt(rect(x0, z0, x1, z1), h, y);
  const gCyl = (r, h, x, y, z, seg, rt) => new T.CylinderGeometry(rt === undefined ? r : rt, r, h, seg || 14).translate(x, y + h / 2, z);
  const rr = (x0, z0, x1, z1, r, n) => { const o = [], q = n || 7; const c = [[x1 - r, z0 + r, -90], [x1 - r, z1 - r, 0], [x0 + r, z1 - r, 90], [x0 + r, z0 + r, 180]];
    c.forEach(k => { for (let i = 0; i <= q; i++) { const a = (k[2] + 90 * i / q) * Math.PI / 180; o.push([k[0] + r * Math.cos(a), k[1] + r * Math.sin(a)]); } }); return o; };
  const flush = () => { Object.keys(acc).forEach(m => {
    const gs = acc[m].map(g => (g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g)); let n = 0; gs.forEach(g => (n += g.attributes.position.count));
    const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), nor = new Float32Array(n * 3); let o = 0;
    gs.forEach(g => { pos.set(g.attributes.position.array, o * 3); nor.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o * 3); o += g.attributes.position.count; });
    const r = new T.BufferGeometry(); r.setAttribute('position', new T.BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); r.setAttribute('normal', new T.BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
    const col = m.charAt(0) === '#' ? parseInt(m.slice(1), 16) : m; K.mesh(r, col); }); };

  const C = S.col;
  K.group(() => {
    /* ---- ground ---- */
    (S.ground || []).forEach(g => { const p = g.rr ? rr(g.rr[0], g.rr[1], g.rr[2], g.rr[3], g.rr[4]) : g.pts; add(g.c, gExt(p, g.th || 0.15, g.y || 0, g.holes)); });
    if (S.palms) K.palms(S.palms, 9);
    /* ---- buildings: floor slabs + dark glazing core + roof slab with open light-wells ---- */
    (S.blds || []).forEach(b => {
      const fl = b.fl || 3.8, H = b.h, wells = (b.wells || []).map(w => rect(w[0], w[1], w[2], w[3]));
      const core = inset(b.pts, b.inset || 0.35);
      add(C.glass, gExt(core, H - 0.8, b.y || 0));
      add(C.slab, gExt(b.pts, 0.8, (b.y || 0)));
      for (let y = fl; y < H - 1; y += fl) add(C.slab, gExt(b.pts, 0.55, (b.y || 0) + y - 0.3));
      add(C.roof, gExt(b.pts, 0.8, (b.y || 0) + H - 0.8, wells));
      if (b.parapet !== false) { /* parapet ring */ const pi = inset(b.pts, 0.5); add(C.slab, gExt(b.pts, 0.9, (b.y || 0) + H, [pi])); }
    });
    (S.boxes || []).forEach(b => { const y = b.y || 0; add(b.c || C.slab, gBox(b.b[0], b.b[1], b.b[2], b.b[3], b.h, y)); if (b.cap) add(C.roof, gBox(b.b[0] - 0.4, b.b[1] - 0.4, b.b[2] + 0.4, b.b[3] + 0.4, 0.5, y + b.h)); });
    (S.plant || []).forEach(p => add(C.plant, gBox(p[0], p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4] || 1.4, p[5])));
    (S.pads || []).forEach(p => add(p.c, gExt(p.pts, p.th || 0.1, p.y || 0)));
    (S.wellsDark || []).forEach(w => add(C.dark, gBox(w[0], w[1], w[2], w[3], 0.1, w[4])));
    (S.pods || []).forEach(p => { add(C.slab, gCyl(1.9, 3.4, p[0], 0, p[1], 12)); add(C.roof, gCyl(2.4, 0.5, p[0], 3.4, p[1], 12)); add(C.glass, gCyl(1.95, 1.6, p[0], 1.2, p[1], 12)); });
    (S.cyls || []).forEach(c => add(c.c, gCyl(c.r, c.h, c.x, c.y || 0, c.z, c.seg || 16, c.rt)));
    if (S.extra) S.extra(K, { inset, area, add, gExt });
    flush();
    (S.rings || []).forEach(r => K.torus(r.R, r.t, r.c, r.x, r.y, r.z));
  }, 0, 1.2, 0, -(S.rot || 0) * Math.PI / 180);
  return K.root;
}

    for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { const A = L[(i + L.length - 1) % L.length], B = L[i], cr = A.dx * B.dz - A.dz * B.dx;
      if (Math.abs(cr) < 1e-6) { o.push([B.x, B.z]); continue; }
      const t = ((B.x - A.x) * B.dz - (B.z - A.z) * B.dx) / cr; o.push([A.x + A.dx * t, A.z + A.dz * t]); }
    return o;
  };
  const gExt = (pts, h, y, holes) => {
    const s = new T.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
    (holes || []).forEach(hp => { const hh = new T.Path(); hp.forEach((p, i) => (i ? hh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : hh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); s.holes.push(hh); });
    const g = new T.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 10 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y || 0, 0); return g;
  };
  const rect = (x0, z0, x1, z1) => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x0, z1]];
  const gBox = (x0, z0, x1, z1, h, y) => gExt(rect(x0, z0, x1, z1), h, y);
  const gCyl = (r, h, x, y, z, seg, rt) => new T.CylinderGeometry(rt === undefined ? r : rt, r, h, seg || 14).translate(x, y + h / 2, z);
  const rr = (x0, z0, x1, z1, r, n) => { const o = [], q = n || 7; const c = [[x1 - r, z0 + r, -90], [x1 - r, z1 - r, 0], [x0 + r, z1 - r, 90], [x0 + r, z0 + r, 180]];
    c.forEach(k => { for (let i = 0; i <= q; i++) { const a = (k[2] + 90 * i / q) * Math.PI / 180; o.push([k[0] + r * Math.cos(a), k[1] + r * Math.sin(a)]); } }); return o; };
  const flush = () => { Object.keys(acc).forEach(m => {
    const gs = acc[m].map(g => (g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g)); let n = 0; gs.forEach(g => (n += g.attributes.position.count));

    const col = m.charAt(0) === '#' ? parseInt(m.slice(1), 16) : m; K.mesh(r, col); }); };

  const C = S.col;
  K.group(() => {
    /* ---- ground ---- */
    (S.ground || []).forEach(g => { const p = g.rr ? rr(g.rr[0], g.rr[1], g.rr[2], g.rr[3], g.rr[4]) : g.pts; add(g.c, gExt(p, g.th || 0.15, g.y || 0, g.holes)); });
    if (S.palms) K.palms(S.palms, 9);
    /* ---- buildings: floor slabs + dark glazing core + roof slab with open light-wells ---- */
    (S.blds || []).forEach(b => {
      const fl = b.fl || 3.8, H = b.h, wells = (b.wells || []).map(w => rect(w[0], w[1], w[2], w[3]));
      const core = inset(b.pts, b.inset || 0.35);
      add(C.glass, gExt(core, H - 0.8, b.y || 0));
      add(C.slab, gExt(b.pts, 0.8, (b.y || 0)));
      for (let y = fl; y < H - 1; y += fl) add(C.slab, gExt(b.pts, 0.55, (b.y || 0) + y - 0.3));
      add(C.roof, gExt(b.pts, 0.8, (b.y || 0) + H - 0.8, wells));
      if (b.parapet !== false) { /* parapet ring */ const pi = inset(b.pts, 0.5); add(C.slab, gExt(b.pts, 0.9, (b.y || 0) + H, [pi])); }
    });
    (S.boxes || []).forEach(b => { const y = b.y || 0; add(b.c || C.slab, gBox(b.b[0], b.b[1], b.b[2], b.b[3], b.h, y)); if (b.cap) add(C.roof, gBox(b.b[0] - 0.4, b.b[1] - 0.4, b.b[2] + 0.4, b.b[3] + 0.4, 0.5, y + b.h)); });
    (S.plant || []).forEach(p => add(C.plant, gBox(p[0], p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4] || 1.4, p[5])));
    (S.pads || []).forEach(p => add(p.c, gExt(p.pts, p.th || 0.1, p.y || 0)));
    (S.wellsDark || []).forEach(w => add(C.dark, gBox(w[0], w[1], w[2], w[3], 0.1, w[4])));
    (S.pods || []).forEach(p => { add(C.slab, gCyl(1.9, 3.4, p[0], 0, p[1], 12)); add(C.roof, gCyl(2.4, 0.5, p[0], 3.4, p[1], 12)); add(C.glass, gCyl(1.95, 1.6, p[0], 1.2, p[1], 12)); });
    (S.cyls || []).forEach(c => add(c.c, gCyl(c.r, c.h, c.x, c.y || 0, c.z, c.seg || 16, c.rt)));
    if (S.extra) S.extra(K, { inset, area, add, gExt });
    flush();
    (S.rings || []).forEach(r => K.torus(r.R, r.t, r.c, r.x, r.y, r.z));
  }, 0, 1.2, 0, -(S.rot || 0) * Math.PI / 180);
  return K.root;
}

function buildSite(K, S) {
  const T = THREE, acc = {};
  const add = (m, g) => { (acc[m] = acc[m] || []).push(g); };
