/* ================= architectural models: metre-based modules placed on the map =================
   A module (iconic-tower-model.js, gem-model.js …) builds its building in true metres around a WGS84 anchor: X east, Y up, Z south.
   It knows nothing about this map. This file only places it:
     · the anchor goes through the map's own projection (lonX / latZ);
     · one metre becomes map units with the same factors the street tiles use, so the model lines up with the OSM streets and neighbours.
       Heights use M2U exactly like every OSM building. East-west the map is an equirectangular grid tuned to 27°N, so at other latitudes it draws
       everything a little wider than true (about 2% at Cairo): that stretch belongs to the map and is applied here, never baked into the model.
   The OSM mass standing on the same footprint is left out of the street tier (and of the site highlight), so there are never two overlapping buildings. */
const MODELS3D = [], M3_NIGHT = new THREE.Color(0x2f6fd0).convertSRGBToLinear().multiplyScalar(0.5);
const models3dG = new THREE.Group(); models3dG.visible = false; scene.add(models3dG);
const M_PER_LAT = lat => 111132.95 - 559.82 * Math.cos(2 * lat * Math.PI / 180) + 1.175 * Math.cos(4 * lat * Math.PI / 180);
const M_PER_LON = lat => 111412.84 * Math.cos(lat * Math.PI / 180) - 93.5 * Math.cos(3 * lat * Math.PI / 180);
/* The city-glow lamps (point lights hung over Cairo, Alexandria, Luxor and Sharm to warm the terrain from afar) would flood a model standing right under them:
   a flat blue or orange cast that depends on where the building is, hiding its own colours and detail. Models are lit by the sky and the two suns only,
   so a building looks the same wherever it stands. */
const M3_HEMI = {value: 1};      /* share of the sky light a model takes: below 1 the sun models its faces more strongly, so openings, steps and cornices read */
const M3_LOOK = {twin: {k: 0.3, cool: 0.3}, sand: {k: 0.45, cool: 0}};      /* modules that bring only daylight colours: how far they are held back, and how far cooled toward the night palette, in each look */
const M3_NOPOINT = (() => { const c = THREE.ShaderChunk.lights_fragment_begin, a = c.indexOf("#if ( NUM_POINT_LIGHTS > 0 ) && defined( RE_Direct )"), b = c.indexOf("#if ( NUM_SPOT_LIGHTS > 0 ) && defined( RE_Direct )"); if (a < 0 || b <= a) return null;
  return (c.slice(0, a) + c.slice(b)).replace("irradiance += getHemisphereLightIrradiance( hemisphereLights[ i ], geometry );", "irradiance += uM3Hemi * getHemisphereLightIrradiance( hemisphereLights[ i ], geometry );"); })();
function model3dLight(t){ if (!M3_NOPOINT || !t || !t.isMeshStandardMaterial || t.m3np) return; t.m3np = true; const prev = t.onBeforeCompile;
  t.onBeforeCompile = (sh, r) => { if (prev) prev(sh, r); sh.uniforms.uM3Hemi = M3_HEMI; sh.fragmentShader = "uniform float uM3Hemi;\n" + sh.fragmentShader.replace("#include <lights_fragment_begin>", M3_NOPOINT); };
  t.customProgramCacheKey = () => "m3np"; t.needsUpdate = true; }
function model3dAdd(def){
  const lib = def.lib; if (!lib || !lib.create) return null;
  /* a module may carry its own anchor and footprint (iconic-tower-model.js, gem-model.js) or leave them to the caller (def.anchor, def.footprint) */
  const a = def.anchor || lib.anchor || (def.map === false ? {longitude: 31, latitude: 27} : null); if (!a) return null;
  const m = Object.assign({h: null, idle: 0, night: null, fade: -1, acc: -1, accHex: -1}, def);
  m.x = lonX(a.longitude); m.z = latZ(a.latitude);
  m.sx = (lonX(a.longitude + 1e-3) - m.x) / (1e-3 * M_PER_LON(a.latitude));       /* map units per metre east */
  m.sz = (latZ(a.latitude - 1e-3) - m.z) / (1e-3 * M_PER_LAT(a.latitude));        /* map units per metre south */
  m.map = def.map !== false;                                   /* false: used by the project simulation only, never placed on the true-scale map */
  m.ring = def.footprint || lib.footprint || null; m.hM = def.height || lib.height || 40;
  m.rM = def.radius || lib.radius || (m.ring ? Math.max(...m.ring.map(q => Math.hypot(q[0], q[1]))) : 60);          /* modules that state no size: the reach of their footprint */
  MODELS3D.push(m); return m;
}
/* is this map point (the centroid of an OSM building) on the footprint of a model? then the OSM mass is not drawn */
function model3dCovers(x, z){
  for (const m of MODELS3D) { if (!m.map) continue; const e = (x - m.x) / m.sx, n = -(z - m.z) / m.sz;
    if (m.mask) { if (m.mask(e, n)) return true; continue; }
    if (!m.ring) { if (e * e + n * n < m.rM * m.rM) return true; continue; }
    let c = false; const r = m.ring; for (let i = 0, j = r.length - 1; i < r.length; j = i++) { if ((r[i][1] > n) !== (r[j][1] > n) && e < (r[j][0] - r[i][0]) * (n - r[i][1]) / (r[j][1] - r[i][1]) + r[i][0]) c = !c; }
    if (c) return true;
    /* parts mapped separately but standing against the outline (an entrance canopy, a porch) belong to the same building */
    const tol = m.cover == null ? 6 : m.cover; for (let i = 0, j = r.length - 1; i < r.length; j = i++) { const ax = r[j][0], ay = r[j][1], bx = r[i][0] - ax, by = r[i][1] - ay, t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((e - ax) * bx + (n - ay) * by) / (bx * bx + by * by || 1)));
      if (Math.hypot(e - ax - bx * t, n - ay - by * t) < tol) return true; } }
  return false;
}
function model3dBuild(m){
  m.h = m.lib.create(THREE, m.opts || {});
  /* modules that return only {group, dispose}: collect their materials here, so the fade and the disposal still reach them */
  if (!m.h.materials || Array.isArray(m.h.materials)) { const set = new Set(); m.h.group.traverse(o => { if (o.material) (Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]).forEach(t => set.add(t)); }); m.h.materials = Object.fromEntries([...set].map((t, i) => [t.name || "m" + i, t])); }
  const g = m.h.group; g.position.set(m.x, H - (m.sink || 0) * M2U, m.z); g.scale.set(m.sx, M2U, m.sz);
  /* drawn with the street tier: same fade, same fog, same draw order as the OSM buildings around it */
  g.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.renderOrder = 3; o.castShadow = o.receiveShadow = false; } });
  Object.values(m.h.materials).forEach(model3dLight);
  m.base = Object.values(m.h.materials).map(t => t.color ? t.color.clone() : null);          /* the module's own daylight colours */
  models3dG.add(g); m.night = null; m.fade = -1; m.acc = -1;
}
function model3dDrop(m){ if (!m.h) return; if (m.holo) { m.holo.dispose(); m.holo = null; } models3dG.remove(m.h.group); m.h.dispose(); m.h = null; }
const M3_MAX = 14; let m3BuiltAt = 0;
function updateModels3d(dt){
  const on = cityGroup.visible, fade = CU.uFade.value; models3dG.visible = on;
  if (typeof HOLO !== "undefined") HOLO.uT.value += dt;
  /* models near the look-at point are built, one at a time and never more than M3_MAX at once (a city can hold dozens); the farthest gives way to a nearer one */
  const R = clamp(ZS.d * 2.5, 0.3, 1.6), now = performance.now(); let built = 0, far = null, want = null;
  for (const m of MODELS3D) { if (!m.map) continue; m.dist = Math.hypot(controls.target.x - m.x, controls.target.z - m.z); if (m.h) { built++; if (!far || m.dist > far.dist) far = m; } else if (on && m.dist < R && (!want || m.dist < want.dist)) want = m; }
  if (want && now - m3BuiltAt > 140) { if (built >= M3_MAX && far && far.dist > want.dist && !(sim.on && sim.pi >= 0 && P[sim.pi].i === far.pi)) { model3dDrop(far); built--; } if (built < M3_MAX) { m3BuiltAt = now; model3dBuild(want); } }
  /* the map's own massing around a standing model is cleared (up to four models at once, nearest first), so no neighbouring block ever stands in front of it */
  { const cl = CU.uMdl.value, lst = on ? MODELS3D.filter(q => q.map && q.h && q.dist < R).sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist) : [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const q = lst[i]; if (q) cl[i].set(q.x, q.z, Math.max(q.rM * 1.15, 45) * Math.max(q.sx, q.sz)); else cl[i].set(0, 0, 0); } }
  /* focus: when the camera is close to one model, any other model standing between the camera and it (or enclosing it) is dimmed away so it never hides the focused model's details */
  { let foc = null, fc = 1e9;
    if (on) for (const q of MODELS3D) { if (!q.map || !q.h) continue; const r = q.rM * Math.max(q.sx, q.sz), d = Math.hypot(controls.target.x - q.x, controls.target.z - q.z); if (d < r * 1.3 && d / r < fc) { fc = d / r; foc = q; } }
    const cp = camera.position; let fr = 0;
    if (foc) { fr = foc.rM * Math.max(foc.sx, foc.sz); if (Math.hypot(cp.x - foc.x, cp.y - H, cp.z - foc.z) > Math.max(model3dFit(foc) * 3, fr * 3)) foc = null; }
    for (const q of MODELS3D) { if (!q.map) continue; let tg = 1;
      if (foc && q !== foc) { const ax = cp.x, az = cp.z, bx = foc.x - ax, bz = foc.z - az, t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((q.x - ax) * bx + (q.z - az) * bz) / (bx * bx + bz * bz || 1))), dd = Math.hypot(q.x - ax - bx * t, q.z - az - bz * t);
        if (dd < q.rM * Math.max(q.sx, q.sz) * 0.95 + fr * 0.15) tg = 0; }
      q.dim = (q.dim == null ? 1 : q.dim) + (tg - (q.dim == null ? 1 : q.dim)) * Math.min(1, dt * 5); } }
  for (const m of MODELS3D) {
    if (!m.map) continue;
    const near = on && m.dist < R;
    if (!near || !m.h) { m.idle += dt; if (m.h && m.idle > 20) model3dDrop(m); if (m.h) m.h.group.visible = on && m.dim > 0.03; continue; }
    m.idle = 0;
    m.h.group.visible = m.dim > 0.03;
    const night = S.theme === "twin"; if (night !== m.night) { m.night = night; const tintAll = HOLO.mode === "tint"; if (m.h.setNight) m.h.setNight(tintAll ? false : night); m.acc = -1; if ((m.key && m.key.startsWith("wsm")) || tintAll) egmHolo(m, night);
      /* modules that bring only daylight colours (the lab's): held back so they do not burn out under the map's lights, and cooled toward the night palette on the digital map */
      if (!m.ownLook) Object.values(m.h.materials).forEach((t, i) => { if (!m.base[i]) return; const L = M3_LOOK[night ? "twin" : "sand"]; t.color.copy(m.base[i]).multiplyScalar(L.k); if (L.cool) t.color.lerp(M3_NIGHT, L.cool); }); }
    /* the project standing on this site is selected: the tower takes the sector colour like the buildings around it */
    let k = 0, hex = 0; if (sim.on && sim.real && sim.pi >= 0 && CU.uHiK.value > 0.01 && Math.hypot(sim.site.x - m.x, sim.site.z - m.z) < ((GEO[P[sim.pi].i] || {}).m || 600) * 0.55 * M2U) { k = Math.round(CU.uHiK.value * CU.uGrow.value * 20) / 20 * 0.55; hex = SECC[sim.sc]; }
    if (m.h.setAccent && (k !== m.acc || hex !== m.accHex)) { m.acc = k; m.accHex = hex; m.h.setAccent(hex, k); }
    const f = Math.round(fade * m.dim * 50) / 50; if (f !== m.fade) { m.fade = f; if (m.holo && night) m.holo.fade(f); for (const n in m.h.materials) { const t = m.h.materials[n]; t.opacity = f; t.transparent = f < 0.99; } }
  }
}
/* camera positions that show the whole model: "hero" (three-quarter), "entrance" (looking along the slot / main axis), "side", "top" */
function model3dView(key, view){
  const m = MODELS3D.find(q => q.key === key); if (!m) return null;
  const hU = m.hM * M2U, t = new THREE.Vector3(m.x, H + hU * 0.5, m.z), d = model3dFit(m);
  /* bearing the camera stands at, clockwise from north; the axis of the model (its entrance side) comes from the module */
  const ax = m.axis == null ? 0 : m.axis, V = {hero: [ax - 38, 1.18], entrance: [ax, 1.3], side: [ax - 90, 1.3], top: [ax, 0.085], far: [ax - 38, 1.05]}[view || "hero"] || [ax - 38, 1.18];
  const b = V[0] * Math.PI / 180, phi = V[1], dd = view === "top" ? d * 1.5 : view === "far" ? d * 5 : d;
  const p = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(b) * Math.sin(phi), Math.cos(phi), -Math.cos(b) * Math.sin(phi)).multiplyScalar(dd).add(t);
  return {p, t};
}
/* the distance from which the whole building (a sphere around it) fits the free part of the screen */
function model3dFit(m){
  const hU = m.hM * M2U, rU = m.rM * M2U, R = Math.hypot(hU / 2, rU) * 1.08, asp = Math.min(1, (FREE.x1 - FREE.x0) / Math.max(1, FREE.y1 - FREE.y0));
  return R / Math.sin(camera.fov * Math.PI / 360) / Math.max(0.45, asp) * 1.12;
}
/* showing a model on the map: the camera comes down to drone height and close, never more than M3_ALT metres above the ground.
   The look-at point stays on the model's axis; the distance fits the width of the model in the free part of the screen (wide sites are entered rather
   than seen from afar: from this height a far site is only a thin line) and, for a model taller than the camera, its whole height. th: spherical theta. */
const M3_ALT = 50, M3_FAR = 320, M3_NEAR = 110, M3_POLAR = 1.95;
/* the built core of a model: centre and radius (metres, east and south of the model's origin) of what stands well above the ground,
   so that a palace is framed and not its garden wall. Measured once from the built model. */
function model3dCore(m){
  if (m.core) return m.core; if (!m.h) { try { model3dBuild(m); m.idle = 0; } catch (e) { return {x: 0, z: 0, r: m.rM, h: m.hM}; } }      /* asked for before the camera is near: built now, so the first view is already the close one */
  const g = m.h.group, inv = new THREE.Matrix4(), mt = new THREE.Matrix4(), v = new THREE.Vector3(), y0 = (m.sink || 0) + 1.5, all = [];
  g.updateMatrixWorld(true); inv.copy(g.matrixWorld).invert();
  g.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh || o.isInstancedMesh || !o.visible || !o.geometry || !o.geometry.attributes.position) return;
    const a = o.geometry.attributes.position, st = Math.max(1, Math.floor(a.count / 3000)); mt.multiplyMatrices(inv, o.matrixWorld);
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i += st) { v.fromBufferAttribute(a, i).applyMatrix4(mt); if (v.y > y0) all.push(v.x, v.z, v.y - (m.sink || 0)); } });
  return m.core = model3dCoreOf(all, m.hM, m.rM);
}
/* all: x, z, height of points of the model above its ground. The bulk height is the level nine tenths of them stay under (one mast or control tower
   does not set the framing of a whole terminal); the core is what rises above a third of that. */
function model3dCoreOf(all, hM, rM){
  if (all.length < 24) return {x: 0, z: 0, r: rM, h: hM};
  const hs = []; for (let i = 2; i < all.length; i += 3) hs.push(all[i]); hs.sort((p, q) => p - q); const hb = hs[Math.floor(hs.length * 0.9)], thr = Math.max(4, hb * 0.35);
  let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, z0 = 1e9, z1 = -1e9, n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i += 3) if (all[i + 2] > thr) { n++; x0 = Math.min(x0, all[i]); x1 = Math.max(x1, all[i]); z0 = Math.min(z0, all[i + 1]); z1 = Math.max(z1, all[i + 1]); }
  if (n < 8) return {x: 0, z: 0, r: rM, h: hM};
  const cx = (x0 + x1) / 2, cz = (z0 + z1) / 2; let r = 0; for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i += 3) if (all[i + 2] > thr) r = Math.max(r, Math.hypot(all[i] - cx, all[i + 1] - cz));
  return {x: cx, z: cz, r: clamp(r, 12, Math.max(12, rM)), h: clamp(Math.max(hb, hM * 0.6), 1, hM)};
}
/* true while the open project is being shown as its model on the map (surface map, a model standing at its site) */
function m3LowView(){ return sim.on && sim.pi >= 0 && S.mode !== "layers" && !!model3dOfProject(sim.pi); }
/* Bird view (asked for on 6 Oct, replaces the 50 m drone rule): a model on the map is always looked at from above, at M3_EL above the horizon,
   from as near as shows its whole built mass with the ring of fact cards that circles it. The height follows the size of the site, so wide sites show whole. */
const M3_BIRD = 0.84, M3_EL = 0.94;                       /* ≈ 54° above the horizon */
function model3dRing(c){ return Math.max(c.r * 1.12 + 12, 45); }      /* radius (m) of the card ring round a model's built mass */
function model3dLow(m, th){
  const tv = Math.tan(camera.fov * Math.PI / 360), fw = Math.max(240, FREE.x1 - FREE.x0), fh = Math.max(200, FREE.y1 - FREE.y0), c = model3dCore(m), Rr = globalThis.__ohWheel ? ohRingM(m) * 1.75 : model3dRing(c), se = Math.sin(M3_EL), ce = Math.cos(M3_EL);
  /* a project that carries photos has a second, higher and wider ring of picture cards: the frame opens up to hold it whole */
  const med = !globalThis.__ohWheel && (((typeof EG_MEDIA_IN !== "undefined" && EG_MEDIA_IN[m.pi]) || []).length + ((window.EG_MEDIA && window.EG_MEDIA[m.pi]) || []).length) > 0, R2 = med ? 1.17 : 1, top = med ? 1.56 : 0.86;
  const Dw = Rr * R2 * 1.16 / (tv * fw / Hh), Dv = Math.max(Rr * (2 * se + 1.45 * ce) / (2 * tv * fh / Hh * 0.9), med ? Rr * (R2 * se + top / 2 * ce) * 1.12 / (tv * fh / Hh * 0.9) : 0), Dh = (c.h * 1.05 * ce + 2 * c.r * se) / (2 * tv * fh / Hh * 0.86);
  const D = Math.max(M3_NEAR, Dw, Dv, Dh), yT = med ? Math.max(c.h * 0.4, Rr * top / 2) : Math.min(Math.max(c.h * 0.4, Rr * 0.3), Math.max(m.hM || 0, Rr * 0.3));
  const tx = m.x + c.x * m.sx, tz = m.z + c.z * m.sz;
  const t = new THREE.Vector3(tx, H + yT * M2U, tz), p = new THREE.Vector3(tx + Math.sin(th) * D * ce * M2U, H + (yT + D * se) * M2U, tz + Math.cos(th) * D * ce * M2U);
  return {p, t, th, d: p.distanceTo(t), phi: Math.PI / 2 - M3_EL, lift: yT * M2U, whole: true};
}

function model3dMats(h){ if (h.materials && !Array.isArray(h.materials)) return Object.values(h.materials); const set = new Set(); h.group.traverse(o => { if (o.material) (Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]).forEach(t => set.add(t)); }); return [...set]; }
function model3dSimBuild(m, sc){
  m.sc = sc;
  const h = m.lib.create(THREE, Object.assign({landscape: false}, m.opts || {})), mats = model3dMats(h);
  h.group.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  /* bounds of what is actually drawn (hidden parts such as a switched-off landscape do not count) */
  const box = new THREE.Box3(), tb = new THREE.Box3(); if (h.box) box.copy(h.box); else (function walk(o){ if (!o.visible) return; if (o.geometry) { if (!o.geometry.boundingBox) o.geometry.computeBoundingBox(); box.union(tb.copy(o.geometry.boundingBox).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld)); } o.children.forEach(walk); })(h.group);
  const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()), c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  /* the pedestal is 4.6 units across: the model keeps its own proportions and is scaled as a whole to stand on it */
  const s = Math.min(4.3 / Math.max(Math.hypot(size.x, size.z), 1), 3.3 / Math.max(size.y, 1)), fit = new THREE.Group();
  h.group.position.set(-c.x, -box.min.y, -c.z); fit.add(h.group); fit.position.y = 0.05; fit.scale.set(s, s * 0.002, s);
  /* on the dark sector plate the daylight colours would burn out under the bloom: the same materials, held back and lifted a little by the sector colour */
  const tint = new THREE.Color(SECC[m.sc == null ? 0 : m.sc]).convertSRGBToLinear();
  mats.forEach(model3dLight);
  mats.forEach(t => { t.transparent = true; t.depthWrite = true; if (t.color) t.color.multiplyScalar(m.simTone || 0.42); if (t.emissive && t.emissiveIntensity <= 0.1) { t.emissive.copy(tint).multiplyScalar(0.07); t.emissiveIntensity = 1; } }); fit.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.renderOrder = 4; o.castShadow = o.receiveShadow = false; } });
  if (h.setNight) h.setNight(false);
  return {h, fit, s, mats, ws: !!m.ws};
}

/* Every ready workshop model with a stated origin stands on the map itself: the model workshop is the single source, and ws_map.py turns its models into
   the EGM_MAP table (ws/egm-map.js). Each row: [project id, latitude and longitude of the model origin (as the workshop states it), half-extent of its
   footprint grid in metres, grid size, height, radius, completion %, footprint grid (bits, row 0 = north), base y, built core x, z, radius, height].
   The model's own ground, roads and water are cut away (a clipping plane at map ground level, the model sunk by the same amount), so only what is built
   stands on the map's own streets; the OSM masses under its footprint grid are left out. A workshop model replaces any earlier module of the same project,
   and the generic pyramid landmarks give way to the Giza and Djoser models. Where two models cover the same ground (a district and a mosque inside it),
   the smaller, more specific one stands and the larger leaves out its own parts there. */

      else { gb.getCenter(c).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld); if (inside(c.x, c.z, span)) o.visible = false; } }); }

/* ---- hologram look (digital map only): translucent glass volumes with glowing edges, as in the reference renders. The sand map keeps the model's own colours.
   Each part now keeps its own colour through the glass (stone stays sand, a roof stays red, planting stays green) instead of one blue for everything: "tint" (default).
   ?holo=mono is the earlier single-blue look, ?holo=real the model's own lit materials with fine edges. ---- */
const HOLO = {uT: {value: 0}, fillA: 0.2, lineA: 0.8, tintA: 0.62, mode: QS.get("holo") || "tint"};
const holoFrag = hue => sh => "varying float vHy; uniform float uH; uniform float uT;\n" + sh.replace("#include <color_fragment>", "#include <color_fragment>\n float hh = clamp(vHy / uH, 0.0, 1.0); diffuseColor.a *= mix(" + (hue ? "1.7, 0.75" : "1.18, 0.86") + ", hh) * (0.88 + 0.12 * sin(vHy * 0.45 - uT * 2.2));" + (hue ? " diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, diffuseColor.rgb * vec3(0.55, 1.5, 1.7), hh * 0.5);" : " diffuseColor.rgb *= mix(0.9, 1.14, hh);"));
function holoGlass(color, opacity, clip, uH, uT, hue){
  const fill = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color, transparent: true, opacity, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.FrontSide, clippingPlanes: clip || null}), fr = holoFrag(hue);
  fill.onBeforeCompile = sh => { sh.uniforms.uH = uH; sh.uniforms.uT = uT; sh.vertexShader = "varying float vHy;\n" + sh.vertexShader.replace("#include <begin_vertex>", "#include <begin_vertex>\n vHy = position.y;"); sh.fragmentShader = fr(sh.fragmentShader); };
  fill.customProgramCacheKey = () => "holo" + (hue ? 1 : 0);
  return fill;
}
/* the glass and edge colours of one part, read from its own material: the hue is kept, only lifted into the range that reads on the dark map (nothing left black, nothing burnt white) */
const holoHSL = {h: 0, s: 0, l: 0}, holoC = new THREE.Color();
function holoTint(mat){
  const m0 = Array.isArray(mat) ? mat[0] : mat, c = m0 && m0.color ? holoC.copy(m0.color).convertLinearToSRGB() : holoC.set(0x8fb4e8); c.getHSL(holoHSL);
  let h = holoHSL.h, sa = holoHSL.s, l = holoHSL.l;
  if (sa < 0.08) { h = 0.59; sa = 0.16; }                       /* concrete, white and grey: a faint cool cast so they sit in the digital palette */
  else sa = clamp(sa * 1.3 + 0.08, 0, 0.92);
  const fl = clamp(0.3 + l * 0.48, 0.3, 0.74);
  return {fill: new THREE.Color().setHSL(h, sa, fl).convertSRGBToLinear(), line: new THREE.Color().setHSL(h, clamp(sa * 0.85, 0, 0.8), clamp(fl + 0.24, 0.66, 0.92)).convertSRGBToLinear(), key: Math.round(h * 60) + "_" + Math.round(sa * 20) + "_" + Math.round(fl * 24)};
}
function egmHolo(m, on){
  const g = m.h.group;
  if (!m.holo) {
    const lin = x => new THREE.Color(x).convertSRGBToLinear(), clip = m.h.clip || null, uH = {value: Math.max(10, m.hM || 40)}, mode = HOLO.mode;
    /* glass and edges are blended normally, not added: where many faces and lines overlap (a carved facade seen from near) they settle on the glass colour and the edge tint instead of burning to white, so the detail stays readable */
    const fill = holoGlass(lin(0x2a78e8), HOLO.fillA, clip, uH, HOLO.uT, true);
    const line = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: lin(0x6fd6ff), transparent: true, opacity: HOLO.lineA, depthWrite: false, clippingPlanes: clip});
    const fills = [fill], lines = [line], cache = {};
    /* ground plates, roads and lawns (flat and wide) stay thin glass, so the map under the model is never blacked out by a slab */
    g.updateMatrixWorld(true); const gs = g.getWorldScale(new THREE.Vector3()), tb = new THREE.Box3(), tv = new THREE.Vector3();
    const flat = o => { const gm = o.geometry; if (!gm || o.isInstancedMesh) return false; if (!gm.boundingBox) gm.boundingBox = new THREE.Box3().setFromBufferAttribute(gm.attributes.position); tb.copy(gm.boundingBox).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld).getSize(tv); const y = tv.y / gs.y, w = Math.max(tv.x / gs.x, tv.z / gs.z), n = Math.min(tv.x / gs.x, tv.z / gs.z); return !!(o.userData && o.userData.ground) || (y < 1.3 && w > 30) || (n > 60 && y < n * 0.05); };
    const pair = (mat, o) => { if (mode !== "tint") return {fill, line}; const t = holoTint(mat), gr = flat(o); if (gr) t.key += "g"; if (!cache[t.key]) { const f = holoGlass(t.fill, gr ? HOLO.fillA * 1.15 : HOLO.tintA, clip, uH, HOLO.uT, false); f.userData.g = gr; const l = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: t.line, transparent: true, opacity: HOLO.lineA, depthWrite: false, clippingPlanes: clip}); fills.push(f); lines.push(l); cache[t.key] = {fill: f, line: l}; } return cache[t.key]; };
    const meshes = []; g.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh && o.visible) meshes.push(o); });
    m.holo = {fill, line, fills, lines, items: [], k: 1, mode,
      fade(f){ const fa = (mode === "tint" ? HOLO.tintA : HOLO.fillA) * f, la = HOLO.lineA * this.k * (mode === "real" ? 0.45 : mode === "tint" ? 0.9 : 1) * f; fills.forEach(q => { q.opacity = q === fill ? HOLO.fillA * f : q.userData.g ? HOLO.fillA * 1.15 * f : fa; }); lines.forEach(q => { q.opacity = la; }); },
      dispose(){ fills.forEach(q => q.dispose()); lines.forEach(q => q.dispose()); this.items.forEach(q => q.ls && q.ls.geometry.dispose()); }};
    meshes.forEach(o => { let ls = null; const gm = o.geometry, pr = pair(o.material, o);
      if (!o.isInstancedMesh && gm && gm.attributes.position && gm.attributes.position.count < 150000) { ls = new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(gm, 26), pr.line); ls.renderOrder = 4; ls.frustumCulled = false; o.add(ls); }
      m.holo.items.push({o, orig: o.material, ls, glass: pr.fill}); });
    /* a district of hundreds of small blocks draws tens of thousands of edges: their lines are thinned out in strength, so the whole does not turn into one bright patch */
    { let seg = 0; m.holo.items.forEach(q => { if (q.ls) seg += q.ls.geometry.attributes.position.count / 2; }); m.holo.k = clamp(Math.sqrt(22000 / Math.max(1, seg)), 0.3, 1); }
  }
  const H0 = m.holo; H0.items.forEach(q => { q.o.material = on && H0.mode !== "real" ? q.glass : q.orig; if (q.ls) q.ls.visible = on; if (q.o.isMesh) q.o.renderOrder = 3; });
  if (on) H0.fade(m.fade < 0 ? 1 : m.fade);
}

/* ================= orbit menu: the sectors as curved holographic screens standing on a ring around the country =================
   Each screen is a section of a cylinder facing the map. Screens on the far side of the ring face the camera and are readable;
   the ones between the camera and the map fade out so they never cover it. Clicking a screen selects its sector. */
const ORB = {R: RING_R + 1.4, y0: RING_Y + 0.9, h: 6.2, lean: 1.2, span: 0.56, n: SECS.length};
/* the screens are pieces of one cylinder around the ring: fixed to it, turning with it, never re-aimed at the camera */
const orbitGroup = new THREE.Group(); orbitGroup.position.set(EC.x, 0, EC.z); scene.add(orbitGroup);
/* each screen is centred over its sector's arc of the national ring (ring angle a ↔ cylinder angle PI/2 - a) */
const orbAng = s => Math.PI / 2 - ARC[s].mid;
const orbNow = s => orbAng(s) - ringRotNow();
const OCW = 1680, OCH = 560;
/* blocks of the screen's canvas [x0, y0, x1, y1] and how each one floats when the sector opens: depth toward the map, lift, sideways drift, delay */
const ORB_CARDS = [[880, 16, 1660, 176, 2.6, 0.55, -0.014, 0], [880, 192, 1660, 404, 4.6, 0.1, -0.024, 0.1], [880, 420, 1660, 544, 1.7, -0.4, -0.01, 0.2], [20, 16, 864, 404, 3.4, 0.3, 0.02, 0.06], [20, 420, 864, 544, 5.4, -0.55, 0.034, 0.16]];
const orbIcons = SECS.map((s, i) => { const im = new Image(); im.src = "data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="${SECC[i]}" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${ICON[i]}</svg>`); im.onload = () => { orbScr[i].sig = ""; }; return im; });
const orbScr = SECS.map((s, i) => {
  const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = OCW; cv.height = OCH;
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv); tex.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding; tex.anisotropy = Math.min(8, renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy()); tex.generateMipmaps = false; tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping; tex.repeat.x = -1; tex.offset.x = 1;          // read from inside the ring
  const a = orbAng(i), t0 = a - ORB.span / 2;
  const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(ORB.R + ORB.lean, ORB.R, ORB.h, 56, 1, true, t0, ORB.span).translate(0, ORB.y0 + ORB.h / 2, 0);
  /* from inside the ring (far side) the inner face shows; from outside (near side) the outer face shows: both read left to right.
     The same shader draws the whole screen and, when the sector is opened, each of its floating layers (a card is just a window on a part of the canvas). */
  const su = {uTime: U.uTime, uSeed: {value: i * 0.37}, uC: {value: new THREE.Color(SECC[i])}, uPulse: {value: 0}, uEx: {value: 0}};
  const mkMat = (rect, card) => { const m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, toneMapped: false, opacity: 0});
    const uu = Object.assign({uRect: {value: new THREE.Vector4(rect[0], rect[1], rect[2], rect[3])}, uCard: {value: card}}, su); m.extensions = {derivatives: true};
    m.onBeforeCompile = sh => { Object.assign(sh.uniforms, uu);
      sh.fragmentShader = sh.fragmentShader.replace("#include <common>", "#include <common>\nuniform float uTime; uniform float uSeed; uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uPulse; uniform float uEx; uniform vec4 uRect; uniform float uCard;")
        .replace("#include <map_fragment>", `vec2 uvq = gl_FrontFacing ? vec2(uRect.x + uRect.z - vUv.x, vUv.y) : vUv; vec4 texelColor = texture2D(map, uvq); texelColor = mapTexelToLinear(texelColor);
          vec2 lu = (uvq - uRect.xy) / (uRect.zw - uRect.xy);
          float keep = mix(1.0 - uEx, 1.0, uCard);                      /* opened: the screen hands its content to the layers and stays behind as bare glass */
          diffuseColor *= vec4(texelColor.rgb, texelColor.a * keep);
          /* a light sweep crossing the screen, fine scanlines and a soft edge glow that breathes */
          float sw = fract(uTime * 0.09 + uSeed); float band = smoothstep(0.06, 0.0, abs(uvq.x - (1.15 - sw * 1.3)));
          float scan = 0.94 + 0.06 * sin(uvq.y * 260.0 - uTime * 6.0);
          float edge = smoothstep(0.03, 0.0, min(min(lu.x, 1.0 - lu.x), min(lu.y, 1.0 - lu.y))) * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(uTime * 2.0 + uSeed * 9.0));
          diffuseColor.rgb = diffuseColor.rgb * scan + uC * (band * 0.22 + edge * 0.35 + uPulse * 0.12) * diffuseColor.a + vec3(band * 0.08) * diffuseColor.a;
          vec2 dl = min(lu, 1.0 - lu), fwl = max(fwidth(lu), vec2(1e-5)); float ln = 1.0 - smoothstep(1.0, 2.6, min(dl.x / fwl.x, dl.y / fwl.y));
          float gx = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.4, abs(fract(lu.x * 16.0) - 0.5) / max(fwidth(lu.x * 16.0), 1e-5)), gy = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.4, abs(fract(lu.y * 5.0) - 0.5) / max(fwidth(lu.y * 5.0), 1e-5));
          float bare = (1.0 - uCard) * uEx * opacity;                                 /* the glass left behind: a faint ruled pane */
          diffuseColor.rgb += uC * (bare * (0.05 + 0.2 * max(gx, gy)) + ln * uCard * uEx * opacity * 0.9);
          diffuseColor.a = max(diffuseColor.a, max(bare * (0.1 + 0.16 * max(gx, gy)), ln * uCard * uEx * opacity * 0.9));`); };
    return m; };
  const mat = mkMat([0, 0, 1, 1], 0);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); mesh.renderOrder = 9; mesh.userData.sec = i; orbitGroup.add(mesh);
  /* glowing frame: top and bottom arcs plus the two upright edges */
  const seg = 48, ring = r => { const out = []; for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) { const th = t0 + ORB.span * k / seg; out.push([Math.sin(th) * r, Math.cos(th) * r]); } return out; };
  const pb = ring(ORB.R), pt = ring(ORB.R + ORB.lean), fp = [];
  [[pb, ORB.y0], [pt, ORB.y0 + ORB.h]].forEach(([pp, y]) => { for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) fp.push(pp[k][0], y, pp[k][1], pp[k + 1][0], y, pp[k + 1][1]); });
  [0, seg].forEach(k => fp.push(pb[k][0], ORB.y0, pb[k][1], pt[k][0], ORB.y0 + ORB.h, pt[k][1]));
  const fg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); fg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(fp, 3));
  const fm = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: new THREE.Color(SECC[i]), transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending});
  const frame = new THREE.LineSegments(fg, fm); frame.renderOrder = 9; orbitGroup.add(frame);
  /* two short stems from the ring's dots up to the screen's lower corners, so the screen stands on its own arc */
  const sp = [];
  [t0 + 0.03, t0 + ORB.span - 0.03].forEach(th => sp.push(Math.sin(th) * RING_R, RING_Y + 0.15, Math.cos(th) * RING_R, Math.sin(th) * ORB.R, ORB.y0, Math.cos(th) * ORB.R));
  const sg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); sg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(sp, 3));
  const stem = new THREE.LineSegments(sg, fm); orbitGroup.add(stem);
  /* the layers: five curved cards cut from the same cylinder, each a window on its own block of the canvas; opening the sector floats them off the screen toward the map at different depths */
  const cards = ORB_CARDS.map(([x0, y0, x1, y1, depth, lift, spread, delay]) => {
    const cu0 = x0 / OCW, cu1 = x1 / OCW, vb = 1 - y1 / OCH, vt = 1 - y0 / OCH, f0 = 1 - cu1, f1 = 1 - cu0;
    const rb = ORB.R + ORB.lean * vb, rt = ORB.R + ORB.lean * vt, hc = (vt - vb) * ORB.h;
    const cg = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, hc, Math.max(8, Math.round(56 * (f1 - f0))), 1, true, t0 + f0 * ORB.span, (f1 - f0) * ORB.span).translate(0, ORB.y0 + (vb + vt) / 2 * ORB.h, 0);
    const uv = cg.attributes.uv; for (let q = 0; q < uv.count; q++) uv.setXY(q, f0 + uv.getX(q) * (f1 - f0), vb + uv.getY(q) * (vt - vb));
    const cm = mkMat([cu0, vb, cu1, vt], 1), m = new THREE.Mesh(cg, cm); m.renderOrder = 10; m.visible = false; orbitGroup.add(m);
    return {m, cm, depth, lift, spread, delay, ph: Math.random() * 6.28};
  });
  return {i, cv, tex, mesh, mat, frame, fm, stem, a, su, cards, ex: 0, vis: 0, hov: 0, sel: 0, sig: "", face: 0, an: 0, wasSel: false};
});

/* ---- drawing one screen: an infographic of the sector, all figures counted from the file ---- */
const orbFont = (w, px, fam) => `${w} ${px}px ${fam}`;
const F_LAT = EN ? '"Inter",' : "";   /* English mode: a Latin face in front of the Arabic ones */
const F_HEAD = F_LAT + '"Madani Arabic","Noto Kufi Arabic","Madani Arabic","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif', F_NUM = '"Oxanium","Madani Arabic","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif', F_BODY = F_LAT + '"Madani Arabic","IBM Plex Sans Arabic","Segoe UI",sans-serif';
function hexA(h, a){ const c = new THREE.Color(h); return `rgba(${Math.round(c.r * 255)},${Math.round(c.g * 255)},${Math.round(c.b * 255)},${a})`; }
function orbStats(s){
  const ids = []; for (let i = 0; i < NP; i++) if (P[i].sc === s && stat.vis[i]) ids.push(i);
  const st = [0, 0, 0], yrs = YEARS.map(() => 0), ms = {}, gv = new Set(); let nat = 0;
  P.forEach(p => { if (p.sc === s && fpass(p)) yrs[clamp(p.y, 2014, 2030) - 2014]++; });
  ids.forEach(i => { const p = P[i]; st[p.kd === "e" ? 2 : p.kd === "p" ? 1 : 0]++; ms[p.ms] = (ms[p.ms] || 0) + 1; p.g.forEach(g => gv.add(g)); if (p.nat) nat++; });
  const top = Object.entries(ms).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 3);
  return {n: ids.length, st, yrs, top, gov: gv.size, nat, total: SEC_TOTAL[s]};
}
function drawOrb(o, focus){
  const s = o.i, c = o.cv.getContext("2d"), col = SECC[s], d = orbStats(s), all = stat.secCnt.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1;
  const an = o.an, ez = t => { t = clamp(t, 0, 1); return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }, A = k => ez((an - k) / 0.55);   /* staged intro: k is each element's start */
  const sig = [d.n, d.st.join(","), d.gov, Math.floor(S.T), focus ? 1 : 0, S.sec === s ? 1 : 0, orbIcons[s].complete ? 1 : 0, document.fonts && document.fonts.status, an < 1 ? Math.round(an * 60) : "d", fltSig].join("|");
  if (sig === o.sig) return; o.sig = sig;
  c.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0); c.clearRect(0, 0, OCW, OCH);
  /* glass */
  let g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, OCH); g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(6,16,32,0.78)"); g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(3,8,18,0.55)");
  c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(0, 0, OCW, OCH);
  g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, OCW, 0); g.addColorStop(0, hexA(col, 0)); g.addColorStop(0.75, hexA(col, 0.06)); g.addColorStop(1, hexA(col, 0.22));
  c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(0, 0, OCW, OCH);
  c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.025)"; for (let y = 0; y < OCH; y += 6) c.fillRect(0, y, OCW, 2);
  c.strokeStyle = hexA(col, S.sec === s ? 0.9 : 0.45); c.lineWidth = S.sec === s ? 6 : 3; c.strokeRect(3, 3, OCW - 6, OCH - 6);
  c.fillStyle = col; [[0, 0, 1, 1], [OCW, 0, -1, 1], [0, OCH, 1, -1], [OCW, OCH, -1, -1]].forEach(([x, y, sx, sy]) => { c.fillRect(x, y, sx * 60, sy * 8); c.fillRect(x, y, sx * 8, sy * 60); });
  c.direction = CDIR; c.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  /* header (card: title) */
  if (orbIcons[s].complete) { c.save(); c.fillStyle = hexA(col, 0.18); c.beginPath(); const ix = OCW - 100, iy = 96; for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { const a = Math.PI / 6 + k * Math.PI / 3; c.lineTo(ix + Math.cos(a) * 58, iy + Math.sin(a) * 58); } c.closePath(); c.fill(); c.drawImage(orbIcons[s], ix - 38, iy - 38, 76, 76); c.restore(); }
  const colL = "#" + new THREE.Color(col).lerp(new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), 0.3).getHexString();
  c.textAlign = "right"; c.fillStyle = colL; let tf = 60; c.font = orbFont(700, tf, F_HEAD); while (tf > 34 && c.measureText(SECS[s].n).width > 560) { tf -= 2; c.font = orbFont(700, tf, F_HEAD); } c.fillText(SECS[s].n, OCW - 180, 104);
  c.font = orbFont(500, 24, F_NUM); c.fillStyle = hexA(col, 0.9); c.direction = "ltr"; c.textAlign = "right"; c.fillText(`SECTOR 0${s + 1} / 0${SECS.length}`, OCW - 182, 146); c.direction = CDIR;
  /* big number (card: count) */
  c.textAlign = "right"; c.font = orbFont(700, 180, F_NUM); c.fillStyle = colL; c.shadowColor = hexA(col, 0.8); c.shadowBlur = 30;
  c.direction = "ltr"; c.fillText(String(Math.round(d.n * A(0.05))), OCW - 50, 368); c.shadowBlur = 0;
  const nw = c.measureText(String(d.n)).width; c.direction = CDIR;
  c.font = orbFont(600, 40, F_HEAD); c.fillStyle = "#dfe8f5"; c.fillText(T("مشروعًا"), OCW - 80 - nw, 318);
  c.font = orbFont(500, 30, F_BODY); c.fillStyle = hexA(col, 0.95); c.fillText(`${Math.round(d.n / all * 100)}% ${T("من مشروعات العرض")}`, OCW - 80 - nw, 366);
  /* status split (card: status) */
  const bx = OCW - 50, bw = 700, by = 444; const tot = Math.max(1, d.st[0] + d.st[1] + d.st[2]);
  const lab = [[T("منجز أو يعمل"), 1], [T("مستمر"), 0.55], [T("قيد التنفيذ أو مستهدف"), 0.3]]; let x = bx;
  d.st.forEach((v, k) => { const w = v / tot * bw * A(0.2 + k * 0.08); if (w > 0) { c.fillStyle = hexA(col, lab[k][1]); if (k === 2) { for (let q = 0; q < w; q += 14) c.fillRect(x - Math.min(q + 9, w), by, Math.min(9, w - q), 22); } else c.fillRect(x - w, by, w - 3, 22); } x -= w; });
  c.font = orbFont(500, 25, F_BODY); x = bx; d.st.forEach((v, k) => { c.fillStyle = k ? "#b9c6d8" : "#ffffff"; const t = `${lab[k][0]} ${v}`; c.fillText(t, x, by + 66); x -= c.measureText(t).width + 34; });
  /* year histogram: all of the sector's projects by completion year (card: timeline) */
  const hx0 = 56, hx1 = 828, hy = 344, hh = 232, mx = Math.max(1, ...d.yrs), bwid = (hx1 - hx0) / d.yrs.length;
  c.font = orbFont(600, 26, F_HEAD); c.direction = CDIR; c.fillStyle = "#dfe8f5"; c.textAlign = "right"; c.fillText(T("حسب سنة الانتهاء أو التشغيل"), hx1, 64);
  d.yrs.forEach((v, k) => { const yy = 2014 + k, h = v / mx * hh * A(0.1 + k * 0.022), past = yy <= Math.floor(S.T);
    c.fillStyle = past ? hexA(col, yy === Math.floor(S.T) ? 1 : 0.75) : hexA(col, 0.22); c.fillRect(hx0 + k * bwid + 3, hy - h, bwid - 6, h); });
  c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)"; c.fillRect(hx0, hy + 2, hx1 - hx0, 2);
  c.font = orbFont(500, 20, F_NUM); c.fillStyle = "#8ea3bd"; c.direction = "ltr"; c.textAlign = "center"; [2014, 2018, 2022, 2026, 2030].forEach(y => c.fillText(String(y), hx0 + (y - 2014 + 0.5) * bwid, hy + 34));
  c.direction = CDIR; c.font = orbFont(600, 26, F_BODY); c.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; c.textAlign = "left"; c.fillText(`${d.gov} ${T("محافظة")}`, hx0, 64);
  if (focus) { c.font = orbFont(500, 21, F_BODY); c.fillStyle = hexA(col, 0.9); c.textAlign = "left"; c.fillText(T("اضغط لعرض مشروعات القطاع"), hx0, 96); }
  /* top entities (card: who) */
  c.textAlign = "right"; c.font = orbFont(500, 24, F_BODY);
  d.top.forEach(([m, v], k) => { const yy = 462 + k * 34, w = v / Math.max(1, d.top[0][1]) * 180 * A(0.3 + k * 0.08);
    c.fillStyle = hexA(col, 0.6); c.fillRect(hx1 - w, yy - 18, w, 14); c.fillStyle = "#dfe8f5"; const t = m.length > 30 ? m.slice(0, 29) + "…" : m; c.fillText(`${t} · ${v}`, hx1 - 200, yy - 4); });
  o.tex.needsUpdate = true;
}

/* ---- per frame: visibility by facing, hover and selection glow ---- */
const orbRay = new THREE.Raycaster(), orbNdc = new THREE.Vector2(); let orbHover = -1, orbAcc = 0, orbRR = 0, orbAnT = 0, orbAnI = 0;
function orbitPick(mx, my){
  if (!orbitGroup.visible) return -1;
  orbNdc.set(mx / W * 2 - 1, -(my / Hh) * 2 + 1); orbRay.setFromCamera(orbNdc, camera);
  const hits = orbRay.intersectObjects(orbScr.map(o => o.mesh), false);
  for (const h of hits) { const o = orbScr[h.object.userData.sec]; if (o.vis > 0.35) return o.i; }
  return -1;
}
function updateOrbit(dt){
  const on = (1 - mL) * (1 - ZS.close) * (QS.has("noorbit") ? 0 : 1);
  orbitGroup.visible = on > 0.01; orbitGroup.rotation.y = -ringRotNow(); if (!orbitGroup.visible) return;
  orbAnT += dt; if (orbAnT > 2.6) { orbAnT = 0; orbAnI = (orbAnI + 1) % ORB.n; if (orbScr[orbAnI].an >= 1 && S.sec < 0) orbScr[orbAnI].an = 0; }   /* every few seconds one screen refreshes its data with the intro animation */
  const k = Math.min(1, dt * 5), cx = camera.position.x - EC.x, cz = camera.position.z - EC.z;
  orbAcc += dt; let redrawI = -1; if (orbAcc > 0.12) { orbAcc = 0; orbRR = (orbRR + 1) % ORB.n; redrawI = orbRR; }   /* repaint one screen per tick, in turn */
  orbScr.forEach(o => {
    const th = orbNow(o.i), px = Math.sin(th) * ORB.R, pz = Math.cos(th) * ORB.R;
    let dx = cx - px, dz = cz - pz; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
    o.face = -(Math.sin(th) * dx + Math.cos(th) * dz);                      // > 0: far side, seen across the map
    /* every screen stays on the ring; the near ones only soften so the map still reads through them */
    const tv = lerp(0.5, 1, sstep(-0.3, 0.3, o.face)) * on * (S.sec >= 0 && S.sec !== o.i ? 0.55 : 1);
    o.vis += (tv - o.vis) * k; o.hov += ((orbHover === o.i ? 1 : 0) - o.hov) * k * 1.5; o.sel += ((S.sec === o.i ? 1 : 0) - o.sel) * k;
    o.mat.opacity = o.vis * (0.82 + 0.18 * o.hov); o.fm.opacity = o.vis * (0.35 + 0.4 * o.hov + 0.45 * o.sel);
    o.mesh.visible = o.frame.visible = o.stem.visible = o.vis > 0.01;
    const isSel = S.sec === o.i; o.wasSel = isSel;      /* opening a sector never wipes its screen: the content stays and lifts off into layers */
    if (o.an < 1 && o.vis > 0.02) o.an = Math.min(1, o.an + dt / 1.6);
    o.kick = Math.max(0, (o.kick || 0) - Math.min(dt, 0.05) * 0.8); const kq = Math.sin(Math.PI * (1 - (o.kick || 0))), kb = kq * kq * 0.4, kc = kq * (o.kick > 0 ? 1 : 0);      /* a soft swell of light and a slight rise: both start and end at rest */
    o.mesh.position.y = o.frame.position.y = kb; o.fm.opacity = Math.min(1, o.fm.opacity + kc * 0.5);
    o.su.uPulse.value = (isSel ? 1 : 0.35) + kc * 1.4;
    o.exL = clamp((o.exL || 0) + (isSel ? 1 : -1.4) * Math.min(dt, 0.05) / 2.0, 0, 1); o.ex = o.exL * o.exL * (3 - 2 * o.exL); o.su.uEx.value = o.ex;      /* opens over the length of the camera move, on a fixed clock: a slow frame can't make it leap */
    const cOn = o.ex > 0.004 && o.mesh.visible, tt = U.uTime.value;
    o.cards.forEach(cd => { cd.m.visible = cOn; if (!cOn) return; const e0 = clamp((o.exL - cd.delay) / (1 - 0.2), 0, 1), e = e0 * e0 * e0 * (e0 * (e0 * 6 - 15) + 10), fl = Math.sin(tt * 0.9 + cd.ph) * 0.07 * e;
      const kk = 1 - (cd.depth + fl * 2) * e / ORB.R; cd.m.scale.set(kk, 1, kk); cd.m.position.y = (cd.lift + fl) * e + kb; cd.m.rotation.y = cd.spread * e; cd.cm.opacity = o.mat.opacity; });
    if ((redrawI === o.i || o.an < 1 || (o.hov > 0.5 && o.sig === "")) && o.vis > 0.02) drawOrb(o, o.hov > 0.5);
  });
}

/* the summary may decide only for social and cultural programmes (a factory that mentions a metro station is still a factory), and for sanitation works anywhere */
const SIM_SUM = [SIM_RULES[1]].concat(SIM_RULES.filter(([k], i) => i > 6 && ["hosp", "edu", "cult"].includes(k)));
const SIM_HOUS = /وحدة سكنية|وحدات سكنية|إسكان|مجتمع سكني/;
/* funding, policy and social programmes with no facility of their own: an abstract emblem, never a building (matched by their full names, so no other project can fall in) */
const SIM_PROG = /^مشروع إدارة تلوث الهواء|الهيدروكلوروفلوروكربونية|\(SASME\)|\(EBIC\)|^مداخلات (جهاز|الجهاز) |الهجرة غير النظامية|^مبادرة بداية|الاستراتيجية الوطنية للطيف|^صناعة التعهيد/;
const SIM_DEF = ["hous", "road", "power", "agri", "ind", "soc", "cult", "gov"];
const SIM_NAME = {air: "مطار ومبنى ركاب", port: "ميناء ومحطة حاويات", rail: "محطة وقطار", hosp: "مستشفى", edu: "جامعة ومنشأة تعليمية", solar: "طاقة شمسية ورياح", oil: "منشأة بترولية", agri: "صوب وري مركزي", ind: "مصنع ومنطقة صناعية", power: "محطة كهرباء", water: "محطة مياه ومعالجة", sport: "استاد ومنشأة رياضية", cult: "متحف ومعلم تراثي", road: "كوبري ومحور طرق", gov: "مبنى إداري ومركز بيانات", hous: "مجتمع عمراني", soc: "مركز خدمات اجتماعية", prog: "برنامج أو مبادرة (رمز تجريدي)"};
function simType(p){ if (p.n0 != null) p = Object.assign({}, p, {n: p.n0, sm: p.sm0});   /* English mode: the rules below read the Arabic originals */
  if (ADM.models[p.i]) return "custom";                       /* a model traced from an image in the settings page */
  if (p.simT && SIM_NAME[p.simT] && p.simT !== "custom") return p.simT;   /* model type chosen in the settings page */
  if (SIM_PROG.test(p.n)) return "prog";
  for (const [k, r] of SIM_RULES) if (r.test(p.n)) return k;
  if (p.sm) for (let i = 0; i < SIM_SUM.length; i++) if ((i === 0 || p.sc === 5 || p.sc === 6) && SIM_SUM[i][1].test(p.sm)) return SIM_SUM[i][0];
  if (p.sm && SIM_HOUS.test(p.sm)) return "hous";
  return SIM_DEF[p.sc];
}

/* ---- geometry kit: every solid is built with its base at y = 0 ---- */
const SK = {
  bx: (w, h, d) => new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d).translate(0, h / 2, 0),
  cy: (r1, r2, h, s) => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r1, r2, h, s || 20).translate(0, h / 2, 0),
  cn: (r, h, s) => new THREE.ConeGeometry(r, h, s || 4).translate(0, h / 2, 0),
  sp: r => new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 16, 12).translate(0, r, 0),
  hs: r => new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 22, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),
  tr: (R, t) => new THREE.TorusGeometry(R, t, 6, 44).rotateX(Math.PI / 2).translate(0, t, 0),
  lt: pts => new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts.map(([r, y]) => new THREE.Vector2(r, y)), 48),
  pr: (w, h, len) => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); s.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(0, h); s.closePath(); return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, {depth: len, bevelEnabled: false}).translate(0, 0, -len / 2); }
};
const SPI = Math.PI;

/* an exactly located project whose buildings are mapped: show the real buildings, not an illustrative model */
const simIsReal = p => { const g = GEO[p.i]; return !!(g && g.b >= 1 && !g.ln && !p.nat); };
const simIsRoute = p => { const g = GEO[p.i]; return !!(g && g.ln); };
/* one model = a list of parts in construction order: foundations first, details last */
function simParts(type){
  const L = [];
  const g = (geo, x, y, z, tn, o) => L.push(Object.assign({geo, x, y, z, tn, gr: "y"}, o));
  const pv = (geo, x, y, z, tn, o) => L.push(Object.assign({geo, x, y, z, tn, gr: "a"}, o));
  const rod = (a, b, r, tn) => { const A = new THREE.Vector3(a[0], a[1], a[2]), B = new THREE.Vector3(b[0], b[1], b[2]), d = B.clone().sub(A), len = d.length();
    L.push({geo: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, r, len, 5), x: (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y: (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, z: (a[2] + b[2]) / 2, tn: tn == null ? 1 : tn, gr: "a", q: new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), d.normalize())}); };
  const slab = () => g(SK.cy(2.02, 2.02, .045, 6), 0, 0, 0, 2);
  const bob = (a, b) => t => [Math.sin(t * .4 + (b || 0)) * (a || .05), Math.sin(t * 1.2) * .015, 0];
  switch (type) {
  case "hous": {

     [-1.2, .62, .62, .32, .56], [-.5, 1.0, .34, .5, .82], [.5, 1.0, .34, .5, .6], [1.2, .62, .62, .32, 1.08]]

        g(SK.bx(w + .012, .022, d + .012), x, .11 + h, z, 3); g(SK.bx(w * .3, .06, d * .34), x, .132 + h, z, 1); });
    break; }
  case "road": {
    slab(3.8, 1.2);
    [-1.3, -.45, .45, 1.3].forEach(x => g(SK.bx(.14, .55, .5), x, .05, 0, 0));
    g(SK.bx(3.6, .1, .62), 0, .6, 0, 1); g(SK.bx(3.4, .012, .04), 0, .7, 0, 3);

      [-1, 1].forEach(dr => [.3, .6, .9, 1.2].forEach((off, j) => rod([px, 2.15 - j * .2, 0], [px + dr * off, .7, 0], .011, 3))); });
    [[-1.2, .3], [.2, .8], [1.1, 2]].forEach(([x, ph]) => g(SK.bx(.2, .07, .11), x, .7, ph > 1 ? .12 : -.12, ph > 1 ? 3 : 1, {mv: t => [Math.sin(t * .5 + ph) * 1.3, 0, 0]}));
    break; }
  case "rail": {
    slab(); g(SK.bx(3.96, .05, .76), 0, 0, 0, 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) g(SK.bx(.05, .025, .5), -1.82 + i * .28, .05, 0, 2);

    break; }
  case "air": {

    slab();
