    g(SK.bx(1.3, 1, .75), 0, .1, -.2, 0, {fc: [.1, .1]}); g(SK.bx(.8, .62, .55), -1.15, .1, -.15, 1, {fc: [.1, .1]}); g(SK.bx(.8, .62, .55), 1.15, .1, -.15, 1, {fc: [.1, .1]});
    g(SK.bx(.7, .2, .5), 0, .1, .4, 1); g(SK.bx(.95, .035, .7), 0, .3, .47, 3); [-.4, .4].forEach(x => g(SK.cy(.02, .02, .25, 8), x, .05, .76, 3));      /* entrance and its canopy */
    g(SK.bx(1.32, .03, .77), 0, 1.1, -.2, 3); [-1.15, 1.15].forEach(x => g(SK.bx(.82, .025, .57), x, .72, -.15, 3));                                    /* parapets */
    g(SK.bx(.4, .06, .13), 0, 1.13, -.2, 3); g(SK.bx(.13, .06, .4), 0, 1.13, -.2, 3);
    g(SK.cy(.24, .24, .03, 32), 1.2, .745, -.15, 1); g(SK.tr(.2, .008), 1.2, .775, -.15, 3); g(SK.bx(.03, .012, .16), 1.14, .775, -.15, 3); g(SK.bx(.03, .012, .16), 1.26, .775, -.15, 3); g(SK.bx(.12, .012, .03), 1.2, .775, -.15, 3);
    g(SK.bx(.22, .1, .12), 0, .062, 1.15, 3, {mv: t => [Math.sin(t * .5) * .95, 0, 0]}); g(SK.bx(2.5, .012, .22), 0, .05, 1.15, 2);
    break; }
  case "edu": {
    slab();
    g(SK.bx(2, .5, .7), 0, .05, -.35, 0, {fc: [.16, .1]}); g(SK.bx(2.1, .06, .5), 0, .53, .05, 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) g(SK.cy(.04, .04, .46, 8), -.9 + i * .3, .07, .12, 3);
    g(SK.pr(.95, .25, .5), 0, .59, .05, 1); g(SK.cy(.3, .3, .18, 24), 0, .55, -.45, 1); g(SK.hs(.3), 0, .73, -.45, 0); g(SK.sp(.05), 0, 1.03, -.45, 3);
    g(SK.bx(.9, .38, .5), -1.4, .05, .55, 1, {fc: [.125, .1]}); g(SK.bx(.9, .38, .5), 1.4, .05, .55, 1, {fc: [.125, .1]});
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) g(SK.bx(1.5 - i * .12, .03, .22), 0, .05 + i * .03, .5 + (2 - i) * .07, 2);
    g(SK.cy(.01, .01, .95, 6), -1.6, .05, -1, 3);
    break; }
  case "sport": {
    slab();
    g(SK.lt([[1.45, 0], [1.62, .75], [1.5, .78], [.95, .15], [.9, .1]]), 0, .05, 0, 0, {sc: [1, 1, .78], ds: 1});
    g(SK.cy(.9, .9, .02, 36), 0, .05, 0, 1, {sc: [1, 1, .78]}); g(SK.tr(.2, .008), 0, .07, 0, 3);
    g(SK.tr(1.58, .03), 0, .83, 0, 3, {sc: [1, 1, .78]});
    [[-1.45, -1.15], [1.45, -1.15], [-1.45, 1.15], [1.45, 1.15]].forEach(([x, z]) => { g(SK.cy(.02, .03, 1.3, 6), x, .05, z, 1); g(SK.bx(.22, .1, .05), x, 1.35, z, 3); });
    break; }
  case "cult": {
    slab();
    g(SK.bx(3, .05, 1.8), 0, .05, 0, 1); g(SK.bx(2.7, .05, 1.5), 0, .1, 0, 1);                                        /* stepped terrace */
    g(SK.bx(1.7, .5, .7), -.45, .15, -.25, 0); g(SK.bx(1.76, .05, 1.04), -.45, .65, -.08, 1);                          /* hall, and the entablature that carries the roof over the portico */
    g(SK.pr(1.04, .22, 1.76), -.45, .7, -.08, 1, {ry: SPI / 2});
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { g(SK.cy(.032, .038, .5, 12), -1.23 + i * .26, .15, .36, 3); g(SK.bx(.09, .02, .09), -1.23 + i * .26, .63, .36, 3); }
    g(SK.cn(.5, .62, 4), .95, .15, -.1, 3, {ry: SPI / 4});   /* a glass pyramid court, as museums have */
    g(SK.cy(.06, .09, 1.4, 4), -1.4, .1, .8, 1, {ry: SPI / 4}); g(SK.cn(.07, .17, 4), -1.4, 1.5, .8, 3, {ry: SPI / 4});      /* the obelisk stands on the lower terrace step (it used to cut through the terrace corner) */
    break; }
  case "gov": {
    slab();
    g(SK.bx(2.3, .28, 1.3), .1, .05, 0, 1, {fc: [.14, .12]}); g(SK.bx(2.34, .025, 1.34), .1, .33, 0, 3);                /* podium with its cornice */
    g(SK.bx(.66, 1.7, .66), -.3, .355, -.1, 0, {fc: [.095, .11]}); g(SK.bx(.7, .03, .7), -.3, 2.055, -.1, 3); g(SK.bx(.4, .12, .4), -.3, 2.085, -.1, 1);      /* office tower, parapet, plant room */
    g(SK.bx(.95, .5, .6), .75, .355, .1, 1, {fc: [.1, .11]}); g(SK.bx(.97, .025, .62), .75, .855, .1, 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) g(SK.cy(.022, .026, .28, 10), -.2 + i * .15, .05, .72, 3); g(SK.bx(.76, .03, .16), .1, .33, .72, 3);                         /* entrance colonnade */
    g(SK.cy(.012, .012, .45, 6), -.3, 2.2, -.1, 3); g(SK.sp(.04), -.3, 2.65, -.1, 3, {flick: 1});
    g(SK.cy(.012, .016, .16, 6), .95, .88, .1, 3); pv(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.15, 20, 8, 0, SPI * 2, 0, SPI * .42).rotateX(SPI - .7).translate(0, .17, 0), .95, 1.02, .1, 3, {ds: 1});      /* a dish on the wing roof */
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) g(SK.bx(.13, .26, .4), -1.32 + i * .19, .05, .9, i % 2 ? 0 : 1);
    pv(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.66, .01, 6, 56).rotateX(SPI / 2), -.3, 1.5, -.1, 3, {spin: ["y", .8]});
    break; }
  case "soc": {
    slab();
    g(SK.bx(1.5, .5, .8), 0, .05, -.45, 0, {fc: [.165, .1]}); g(SK.bx(1.7, .06, 1), 0, .55, -.45, 1);
    g(SK.cy(.85, .85, .03, 40), 0, .05, .75, 1); g(SK.tr(.85, .01), 0, .07, .75, 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const a = i / 8 * SPI * 2, x = Math.cos(a) * .55, z = .75 + Math.sin(a) * .55; g(SK.cy(.035, .045, .14, 8), x, .08, z, 3); g(SK.sp(.045), x, .22, z, 3); }
    g(SK.cy(.02, .025, .3, 6), 1.4, .05, .6, 1); g(SK.sp(.17), 1.4, .3, .6, 0);
    break; }
  case "prog": {
    /* a programme, not a place: a stepped round plinth carrying a slowly turning emblem, with a ring of linked nodes for the people and places it reaches */
    slab();
    g(SK.cy(1.3, 1.36, .1, 48), 0, .05, 0, 1); g(SK.cy(.98, 1.02, .1, 48), 0, .15, 0, 0); g(SK.tr(.9, .012), 0, .25, 0, 3); g(SK.tr(1.24, .01), 0, .15, 0, 3);
    g(SK.cy(.035, .06, .95, 12), 0, .25, 0, 1); g(SK.cy(.13, .13, .03, 24), 0, 1.2, 0, 3);
    pv(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(.3, 0).scale(1, 1.35, 1), 0, 1.78, 0, 3, {spin: ["y", .5]});
    pv(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.58, .012, 6, 56).rotateX(SPI / 2 - .5), 0, 1.78, 0, 1, {spin: ["y", .35]}); pv(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.76, .009, 6, 64).rotateX(SPI / 2 + .35), 0, 1.78, 0, 3, {spin: ["y", -.22]});
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const a = i / 6 * SPI * 2 + .26, x = Math.cos(a) * 1.66, z = Math.sin(a) * 1.66, h = .34 + (i % 2) * .16;
      g(SK.cy(.11, .13, .04, 16), x, .05, z, 1); g(SK.cy(.02, .028, h, 8), x, .09, z, 0); g(SK.sp(.065), x, .09 + h, z, 3);
      rod([Math.cos(a) * 1.36, .07, Math.sin(a) * 1.36], [x, .07, z], .012, 3); }
    break; }
  default: slab(); g(SK.bx(1, 1, 1), 0, .05, 0, 0);
  }
  return L;
}

/* ---- materials: four tones (main, light, dark, accent), solid and ghost ---- */
const SIM_O = [.64, .6, .46, .8], SIM_GO = [.07, .06, .08, .12];
/* solids are single-sided and write depth, so a model reads as clean glass massing with only its visible edges drawn (no back faces showing through);
   parts flagged fc = [storey height, bay width] get a procedural facade: a glazing band per storey cut by slender piers, anti-aliased and faded out with distance */
const SIM_FS_V = "attribute vec2 aF; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying vec3 vP; varying vec3 vL; varying vec2 vF; void main(){ vec4 wp = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); vN = normalize(mat3(modelMatrix) * normal); vV = cameraPosition - wp.xyz; vP = position; vL = normal; vF = aF; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp; }";
const SIM_FS_F = `uniform vec3 uC; uniform vec3 uE; uniform float uO; uniform float uP; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying vec3 vP; varying vec3 vL; varying vec2 vF;
  void main(){ vec3 n = normalize(vN); if (!gl_FrontFacing) n = -n; float ndv = clamp(abs(dot(n, normalize(vV))), 0.0, 1.0); float fr = pow(1.0 - ndv, 2.0); float sh = 0.6 + 0.4 * max(dot(n, normalize(vec3(0.4, 0.8, 0.45))), 0.0);
    float win = 0.0;
    if (vF.x > 0.0 && abs(vL.y) < 0.5) { float u = abs(vL.x) > 0.5 ? vP.z : vP.x, sy = vP.y / vF.x, su = u / vF.y + 0.5, ay = fwidth(sy), au = fwidth(su), fy = fract(sy), fu = fract(su);
      float band = smoothstep(0.3 - ay, 0.3 + ay, fy) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.8 - ay, 0.8 + ay, fy)), pier = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.07, 0.07 + au * 1.5, min(fu, 1.0 - fu));
      win = band * (1.0 - pier) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.3, 0.7, max(ay, au))); }
    vec3 c = uC * sh * (1.0 - 0.22 * win) + uE * uP * (1.0 + 2.2 * win) + uC * fr * 0.7 + mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.35) * win * 0.3; c = c / (1.0 + 0.7 * max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)));
    gl_FragColor = vec4(c, uO * (0.6 + 0.9 * fr) * (1.0 + 0.3 * win)); }`;
const mkSimMat = (o, ghost, uni) => { const m = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({transparent: true, depthWrite: !ghost, side: ghost ? THREE.DoubleSide : THREE.FrontSide, polygonOffset: !ghost, polygonOffsetFactor: 1, polygonOffsetUnits: 1, extensions: {derivatives: true},
    vertexShader: SIM_FS_V, fragmentShader: SIM_FS_F, uniforms: uni || {uC: {value: new THREE.Color()}, uE: {value: new THREE.Color()}, uO: {value: o}, uP: {value: 1}}});
  m.color = m.uniforms.uC.value; m.emissive = m.uniforms.uE.value;
  Object.defineProperty(m, "opacity", {get() { return this.uniforms.uO.value; }, set(v) { this.uniforms.uO.value = v; }});
  Object.defineProperty(m, "emissiveIntensity", {get() { return this.uniforms.uP.value; }, set(v) { this.uniforms.uP.value = v; }});
  return m; };
const simMats = SIM_O.map(o => mkSimMat(o)), simGhost = SIM_GO.map(o => mkSimMat(o, true));
/* open shells (lathed towers and bowls) need both faces: same uniforms as the solid tones, double-sided */
const simMatsD = simMats.map(m => { const d = mkSimMat(0, false, m.uniforms); d.side = THREE.DoubleSide; return d; });
const mkSimLine = o => new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: o, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false});
const simLine = [mkSimLine(1), mkSimLine(1), mkSimLine(.4)];
function setSimColor(sc){
  const c = col(SECC[sc]), w = new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), r = new THREE.Color(SECC[sc]);
  const tone = [[r.clone().multiplyScalar(.5), r.clone().multiplyScalar(.16)], [r.clone().lerp(w, .12).multiplyScalar(.85), r.clone().multiplyScalar(.2)], [r.clone().multiplyScalar(.16), new THREE.Color(0, 0, 0)], [r.clone().lerp(w, .3), r.clone().multiplyScalar(.22)]];
  [simMats, simGhost].forEach(set => set.forEach((m, i) => { m.color.copy(tone[i][0]); m.emissive.copy(tone[i][1]); }));
  simLine[0].color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .3)); simLine[1].color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .7)); simLine[2].color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .25));
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--lc", SECC[sc]);   /* floating figures and captions follow the sector colour */
  simU.uC.value.copy(c); simRing.color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .3)); simScan.material.color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .3)); simShock.forEach(m => m.material.color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .45))); simDash.color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .2));
}

/* ---- pedestal, projector cone, scan ring ---- */
const simU = {uC: {value: new THREE.Color(1, .7, .3)}, uA: {value: 0}};
const simG = new THREE.Group(); simG.visible = false; scene.add(simG);
const simBase = new THREE.Group(); simG.add(simBase);
let simModel = new THREE.Group(); simG.add(simModel);
const simRing = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: .8, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide});
const simDash = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({color: 0xffffff, dashSize: .16, gapSize: .12, transparent: true, opacity: .85});
const simPlate = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.3, 2.42, .12, 6), simMats[0]); simPlate.position.y = -.06; simBase.add(simPlate);
simPlate.add(new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(simPlate.geometry, 20), simLine[0]));
const simIn = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(1.88, 1.96, 72).rotateX(-SPI / 2), simRing); simIn.position.y = .012; simBase.add(simIn);
const simIn2 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(2.08, 2.12, 72).rotateX(-SPI / 2), simRing); simIn2.position.y = .012; simBase.add(simIn2);
const simDashL = (() => { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 128; i++) { const a = i / 128 * SPI * 2; pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a) * 2.7, 0.02, Math.sin(a) * 2.7)); }
  const l = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), simDash); l.computeLineDistances(); simBase.add(l); return l; })();
const simScan = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(1.5, 1.57, 72).rotateX(-SPI / 2), simRing.clone()); simScan.material.depthTest = false; simScan.renderOrder = 6; simBase.add(simScan);
const simVS = "varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }";
const simCone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.25, 2.0, 3.4, 48, 1, true).translate(0, 1.7, 0), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, uniforms: simU,
  vertexShader: simVS, fragmentShader: "uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ float a = pow(1.0 - vUv.y, 1.9) * 0.1 * uA; gl_FragColor = vec4(uC, a); }"})); simCone.renderOrder = 3; simBase.add(simCone);
const simPool = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(3.7, 48).rotateX(-SPI / 2), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, uniforms: simU,
  vertexShader: simVS, fragmentShader: "uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ float r = length(vUv - 0.5) * 2.0; gl_FragColor = vec4(uC, pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - r), 1.8) * 0.5 * uA); }"})); simPool.position.y = .02; simPool.renderOrder = 2; simBase.add(simPool);

const simShade = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(3.9, 48).rotateX(-SPI / 2), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({transparent: true, depthWrite: false, uniforms: {uA: {value: 0}}, vertexShader: simVS, fragmentShader: "uniform float uA; varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ float r = length(vUv - 0.5) * 2.0; gl_FragColor = vec4(0.005, 0.03, 0.04, smoothstep(1.0, 0.45, r) * 0.6 * uA); }"})); simShade.position.y = .008; simShade.renderOrder = 1; simBase.add(simShade);

const simTeth = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.03, .03, 1, 6).translate(0, -.5, 0), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false})); simTeth.renderOrder = 5; simG.add(simTeth);

/* arrival shockwave: two thin rings that burst out of the point when the dive lands */
const simShock = [0, 1].map(() => { const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(.94, 1, 96).rotateX(-SPI / 2), simRing.clone()); m.position.y = .03; m.renderOrder = 6; m.material.depthTest = false; m.visible = false; simG.add(m); return m; });
/* the real footprint or route of an exactly located project, traced on the ground in the sector colour */
/* on the dark map the ribbon is light added to the ground; on the sand map added light vanishes, so there it is a deeper tone of the sector colour laid over the ground (one premultiplied blend serves both) */
const routeMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: {uH: {value: H}, uRel: TU.uRel, uM2U: {value: 0}, uTime: U.uTime, uC: {value: new THREE.Color()}, uA: {value: 0}, uTwin: TU.uTwin},
  transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendSrc: THREE.OneFactor, blendDst: THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  vertexShader: `uniform float uH; uniform float uRel; uniform float uM2U; attribute float aRel; attribute float aSide; attribute float aAlong; varying float vS; varying float vA;
    void main(){ vS = aSide; vA = aAlong; vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position.x, uH + aRel * uRel + 6.0 * uM2U, position.z, 1.0); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * w; }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; uniform float uTwin; varying float vS; varying float vA;
    void main(){ float e = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.2, 1.0, abs(vS)); float p = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(vA * 0.004 - uTime * 2.6), 10.0);
      float a = uA * e * (0.35 + 0.65 * p), aS = uA * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.45, 1.0, abs(vS))) * (0.62 + 0.3 * p);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uC * (0.62 - 0.2 * p) * aS, uC * (0.75 + p * 0.5) * a * a, uTwin), aS * (1.0 - uTwin)); }`});
let simRoute = null, simFill = null;
/* the site's footprint itself, filled with a soft sector-coloured glass, so the real extent reads even where the map has few buildings */
const fillMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: {uH: routeMat.uniforms.uH, uRel: TU.uRel, uM2U: routeMat.uniforms.uM2U, uTime: U.uTime, uC: routeMat.uniforms.uC, uA: routeMat.uniforms.uA, uTwin: TU.uTwin},
  transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -4,
  vertexShader: `uniform float uH; uniform float uRel; uniform float uM2U; attribute float aRel; varying vec2 vXZ;
    void main(){ vXZ = position.xz; vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position.x, uH + aRel * uRel + 4.0 * uM2U, position.z, 1.0); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * w; }`,
  /* a light translucent wash, not a slab: pale on the dark map, a deeper tone of the sector colour on the sand map; the crisp outline (simEdge) carries the "this is the site" reading */
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; uniform float uTwin; varying vec2 vXZ;
    void main(){ vec3 c = mix(uC * 0.6, mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.5), uTwin); float a = uA * mix(0.2, 0.075, uTwin) * (1.0 + 0.14 * sin(uTime * 1.6)); gl_FragColor = vec4(c, a); }`});
/* the crisp outline of the site: a thin constant line on the footprint's edge, in both themes */
const edgeMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: fillMat.uniforms, transparent: true, depthWrite: false,
  vertexShader: `uniform float uH; uniform float uRel; uniform float uM2U; attribute float aRel;
    void main(){ vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position.x, uH + aRel * uRel + 6.5 * uM2U, position.z, 1.0); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * w; }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; uniform float uTwin; void main(){ gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uC * 0.5, mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.72), uTwin), uA * 0.95); }`});
let simEdge = null;
function buildRoute(g){
  if (simRoute) { scene.remove(simRoute); simRoute.geometry.dispose(); simRoute = null; }
  if (simFill) { scene.remove(simFill); simFill.geometry.dispose(); simFill = null; }
  if (simEdge) { scene.remove(simEdge); simEdge.geometry.dispose(); simEdge = null; }
  if (g && g.pl && g.pl.length > 2) {
    const v2 = g.pl.map(([lo, la]) => { const q = proj(la, lo); return new THREE.Vector2(q[0] * SC, q[1] * SC); });
    const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v2, []), fp = [], fr = [];
    v2.forEach(v => { fp.push(v.x, 0, v.y); fr.push(relH(v.x, v.y)); });
    const fg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); fg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(fp, 3)); fg.setAttribute("aRel", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(fr, 1)); fg.setIndex(tri.flat());
    simFill = new THREE.Mesh(fg, fillMat); simFill.frustumCulled = false; simFill.renderOrder = 6; scene.add(simFill);
    const eg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); eg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(fp, 3)); eg.setAttribute("aRel", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(fr, 1));
    simEdge = new THREE.LineLoop(eg, edgeMat); simEdge.frustumCulled = false; simEdge.renderOrder = 7; scene.add(simEdge);
  }
  const lines = g && (g.ln || (g.pl ? [g.pl.concat([g.pl[0]])] : null)); if (!lines) return;
  const P = [], R = [], Sd = [], A = [], I = [], wm = g.ln ? 38 : 22;
  lines.forEach(ln => { const pts = ln.map(([lo, la]) => { const q = proj(la, lo); return [q[0] * SC, q[1] * SC]; }); const n = pts.length; let along = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = pts[i], a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)]; let tx = b[0] - a[0], tz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1; tx /= l; tz /= l;
      if (i) along += Math.hypot(p[0] - pts[i - 1][0], p[1] - pts[i - 1][1]) / M2U; const w = wm * M2U * 0.5, rr = relH(p[0], p[1]);
      P.push(p[0] - tz * w, 0, p[1] + tx * w, p[0] + tz * w, 0, p[1] - tx * w); R.push(rr, rr); Sd.push(-1, 1); A.push(along, along);
      if (i < n - 1) { const b0 = P.length / 3 - 2; I.push(b0, b0 + 1, b0 + 2, b0 + 1, b0 + 3, b0 + 2); } } });
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(P, 3)); geo.setAttribute("aRel", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(R, 1));
  geo.setAttribute("aSide", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(Sd, 1)); geo.setAttribute("aAlong", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(A, 1)); geo.setIndex(I);
  routeMat.uniforms.uM2U.value = M2U; simRoute = new THREE.Mesh(geo, routeMat); simRoute.frustumCulled = false; simRoute.renderOrder = 7; scene.add(simRoute);
}
/* approximate location: a wide dashed circle (1.5 km) says the point is only known to the city */
const simApprox = (() => { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 160; i++) { const a = i / 160 * SPI * 2; pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a), 0.01, Math.sin(a))); }
  const l = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({color: 0xffd28a, dashSize: .035, gapSize: .025, transparent: true, opacity: .5, depthWrite: false}));
  l.computeLineDistances(); l.renderOrder = 6; l.visible = false; simG.add(l); return l; })();
/* ---- state ---- */
const SIM_S = 1.25;
const STAGE_SITE = {x: (27.1 - 30.8) * 4.455, z: (27 - 25.7) * 5};
/* real footprint (metres across) of each kind of model, used when the hologram is shown at true scale on the map */
const SIM_M = {air: 3200, port: 2600, rail: 1500, hosp: 300, edu: 900, solar: 2400, oil: 1600, agri: 1600, ind: 1100, power: 900, water: 800, sport: 520, cult: 420, road: 2400, gov: 260, hous: 1800, soc: 300, prog: 300};
const sim = {hold: false, k0: -1, on: false, vis: 0, k: 1.3, dur: 5.2, pi: -1, type: "", site: null, ty: 0, sc: 0, parts: [], rot: 0, baseY: 0, ghostFrom: 999, pulse: 0, nat: false, sizeM: 400, s: SIM_S, exact: false, real: false};
function simSite(p){ { const wm = MODELS3D.find(m => m.map && m.key === "wsm" + p.i); if (wm) return {x: wm.x, z: wm.z, nat: false, exact: true}; } if (p.nat || !p.ins.length) return {x: STAGE_SITE.x, z: STAGE_SITE.z, nat: true}; const q = INST[p.ins[0]], g = GEO[p.i];
  if (g && g.f && S.mode !== "layers") return {x: lonX(g.f[0]), z: latZ(g.f[1]), nat: false, exact: true};      /* an airport is framed on its terminals and aprons, not on the middle of the airfield */
  return {x: q.x, z: q.z, nat: false, exact: !!q.exact}; }
function simSizeM(p, type){ if (type === "custom" && ADM.models[p.i]) return admModelSize(ADM.models[p.i]); const g = GEO[p.i], d = SIM_M[type] || 600; if (g && g.f) return g.f[2]; if (g && g.m) return clamp(g.m, d * 0.35, d * 3.2); return d; }
/* true-scale factor (scene units per model unit): the pedestal (radius 2.3) spans the real footprint */
const simRealS = m => m / 2 / 2.3 * M2U;
function simScaleNow(){ return S.mode === "layers" ? SIM_S : simRealS(sim.sizeM); }
function simSiteTy(site, sc){ const c = relH(site.x, site.z); let m = c; const k = (sc || SIM_S) / SIM_S; for (let a = 0; a < 10; a++) for (const r of [1, 2, 3]) m = Math.max(m, relH(site.x + Math.cos(a * .628) * r * k, site.z + Math.sin(a * .628) * r * k)); return c + (m - c) * .85; }
function simDispose(){ if (sim.arch) { sim.arch.h.dispose(); sim.arch = null; } simModel.traverse(o => { if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); }); simG.remove(simModel); }
function showSim(pi, ov){
  if (!pvHas(P[pi]) || !pvMap(P[pi])) { hideSim(); return; }      /* the simulation only ever stands a real model on the map: no generic symbols of a kind */
  const p = P[pi], site = simSite(p), type = ov || simType(p);
  simDispose(); simModel = new THREE.Group(); simG.add(simModel);
  sim.pi = pi; sim.k0 = site.nat ? -1 : p.ins[0]; sim.type = type; sim.site = site; sim.sc = p.sc; sim.nat = site.nat; sim.pulse = p.kd === "p" ? 1 : 0;
  setSimColor(p.sc);
  sim.sizeM = simSizeM(p, type); sim.custom = type === "custom" && !!ADM.models[p.i]; sim.exact = !!site.exact || !!p.admLoc; const g = GEO[p.i]; sim.real = simIsReal(p);
  cityHighlight(null); sim.hiAcc = 1;
  buildRoute(sim.exact ? g : null); routeMat.uniforms.uC.value.copy(col(SECC[p.sc]));
  siteBuild(p, sim.exact ? g : null, site); dressClear();
  sim.ty = simSiteTy(site, simRealS(sim.sizeM));
  /* a project whose building has its own code-built model: that model is the diorama, not a generic symbol of its kind */
  { const am = sim.custom ? null : model3dFor(p.i); if (am) { sim.arch = model3dSimBuild(am, p.sc); simModel.add(sim.arch.fit); } }
  const list = sim.arch ? [] : sim.custom ? admModelParts(ADM.models[p.i], sim.sizeM) : simParts(type), n = list.length; sim.ghostFrom = p.kd === "e" ? Math.max(2, Math.round(n * .58)) : 9999;
  sim.parts = list.map((pt, i) => {
    const ghost = i >= sim.ghostFrom, mesh = new THREE.Mesh(pt.geo, (ghost ? simGhost : pt.ds || sim.custom ? simMatsD : simMats)[pt.tn]);
    if (pt.fc && !pt.geo.attributes.aF) { const n = pt.geo.attributes.position.count, f = new Float32Array(n * 2); for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) { f[q * 2] = pt.fc[0]; f[q * 2 + 1] = pt.fc[1]; } pt.geo.setAttribute("aF", new THREE.BufferAttribute(f, 2)); }
    const ln = new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(pt.geo, 28), ghost ? simLine[2] : simLine[pt.tn === 3 ? 1 : 0]); ln.renderOrder = 5; mesh.add(ln);      /* edges after every face: only the visible ones survive the depth test */
    mesh.position.set(pt.x, pt.y, pt.z); if (pt.q) mesh.quaternion.copy(pt.q); else mesh.rotation.set(pt.rx || 0, pt.ry || 0, pt.rz || 0);
    const bs = pt.sc || [1, 1, 1]; mesh.scale.set(bs[0], 1e-3, bs[2]); pt.geo.computeBoundingBox(); mesh.renderOrder = ghost ? 4.5 : pt.geo.boundingBox.max.y - pt.geo.boundingBox.min.y < .07 && pt.y < .09 && !pt.mv ? 3.6 : 4; simModel.add(mesh);      /* ground slabs and decals first, solids, then the unbuilt ghost parts */
    return {pt, mesh, bs, ghost, d: i === 0 ? 0 : .05 + i / (n - 1) * .66};
  });
  sim.k = 0; sim.hold = false; sim.on = true; simG.visible = true; sim.rot = .4;
  const lb = document.getElementById("simfx"); if (lb) lb.hidden = false; buildSimFx(p, type);
}
function hideSim(){ sim.on = false; sim.pi = -1; sim.hold = false; cityHighlight(null); buildRoute(null); siteClear(); dressClear(); }
function simReplay(){ if (sim.pi >= 0) sim.k = 0; }
/* camera view that frames the model at its site */
function simViewFor(pi){
  const p = P[pi], site = simSite(p), lay = S.mode === "layers", type = simType(p), sz = simSizeM(p, type), sc = lay ? SIM_S : simRealS(sz), f = sc / SIM_S, ty = simSiteTy(site, sc);
  /* relief exaggeration at the destination distance (the view is close, so the ground is shown at true height) */
  const m3 = lay ? null : model3dOfProject(pi), dist0 = lay ? (innerWidth <= 900 ? 23 : 12) : Math.max(0.0119, sz * M2U * (innerWidth <= 900 ? 3.8 : 2.7));
    if (m3) { tmpS.setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(controls.target)); const v = model3dLow(m3, tmpS.theta + .12); return {p: v.p, t: v.t, f: 1e-9}; }   /* a true-shape model on the map: drone height (never above 50 m), close */
  const dist = dist0;
  const relAt = lay ? 1 : lerp(1 / 15, 1, sstep(0.45, 12, dist));
  const kd = dist / dist0, fk = f * kd;                             /* the lift of the look-at point follows the distance, so the site stays centred */
  const by = lay ? plates[p.sc].y + .4 : H + ty * relAt + .32 * sc * kd;
  const t = new THREE.Vector3(site.x, by + 1.3 * fk, site.z); tmpS.setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(controls.target));
  return {p: new THREE.Vector3().setFromSpherical(new THREE.Spherical(dist, lay ? 1.17 : 1.08, tmpS.theta + .12)).add(t), t, f: fk};
}

/* ---- floating data widgets with leader lines, in the spirit of a HUD ---- */
const simFx = document.getElementById("simfx"), simSvg = document.getElementById("simsvg");
const simW = [1, 2, 3].map(i => document.getElementById("fw" + i)), simCap = document.getElementById("simcap");
const simLn = simSvg ? [...simSvg.querySelectorAll("path")] : [], simDm = simSvg ? [...simSvg.querySelectorAll("rect")] : [];
function buildSimFx(p, type){
  if (!simFx) return;
  const when = p.yd === 0 ? p.y : p.yd === 1 ? "منذ " + p.y : "جارٍ حاليًا", cost = p.cd && p.cd !== "—" ? p.cd : "غير محددة بالملف", raw = (p.cf || p.cd === "—") && p.cr;
  simFx.style.setProperty("--lc", SECC[p.sc]);
  simW[0].innerHTML = `<small>الحالة والتوقيت</small><b>${esc(stLabel(p))}${p.yd === 0 ? ` <i>·</i> <span class="num">${esc(String(when))}</span>` : ""}</b>`;
  simW[1].innerHTML = `<small>التكلفة المعلنة</small><b class="num${cost.length > 18 ? " sm" : ""}">${esc(cost)}</b>${raw ? `<em>كما ورد بالملف</em>` : ""}`;
  simW[2].innerHTML = `<small>الجهة</small><b class="sm">${esc(p.mn)}</b>`;
  const st = p.nat ? "مشروع على مستوى الجمهورية: المجسم لا يحدد موقعًا" : p.kd === "e" ? "الجزء المتقطع من المجسم لم يكتمل بعد (توضيحي)" : p.kd === "p" ? "مشروع مستمر (توضيحي)" : "";
  const g = GEO[p.i];
  if (S.mode === "layers" && sim.arch) simCap.innerHTML = `<span><i></i>${sim.arch.ws ? "مجسم الموقع الفعلي · مبني بالكود" : "مجسم المبنى الفعلي · مبني بالكود"}</span><small>على لوح القطاع بمقياس رمزي · الشكل من مراجع المبنى، والتفاصيل تقديرية</small>`;
  else if (simIsReal(p)) simCap.innerHTML = `<span><i></i>المبنى الفعلي بحجمه الحقيقي · ${esc(g.src || "")}</span><small>${(m => m && m.note ? esc(m.note) : "المباني من خرائط OpenStreetMap المفتوحة، والموقع مطابق باسم المشروع")(MODELS3D.find(m => m.map && m.pi === p.i))}</small>`;
  else if (g && g.ln) simCap.innerHTML = `<span><i></i>المسار الفعلي على الخريطة · ${esc(g.src || "")}</span><small>المسار مرسوم من خرائط OpenStreetMap المفتوحة بحجمه الحقيقي</small>`;
  else if (S.mode === "layers") simCap.innerHTML = `<span><i></i>تصوّر ثلاثي الأبعاد توضيحي · ${SIM_NAME[type]}</span><small>على لوح القطاع فقط، وليس التصميم المعتمد للمشروع${st ? " · " + st : ""}</small>`;
  else if (p.nat) simCap.innerHTML = `<span><i></i>مشروع على مستوى الجمهورية</span><small>لا يرتبط بموقع واحد على الخريطة</small>`;
  else if (g) simCap.innerHTML = `<span><i></i>الموقع الفعلي · ${esc(g.src || "")}</span><small>الموقع مطابق من OpenStreetMap، ولا توجد مبانٍ مرسومة له على الخريطة بعد</small>`;
  else simCap.innerHTML = `<span><i></i>الموقع تقريبي داخل ${esc(GN[p.g[0]] || "المحافظة")}</span><small>الملف لا يحدد موقعًا دقيقًا، لذلك لا نعرض مجسمًا للمشروع</small>`;
}
function simSlots(c, R){
  const fr = FREE, cl = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
  const spec = [[c[0] + R * 1.12, c[1] - R * 1.0, 0], [c[0] + R * 1.2, c[1] + R * .12, 0], [c[0] - R * 1.12, c[1] + R * .5, 1]];
  return spec.map(([x, y, left], i) => { const el = simW[i], w = el.offsetWidth, h = el.offsetHeight;
    let px = left ? x - w : x, py = y - h / 2; px = cl(px, fr.x0 + 10, fr.x1 - w - 10); py = cl(py, fr.y0 + 10, fr.y1 - h - 10); return {px, py, w, h, left}; });
}
function updateSimFx(t){
  if (!simFx) return;
  const phone = innerWidth <= 900, show = false;   /* the flat boxes are retired: the same facts now circle the site as cards (borb.js) */
  simW.forEach(e => e.classList.toggle("on", show)); simCap.classList.toggle("on", false);
  if (!show) { simLn.forEach(l => l.setAttribute("d", "")); simDm.forEach(d => d.setAttribute("transform", "translate(-99,-99) rotate(45)")); }
  const x = sim.site.x, z = sim.site.z, y = sim.baseY, f = sim.s / SIM_S;
  const c = screenOf(x, y + 1.45 * f, z), e = screenOf(x + 2.7 * f, y + 1.45 * f, z), R = Math.max(70, Math.min(430, Math.hypot(e[0] - c[0], e[1] - c[1])));
  if (!phone && sim.on) { const dx = camera.position.x - x, dz = camera.position.z - z, dl = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1, fx = x + dx / dl * 3.25 * sim.s, fz = z + dz / dl * 3.25 * sim.s, b = screenOf(fx, y, fz), w = simCap.offsetWidth; const ty = S.show ? FREE.y0 + 10 : Math.min(FREE.y1 - simCap.offsetHeight - 6, b[1] + 6), tx = S.show ? (FREE.x0 + FREE.x1) / 2 - w / 2 : Math.max(FREE.x0 + 8, Math.min(FREE.x1 - w - 8, b[0] - w / 2)); simCap.style.transform = `translate(${tx.toFixed(1)}px,${ty.toFixed(1)}px)`; }
  if (!show) return;
  const sl = simSlots(c, R), anc = [[x + 1.1 * f, y + 3 * f, z], [x + 2.1 * f, y + 1.2 * f, z + .3 * f], [x - 2.1 * f, y + 1 * f, z]];
  sl.forEach((s, i) => { simW[i].style.transform = `translate(${s.px.toFixed(1)}px,${s.py.toFixed(1)}px)`;
    const a = screenOf(anc[i][0], anc[i][1], anc[i][2]), ex = s.left ? s.px + s.w : s.px, ey = s.py + s.h / 2;
    if (a[2] > 1) { simLn[i].setAttribute("d", ""); return; }
    simLn[i].setAttribute("d", `M${ex.toFixed(1)} ${ey.toFixed(1)} H${(ex + (s.left ? 16 : -16)).toFixed(1)} L${a[0].toFixed(1)} ${a[1].toFixed(1)}`);
    simDm[i].setAttribute("transform", `translate(${a[0].toFixed(1)},${a[1].toFixed(1)}) rotate(45)`); });
}

/* ---- per-frame ---- */
function updateSim(dt, t){
  if (sim.hold && !(fly && fly.kind === "dive")) { sim.hold = false; sim.k = 0; diveFxSet(-1); }   /* dive cancelled by the user: build right away */
  sim.vis += ((sim.on && !sim.hold ? 1 : 0) - sim.vis) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
  if (sim.vis < .01 && !sim.on) { if (simG.visible) { simG.visible = false; if (simFx) { simFx.hidden = true; simW.forEach(e => e.classList.remove("on")); simCap.classList.remove("on"); } } return; }
  simG.visible = true; if (simFx && simFx.hidden) simFx.hidden = false;
  if (!sim.hold) sim.k = Math.min(1.3, sim.k + dt / sim.dur); sim.rot += dt * .2; const v0 = sim.vis;
  { const a = sim.hold ? -1 : sim.k * sim.dur; simShock.forEach((m, i) => { const s = a - i * .16; m.visible = s >= 0 && s < 1.15;
      if (m.visible) { const q = s / 1.15; m.scale.setScalar(.25 + (1 - Math.pow(1 - q, 2.2)) * 7.5); m.material.opacity = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, q * 1.1)) * Math.pow(1 - q, 0.6) * (i ? .26 : .45); } }); }
  sim.s = lerp(simRealS(sim.sizeM), SIM_S, mL);
  sim.baseY = lerp(H + sim.ty * TU.uRel.value + (sim.real ? .03 : sim.custom ? .004 : .32) * sim.s, plates[sim.sc].y + .4, mL);
  simG.position.set(sim.site.x, sim.baseY, sim.site.z); simG.scale.setScalar(sim.s); simModel.rotation.y = sim.real ? 0 : sim.custom ? sim.rot * (mL > 0.5 ? 1 : 0) : sim.rot;
  simModel.visible = mL > 0.5 || !!sim.custom;   /* the illustrative model only lives on the abstract layer plates; on the map everything is real scale */
  CU.uGrow.value = clamp((sim.k - 0.08) / 0.85, 0, 1);
  /* the real buildings at an exactly located site light up in the sector colour */
  CU.uHiCol.value.set(SECC[sim.sc]); CU.uHiK.value = sim.real ? v0 * (1 - mL) : 0; CU.uHiR.value = 0;
  if (sim.real && sim.on) { sim.hiAcc = (sim.hiAcc || 0) + dt; if (sim.hiAcc > 0.5) { sim.hiAcc = 0; cityHighlight(GEO[P[sim.pi].i], sim.site); } }
  [simPlate, simCone, simPool, simShade].forEach(o => o.visible = mL > 0.5);
  routeMat.uniforms.uA.value = v0 * (1 - mL) * (0.35 + 0.65 * ZS.close);
  simApprox.visible = !sim.exact && !sim.nat && mL < 0.5; if (simApprox.visible) { const r = 1500 * M2U / sim.s; simApprox.scale.set(r, 1, r); simApprox.material.opacity = 0.55 * v0; simApprox.rotation.y = t * 0.03; }
  const v = v0, pulse = 1 + (sim.pulse ? .35 * Math.sin(t * 2.4) : 0), fl = .95 + .05 * Math.sin(t * 31);
  simMats.forEach((m, i) => { m.opacity = SIM_O[i] * v * fl; m.emissiveIntensity = pulse; }); simGhost.forEach((m, i) => { m.opacity = SIM_GO[i] * v * (.8 + .4 * Math.sin(t * 2 + i)); m.emissiveIntensity = 1; });
  simLine.forEach((m, i) => m.opacity = (i === 0 ? .85 : i === 1 ? .95 : .34 + .12 * Math.sin(t * 2)) * v);
  const scanF = (t * .2) % 1, rk = (sim.real ? .4 : .55) * (mL > 0.5 ? 1 / .55 : 1); simRing.opacity = .36 * v * rk; simDash.opacity = .42 * v * rk; simScan.material.opacity = .32 * v * Math.sin(Math.PI * scanF) * (sim.real ? 0 : 1); simU.uA.value = v * (.55 + .45 * Math.min(1, sim.k * 2));
  const gy = lerp(H + relH(sim.site.x, sim.site.z) * TU.uRel.value, plates[sim.sc].y, mL) + .03 * sim.s / SIM_S; simTeth.scale.y = Math.max(.001, (sim.baseY - gy) / sim.s); simTeth.material.opacity = .5 * v * (sim.baseY - gy > .44 * sim.s ? 1 : 0); simTeth.material.color.copy(simRing.color); simTeth.scale.x = simTeth.scale.z = 1;
  simShade.material.uniforms.uA.value = v; simDashL.rotation.y = -t * .06; simScan.position.y = scanF * 3.1;
  for (const s of sim.parts) { const pt = s.pt, m = s.mesh, p = clamp((sim.k - s.d) / .3, 0, 1), e = p * p * (3 - 2 * p);
    m.visible = p > .002;
    if (pt.gr === "y") m.scale.set(s.bs[0], Math.max(1e-3, s.bs[1] * e * (pt.flick ? 1 + .3 * Math.sin(t * 17) : 1)), s.bs[2]); else m.scale.setScalar(Math.max(1e-3, e));
    if (p >= 1 && !s.ghost) { if (pt.spin) m.rotation[pt.spin[0]] = t * pt.spin[1]; if (pt.mv) { const o = pt.mv(t); m.position.set(pt.x + o[0], pt.y + o[1], pt.z + o[2]); if (o.length > 3) { m.scale.setScalar(Math.max(1e-3, o[3])); m.rotation.z = o[4] || 0; } } } }
  if (sim.arch) { const a = sim.arch, q = clamp((sim.k - .06) / .8, 0, 1), e = q * q * (3 - 2 * q); a.fit.scale.set(a.s, a.s * Math.max(.002, e), a.s); const o = Math.round(v * 40) / 40; if (o !== a.o) { a.o = o; a.mats.forEach(m => { m.opacity = o; }); } }
  siteUpdate(dt, t, v0);
  dressUpdate(dt, t, v0);
  updateSimFx(t);
}


/* ================= work site: a project still under construction =================
   Its real footprint from the map is raised as a hatched scaffold envelope and tower cranes work around it.
   Both are a sign for "under construction", sized to the site; they are not the project's design, and the status card says so. */
const siteG = new THREE.Group(); siteG.visible = false; scene.add(siteG);
const siteU = {uTime: U.uTime, uC: {value: new THREE.Color()}, uA: {value: 0}, uGrow: {value: 0}, uBase: {value: H}, uHt: {value: 0.01}, uHm: {value: 30}, uUC: {value: 1}, uTwin: TU.uTwin};
const SITE_VS = `uniform float uGrow; uniform float uBase; uniform float uHt; attribute float aT; attribute float aL; varying float vT; varying float vL;
  void main(){ vT = aT; vL = aL; vec3 p = vec3(position.x, uBase + aT * uHt * uGrow, position.z); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * modelMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0); }`;
/* light added to the dark map; on the sand map added light is invisible, so there the scaffold, frame and cranes are drawn in a deeper tone of the sector colour (one premultiplied blend serves both themes) */
const siteWallMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: siteU, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendSrc: THREE.OneFactor, blendDst: THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor, extensions: {derivatives: true}, vertexShader: SITE_VS,
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; uniform float uHm; uniform float uGrow; uniform float uUC; uniform float uTwin; varying float vT; varying float vL;
    void main(){ float ym = vT * uHm * uGrow;                                   /* metres up the wall */
      float fl = abs(fract(ym / 4.0) - 0.5), fw1 = max(fwidth(ym / 4.0), 1e-4); float floors = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.5, (0.5 - fl) / fw1);      /* a deck line every 4 m */
      float pv = abs(fract(vL / 9.0) - 0.5), fw2 = max(fwidth(vL / 9.0), 1e-4); float posts = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.5, (0.5 - pv) / fw2);       /* a standard every 9 m */
      float dg = abs(fract((vL + ym) / 9.0 - uTime * 0.04) - 0.5); float brace = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.035, 0.5 - dg)) * 0.5;                 /* diagonal bracing, drifting slowly */
      float top = smoothstep(0.93, 1.0, vT);
      /* a finished site with no mapped buildings gets a plain low glass kerb round its real outline; scaffolding only where work is still under way */
      float a = uA * mix(0.1 + 0.3 * (1.0 - vT) + 0.6 * top, 0.07 + 0.42 * max(floors, posts) + 0.2 * brace + 0.5 * top, uUC); float aS = min(1.0, a * 1.3); gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uC * 0.5 * aS, (uC * a + vec3(1.0) * top * uA * 0.25) * a, uTwin), aS * (1.0 - uTwin)); }`});
const siteLineMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: siteU, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendSrc: THREE.OneFactor, blendDst: THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor, vertexShader: SITE_VS,
  fragmentShader: `uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; uniform float uTwin; varying float vT; varying float vL; void main(){ gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uC * 0.45 * uA, mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.35) * uA * uA, uTwin), uA * (1.0 - uTwin)); }`});
const craneMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending});
const craneLamp = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xff5540, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending});
/* one tower crane in metres: a lattice mast 70 m tall, a 55 m jib with its tie bars and a counter-jib */
const CRANE = (() => {
  const m = [], j = [], L = (a, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) => a.push(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1), w = 1.3, Hm = 70;
  [[-w, -w], [w, -w], [w, w], [-w, w]].forEach(([x, z]) => L(m, x, 0, z, x, Hm, z));
  for (let y = 0; y < Hm; y += 7) { const c = [[-w, -w], [w, -w], [w, w], [-w, w]]; for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) { const a = c[q], b = c[(q + 1) % 4]; L(m, a[0], y, a[1], b[0], y, b[1]); L(m, a[0], y, a[1], b[0], y + 7, b[1]); } }
  [[-4, -4], [4, -4], [4, 4], [-4, 4]].forEach(([x, z], q, c) => { const b = c[(q + 1) % 4]; L(m, x, 0.3, z, b[0], 0.3, b[1]); L(m, x, 0.3, z, x * 0.33, 6, z * 0.33); });          /* ballast base */
  const JL = 55, CL = 16, z = 1.1; L(j, -CL, 0, -z, JL, 0, -z); L(j, -CL, 0, z, JL, 0, z); L(j, 0, 3.2, 0, JL, 1.2, 0);
  for (let x = 0; x < JL; x += 5.5) { L(j, x, 0, -z, x, 0, z); const yt = 3.2 - x / JL * 2, yn = 3.2 - (x + 5.5) / JL * 2; L(j, x, 0, -z, x + 2.75, (yt + yn) / 2, 0); L(j, x, 0, z, x + 2.75, (yt + yn) / 2, 0); L(j, x + 2.75, (yt + yn) / 2, 0, x + 5.5, 0, -z); L(j, x + 2.75, (yt + yn) / 2, 0, x + 5.5, 0, z); }
  L(j, 0, 0, 0, 0, 11, 0); L(j, 0, 11, 0, JL * 0.72, 2.2, 0); L(j, 0, 11, 0, -CL, 0.5, 0);                                                                                   /* tower head and tie bars */
  [[-CL, -z], [-CL, z]].forEach(([x, zz]) => L(j, x, 0, zz, x, -4, zz)); L(j, -CL, -4, -z, -CL, -4, z); L(j, -CL + 5, -4, -z, -CL + 5, -4, z); L(j, -CL, -4, -z, -CL + 5, -4, -z); L(j, -CL, -4, z, -CL + 5, -4, z); L(j, -CL + 5, 0, -z, -CL + 5, -4, -z); L(j, -CL + 5, 0, z, -CL + 5, -4, z);   /* counterweight */
  L(j, 34, 0, 0, 34, -32, 0); L(j, 32.6, -32, 0, 35.4, -32, 0); L(j, 32.6, -32, 0, 34, -35, 0); L(j, 35.4, -32, 0, 34, -35, 0);                                                    /* trolley rope and hook block */
  const G = a => { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(a, 3)); return g; };
  return {mast: G(m), jib: G(j), H: Hm, lamp: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.9, 8, 6)};
})();
let siteParts = null; const siteWhite = new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1);
function siteClear(){ if (!siteParts) return; siteParts.own.forEach(g => g.dispose()); while (siteG.children.length) siteG.remove(siteG.children[0]); siteParts = null; siteG.visible = false; }
function siteBuild(p, g, site){
  siteClear(); if (!g || g.ln) return; const uc = p.kd === "e"; if (!uc && (!g.pl || g.pl.length < 3 || (g.b || 0) >= 1)) return;
  const sizeM = clamp(g.m || 400, 80, 9000); siteU.uUC.value = uc ? 1 : 0;
  let ring = g.pl && g.pl.length > 2 ? g.pl.map(([lo, la]) => [lonX(lo), latZ(la)]) : null;
  if (!ring) { ring = []; const r = sizeM / 2 * M2U; for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) { const a = i / 28 * Math.PI * 2; ring.push([site.x + Math.cos(a) * r, site.z + Math.sin(a) * r]); } }
  const n = ring.length, hm = uc ? clamp(sizeM * 0.035, 12, 48) : clamp(sizeM * 0.012, 5, 22);
  /* envelope walls and its line frame */
  const P = [], T = [], Lm = [], I = [], LP = [], LT = [], LL = []; let acc = 0, cx = 0, cz = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % n], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) / M2U, base = P.length / 3;
    P.push(a[0], 0, a[1], b[0], 0, b[1], b[0], 0, b[1], a[0], 0, a[1]); T.push(0, 0, 1, 1); Lm.push(acc, acc + len, acc + len, acc); I.push(base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3);
    LP.push(a[0], 0, a[1], b[0], 0, b[1], a[0], 0, a[1], b[0], 0, b[1], a[0], 0, a[1], a[0], 0, a[1]); LT.push(1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1); LL.push(acc, acc + len, acc, acc + len, acc, acc);
    acc += len; cx += a[0]; cz += a[1]; }
  cx /= n; cz /= n;
  const wg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); wg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(P, 3)); wg.setAttribute("aT", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(T, 1)); wg.setAttribute("aL", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(Lm, 1)); wg.setIndex(I);
  const lg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); lg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(LP, 3)); lg.setAttribute("aT", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(LT, 1)); lg.setAttribute("aL", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(LL, 1));
  const walls = new THREE.Mesh(wg, siteWallMat); walls.frustumCulled = false; walls.renderOrder = 7; siteG.add(walls);
  const frame = new THREE.LineSegments(lg, siteLineMat); frame.frustumCulled = false; frame.renderOrder = 8; siteG.add(frame);
  siteU.uHt.value = hm * M2U; siteU.uHm.value = hm; siteU.uBase.value = H + 1.5 * M2U; siteU.uC.value.set(SECC[p.sc]);
  /* cranes: spaced along the perimeter, stepped in toward the middle of the site */
  /* a tower crane is 45 to 95 m tall whatever the size of the site: a larger site gets more cranes, not taller ones */
  const nc = uc ? clamp(Math.round(acc / 420), 2, 9) : 0, ch = clamp(sizeM * 0.11, 45, 95), sc = ch / (CRANE.H + 11) * M2U, cranes = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < nc; c++) { let d = (c + 0.5) / nc * acc, x = ring[0][0], z = ring[0][1];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % n], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) / M2U; if (d <= len || i === n - 1) { const f = len > 0 ? clamp(d / len, 0, 1) : 0; x = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f; z = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f; break; } d -= len; }
    x += (cx - x) * 0.2; z += (cz - z) * 0.2;
    const grp = new THREE.Group(); grp.position.set(x, H + 1.5 * M2U, z); grp.scale.setScalar(sc); grp.rotation.y = c * 1.7;
    const mast = new THREE.LineSegments(CRANE.mast, craneMat), jib = new THREE.Group(); jib.position.y = CRANE.H; jib.add(new THREE.LineSegments(CRANE.jib, craneMat));
    const lamp = new THREE.Mesh(CRANE.lamp, craneLamp); lamp.position.y = 11.5; jib.add(lamp);
    [mast, jib.children[0]].forEach(o => { o.frustumCulled = false; o.renderOrder = 8; }); grp.add(mast); grp.add(jib); siteG.add(grp); cranes.push({grp, jib, ph: c * 2.1, sp: 0.1 + 0.05 * ((c * 7) % 3), sc});
  }
  craneMat.color.set(SECC[p.sc]).lerp(new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), 0.35);
  siteParts = {own: [wg, lg], cranes}; siteG.visible = true;
}
function siteUpdate(dt, t, v){
  if (!siteParts) return; const on = (1 - mL) * v; siteG.visible = on > 0.01; if (!siteG.visible) return;
  const gk = clamp((sim.k - 0.05) / 0.7, 0, 1), ge = gk * gk * (3 - 2 * gk);
  const sand = TU.uTwin.value < 0.5; craneMat.blending = craneLamp.blending = sand ? THREE.NormalBlending : THREE.AdditiveBlending;
  craneMat.color.set(SECC[sim.sc]); if (sand) craneMat.color.multiplyScalar(0.45); else craneMat.color.lerp(siteWhite, 0.35);
  siteU.uA.value = on; siteU.uGrow.value = ge; craneMat.opacity = 0.9 * on; craneLamp.opacity = on * (0.35 + 0.65 * (Math.sin(t * 3.2) > 0.3 ? 1 : 0));
  siteParts.cranes.forEach((c, i) => { const ck = clamp((sim.k - 0.12 - i * 0.07) / 0.5, 0, 1), ce = ck * ck * (3 - 2 * ck);          /* each mast climbs, then its jib starts to slew */
    c.grp.scale.set(c.sc, c.sc * Math.max(0.001, ce), c.sc); c.jib.rotation.y = c.ph + Math.sin(t * c.sp + c.ph) * 1.25 * ce; });
}


/* ================= life at the site: what moves there, by the kind of place it is =================
   Airports get aircraft rolling down their real runways and parked on their aprons; rail and monorail lines get trains on the real track;
   road axes and bridges get buses and cars on the real carriageway; container terminals get quay cranes and stacks inside their real outline.
   The geometry they ride on is the map's own (OpenStreetMap); the vehicles themselves are symbols, enlarged a little so they read from the air. */
const dressG = new THREE.Group(); dressG.visible = false; scene.add(dressG);
/* one shaded material for every prop: pearl body tinted by the sector colour, soft sky/sun shading, a thin luminous rim, a glazing band.
   aTone: 0 body · 1 secondary surfaces · 2 sector-colour accent · 3 dark (tyres, intakes) ; aBand = glazing band in model metres (y0, y1, x0, x1) */
const dressU = {uC: {value: new THREE.Color()}, uA: {value: 0}, uT: U.uTime};
const dressMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: dressU, transparent: true, depthWrite: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  vertexShader: `attribute float aTone; attribute vec4 aBand; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying vec3 vP; varying float vTone; varying vec4 vBand;
    void main(){ vec4 lp = vec4(position, 1.0); vec3 n = normal;
      #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
        lp = instanceMatrix * lp; n = mat3(instanceMatrix) * n;
      #endif
      vec4 wp = modelMatrix * lp; vN = mat3(modelMatrix) * n; vV = cameraPosition - wp.xyz; vP = position; vTone = aTone; vBand = aBand; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp; }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying vec3 vP; varying float vTone; varying vec4 vBand;
    void main(){ vec3 n = normalize(vN), v = normalize(vV); float ndv = clamp(abs(dot(n, v)), 0.0, 1.0), rim = pow(1.0 - ndv, 3.0);
      vec3 L = normalize(vec3(0.45, 0.8, 0.35)); float lam = max(dot(n, L), 0.0), sky = 0.5 + 0.5 * n.y, sh = 0.3 + 0.24 * sky + 0.46 * lam;
      float spec = pow(max(dot(n, normalize(L + v)), 0.0), 48.0);
      vec3 base = mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.84); float gl = 1.0;
      if (vTone > 2.5) { base = vec3(0.035, 0.05, 0.08); gl = 0.25; } else if (vTone > 1.5) base = mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.1); else if (vTone > 0.5) base = mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.66) * 0.9;
      float band = step(vBand.x, vP.y) * step(vP.y, vBand.y) * step(vBand.z, vP.x) * step(vP.x, vBand.w);
      if (vTone > 0.1 && vTone < 0.4) band = max(band, step(15.75, vP.x) * step(vP.x, 17.3) * step(4.32, vP.y) * step(vP.y, 4.98));      /* flight-deck windows */
      base = mix(base, mix(vec3(0.03, 0.06, 0.11), uC, 0.22), band);
      vec3 c = base * sh + vec3(1.0) * spec * 0.3 * gl + mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.55) * rim * 0.5 * gl + mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.7) * band * 0.22;
      gl_FragColor = vec4(c, uA); }`});
const dressLine = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false});
/* navigation lights are drawn as round screen-space points so they stay crisp at any zoom */
const dressDot = (() => { const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = c.height = 32; const x = c.getContext("2d"), g = x.createRadialGradient(16, 16, 0, 16, 16, 16);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)"); g.addColorStop(0.25, "rgba(255,255,255,.85)"); g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)"); x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 32); return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); })();
const mkDotMat = sz => new THREE.PointsMaterial({size: sz, sizeAttenuation: false, map: dressDot, vertexColors: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false});
const dressShadow = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map: dressDot, color: 0x000814, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, toneMapped: false});

const dressNav = mkDotMat(7), dressStrobe = mkDotMat(10), dressBeacon = mkDotMat(8);
/* a true-size airliner is only a few pixels long in the wide view of an airfield, so each one carries a locator sized in screen pixels: a small soft glint on the parked ones,
   and a thin breathing ring on the one that is moving. Both fade out as the aircraft itself grows on screen (gone once it is about 64 px long), so nothing is left on the close-up. */
const dressGlintU = {uC: dressU.uC, uA: {value: 0}, uT: U.uTime, uPx: {value: 800}, uPR: {value: 1}, uLen: {value: 37.6 * M2U}, uTwin: TU.uTwin};
const mkGlint = ring => new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: dressGlintU, defines: ring ? {RING: 1} : {}, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, depthTest: false,
  blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendSrc: THREE.OneFactor, blendDst: THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor,
  vertexShader: `uniform float uPx; uniform float uPR; uniform float uLen; varying float vF; varying float vPh;
    void main(){ vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); vec4 mv = viewMatrix * w; float px = uLen * uPx / max(-mv.z, 1e-6);      /* length of the aircraft on screen, device pixels */
      vF = 1.0 - smoothstep(26.0 * uPR, 64.0 * uPR, px); vPh = fract(sin(dot(floor(w.xz / uLen * 3.0), vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
      #ifdef RING
        gl_PointSize = 40.0 * uPR;
      #else
        gl_PointSize = 9.0 * uPR;
      #endif
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,

    void main(){ float r = length(gl_PointCoord - 0.5) * 2.0; if (vF < 0.004 || r > 1.0) discard; float a;
      #ifdef RING
        float q = fract(uT * 0.4); a = smoothstep(0.075, 0.0, abs(r - 0.8)) * 0.6 + smoothstep(0.1, 0.0, abs(r - (0.22 + 0.58 * q))) * (1.0 - q) * 0.5;
      #else
        a = (smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, r) * 0.3 + smoothstep(0.5, 0.0, r) * 0.5) * (0.72 + 0.28 * sin(uT * 2.1 + vPh * 6.2832));
      #endif
      a *= vF * uA; vec3 c = mix(uC * 0.55, mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.6), uTwin);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(c * a, a * (1.0 - uTwin * 0.85)); }`});            /* light on the dark map (nearly additive), a deeper tone of the sector colour on the sand map */
const dressGlint = mkGlint(false), dressHalo = mkGlint(true);
const D_GLINT = (() => { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute([0, 4, 0], 3)); return g; })();
/* ---- geometry kit (metres, nose along +x, standing on y = 0) ---- */
const dSmooth = (pos, idx) => { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setIndex(idx); g.computeVertexNormals(); const q = g.toNonIndexed(); g.dispose(); return q; };
/* a body lofted through cross-sections [x, centreY, halfHeight, halfWidth]; n = 2 round, higher = rounded box; open ends are closed with flat caps */
function dLoft(st, N, n, open){
  const pos = [], idx = [], e = 2 / (n || 2), M = st.length, up = st[M - 1][0] > st[0][0], out = [];
  const ring = ([x, cy, ry, rz]) => { const r = []; for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) { const a = j / N * Math.PI * 2, c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a); r.push(x, cy + ry * Math.sign(s) * Math.pow(Math.abs(s), e), rz * Math.sign(c) * Math.pow(Math.abs(c), e)); } return r; };
  st.forEach(s => pos.push(...ring(s)));
  for (let i = 0; i < M - 1; i++) for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) { const a = i * N + j, b = i * N + (j + 1) % N, c = a + N, d = b + N; if (up) idx.push(a, c, b, b, c, d); else idx.push(a, b, c, b, d, c); }
  out.push(dSmooth(pos, idx));
  [0, M - 1].forEach(i => { const s = st[i]; if (open || s[2] < 0.02 || s[3] < 0.02) return; const p = ring(s), ix = []; p.push(s[0], s[1], 0); const first = (i === 0) === up; for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) { const b = (j + 1) % N; if (first) ix.push(N, j, b); else ix.push(N, b, j); } out.push(dSmooth(p, ix)); });
  return out;
}
/* a lifting surface lofted through sections [leading edge x, y, z, chord, thickness, thickness axis y, thickness axis z]; the chord runs back along -x */
const D_FOIL = [[0, 0], [.03, .3], [.12, .46], [.3, .5], [.6, .36], [1, .03], [1, -.03], [.6, -.2], [.3, -.34], [.12, -.34], [.03, -.24]];
function dFoil(st0){
  const l = st0[st0.length - 1], p = st0[st0.length - 2], d = [l[0] - p[0], l[1] - p[1], l[2] - p[2]], dl = Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]) || 1, o = l[4] * 0.6 / dl;
  const st = st0.concat([[l[0] + d[0] * o - l[3] * 0.1, l[1] + d[1] * o, l[2] + d[2] * o, l[3] * 0.78, l[4] * 0.08, l[5], l[6]]]);      /* rounded tip */
  const pos = [], idx = [], N = D_FOIL.length, M = st.length;
  st.forEach(([x, y, z, c, t, ay, az]) => D_FOIL.forEach(([u, w]) => pos.push(x - u * c, y + w * t * ay, z + w * t * az)));
  const V = i => new THREE.Vector3(pos[i * 3], pos[i * 3 + 1], pos[i * 3 + 2]), nn = V(N + 3).sub(V(3)).cross(V(4).sub(V(3))), flip = nn.y * st[0][5] + nn.z * st[0][6] < 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < M - 1; i++) for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) { const a = i * N + j, b = i * N + (j + 1) % N, c = a + N, e = b + N; if (flip) idx.push(a, b, c, b, e, c); else idx.push(a, c, b, b, c, e); }
  return dSmooth(pos, idx);
}
const dBox = (w, h, d, x, y, z) => new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d).translate(x, y, z).toNonIndexed();
const dWheel = (r, w, x, z) => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, r, w, 16).rotateX(Math.PI / 2).translate(x, r, z).toNonIndexed();
const dRod = (r, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) => { const a = new THREE.Vector3(x0, y0, z0), b = new THREE.Vector3(x1, y1, z1), d = b.clone().sub(a), len = d.length(); const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, r, len, 8).toNonIndexed();
  g.applyMatrix4(new THREE.Matrix4().compose(a.add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5), new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), d.normalize()), new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1))); return g; };
const dMirror = g => g.clone().applyMatrix4(new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(1, 1, -1));
/* parts: [geometry or list, tone, band] -> one buffer with position, normal, aTone, aBand */
function dBuild(parts){
  const pos = [], nor = [], tone = [], band = [];
  parts.forEach(([geo, t, bd]) => [].concat(geo).forEach(q => { const a = q.attributes.position.array, n = q.attributes.normal.array; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 3) { pos.push(a[i], a[i + 1], a[i + 2]); nor.push(n[i], n[i + 1], n[i + 2]); tone.push(t || 0); if (bd) band.push(bd[0], bd[1], bd[2], bd[3]); else band.push(0, 0, 0, 0); } q.dispose(); }));
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
  g.setAttribute("aTone", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(tone, 1)); g.setAttribute("aBand", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(band, 4)); return g;
}
