/* ---- map geometry near the site, from the street tiles already loaded ---- */
function tileLines(sec, pred, cx, cz, R){
  const out = [];
  cityTiles.forEach(e => { const T = e.T; if (Math.hypot(T.cx - cx, T.cz - cz) > R + T.size) return; const [meta, co] = T.sec[sec]; let m = 0, c = 0;
    while (m < meta.length) {
      if (sec === 5 && meta[m] < 100) { const nr = meta[m + 1]; let tot = 0; for (let r = 0; r < nr; r++) tot += meta[m + 2 + r]; m += 2 + nr; c += tot * 2; continue; }
      const cls = meta[m], n = meta[m + 1]; m += 2; if (!pred(cls)) { c += n * 2; continue; }
      const pts = []; let near = false; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = T.sx(co[c]), z = T.sz(co[c + 1]); c += 2; pts.push([x, z]); if (!near && Math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz) < R) near = true; }
      if (near && n > 1) out.push(pts); } });
  return out;
}
function tilePolyCentres(sec, pred, cx, cz, R){
  const out = [];
  cityTiles.forEach(e => { const T = e.T; if (Math.hypot(T.cx - cx, T.cz - cz) > R + T.size) return; const [meta, co] = T.sec[sec]; let m = 0, c = 0;
    while (m < meta.length) { const cls = meta[m];
      if (sec === 5 && cls >= 100) { const n = meta[m + 1]; m += 2; c += n * 2; continue; }
      const nr = meta[m + 1]; m += 2; let x = 0, z = 0, n0 = meta[m], k = 0, x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, z0 = 1e9, z1 = -1e9; const ring = [];
      for (let r = 0; r < nr; r++) { const n = meta[m + r]; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (r === 0) { const px = T.sx(co[c]), pz = T.sz(co[c + 1]); x += px; z += pz; k++; ring.push([px, pz]); x0 = Math.min(x0, px); x1 = Math.max(x1, px); z0 = Math.min(z0, pz); z1 = Math.max(z1, pz); } c += 2; } }
      m += nr; if (!pred(cls) || !k) continue; x /= k; z /= k; if (Math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz) < R) out.push({x, z, r: Math.max(x1 - x0, z1 - z0) / 2, ring}); } });
  return out;
}
/* tiles cut every line at their borders: stitch the pieces back into runs by their end points */
function chainLines(lines, tol){
  const L = lines.map(l => l.slice()), used = new Array(L.length).fill(false), out = [], near = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]) < tol;
  for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { if (used[i]) continue; used[i] = true; let cur = L[i], grew = true;
    while (grew) { grew = false; for (let j = 0; j < L.length; j++) { if (used[j]) continue; const b = L[j];
        if (near(cur[cur.length - 1], b[0])) cur = cur.concat(b.slice(1)); else if (near(cur[cur.length - 1], b[b.length - 1])) cur = cur.concat(b.slice(0, -1).reverse());
        else if (near(cur[0], b[b.length - 1])) cur = b.slice(0, -1).concat(cur); else if (near(cur[0], b[0])) cur = b.slice(1).reverse().concat(cur); else continue;
        used[j] = true; grew = true; } }
    out.push(cur); }
  return out;
}
function mkPath(pts){ const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); return {pts, cum, len: cum[cum.length - 1]}; }
function pathAt(P, s, out){ s = clamp(s, 0, P.len); let i = 1; while (i < P.cum.length - 1 && P.cum[i] < s) i++; const a = P.pts[i - 1], b = P.pts[i], l = P.cum[i] - P.cum[i - 1] || 1, f = (s - P.cum[i - 1]) / l;
  out.x = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f; out.z = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f; out.yaw = Math.atan2(-(b[1] - a[1]), b[0] - a[0]); return out; }
const dPos = {x: 0, z: 0, yaw: 0}, dObj = new THREE.Object3D(), dVec = new THREE.Vector3();
const dMesh = (geo, mat) => { const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); m.frustumCulled = false; m.renderOrder = 9; return m; };
const dInRing = (ring, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = ring.length - 1; i < ring.length; j = i++) { const [xi, zi] = ring[i], [xj, zj] = ring[j]; if ((zi > z) !== (zj > z) && x < (xj - xi) * (z - zi) / (zj - zi) + xi) c = !c; } return c; };
function mkPlane(k, moving){ const g = new THREE.Group(); g.add(dMesh(D_PLANE, dressMat));
  (moving ? [dressHalo, dressGlint] : [dressGlint]).forEach(m => { const p = new THREE.Points(D_GLINT, m); p.frustumCulled = false; p.renderOrder = 12; g.add(p); });
  [[D_NAV, dressNav], [D_STROBE, dressStrobe], [D_BEACON, dressBeacon]].forEach(([geo, m]) => { const p = new THREE.Points(geo, m); p.frustumCulled = false; p.renderOrder = 11; g.add(p); });
  g.scale.setScalar(M2U * k); dressG.add(g); return g; }
function mkTrain(k, cars){ const g = new THREE.Group(); for (let i = 0; i < cars; i++) { const c = dMesh(i === 0 || i === cars - 1 ? D_CARE : D_CARM, dressMat); c.scale.setScalar(M2U * k); g.add(c); } dressG.add(g); return g; }
function dressBuild(p, g, site, type){
  /* props keep their real size; only on routes tens of kilometres long are vehicles enlarged (at most 2x) so they can be seen at all */
  const R = clamp((g.m || 800) * 0.6, 400, 5200) * M2U, RA = 2600 * M2U, kS = sz => clamp((sim.sizeM * 0.011) / sz, 1, 2), own = [], items = [];
  dressEmpty(); dressQuay = "";
  const routePts = g.ln ? chainLines(g.ln.map(l => l.map(([lo, la]) => [lonX(lo), latZ(la)])), 60 * M2U) : null;
  if (type === "air") {
    const runs = chainLines(tileLines(5, c => c === 101, site.x, site.z, R), 25 * M2U).map(mkPath).filter(P => P.len > 900 * M2U).sort((a, b) => b.len - a.len).slice(0, 2);
    /* one aircraft in the air at a time: it takes off on the main runway, then one lands (on the second runway when there is one), always along the real centre line */
    if (runs.length) { const d0 = pathAt(runs[0], runs[0].len / 2, dPos).yaw;
      const Pl = runs[1] || runs[0]; if (runs[1] && Math.cos(pathAt(Pl, Pl.len / 2, dPos).yaw - d0) < 0) { runs[1] = mkPath(Pl.pts.slice().reverse()); }
      items.push({kind: "fly", P: runs[0], P2: runs[1] || runs[0], o: mkPlane(1, true), sh: mkShadow(52, 50)}); }
    /* parked aircraft: along the edges of the real aprons, nose-in to the edge, a full wing span apart, every one wholly inside the apron */
    const spots = [], U1 = M2U, ok = (ring, x, z, hx, hz) => [[19.5, 0], [-19.5, 0], [-6, 19], [-6, -19], [0, 0]].every(([f, s]) => dInRing(ring, x + hx * f * U1 - hz * s * U1, z + hz * f * U1 + hx * s * U1));
    tilePolyCentres(5, c => c === 4, site.x, site.z, RA).filter(a => a.r > 45 * M2U).sort((a, b) => b.r - a.r).slice(0, 12).forEach(ap => { const ring = ap.ring, n = ring.length; let per = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < n && spots.length < 14 && per < 6; i++) { const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % n], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (len < 60 * U1) continue;
        const ex = (b[0] - a[0]) / len, ez = (b[1] - a[1]) / len; let nx = -ez, nz = ex; if (!dInRing(ring, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2 + nx * 12 * U1, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + nz * 12 * U1)) { nx = -nx; nz = -nz; }
        const pitch = 46 * U1, cnt = Math.min(4, Math.floor((len - 8 * U1) / pitch));
        for (let q = 0; q < cnt && spots.length < 14 && per < 6; q++) { const f = (len - (cnt - 1) * pitch) / 2 + q * pitch, x = a[0] + ex * f + nx * 27 * U1, z = a[1] + ez * f + nz * 27 * U1;
          if (!ok(ring, x, z, -nx, -nz) || spots.some(s => Math.hypot(s.x - x, s.z - z) < 45 * U1)) continue;
          if (runs.some(P => P.pts.some(pt => Math.hypot(pt[0] - x, pt[1] - z) < 90 * U1))) continue;
          spots.push({x, z, yaw: Math.atan2(nz, -nx)}); per++; } } });
    spots.forEach(s => { const o = mkPlane(1); o.position.set(s.x, H + 2 * M2U, s.z); o.rotation.y = s.yaw; const sh = mkShadow(52, 50); sh.position.set(s.x, H + 1.75 * M2U, s.z); sh.rotation.y = s.yaw; items.push({kind: "parked", o}); });
  } else if (type === "rail" || (routePts && /مونوريل|قطار|سكة|مترو/.test(p.n0 || p.n))) {
    const paths = (routePts || chainLines(tileLines(1, c => c === 8 || c === 9, site.x, site.z, R), 20 * M2U)).map(mkPath).filter(P => P.len > 300 * M2U).sort((a, b) => b.len - a.len).slice(0, 3), k = kS(90);
    paths.forEach((P, i) => { const n = routePts ? clamp(Math.round(P.len / (900 * M2U)), 2, 14) : 1, cars = P.len > 260 * M2U * k ? 6 : 4; for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) items.push({kind: "train", P, o: mkTrain(k, cars), off: (q + 0.3) / n, dir: q % 2 ? -1 : 1, k, sp: 28 * M2U * k}); });
  } else if (routePts && type !== "water") {
    /* road axis or bridge: buses and cars on both carriageways, keeping to the right */
    const paths = routePts.map(mkPath).filter(P => P.len > 200 * M2U), tot = paths.reduce((a, P) => a + P.len, 0), k = kS(40), nB = clamp(Math.round(tot / (900 * M2U)), 4, 26), nC = clamp(Math.round(tot / (260 * M2U)), 10, 90);
    const bus = new THREE.InstancedMesh(D_BUS, dressMat, nB), car = new THREE.InstancedMesh(D_AUTO, dressMat, nC); [bus, car].forEach(m => { m.frustumCulled = false; m.renderOrder = 9; dressG.add(m); });
    const pick = u => { let s = u * tot; for (const P of paths) { if (s <= P.len) return [P, s]; s -= P.len; } return [paths[0], 0]; };
    if (paths.length) items.push({kind: "traffic", bus, car, nB, nC, pick, tot, k, paths});
  }
  if (type === "port" && g.pl && g.pl.length > 3 && (g.b || 0) < 1) {
    /* container terminal with nothing mapped inside: real-size gantry cranes along its longest edge and container blocks in the yard behind them, all inside the real outline */
    const ring = g.pl.map(([lo, la]) => [lonX(lo), latZ(la)]), ins = (x, z) => dInRing(ring, x, z);
    /* the quay is the edge of the outline that has the map's own water just outside it and land just inside. The longest such edge gets the cranes.
       If the map shows no water along any edge, no crane is placed at all (a crane on the wrong side would be an error; a missing one is not) and the yard is laid out from the longest edge. */
    const water = tilePolyCentres(2, () => true, site.x, site.z, 9000 * M2U), wet = (x, z) => water.some(w => dInRing(w.ring, x, z));
    let bi = 0, bl = 0, qi = -1, ql = 0, cx = 0, cz = 0; const nR = ring.length;
    ring.forEach((a, i) => { const b = ring[(i + 1) % nR], l = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); cx += a[0]; cz += a[1]; if (l > bl) { bl = l; bi = i; }
      if (l < 150 * M2U || l <= ql || !water.length) return; const ux = (b[0] - a[0]) / l, uz = (b[1] - a[1]) / l; let ox = -uz, oz = ux;
      if (ins((a[0] + b[0]) / 2 + ox * 8 * M2U, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + oz * 8 * M2U)) { ox = -ox; oz = -oz; }                                            /* o points out of the terminal */
      let w = 0, dry = 0, n = 0; [.15, .3, .5, .7, .85].forEach(f => { const x = a[0] + ux * l * f, z = a[1] + uz * l * f; [35, 75].forEach(d => { n++; if (wet(x + ox * d * M2U, z + oz * d * M2U)) w++; }); if (!wet(x - ox * 40 * M2U, z - oz * 40 * M2U)) dry++; });
      if (w / n >= 0.8 && dry >= 4) { ql = l; qi = i; } });
    cx /= nR; cz /= nR; const quay = qi >= 0; if (quay) { bi = qi; bl = ql; } dressQuay = (quay ? "water edge " + qi : "no water edge") + ", " + water.length + " water polygons";
    const a = ring[bi], b = ring[(bi + 1) % nR], ex = (b[0] - a[0]) / bl, ez = (b[1] - a[1]) / bl; let nx = -ez, nz = ex;
    if (quay ? !ins((a[0] + b[0]) / 2 + nx * 8 * M2U, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + nz * 8 * M2U) : (cx - a[0]) * nx + (cz - a[1]) * nz < 0) { nx = -nx; nz = -nz; }      /* n points into the yard */
    const U1 = M2U, blM = bl / U1, yaw = Math.atan2(nz, -nx), cr = [];
    for (let i = 0, nCr = quay ? clamp(Math.round(blM / 120), 2, 8) : 0; i < nCr; i++) { const f = (i + 0.5) / nCr, x = a[0] + ex * bl * f + nx * 23 * U1, z = a[1] + ez * bl * f + nz * 23 * U1;
      if ([[17, 15], [17, -15], [-17, 15], [-17, -15]].every(([dn, de]) => ins(x + nx * dn * U1 + ex * de * U1, z + nz * dn * U1 + ez * de * U1))) cr.push([x, z]); }
    if (cr.length) { const im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(D_STS, dressMat, cr.length); im.frustumCulled = false; im.renderOrder = 9; cr.forEach(([x, z], i) => { dObj.position.set(x, H + 1.5 * M2U, z); dObj.rotation.set(0, yaw, 0); dObj.scale.setScalar(U1); dObj.updateMatrix(); im.setMatrixAt(i, dObj.matrix); }); im.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; dressG.add(im); items.push({kind: "crane", o: im}); }
    const kc = Math.max(1, Math.sqrt(blM / 1200)), du = 13.4 * kc, dv = 9.2 * kc, mats = [], hsh = (i, j) => fr(Math.sin(i * 127.1 + j * 311.7) * 43758.5453);
    for (let iu = 0; iu * du < blM && mats.length < 6000; iu++) { if (iu % 7 === 6) continue;
      for (let iv = 0; iv < 34 && mats.length < 6000; iv++) { if (iv % 5 === 4) continue; const u = (iu + 0.5) * du, v = 62 + iv * dv, x = a[0] + ex * u * U1 + nx * v * U1, z = a[1] + ez * u * U1 + nz * v * U1;
        if (![[7, 4], [7, -4], [-7, 4], [-7, -4]].every(([de, dn]) => ins(x + ex * de * kc * U1 + nx * dn * kc * U1, z + ez * de * kc * U1 + nz * dn * kc * U1))) continue;
        const blk = hsh(Math.floor(iu / 7), Math.floor(iv / 5)), tiers = Math.round(clamp(1 + blk * 3 + (hsh(iu, iv) - 0.5) * 1.6, 0, 4));
        for (let h = 0; h < tiers; h++) { dObj.position.set(x, H + (1.5 + h * 2.59 * kc) * M2U, z); dObj.rotation.set(0, Math.atan2(-ez, ex), 0); dObj.scale.setScalar(U1 * kc); dObj.updateMatrix(); mats.push(dObj.matrix.clone()); } } }
    if (mats.length) { const im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(D_BOX, dressMat, mats.length); im.frustumCulled = false; im.renderOrder = 9; mats.forEach((m, i) => im.setMatrixAt(i, m)); im.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; dressG.add(im); items.push({kind: "stacks", o: im}); }
  }
  dress = {own, items, type, quay: dressQuay}; dressG.visible = items.length > 0; return items.length;
}
/* tiles arrive while the camera is still diving: (re)build when the set of loaded tiles near the site changes */
function dressSync(dt){
  if (!sim.on || sim.pi < 0 || !sim.exact || mL > 0.5) { if (dress) dressClear(); return; }
  dressAcc += dt; if (dressAcc < 0.7 && dress) return; dressAcc = 0;
  const p = P[sim.pi], g = GEO[p.i]; if (!g) return; let n = 0; cityTiles.forEach(e => { if (Math.hypot(e.T.cx - sim.site.x, e.T.cz - sim.site.z) < 6000 * M2U) n++; });
  const sig = sim.pi + "|" + n; if (sig === dressSig) return; dressSig = sig; dressBuild(p, g, sim.site, sim.type);
}
/* take-off and landing in seconds, about 1.6x real time: a 32 s roll to rotation, a steady climb-out; a 3 degree approach, flare, and a long roll-out */
const D_FLY = {T: 66};
function dressUpdate(dt, t, v){
  dressSync(dt); if (!dress || !dress.items.length) return;
  const a = v * (1 - mL) * clamp((sim.k - 0.5) / 0.4, 0, 1); dressG.visible = a > 0.01; if (!dressG.visible) return;
  dressU.uC.value.copy(col(SECC[sim.sc])); dressU.uA.value = a;
  dressGlintU.uA.value = a; dressGlintU.uPR.value = renderer.getPixelRatio(); dressGlintU.uPx.value = renderer.domElement.height / (2 * Math.tan(camera.fov * Math.PI / 360));
  /* the navigation lights are screen-space points too: in the wide view they would swamp a ten-pixel aircraft and run together into white smears, so they shrink and dim with it */
  const pxLen = 37.6 * M2U * dressGlintU.uPx.value / dressGlintU.uPR.value / Math.max(1e-6, camera.position.distanceTo(dVec.set(sim.site.x, H, sim.site.z))), kL = clamp(pxLen / 48, 0.3, 1), aL = a * (0.4 + 0.6 * kL);
  dressNav.size = 7 * kL; dressStrobe.size = 10 * kL; dressBeacon.size = 8 * kL;
  const sf = fr(t / 1.3), bf = fr(t / 1.1 + 0.4); dressNav.opacity = aL * 0.95; dressShadow.opacity = a * 0.42; dressStrobe.opacity = aL * (sf < 0.06 || (sf > 0.14 && sf < 0.2) ? 1 : 0); dressBeacon.opacity = aL * (bf < 0.14 ? 1 : 0.06); const y0 = H + 2 * M2U;
  dress.items.forEach(it => {
    if (it.kind === "fly") { const T = D_FLY.T, tt = fr(t / (2 * T)) * 2 * T, land = tt >= T, q = land ? tt - T : tt, P = land ? it.P2 : it.P, L = P.len / M2U; let s, alt = 0, pitch = 0, vis = true;
      if (!land) { const d = Math.min(0.62 * L, 2100), s0 = Math.min(90, L * 0.04), tr = 32, vr = 2 * d / tr;
        if (q < 4) s = s0; else if (q < 4 + tr) { const w = (q - 4) / tr; s = s0 + d * w * w; pitch = 0.16 * clamp((w - 0.9) / 0.1, 0, 1); }
        else { const c = q - 4 - tr; s = s0 + d + vr * c; pitch = 0.16 + 0.06 * clamp(c / 4, 0, 1); alt = vr * Math.max(0, c - 0.6) * 0.15 * clamp(c / 3, 0.35, 1); vis = q < T - 2; } }
      else { const va = 112, td = Math.min(420, L * 0.16), ta = 30, dr = Math.min(0.6 * L, 1700), tr = 2 * dr / va;
        if (q < ta) { const dist = va * (ta - q); s = td - dist; alt = Math.max(0, dist * 0.0524 - 6 * clamp(1 - dist / 420, 0, 1)); pitch = 0.05 + 0.05 * clamp(1 - dist / 500, 0, 1); }
        else { const c = Math.min(q - ta, tr), w = c / tr; s = td + va * c - 0.5 * va / tr * c * c; pitch = 0.1 * clamp(1 - w * 5, 0, 1); vis = q < ta + tr + 3; } }
      const sU = s * M2U, over = sU < 0 ? sU : Math.max(0, sU - P.len); pathAt(P, clamp(sU, 0, P.len), dPos); const dx = Math.cos(dPos.yaw), dz = -Math.sin(dPos.yaw);
      it.o.position.set(dPos.x + dx * over, y0 + alt * M2U, dPos.z + dz * over); it.o.rotation.set(0, dPos.yaw, 0); it.o.rotateZ(pitch); it.o.visible = vis; it.sh.visible = vis && alt < 260; it.sh.position.set(it.o.position.x, H + 1.75 * M2U, it.o.position.z); it.sh.rotation.y = dPos.yaw; const ss = 1 + alt / 120; it.sh.scale.set(52 * M2U * ss, 1, 50 * M2U * ss); }
    else if (it.kind === "train") { const P = it.P, per = P.len * 2, s0 = fr(it.off + t * it.sp / per) * per, fwd = s0 < P.len, s = fwd ? s0 : per - s0, last = it.o.children.length - 1;
      it.o.children.forEach((car, i) => { pathAt(P, s - (fwd ? 1 : -1) * i * 23.7 * M2U * it.k, dPos); car.position.set(dPos.x, y0, dPos.z); car.rotation.y = dPos.yaw + (i === last ? Math.PI : 0) + (fwd ? 0 : Math.PI); }); }
    else if (it.kind === "traffic") { const lane = 5.5 * M2U * it.k;
      const put = (im, n, sp, sz) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const dir = i % 2 ? 1 : -1, u = fr(i / n + (i * 0.618) % 0.13 + dir * t * sp / it.tot), [P, s] = it.pick(u); pathAt(P, s, dPos);
          dObj.position.set(dPos.x + Math.sin(dPos.yaw) * lane * dir, y0, dPos.z + Math.cos(dPos.yaw) * lane * dir); dObj.rotation.set(0, dPos.yaw + (dir < 0 ? Math.PI : 0), 0); dObj.scale.setScalar(M2U * it.k * sz); dObj.updateMatrix(); im.setMatrixAt(i, dObj.matrix); } im.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; };
      put(it.bus, it.nB, 16 * M2U * it.k, 1); put(it.car, it.nC, 26 * M2U * it.k, 1); }
  });
}


/* ================= building orbit: a project's facts and its photos or videos as curved glass cards circling its site =================
   Replaces the flat HUD boxes. The cards are pieces of a cylinder around the site (the same idea as the sector screens around the country):
   the ones on the far side face the camera and read normally, the ones between the camera and the building fade so they never hide it.
   Tier 1 carries the facts from the file; tier 2 carries media the presenter adds (kept in this browser, or bundled through media/manifest.js offline). */
const BO = {R: 3.0, y: 0.95, h: 1.5, W: 640, Hc: 400, R2: 3.5, y2: 2.7, maxMedia: 8};
const boGroup = new THREE.Group(); simG.add(boGroup);
const boT1 = new THREE.Group(), boT2 = new THREE.Group(); boGroup.add(boT1); boGroup.add(boT2);
const boRingMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending});
const boRing = r => { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 128; i++) { const a = i / 128 * Math.PI * 2; pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(a) * r, 0, Math.cos(a) * r)); } const l = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), boRingMat); l.renderOrder = 9; return l; };
const boRing1 = boRing(BO.R), boRing2 = boRing(BO.R2); boRing1.position.y = BO.y - 0.1; boRing2.position.y = BO.y2 - 0.1; boGroup.add(boRing1); boGroup.add(boRing2);
let boCards = [], boPid = -1, boHover = null, boSpin = 1, boSeq = 0, boAim = false;
const boSpan = r => BO.h * (BO.W / BO.Hc) / r;
function boMat(tex, colHex){
  /* same glass as the sector screens round the country: see-through pane, fine scanlines, a light sweep and a breathing edge.
     Which way the text runs is decided once per card (uFlip, from the side the camera is on), never per pixel, so a card seen edge-on can't show half of itself mirrored. */
  const m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, toneMapped: false, opacity: 0});
  const uu = {uTime: U.uTime, uC: {value: new THREE.Color(colHex)}, uHot: {value: 0}, uSeed: {value: Math.random()}, uFlip: {value: 0}};
  m.userData.u = uu;
  m.onBeforeCompile = sh => { Object.assign(sh.uniforms, uu);
    sh.fragmentShader = sh.fragmentShader.replace("#include <common>", "#include <common>\nuniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uHot; uniform float uSeed; uniform float uFlip;")
      .replace("#include <map_fragment>", `vec2 uvq = vec2(mix(vUv.x, 1.0 - vUv.x, uFlip), vUv.y); vec4 texelColor = texture2D(map, uvq); texelColor = mapTexelToLinear(texelColor); diffuseColor *= texelColor;
        float sw = fract(uTime * 0.09 + uSeed); float band = smoothstep(0.06, 0.0, abs(uvq.x - (1.15 - sw * 1.3)));
        float scan = 0.94 + 0.06 * sin(uvq.y * 150.0 - uTime * 6.0);
        float edge = smoothstep(0.035, 0.0, min(min(uvq.x, 1.0 - uvq.x), min(uvq.y, 1.0 - uvq.y))) * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(uTime * 2.0 + uSeed * 9.0));
        diffuseColor.rgb = diffuseColor.rgb * scan + uC * (band * 0.22 + edge * 0.35 + uHot * 0.16) * diffuseColor.a + vec3(band * 0.08) * diffuseColor.a;`); };
  return m;
}
function boWrap(c, text, maxW){ const words = String(text).split(/\s+/), lines = []; let cur = ""; for (const w of words) { const t = cur ? cur + " " + w : w; if (c.measureText(t).width > maxW && cur) { lines.push(cur); cur = w; } else cur = t; } if (cur) lines.push(cur); return lines; }
/* cards are sized by what they carry: the declared cost is the hero, status and year come second, the entity third; the location note and the add-media tile are small */
function boCanvas(wk, hk){ const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = Math.round(BO.W * (wk || 1)); cv.height = Math.round(BO.Hc * (hk || 1)); cv.wk = wk || 1; cv.hk = hk || 1; return cv; }
function boGlass(c, col, hot){ const Wc = c.canvas.width, Hc = c.canvas.height; c.clearRect(0, 0, Wc, Hc);
  let g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, Hc); g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(6,16,32,0.62)"); g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(3,8,18,0.4)"); c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(0, 0, Wc, Hc);
  g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, Wc, 0); g.addColorStop(0, hexA(col, 0)); g.addColorStop(0.75, hexA(col, hot ? 0.12 : 0.06)); g.addColorStop(1, hexA(col, hot ? 0.34 : 0.22)); c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(0, 0, Wc, Hc);
  c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)"; for (let y = 0; y < Hc; y += 6) c.fillRect(0, y, Wc, 2);
  c.strokeStyle = hexA(col, hot ? 0.95 : 0.5); c.lineWidth = hot ? 6 : 3; c.strokeRect(3, 3, Wc - 6, Hc - 6);
  c.fillStyle = col; [[0, 0, 1, 1], [Wc, 0, -1, 1], [0, Hc, 1, -1], [Wc, Hc, -1, -1]].forEach(([x, y, sx, sy]) => { c.fillRect(x, y, sx * 46, sy * 7); c.fillRect(x, y, sx * 7, sy * 46); });
  c.direction = CDIR; c.textAlign = "right"; c.textBaseline = "alphabetic"; }
const boLite = (col, k) => "#" + new THREE.Color(col).lerp(new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), k).getHexString();
function boLabel(c, col, label, size){ const Wc = c.canvas.width; c.fillStyle = col; c.save(); c.translate(Wc - 50, 62); c.rotate(Math.PI / 4); c.fillRect(-8, -8, 16, 16); c.restore(); c.font = orbFont(600, size || 30, F_HEAD); c.fillStyle = "#b9c6d8"; c.fillText(label, Wc - 78, 73); }
function boFit(c, text, w, fam, px, min, maxLines){ let fs = px, lines; do { c.font = orbFont(700, fs, fam); lines = boWrap(c, text, w); if (lines.length <= maxLines && lines.every(l => c.measureText(l).width <= w)) break; fs -= 3; } while (fs > min); return {fs, lines: lines.slice(0, maxLines)}; }
/* hero: the declared cost. The figure is set as large as the card allows, its unit beside it */
function boCost(col, p){
  const cv = boCanvas(1.5, 1.3), c = cv.getContext("2d"), Wc = cv.width, Hc = cv.height; boGlass(c, col, true); boLabel(c, col, T("التكلفة المعلنة"), 34);
  const has = p.cd && p.cd !== "—", m = has ? String(p.cd).match(/^([\d.,٫٬]+)\s*(.*)$/) : null, raw = (p.cf || p.cd === "—") && p.cr;
  c.shadowColor = hexA(col, 0.8); c.shadowBlur = 26; c.fillStyle = boLite(col, 0.5);
  if (m) { let fs = 250; c.direction = "ltr"; c.font = orbFont(700, fs, F_NUM); while (c.measureText(m[1]).width > Wc * 0.56 && fs > 90) { fs -= 8; c.font = orbFont(700, fs, F_NUM); }
    c.textAlign = "right"; c.fillText(m[1], Wc - 50, Hc * 0.66 + fs * 0.2); const nw = c.measureText(m[1]).width; c.shadowBlur = 0; c.direction = CDIR;
    const u = boFit(c, m[2] || "", Wc - nw - 130, F_HEAD, 62, 30, 2); c.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; u.lines.forEach((l, k) => c.fillText(l, Wc - 80 - nw, Hc * 0.66 + fs * 0.2 - (u.lines.length - 1 - k) * u.fs * 1.2)); }
  else { const f = boFit(c, has ? p.cd : T("غير محددة بالملف"), Wc - 100, has ? F_HEAD : F_HEAD, has ? 92 : 70, 34, 2); c.fillStyle = has ? boLite(col, 0.5) : "#9fb0c6"; f.lines.forEach((l, k) => c.fillText(l, Wc - 50, Hc * 0.5 + k * f.fs * 1.25)); c.shadowBlur = 0; }
  c.shadowBlur = 0; if (raw) { c.font = orbFont(500, 26, F_BODY); c.fillStyle = "#ffc98a"; c.fillText(T("كما ورد بالملف"), Wc - 50, Hc - 38); }
  return cv;
}
/* second: status with the year as the figure */
function boStatus(col, p, note){
  const cv = boCanvas(1.15, 1.05), c = cv.getContext("2d"), Wc = cv.width, Hc = cv.height; boGlass(c, col); boLabel(c, col, p.yd === 0 ? T("سنة الانتهاء أو التشغيل") : T("الحالة"), 28);
  const st = stLabel(p), yr = p.yd === 0 ? String(p.y) : p.yd === 1 ? String(p.y) : "";
  let y = Hc * 0.6;
  if (yr) { c.direction = "ltr"; c.textAlign = "right"; c.font = orbFont(700, 150, F_NUM); c.fillStyle = boLite(col, 0.45); c.shadowColor = hexA(col, 0.7); c.shadowBlur = 18; c.fillText(yr, Wc - 50, y); const nw = c.measureText(yr).width; c.shadowBlur = 0; c.direction = CDIR;
    if (p.yd === 1) { c.font = orbFont(500, 34, F_HEAD); c.fillStyle = "#b9c6d8"; c.fillText(T("منذ"), Wc - 70 - nw, y - 10); } }
  /* status pill: solid for done, outlined for ongoing, dashed for work still under way */
  const f = boFit(c, st, Wc - 150, F_HEAD, yr ? 40 : 76, 26, yr ? 1 : 2), py = yr ? Hc * 0.6 + 78 : Hc * 0.55, tw = Math.max(...f.lines.map(l => c.measureText(l).width));
  if (yr) { const bw = tw + 76, bh = f.fs * 1.7, bx = Wc - 50 - bw, by = py - f.fs * 1.15; c.fillStyle = hexA(col, p.kd === "a" ? 0.3 : 0.1); c.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); c.strokeStyle = hexA(col, 0.9); c.lineWidth = 3; if (p.kd === "e") c.setLineDash([12, 9]); c.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); c.setLineDash([]);
    c.fillStyle = col; c.beginPath(); c.arc(Wc - 78, by + bh / 2, 9, 0, 6.3); c.fill(); c.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; c.fillText(f.lines[0], Wc - 100, py); }
  else { c.fillStyle = boLite(col, 0.45); f.lines.forEach((l, k) => c.fillText(l, Wc - 50, py + k * f.fs * 1.25)); }
  if (note) { c.font = orbFont(500, 22, F_BODY); c.fillStyle = "#b9c6d8"; boWrap(c, note, Wc - 90).slice(0, 2).forEach((l, k) => c.fillText(l, Wc - 46, Hc - 52 + k * 28)); }
  return cv;
}
/* third: who delivers it */

function boAddCanvas(col){ const cv = boCanvas(0.62, 0.6), c = cv.getContext("2d"), Wc = cv.width, Hc = cv.height; boGlass(c, col); c.strokeStyle = hexA(col, 0.9); c.lineWidth = 4; c.setLineDash([14, 11]); c.strokeRect(34, 30, Wc - 68, Hc - 60); c.setLineDash([]);

  c.textAlign = "center"; c.font = orbFont(600, 30, F_HEAD); c.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; c.fillText(T("صورة أو فيديو"), Wc / 2, 186); return cv; }
function boMediaCanvas(img, col){ const cv = boCanvas(1.25, 1.25), c = cv.getContext("2d"), Wc = cv.width, Hc = cv.height; c.fillStyle = "rgba(4,16,30,0.9)"; c.fillRect(0, 0, Wc, Hc);
  const s = Math.max(Wc / img.width, Hc / img.height), w = img.width * s, h = img.height * s; c.globalAlpha = 0.94; c.drawImage(img, (Wc - w) / 2, (Hc - h) / 2, w, h); c.globalAlpha = 1;
  c.strokeStyle = hexA(col, 0.6); c.lineWidth = 3; c.strokeRect(3, 3, Wc - 6, Hc - 6); c.fillStyle = col; [[0, 0, 1, 1], [Wc, 0, -1, 1], [0, Hc, 1, -1], [Wc, Hc, -1, -1]].forEach(([x, y, sx, sy]) => { c.fillRect(x, y, sx * 46, sy * 7); c.fillRect(x, y, sx * 7, sy * 46); }); return cv; }
function boTex(src){ const t = src instanceof HTMLVideoElement ? new THREE.VideoTexture(src) : new THREE.CanvasTexture(src); t.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding; t.generateMipmaps = false; t.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter; t.anisotropy = Math.min(8, renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy());
  t.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping; t.repeat.x = -1; t.offset.x = 1; return t; }
function boCard(tier, src, col, kind, extra){
  const wk = src.wk || (extra && extra.wk) || 1, hk = src.hk || (extra && extra.hk) || 1, r = tier ? BO.R2 : BO.R, span = boSpan(r) * wk, hh = BO.h * hk, geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, r, hh, Math.max(8, Math.round(20 * wk)), 1, true, -span / 2, span);
  const tex = boTex(src), mat = boMat(tex, col), mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); mesh.renderOrder = 10; mesh.position.y = (tier ? BO.y2 : BO.y) + BO.h / 2; (tier ? boT2 : boT1).add(mesh);
  const cd = Object.assign({tier, mesh, mat, tex, kind, span, th: 0, a: 0, seq: boSeq++, vis: 0, hov: 0}, extra || {}); mesh.userData.bo = cd; boCards.push(cd); return cd;
}
/* cards share the ring by their own width, with equal gaps between them */
function boLayout(){ [0, 1].forEach(t => { const l = boCards.filter(c => c.tier === t); if (!l.length) return; const tot = l.reduce((a, c) => a + c.span, 0), gap = Math.max(0.06, (Math.PI * 2 - tot) / l.length), k = Math.min(1, Math.PI * 2 / (tot + gap * l.length)); let a = t ? 0.5 : 0;
  l.forEach(c => { a += c.span / 2 * k; c.th = a; c.mesh.rotation.y = a; a += (c.span / 2 + gap) * k; }); }); }
function boClear(){ boCards.forEach(c => { c.mesh.parent.remove(c.mesh); c.mesh.geometry.dispose(); c.tex.dispose(); c.mat.dispose(); if (c.video) { c.video.pause(); c.video.removeAttribute("src"); c.video.load(); } if (c.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(c.url); }); boCards = []; boSeq = 0; }

const EG_MEDIA_IN = {};
/* ---- media store: files the presenter adds stay in this browser (IndexedDB); a packaged show can also list files in media/manifest.js ---- */
let boDb = null;
const boOpenDb = () => new Promise(res => { if (boDb) return res(boDb); try { const rq = indexedDB.open("eg-media", 1); rq.onupgradeneeded = () => { const s = rq.result.createObjectStore("m", {keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true}); s.createIndex("pid", "pid"); }; rq.onsuccess = () => { boDb = rq.result; res(boDb); }; rq.onerror = () => res(null); } catch (e) { res(null); } });
const boDbAll = pid => boOpenDb().then(db => new Promise(res => { if (!db) return res([]); try { const rq = db.transaction("m").objectStore("m").index("pid").getAll(pid); rq.onsuccess = () => res(rq.result || []); rq.onerror = () => res([]); } catch (e) { res([]); } }));
const boDbAdd = rec => boOpenDb().then(db => new Promise(res => { if (!db) return res(null); try { const rq = db.transaction("m", "readwrite").objectStore("m").add(rec); rq.onsuccess = () => res(rq.result); rq.onerror = () => res(null); } catch (e) { res(null); } }));
const boDbDel = id => boOpenDb().then(db => { if (!db || id == null) return; try { db.transaction("m", "readwrite").objectStore("m").delete(id); } catch (e) {} });
function boAddMedia(url, isVideo, col, meta){
  if (boCards.filter(c => c.kind === "media").length >= BO.maxMedia) return;
  if (isVideo) { const v = document.createElement("video"); v.muted = true; v.loop = true; v.playsInline = true; v.preload = "auto"; v.src = url; const pid = boPid;
    v.addEventListener("loadeddata", () => { if (pid !== boPid) return; boCard(1, v, col, "media", Object.assign({video: v, url, isVideo: true, wk: 1.25, hk: 1.25}, meta)); boLayout(); v.play().catch(() => {}); }, {once: true}); v.load(); }
  else { const im = new Image(), pid = boPid; im.onload = () => { if (pid !== boPid) return; boCard(1, boMediaCanvas(im, col), col, "media", Object.assign({url, img: im}, meta)); boLayout(); }; im.src = url; }
}
function boBuild(pi){
  boClear(); boPid = pi; boAim = false; const p = P[pi], col = SECC[p.sc], g = GEO[p.i]; boRingMat.color.set(col);
  const when = p.yd === 0 ? String(p.y) : p.yd === 1 ? T("منذ ") + p.y : "", cost = p.cd && p.cd !== "—" ? p.cd : T("غير محددة بالملف"), raw = (p.cf || p.cd === "—") && p.cr;
  boCard(0, boCost(col, p), col, "info");
  boCard(0, boStatus(col, p, p.kd === "e" && g && !g.ln ? T("الهيكل والرافعات رمز لحالة التنفيذ، لا التصميم") : ""), col, "info");
  boCard(0, boEntity(col, p), col, "info");
  let loc, note;
  const wsP = wsPrelimOf(p.i);
  if (wsModelOf(p.i)) { loc = T("موقع مطابق · مجسم الورشة"); note = T("مجسم مبني بالكود من ورشة المجسمات: المحيط من OpenStreetMap والتفاصيل تقدير من الصور والمصادر"); }
  else if (simIsReal(p)) { loc = T("موقع مطابق على الخريطة"); note = (g.b > 12 ? T("كل المباني داخل حدود الموقع، من OpenStreetMap · ") : T("المبنى من OpenStreetMap · ")) + (g.src || ""); }
  else if (g && g.ln) { loc = T("مسار فعلي على الخريطة"); note = T("مرسوم من OpenStreetMap · ") + (g.src || ""); }
  else if (p.nat) { loc = T("على مستوى الجمهورية"); note = T("لا يرتبط بموقع واحد على الخريطة"); }
  else if (g && g.v === "r" && !g.pl) { loc = T("موقع مطابق"); note = T("حُدِّد بالمراجعة على الصور الجوية والمصادر المنشورة") + (g.src ? " · " + T(g.src) : ""); }
  else if (g) { loc = T("موقع مطابق"); note = (g.pl ? T("حدود الموقع من OpenStreetMap · ") : T("لا توجد مبانٍ مرسومة له على الخريطة بعد · ")) + (g.src || ""); }
  else if (p.admLoc) { loc = T("موقع مُدخل من صفحة الإعدادات"); note = T("إحداثيات أُدخلت يدويًا وليست من الملف المصدر"); }
  else { loc = T("موقع تقريبي داخل ") + (GN[p.g[0]] || T("المحافظة")); note = T("الملف لا يحدد موقعًا دقيقًا للمشروع"); }
  { const ty = simType(p); if (g && !p.nat && (ty === "air" || ty === "rail" || ty === "port" || (g.ln && ty !== "water"))) note += T(" · الطائرات والقطارات والمركبات والحاويات رموز حركة توضيحية"); }
  boCard(0, boLoc(col, loc, note, wsP ? T("نسخة أولية") + " · " + wsP.pct + (EN ? "%" : "٪") : ""), col, "info");
  boCard(0, boAddCanvas(col), col, "add");
  boLayout();
  /* media that ships with the page itself (media/ beside it, listed in holo3/media/manifest.json at build time) comes first, then what a packaged show lists in media/manifest.js */
  const list = [...new Set([...(EG_MEDIA_IN[p.i] || []), ...((window.EG_MEDIA && window.EG_MEDIA[p.i]) || [])])]; list.forEach(f => boAddMedia(EGB + "media/" + f, /\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v)$/i.test(f), col, {fixed: true}));
  boDbAll(p.i).then(rows => { if (pi !== boPid) return; rows.forEach(r => { const url = URL.createObjectURL(r.blob); boAddMedia(url, /^video/.test(r.type), col, {dbId: r.id}); }); });
}
const boFile = document.createElement("input"); boFile.type = "file"; boFile.accept = "image/*,video/*"; boFile.multiple = true; boFile.hidden = true; document.body.appendChild(boFile);
boFile.addEventListener("change", () => { if (boPid < 0) return; const p = P[boPid], col = SECC[p.sc];
  [...boFile.files].forEach(f => { const isV = /^video/.test(f.type); if (!isV && !/^image/.test(f.type)) return;
    boDbAdd({pid: p.i, type: f.type, name: f.name, blob: f}).then(id => { boAddMedia(URL.createObjectURL(f), isV, col, {dbId: id}); }); });
  boFile.value = ""; });

/* ---- viewer: a clicked photo or video opens large, with sound for video ---- */
const boLb = document.createElement("div"); boLb.className = "bolb"; boLb.hidden = true; boLb.innerHTML = `<div class="in"></div><div class="bar"><button type="button" data-a="del">${T("حذف من العرض")}</button><button type="button" data-a="close" class="pri">${T("إغلاق ✕")}</button></div>`; document.body.appendChild(boLb);
let boLbCard = null;
function boOpen(cd){ boLbCard = cd; const box = boLb.querySelector(".in"); box.innerHTML = "";
  if (cd.isVideo) { const v = document.createElement("video"); v.src = cd.url; v.controls = true; v.autoplay = true; v.playsInline = true; box.appendChild(v); } else { const im = new Image(); im.src = cd.url; im.alt = ""; box.appendChild(im); }
  boLb.querySelector('[data-a="del"]').hidden = !!cd.fixed; boLb.hidden = false; }
function boClose(){ boLb.hidden = true; boLb.querySelector(".in").innerHTML = ""; boLbCard = null; }
boLb.addEventListener("click", e => { const a = e.target.dataset && e.target.dataset.a;
  if (a === "del" && boLbCard) { const cd = boLbCard; boDbDel(cd.dbId); boCards = boCards.filter(c => c !== cd); cd.mesh.parent.remove(cd.mesh); if (cd.video) cd.video.pause(); boLayout(); boClose(); }
  else if (a === "close" || e.target === boLb) boClose(); });
addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Escape" && !boLb.hidden) { boClose(); e.stopPropagation(); } }, true);

/* ---- picking and per-frame ---- */
const boRay = new THREE.Raycaster(), boNdc = new THREE.Vector2();
function boPick(mx, my){
  if (OH_ON || !simG.visible || !boCards.length) return null;
  boNdc.set(mx / W * 2 - 1, -(my / Hh) * 2 + 1); boRay.setFromCamera(boNdc, camera);
  const hits = boRay.intersectObjects(boCards.map(c => c.mesh), false);
  for (const h of hits) { const cd = h.object.userData.bo; if (cd.vis > 0.45 && cd.a > 0.3) return cd; }
  return null;
}
function boClick(cd){ if (cd.kind === "add") boFile.click(); else if (cd.kind === "media") boOpen(cd); }
const boV = new THREE.Vector3();
let boK = 1; const boC = new THREE.Vector3();
function updateBO(dt, t){
  const on = sim.on && sim.vis > 0.3 && sim.k > 0.45 ? 1 : 0;
  /* round a model that stands on the map the ring is fitted to that model: centred on its built mass and just wider than it, cards scaled with it, so it circles the building itself in the bird view */
  { const m3 = sim.on && sim.pi >= 0 && S.mode !== "layers" ? model3dOfProject(sim.pi) : null;
    if (m3 && sim.s > 0) { const c = model3dCore(m3); boK = model3dRing(c) * M2U / (BO.R * sim.s); boC.set(m3.x + c.x * m3.sx, simG.position.y, m3.z + c.z * m3.sz); boGroup.scale.setScalar(boK); boGroup.position.set((boC.x - simG.position.x) / sim.s, 0, (boC.z - simG.position.z) / sim.s); }
    else { boK = 1; boC.copy(simG.position); boGroup.scale.setScalar(1); boGroup.position.set(0, 0, 0); } }
  if (sim.pi !== boPid && sim.on && sim.pi >= 0) boBuild(sim.pi);
  if (!sim.on && sim.vis < 0.02 && boCards.length) { boClear(); boPid = -1; }
  if (on && !boAim && boCards.length) { boAim = true; const far = Math.atan2(camera.position.x - boC.x, camera.position.z - boC.z) + Math.PI;      /* the ring opens with the hero card (the cost) on the far side, facing you */
    boT1.rotation.y = far - boCards[0].th + 0.25; boT2.rotation.y = far - 0.5; }
  boSpin += ((boHover ? 0 : 1) - boSpin) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
  boT1.rotation.y += dt * 0.06 * boSpin; boT2.rotation.y -= dt * 0.045 * boSpin;
  let ringA = 0; const k = Math.min(1, dt * 5);
  boCards.forEach(cd => {
    const tgt = on ? 1 : 0, delay = cd.seq * 0.13; cd.a += (tgt - cd.a) * Math.min(1, dt * (tgt ? 2.2 : 5)); const e0 = clamp((cd.a - Math.min(0.6, delay * 0.35)) / 0.4, 0, 1), e = e0 * e0 * (3 - 2 * e0);
    /* which side of the site the card is on: world angle of its centre against the direction to the camera */
    const grp = cd.tier ? boT2 : boT1, th = cd.th + grp.rotation.y, r = cd.tier ? BO.R2 : BO.R;
    boV.set(Math.sin(th) * r, 0, Math.cos(th) * r).multiplyScalar(sim.s * boK).add(boC); let dx = camera.position.x - boV.x, dz = camera.position.z - boV.z; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
    const face = -(Math.sin(th) * dx + Math.cos(th) * dz), tv = lerp(0.3, 1, sstep(-0.3, 0.3, face));   /* like the sector screens: every card stays on its ring; the ones in front of the building only soften so it reads through them */
    cd.mat.userData.u.uFlip.value = face >= 0 ? 0 : 1;
    cd.vis += (tv - cd.vis) * k; cd.hov += ((boHover === cd ? 1 : 0) - cd.hov) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
    const m = cd.mesh, base = (cd.tier ? BO.y2 : BO.y) + BO.h / 2, sx = lerp(0.55, 1, e) * (1 + 0.04 * cd.hov);
    m.visible = e > 0.01; m.scale.set(sx, Math.max(0.02, e) * (1 + 0.04 * cd.hov), sx); m.position.y = lerp(0.1, base, e) + Math.sin(t * 0.8 + cd.seq * 1.7) * 0.035 * e;
    cd.mat.opacity = e * cd.vis * sim.vis * (0.86 + 0.14 * cd.hov); cd.mat.userData.u.uHot.value = cd.hov; ringA = Math.max(ringA, e);
  });
  boRingMat.opacity = 0.32 * ringA * sim.vis; boRing1.visible = boRing2.visible = ringA > 0.01; boRing2.visible = boRing2.visible && boCards.some(c => c.tier === 1);
  boRing1.scale.setScalar(lerp(0.55, 1, ringA)); boRing2.scale.setScalar(lerp(0.55, 1, ringA));
  if (OH_ON) boGroup.visible = false;
}

/* ================= orbital wheel (v99) =================
   One ring of arcs laid on the ground round the model and projected with the camera (a CSS homography), so it keeps the model's perspective.
   The big arcs sit in front (name, cost, year), the ones with sub-menus at the sides; a sub-menu is an outer ring of arcs; the facts open on the far side
   as a polar grid of arc cells (one fact per cell); a thin outer ring places the project's year on 2014–2030. All writing runs on circular paths. */

function pointsOf(t){
  let s = String(t).replace(/[.]\s*$/, ""), head, tail, res = "";
  const r = s.search(/،\s*(?:ما|مما)\s/); if (r > 0) { res = s.slice(r + 1).trim(); s = s.slice(0, r); }
  const k = s.indexOf(" عبر "); if (k > 0) { head = s.slice(0, k).trim(); tail = s.slice(k + 5); } else return null;
  const pts = tail.split("،").flatMap(x => x.trim().split(new RegExp("\\s+و(?=(?:" + IG_VERB + ")\\s)"))).map(x => x.trim().replace(new RegExp("^و(?=(?:" + IG_VERB + ")\\s)"), "")).filter(Boolean);
  return pts.length >= 2 ? {head, pts, res} : null;
}

function jobsOf(text){ const m = String(text).match(/(\d[\d.,]*)\s*(ألف|آلاف|مليون)?\s*فرص(?:ة)?\s+عمل(\s+مباشرة)?/); if (!m) return null;
  return {n: m[1], l: (m[2] ? (m[2] === "آلاف" ? "ألف" : m[2]) + " " : "") + "فرصة عمل" + (m[3] ? " مباشرة" : ""), jobs: true}; }
function statsOf(text){
  text = String(text || "").replace(/(^|\s)و(?=\d)/g, "$1و ");
  /* a figure stands on its own (not the «2» of «كم2»); «كم2 / م3» read as square and cubic units */
  const out = [], re = /(?<![ء-ي\d.,/])(\d[\d.,]*)(?:\s+(مليون|مليار|ألف|تريليون))?\s+([ء-ي]+(?:\s+[ء-ي]+)?)/g; let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(text)) && out.length < 3) { if (/^(19|20)\d\d$/.test(m[1])) continue; const w = m[3].split(/\s+/); while (w.length && IG_STOP.has(w[w.length - 1])) w.pop(); if (!w.length) continue;
    const sup = text[m.index + m[0].length]; let l = (m[2] ? m[2] + " " : "") + w.join(" "); if (sup === "2" || sup === "3") l += sup === "2" ? "²" : "³";
    out.push({n: m[1], l}); }
  return out;
}

/* writing with the numbers inside it lifted out in colour */
function arcRich(t, r, a0, a1, fs, cls, dl){
  const id = "tp" + (ohTp++), d = ohFront((a0 + a1) / 2) ? `M${ohPt(r, a1)}A${r},${r} 0 0 0 ${ohPt(r, a0)}` : `M${ohPt(r, a0)}A${r},${r} 0 0 1 ${ohPt(r, a1)}`;
  const kc = cls === "ig-h" || cls === "ig-sn" ? "" : "ig-k ", body = ohEsc(t).replace(/(\d[\d.,/]*\d|\d)/g, `<tspan class="${kc}cnt" data-cnt="$1">$1</tspan>`);
  const tw = !/^ig-(h|sn|k|qm|n|pd)$/.test(cls) || (cls === "ig-n" && !/^\d{4}$/.test(t));
  if (!tw) return `<path id="${id}" d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="none"/><text class="igt ${cls}" style="font-size:${fs}px;animation-delay:${dl}ms" dominant-baseline="central"><textPath href="#${id}" startOffset="50%" text-anchor="middle">${body}</textPath></text>`;
  /* typed: the whole line is laid out from the start (the rest is there but unseen), so letters land in place, right to left, and the newest ones glow */
  return `<path id="${id}" d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="none"/><text class="igt tw ${cls}" style="font-size:${fs}px;animation-delay:${dl}ms" data-dl="${dl}" data-tw="${ohEsc(t)}" data-fin="${ohEsc(body)}" dominant-baseline="central"><textPath href="#${id}" startOffset="50%" text-anchor="middle"><tspan class="tw-t"></tspan><tspan class="tw-h"></tspan><tspan class="tw-r">${ohEsc(t)}</tspan></textPath></text>`; }
/* lines of one paragraph share the words evenly, so no word is left alone on the last line */
function igBalance(lines){
  if (lines.length < 2 || /…$/.test(lines[lines.length - 1])) return lines;
  const w = lines.join(" ").split(/\s+/), n = lines.length, tot = w.join(" ").length, out = []; let cur = "";
  w.forEach(z => { const tgt = tot / n * (out.length + 1); if (cur && out.length < n - 1 && (out.join(" ").length + cur.length + z.length / 2) > tgt) { out.push(cur); cur = z; } else cur = cur ? cur + " " + z : z; });
  out.push(cur); return out;
}

const igDeg = (w, rr) => w / rr * 180 / Math.PI;
function igLayout(q){

  const MAX = info.span, r0 = OWI0, Lmax = rr => rr * (MAX - 8) * Math.PI / 180 * .92, plan = [];
  let r = r0 + 48, need = 30;
  /* pass 1: lines, rows and the angle each one really needs */
  info.B.forEach(b => {
    if (b.k === "dv") { plan.push({k: "dv", r}); r += 16; return; }
    if (b.k === "st") { const n = b.items.length, fsn = n > 2 ? 46 : 56; let w = 0; b.items.forEach(it => { w = Math.max(w, igMw(it.n, "sn", fsn), igMw(it.l, "sl", 19)); });
      need = Math.max(need, n * (igDeg(w, r + 66) + 6) + 4); plan.push({k: "st", r, b, fsn}); r += 134; return; }
    if (b.k === "pts" && b.items.length > 5) { const n = b.items.length, rr = r + 58, cw = Lmax(rr + 60); let w = 0;

      need = Math.max(need, n * (igDeg(48, rr) + 1.2) + 16, igDeg(w, rr + 62) + 12); plan.push({k: "pts", r, b, rr, many: true}); r = rr + 40 + 2 * 28 + 14; return; }
    if (b.k === "pts") { const n = b.items.length, rr = r + 66, slot = rr * (MAX - 16) / n * Math.PI / 180 * .92; let w = 0, two = false;

      const rows = [{lab: (c.b + (c.u ? " " + c.u : "")) + " · " + (c.yb || "قبل"), v: vb, cl: "o"}, {lab: (c.a + (c.u ? " " + c.u : "")) + " · الآن", v: va, cl: ""}];

/* the typewriter: each line starts on its own beat; its speed follows its length so long lines do not hold the card back */
function runTypers(root){
  const t00 = performance.now();
  root.querySelectorAll("text.tw").forEach(el => { const s = el.getAttribute("data-tw"), n = [...s].length, ch = [...s], dl = +el.dataset.dl || 0, D = Math.min(1100, Math.max(320, n * 24)), t0 = t00 + dl + 140;
    const [tT, tH, tR] = el.querySelectorAll("tspan");
    const f = now => { if (!el.isConnected) return; const u = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (now - t0) / D)), k = Math.floor(u * n);
      if (u <= 0) { requestAnimationFrame(f); return; }
      if (u < 1) { tT.textContent = ch.slice(0, Math.max(0, k - 2)).join(""); tH.textContent = ch.slice(Math.max(0, k - 2), k).join(""); tR.textContent = ch.slice(k).join(""); requestAnimationFrame(f); }
      else { el.querySelector("textPath").innerHTML = el.getAttribute("data-fin"); el.classList.add("done"); runCounters(el, true); } };
    requestAnimationFrame(f); });
}
/* the point player: shows each means in turn, then starts over */
function runPoints(root){
  root.querySelectorAll(".ig-pts").forEach(g => { const n = +g.dataset.n, st = [...g.querySelectorAll(".ig-stn")], rp = g.querySelector(".ig-rtp"), L = rp ? +rp.dataset.len : 0;
    let cur = -1, tm = 0;
    const show = i => { if (!g.isConnected) return; cur = (i + n) % n;
      st.forEach((s, k) => { s.classList.toggle("lit", k <= cur); s.classList.toggle("cur", k === cur); });
      g.querySelectorAll(".ig-cp").forEach(c => { const on = +c.dataset.i === cur; c.classList.toggle("on", on); if (on) c.querySelectorAll("text.cp").forEach((t, li) => igTypeCap(t, li * 260)); });
      if (rp) rp.style.strokeDashoffset = (L * (1 - (cur + .5) / n)).toFixed(1);
      clearTimeout(tm); tm = setTimeout(() => show(cur + 1 >= n ? 0 : cur + 1), cur + 1 >= n ? 3600 : 2000); };
    g.__go = show; st.forEach(s => s.addEventListener("click", e => { e.stopPropagation(); show(+s.dataset.i); })); setTimeout(() => show(0), +g.dataset.dl || 0); });
}
/* the caption of the lit station types itself in, the newest letters glowing */
function igTypeCap(el, dl){
  const s = el.dataset.cp, ch = [...s], n = ch.length, tp = el.querySelector("textPath"), D = Math.min(900, Math.max(280, n * 20)), t0 = performance.now() + dl, tok = (el.__tok = (el.__tok || 0) + 1);
  tp.innerHTML = `<tspan class="tw-t"></tspan><tspan class="tw-h"></tspan><tspan class="tw-r">${ohEsc(s)}</tspan>`; const [tT, tH, tR] = tp.querySelectorAll("tspan");
  const f = now => { if (!el.isConnected || el.__tok !== tok) return; const u = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (now - t0) / D)), k = Math.floor(u * n);
    tT.textContent = ch.slice(0, Math.max(0, k - 2)).join(""); tH.textContent = ch.slice(Math.max(0, k - 2), k).join(""); tR.textContent = ch.slice(k).join("");
    if (u < 1) requestAnimationFrame(f); else tp.textContent = s; };
  requestAnimationFrame(f);
}

    const yr = !dec && !sep && to >= 1900 && to <= 2100, from = yr ? to - 11 : 0, tx = el.closest("text"), dl = now0 ? 0 : tx ? parseFloat(tx.style.animationDelay) || 0 : 0, t0 = performance.now() + dl + 120, D = now0 ? 900 : 1400;

}

function ohFocus(){

}

/* projection: a patch of ground round the model; four ground points give a homography for CSS */
function ohHomog(src, dst){
  const A = [], b = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const [x, y] = src[i], [X, Y] = dst[i]; A.push([x, y, 1, 0, 0, 0, -x * X, -y * X]); b.push(X); A.push([0, 0, 0, x, y, 1, -x * Y, -y * Y]); b.push(Y); }
  for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) { let p = c; for (let r = c + 1; r < 8; r++) if (Math.abs(A[r][c]) > Math.abs(A[p][c])) p = r; [A[c], A[p]] = [A[p], A[c]]; [b[c], b[p]] = [b[p], b[c]];
    for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) { if (r === c) continue; const f = A[r][c] / A[c][c]; if (!f) continue; for (let k = c; k < 8; k++) A[r][k] -= f * A[c][k]; b[r] -= f * b[c]; } }
  const h = b.map((v, i) => v / A[i][i]); if (h.some(v => !isFinite(v))) return null;
  return `matrix3d(${h[0].toFixed(6)},${h[3].toFixed(6)},0,${h[6].toFixed(9)},${h[1].toFixed(6)},${h[4].toFixed(6)},0,${h[7].toFixed(9)},0,0,1,0,${h[2].toFixed(2)},${h[5].toFixed(2)},0,1)`;
}

function applyK(){ const base = innerWidth <= 900 ? 1 : clamp(Math.min(innerWidth / 1920, innerHeight / 1080), 0.78, 2.2); document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--k", (base * S.userK).toFixed(3)); }
let composer = null, bloom = null, quality = QS.has("q") ? parseInt(QS.get("q")) : 2, qLocked = QS.has("q");
function buildComposer(){
  try {
    const size = renderer.getDrawingBufferSize(new THREE.Vector2());
    const rt = renderer.capabilities.isWebGL2 && typeof THREE.WebGLMultisampleRenderTarget === "function" ? new THREE.WebGLMultisampleRenderTarget(size.x, size.y, {format: THREE.RGBAFormat, encoding: THREE.sRGBEncoding}) : new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(size.x, size.y, {format: THREE.RGBAFormat, encoding: THREE.sRGBEncoding});
    composer = new THREE.EffectComposer(renderer, rt);
    composer.addPass(new THREE.RenderPass(scene, camera));
    bloom = new THREE.UnrealBloomPass(new THREE.Vector2(size.x, size.y), parseFloat(QS.get("bs") || (THEME[S.theme] || THEME.sand).bloom), parseFloat(QS.get("br") || 0.45), parseFloat(QS.get("bt") || 0.88)); composer.addPass(bloom);
  } catch (e) { composer = null; quality = 0; }
}
function resize(){
  const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(); W = Math.max(1, r.width); Hh = Math.max(1, r.height);
  { const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1; PR = quality >= 2 ? Math.min(dpr, coarse ? 1.5 : 2) : quality === 1 ? Math.min(dpr, 1.25) : 1; }   /* re-read: the window may have moved to another screen */
  applyK(); renderer.setPixelRatio(PR); renderer.setSize(W, Hh, false); U.uPR.value = PR;
  camera.aspect = W / Hh; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  KP = clamp(Hh / 1080, 0.72, 2.2); U.uKP.value = KP;
  U.uScale.value = Hh * PR * 0.5 / Math.tan(camera.fov * Math.PI / 360); U.uRes.value.set(W * PR, Hh * PR);
  beamMat.uniforms.uPx.value = 2.3 * PR * KP; ringMat.uniforms.uPx.value = 8.5 * PR * KP;
  if (composer) { composer.setPixelRatio(PR); composer.setSize(W, Hh); }
  reserve(true);
}

const FREE = {x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 1, y1: 1}, FREET = {x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 1, y1: 1};
function measureFree(){
  const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(), phone = innerWidth <= 900, rem = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize) || 16;
  const rc = id => { const e = $(id); if (!e || e.hidden || !e.getClientRects().length) return null; const b = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return {l: b.left - r.left, t: b.top - r.top, r: b.right - r.left, b: b.bottom - r.top}; };
  let x0 = 0, x1 = W, y0 = 0, y1 = Hh;
  if (!phone) {
    const L = rc("colL"), R = null, T = rc("tl");          /* the sectors now live on the orbit around the map, so the right edge is free */
    y0 = 4.4 * rem; if (L) x0 = L.r - (L.r - L.l) * 0.1; if (R) x1 = R.l + (R.r - R.l) * 0.1; if (T) y1 = T.t - 0.2 * rem;
    x0 = Math.max(x0, 0); x1 = Math.min(x1, W);
  } else {
    const L = rc("colL"), R = rc("railR"), T = rc("tl"), C = rc("ctx");
    y0 = (L ? L.b : 0) + 4; y1 = Hh; if (T) y1 = Math.min(y1, T.t); if (R) y1 = Math.min(y1, R.t); if (C && !card.hidden) y1 = Math.min(y1, C.t);
  }
  for (const id of ["srch", "tls"]) { const e = $(id); if (e && !e.hidden && !e.classList.contains("out") && e.offsetHeight) { const op = e.offsetParent, o = op ? op.getBoundingClientRect() : r; y1 = Math.min(y1, o.top - r.top + e.offsetTop - 0.4 * rem); } }      /* the search panel with its keyboard: the map is centred in what stays free above it (layout position, so the panel's entry animation does not matter) */
  { const e = $("pv"); if (!phone && e && !e.hidden && !e.classList.contains("out") && !e.classList.contains("sr") && e.offsetWidth) { const op = e.offsetParent, o = op ? op.getBoundingClientRect() : r; x1 = Math.min(x1, o.left - r.left + e.offsetLeft - 0.8 * rem); } }      /* the project preview: the map is centred between the card and the screen */
  { const e = $("pv"); if (phone && e && !e.hidden && !e.classList.contains("out") && !e.classList.contains("sr") && e.offsetHeight) { const op = e.offsetParent, o = op ? op.getBoundingClientRect() : r; y0 = Math.max(y0, o.top - r.top + e.offsetTop + e.offsetHeight + 0.3 * rem); } }
  if (x1 - x0 < 240) { x0 = 0; x1 = W; } if (y1 - y0 < 200) { y0 = 0; y1 = Hh; }
  FREET.x0 = x0; FREET.x1 = x1; FREET.y0 = y0; FREET.y1 = y1;
}
function applyView(){
  const fx = (FREE.x0 + FREE.x1) / 2, fy = (FREE.y0 + FREE.y1) / 2, ox = -(fx - W / 2), oy = -(fy - Hh / 2);
  if (Math.abs(ox) < 0.4 && Math.abs(oy) < 0.4) { if (camera.view && camera.view.enabled) camera.clearViewOffset(); }
  else camera.setViewOffset(W, Hh, ox, oy, W, Hh);
}
function stepFree(dt, snap){
  const k = snap ? 1 : Math.min(1, dt * 7); let ch = false;
  for (const n of ["x0", "y0", "x1", "y1"]) { const d = FREET[n] - FREE[n]; if (Math.abs(d) > 0.2) { FREE[n] += d * k; ch = true; } else if (d) { FREE[n] = FREET[n]; ch = true; } }
  if (ch || snap) applyView();
}

  const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();

/* camera fit: distance at which Egypt (about 58 x 54 units) fits the free area at a given pitch */
function fitDist(pol, extra){
  const tv = Math.tan(camera.fov * Math.PI / 360), fw = Math.max(240, FREET.x1 - FREET.x0), fh = Math.max(200, FREET.y1 - FREET.y0);
  const dw = 30.5 / (tv * fw / Hh), dh = (27 * Math.cos(pol) + 2.6 + (extra || 0)) * 1.1 / (tv * fh / Hh);
  return Math.max(dw * (fw < fh ? ((extra || 0) > 20 ? 1.3 : 1.1) : 1), dh * 1.05) * 1.14;
}
function homeView(mode){
  mode = mode || S.mode; let pol = 0.8, th = 0.3, ty = 1.0, d;
  if (mode === "density") { pol = 0.98; ty = 3; d = fitDist(pol, 6) * 0.98; }
  else if (mode === "layers") { pol = 1.12; th = 0.42; ty = 19; d = fitDist(pol, 34) * 0.7; }
  else d = fitDist(pol) * (S.show ? 0.92 : 1);
  const t = new THREE.Vector3(EC.x, ty, EC.z + 2.5 + (S.show ? 4 : 0));
  return {p: new THREE.Vector3().setFromSpherical(new THREE.Spherical(d, pol, th)).add(t), t};
}

/* camera flights follow arcs around the target instead of cutting straight through the map */
/* camera flights are timed on FLYT: real milliseconds, except during the show, where it runs at the show's speed (0 = paused) */
let FLYT = performance.now(), SHOW_RATE = 1; const flyNow = () => FLYT;
let fly = null, prevView = null, userMoved = false;
const sphA = new THREE.Spherical();
function flyTo(v, dur, flat){
  if (reduce) dur = 0; if (dur == null) dur = 1700; diveFxSet(-1);
  const s0 = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(controls.target)), s1 = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(v.p.clone().sub(v.t));
  let dth = s1.theta - s0.theta; dth = Math.atan2(Math.sin(dth), Math.cos(dth));
  const t0 = controls.target.clone(), far = Math.hypot(v.t.x - t0.x, v.t.z - t0.z) + Math.abs(s1.radius - s0.radius) * 0.6;
  fly = {p1: v.p.clone(), t1: v.t.clone(), t0, s0, s1, dth, lift: flat ? 0 : Math.min(14, far * 0.16), st: flyNow(), dur};
  if (!dur) { camera.position.copy(v.p); controls.target.copy(v.t); fly = null; }
}
const ease = k => k < 0.5 ? 4 * k * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 3) / 2;
const smooth = k => k * k * (3 - 2 * k);
/* cinematic dive: from wherever the camera is, plunge straight down onto the project's point
   (log-scale zoom so the speed feels constant, like zooming in from orbit), then swing out to reveal the hologram */
const diveEl = document.getElementById("divefx");
function diveFxSet(k){
  if (!diveEl) return;
  if (k < 0) { diveEl.style.opacity = 0; return; }
  const fx = (FREE.x0 + FREE.x1) / 2 / W * 100, fy = (FREE.y0 + FREE.y1) / 2 / Hh * 100;
  diveEl.style.setProperty("--dx", fx.toFixed(1) + "%"); diveEl.style.setProperty("--dy", fy.toFixed(1) + "%");
  diveEl.style.setProperty("--z", (1 + k * 0.35).toFixed(3)); diveEl.style.opacity = (Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, k * 1.08)), 0.8) * 0.95).toFixed(3);
}
function diveTo(pi, thenDur){
  const v = simViewFor(pi), phone = innerWidth <= 900;
  if (reduce) { flyTo(v, 0); sim.hold = false; return; }
  const t1 = v.t.clone(); t1.y -= 1.3 * (v.f || 1);
  const t0 = controls.target.clone(), s0 = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(t0));
  const vd = v.p.distanceTo(v.t), r1 = Math.max(controls.minDistance * 1.15, vd * 0.62), L = Math.hypot(t1.x - t0.x, t1.z - t0.z), lr = Math.log(Math.max(s0.radius, r1 * 1.05) / r1);
  const dur = clamp(700 + 300 * lr + L * 7, 1000, 3200), s1 = new THREE.Spherical(r1, 0.11, s0.theta + 0.6);
  fly = {kind: "dive", t0, t1, s0, s1, lift: Math.max(0, L * 0.75 - s0.radius * 0.45), st: flyNow(), dur,
    p1: new THREE.Vector3().setFromSpherical(s1).add(t1), then: () => simViewFor(pi), thenDur: thenDur || (phone ? 1700 : 1900)};
  sim.hold = true;
}
function endDive(f){
  fly = null; diveFxSet(-1); sim.hold = false; sim.k = 0;
  if (f.then) flyTo(f.then(), f.thenDur);
}
function stepFly(){
  const f = fly;
  if (f.kind === "dive") {
    const k = clamp((flyNow() - f.st) / f.dur, 0, 1), e = ease(k), ep = smooth(clamp(k / 0.55, 0, 1)), et = 1 - Math.pow(1 - clamp(k / 0.7, 0, 1), 3);
    controls.target.lerpVectors(f.t0, f.t1, et);
    sphA.radius = Math.exp(lerp(Math.log(f.s0.radius), Math.log(f.s1.radius), e)) + Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, k * 1.15)) * f.lift;
    sphA.phi = lerp(f.s0.phi, f.s1.phi, ep); sphA.theta = lerp(f.s0.theta, f.s1.theta, e);
    camera.position.setFromSpherical(sphA).add(controls.target); diveFxSet(k);
    if (k >= 1) { camera.position.copy(f.p1); controls.target.copy(f.t1); endDive(f); }
    return;
  }
  const k = f.dur ? clamp((flyNow() - f.st) / f.dur, 0, 1) : 1, e = k * k * k * (k * (k * 6 - 15) + 10);   /* quintic ease: no jerk at start or stop */
  controls.target.lerpVectors(f.t0, f.t1, e);
  /* distance moves on a log scale (a ten-times zoom feels as long as any other), with a soft lift in the middle */
  sphA.radius = Math.exp(lerp(Math.log(Math.max(1e-4, f.s0.radius)), Math.log(Math.max(1e-4, f.s1.radius)), e)) + Math.sin(Math.PI * e) * f.lift; sphA.phi = lerp(f.s0.phi, f.s1.phi, e); sphA.theta = f.s0.theta + f.dth * e;
  camera.position.setFromSpherical(sphA).add(controls.target); if (k >= 1) { camera.position.copy(f.p1); controls.target.copy(f.t1); fly = null; }
}

      ok = S.mode === "surface" && ZS.d < PJ_PIN_D && ap[k] > 0.6 && dimK[k] > 0.45 && !!stat.vis[pi] && !(sim.on && sim.vis > 0.3 && sim.pi === pi);
      pos = [aHeadPos[k * 3], aHeadPos[k * 3 + 1], aHeadPos[k * 3 + 2]]; fs = 12;
      if (ok) { if (L.lang !== EN) { L.lang = EN; L.txt = pjShort(p.n); L.sp.textContent = L.txt; } txt = L.txt.length * 0.92 + 3; }
      pri = (pi === S.selP || pi === S.hoverP ? -1 : 1.6 - p.tr * 0.25) + (sim.on && sim.vis > 0.3 ? 2 : 0);
      sO = screenOf(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]); sO = [sO[0] + aOff[k * 2], sO[1] + aOff[k * 2 + 1] - 15 * KP, sO[2]];
      pri += Math.hypot(sO[0] - W / 2, sO[1] - Hh / 2) / Math.max(W, Hh) * 1.5; }
    else { ok = false; pos = ringPos(0, ringRot, RING_R, ringY); pri = 9; fs = 12; txt = 1; }
    const s = sO || screenOf(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
    if (s[2] > 1 || s[0] < -40 || s[0] > W + 40 || s[1] < -20 || s[1] > Hh + 20) ok = false;
    const tw = side ? L.w : txt * fs * 0.55 + 10, rect = side ? [PLX0 - tw, s[1] - fs * 0.8, PLX0, s[1] + fs * 0.8] : [s[0] - tw / 2, s[1] - fs, s[0] + tw / 2, s[1] + fs * 0.6];
    cand.push({L, s, rect, ok, pri, side});
  }
  cand.sort((a, b) => a.pri - b.pri);
  for (const c of cand) { const L = c.L, show = c.ok && (c.pri <= -1 || free(c.rect)); if (show) placed.push(c.rect);
    if (show !== L.vis) { L.vis = show; L.el.classList.toggle("off", !show); }
    if (L.kind === "g") { const sel = L.id === S.selG; if (sel !== L.sel) { L.sel = sel; L.el.classList.toggle("sel", sel); } L.el.classList.toggle("big", S.mode === "density");
      const n = stat.govCnt[L.id] || 0; if (n !== L.n) { L.n = n; L.cnt.textContent = n; } }
    if (L.kind === "pl" || L.kind === "rg") { const sel = L.s === S.sec; if (sel !== L.sel) { L.sel = sel; L.el.classList.toggle("sel", sel); L.w = 0; } if (L.kind === "pl") { const dm = S.sec >= 0 && !sel; if (dm !== L.dm) { L.dm = dm; L.el.classList.toggle("dim", dm); } }
      const n = L.kind === "pl" ? stat.secCnt[L.s] : stat.natBy[L.s]; if (n !== L.n) { L.n = n; L.cnt.textContent = n; } }
    if (L.kind === "pj" && show) { const hot = L.pi === S.hoverP || L.pi === S.selP; if (hot !== L.hot) { L.hot = hot; L.el.classList.toggle("hot", hot); } }
    if (show && c.side) { const lw = Math.max(14, Math.round(c.s[0] - PLX0)); if (lw !== L.lw) { L.lw = lw; L.el.style.setProperty("--lw", lw + "px"); } }
    if (show) { const tx = `translate(${c.s[0].toFixed(1)}px,${c.s[1].toFixed(1)}px) translate(${c.side ? "-100%" : "-50%"},-50%)`; if (L.tx !== tx) { L.tx = tx; L.el.style.transform = tx; } }
  }
}

    return T("المجسم للمعاينة فقط: لا يوجد موقع واحد مؤكد للمشروع على الخريطة"); })()}</span><button class="rp" type="button">⟲ ${T("إعادة المحاكاة")}</button><button class="rp pvb" type="button">▣ ${T("معاينة المجسم")}</button></div>`}
  <div class="bgrid">
    <div class="bt w2"><span class="lbl">${T("الجهة")}</span><b>${esc(p.mn)}</b></div>
    <div class="bt"><span class="lbl">${when[0]}</span><b${when[2] ? ' class="num"' : ""}>${when[1]}</b></div>
    <div class="bt"><span class="lbl">${T("الحالة")}</span><b><span class="stt ${kd}"><i></i>${stLabel(p)}</span></b></div>
    <div class="bt w2"><span class="lbl">${T("الموقع")}</span><b>${esc(loc)}</b>${gx && p.onMap ? `<em class="osm">${gx.ln ? T("المسار") : T("الموقع الدقيق")}: ${gx.src ? esc(T(gx.src)) + " · " : ""}${gx.v === "r" ? T("حُدِّد بالمراجعة على الصور الجوية والمصادر المنشورة") : T("مطابقة بالاسم على خرائط") + " OpenStreetMap"}</em>` : (p.admLoc ? `<em class="osm">${T("إحداثيات مُدخلة من صفحة الإعدادات، وليست من الملف المصدر")}</em>` : "")}${(m => m ? `<em class="osm" style="color:#ffc98a">${T("نسخة أولية")} ${m.pct}${EN ? "%" : "٪"} · ${T("المجسم قيد المراجعة والتحسين")}</em>` : "")(wsPrelimOf(p.i))}</div>
    <div class="bt w2 cost"><span class="lbl">${T("التكلفة المعلنة")}</span><b class="num${cost.length > 20 ? " sm" : ""}">${esc(cost)}</b>${showRaw ? `<span class="raw">${T("كما ورد بالملف:")} <bdi>${esc(p.cr)}</bdi></span>` : ""}</div>
    ${p.sm ? `<div class="bt w2 desc"><span class="lbl">${T("نبذة")}</span><p>${esc(p.sm)}</p></div>` : ""}
    ${S.check && p.nt ? `<div class="bt w2 nt"><p>${T("ملاحظة بيانات:")} ${esc(p.nt)}<br>${T("النص الأصلي للتاريخ:")} ${esc(p.dt || "—")} · ${T("التكلفة:")} ${esc(p.ct)}</p></div>` : ""}
  </div>
  <div class="src"><span>${p.adm === "a" ? T("مشروع مُضاف من صفحة الإعدادات، وليس من الملف المصدر") : `${T("المصدر: الملف المرفق، ص")} ${p.pg} · ${T("مشروع رقم")} ${p.i}`}</span>${idx >= 0 ? `<span class="nav"><button data-nav="-1" aria-label="${T("السابق")}">›</button><button data-nav="1" aria-label="${T("التالي")}">‹</button></span>` : ""}</div>`;
}
let selFXTarget = null;
const leadP = $("leadP"), leadR = $("leadR"), leadC = $("leadC"), leadSvg = $("lead"); let leadOn = false;
function leadHide(){ if (leadOn) { leadOn = false; leadP.setAttribute("d", ""); leadR.setAttribute("transform", "translate(-99,-99) rotate(45)"); leadC.setAttribute("cx", "-99"); } }
/* a thin dashed leader ties the open card to the beam (or governorate) it is about */
function updateLeader(){
  if (innerWidth <= 900 || card.hidden || !selFXTarget) { leadHide(); return; }
  const t = selFXTarget; let wx, wy, wz;
  if (t.gov) { wx = t.x; wz = t.z; wy = govTopY(govs[t.gov], t.x, t.z) + 0.25; }
  else { if (S.selP < 0) { leadHide(); return; } const p = P[S.selP]; if (p.nat) { leadHide(); return; } const k = p.ins[0]; wx = aPos[k * 3]; wy = sim.on ? sim.baseY + 1.3 : aHeadPos[k * 3 + 1]; wz = aPos[k * 3 + 2]; }
  const s = screenOf(wx, wy, wz), cr = card.getBoundingClientRect(), sr = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  const ax = cr.right - sr.left, ay = cr.top - sr.top + cr.height * 0.12;
  if (s[2] > 1 || s[0] < ax + 24 || s[0] > W - 4 || s[1] < 0 || s[1] > Hh) { leadHide(); return; }
  leadOn = true; leadP.setAttribute("d", `M${ax.toFixed(1)} ${ay.toFixed(1)} H${(ax + 18).toFixed(1)} L${s[0].toFixed(1)} ${s[1].toFixed(1)}`);
  leadR.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${s[0].toFixed(1)},${s[1].toFixed(1)}) rotate(45)`); leadC.setAttribute("cx", s[0].toFixed(1)); leadC.setAttribute("cy", s[1].toFixed(1));
}
function openProject(pi, list, quiet, direct){
  if (S.mode === "density") setMode("surface");
  rememberView(); S.selP = pi; S.selG = null; S.listK = S.listId = null; if (list) S.navList = list; else if (!S.navList || S.navList.indexOf(pi) < 0) S.navList = null; colorDirty = true; buildArcs(pi);
  const p = P[pi], q = INST[p.ins[0]];
  openCard(projectHTML(pi), SECC[p.sc], SECRGB[p.sc]);
  card.querySelectorAll("[data-nav]").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => { const l = S.navList, i = l.indexOf(pi), j = (i + parseInt(b.dataset.nav) + l.length) % l.length; openProject(l[j], l); }));
  setSelColor(p.sc); leadSvg.style.setProperty("--lc", SECC[p.sc]);
  card.querySelectorAll(".rp").forEach(b => pvRpInit(b, pi));
  if (p.onMap) selFXTarget = q; else { selFX.visible = false; selFXTarget = null; }
  if (!quiet) {
    if (!pvHas(p)) { hideSim(); pvClose(); }      /* nothing confirmed to draw: the card carries the file's data and that is all */
    else if (pvMap(p)) { pvClose(); showSim(pi); if (!inShow()) { rememberView(); diveTo(pi); } }      /* a pick goes straight into the project on the map; «معاينة المجسم» in the card still opens the preview */
    else { hideSim(); pvOverview(pi); pvOpen(pi); }
  }
  if (p.sc !== S.sec && S.sec >= 0) setSector(p.sc);
}
function openGov(id, noFly){
  S.selG = id; S.selP = -1; S.listK = S.listId = null; S.navList = null; colorDirty = true; buildArcs(-1); hideSim(); if (PV && PV.on) pvClose();
  const list = []; for (let i = 0; i < NP; i++) if (P[i].g.includes(id) && stat.vis[i] && (S.sec < 0 || P[i].sc === S.sec)) list.push(i);
  list.sort((a, b) => P[b].y - P[a].y);
  const ms = new Set(list.map(i => P[i].mn));
  openCard(`<div class="hd"><span class="sect"><span class="sic">${PIN}</span><span>${EN ? "Governorate" : "محافظة"}</span></span><button class="x" aria-label="${T("إغلاق")}">✕</button></div><h2>${GN[id]}</h2>
    <div class="gstats"><div class="bt"><span class="lbl">${T("مشروعًا")}</span><b class="num">${list.length}</b></div><div class="bt"><span class="lbl">${T("جهة")}</span><b class="num">${ms.size}</b></div></div>
    <ul class="gl">${list.map(i => `<li data-i="${i}" style="--c:${SECC[P[i].sc]}"><span class="y">${P[i].yd === 2 ? T("الآن") : P[i].y}</span><span>${esc(P[i].n)}</span></li>`).join("") || `<li><span></span><span>${T("لا مشروعات ضمن العرض الحالي")}</span></li>`}</ul>
    <div class="src"><span>${T("المصدر: الملف المرفق")}</span></div>`, SAND.c, SAND.cs);
  card.querySelectorAll(".gl li[data-i]").forEach(li => li.addEventListener("click", () => openProject(+li.dataset.i, list)));
  setSelColor(-1); leadSvg.style.setProperty("--lc", SAND.c); const o = govs[id]; selFXTarget = {x: o.lx, z: o.lz, gov: id}; if (!inShow() && !noFly) { rememberView(); flyTo(govView(id), 1500); }
}

/* ================= a sector or an entity opens the same pick-list a governorate does ================= */
let listSig = "";
const ENT_I = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 21V9l8-5 8 5v12M9 21v-6h6v6M8 12h2M14 12h2"/></svg>';
function listItems(k, id){
  const a = []; for (let i = 0; i < NP; i++) { const p = P[i]; if (!(S.T >= p.y + p.sg && fpass(p))) continue;
    if (k === "sec" ? p.sc !== id : (p.mn !== id || (S.sec >= 0 && p.sc !== S.sec))) continue; a.push(i); }
  return a.sort((x, y) => P[y].y - P[x].y);
}
function openList(k, id, keep){
  const sec = k === "sec", list = listItems(k, id), c = sec ? SECC[id] : SAND.c, cs = sec ? SECRGB[id] : SAND.cs;
  const old = card.querySelector(".gl"), top = keep && old ? old.scrollTop : 0, same = keep && S.listK === k && S.listId === id;
  S.selP = -1; S.selG = null; S.navList = null; S.listK = k; S.listId = id; listSig = k + "|" + id + "|" + list.join(","); colorDirty = true; buildArcs(-1); hideSim(); if (PV && PV.on) pvClose();
  const ms = new Set(list.map(i => P[i].mn)), ss = new Set(list.map(i => P[i].sc)), s = SECS[id];
  const facts = sec && s.facts && s.facts.length ? `<details class="lfx"><summary>${T("لمحات قطاع")} ${s.n}</summary><div class="facts">${s.facts.map(f => `<div class="fact"><b>${f[0]}</b><span>${f[1]}</span><i>${T("المصدر:")} ${f[2]}</i></div>`).join("")}</div></details>` : "";
  openCard(`<div class="hd"><span class="sect"><span class="sic">${sec ? svgI(id) : ENT_I}</span><span>${sec ? T("قطاع") : T("جهة")}</span></span><button class="x" aria-label="${T("إغلاق")}">✕</button></div><h2>${sec ? s.n : esc(id)}</h2>
    <div class="gstats"><div class="bt"><span class="lbl">${T("مشروعًا")}</span><b class="num">${list.length}</b></div><div class="bt"><span class="lbl">${sec ? T("جهة") : T("قطاع")}</span><b class="num">${sec ? ms.size : ss.size}</b></div></div>
    <ul class="gl">${list.map(i => `<li data-i="${i}" style="--c:${SECC[P[i].sc]}"><span class="y">${P[i].yd === 2 ? T("الآن") : P[i].y}</span><span>${esc(P[i].n)}</span></li>`).join("") || `<li><span></span><span>${T("لا مشروعات ضمن العرض الحالي")}</span></li>`}</ul>${facts}
    <div class="src"><span>${T("المصدر: الملف المرفق")}</span></div>`, c, cs);
  const x = card.querySelector(".x"), nx = x.cloneNode(true); x.replaceWith(nx); nx.addEventListener("click", () => closeCard(false));      /* closing the list leaves the sector or entity chosen and the camera where it is */
  card.querySelectorAll(".gl li[data-i]").forEach(li => li.addEventListener("click", () => openProject(+li.dataset.i, list)));
  const gl = card.querySelector(".gl"); if (gl && top) gl.scrollTop = top; if (same) card.style.animation = "none";
  setSelColor(sec ? id : -1); leadSvg.style.setProperty("--lc", c); selFX.visible = false; selFXTarget = null; leadHide();
}
function listRefresh(){
  if (S.listK === "sec" && S.listId !== S.sec) { if (S.sec >= 0) openList("sec", S.sec, true); else closeCard(false); return; }
  if (S.listK + "|" + S.listId + "|" + listItems(S.listK, S.listId).join(",") !== listSig) openList(S.listK, S.listId, true);
}
