function toggleNotes(on){ S.check = on === undefined ? !S.check : on; $("notes").hidden = !S.check; if (S.check) buildNotes(); $("bNotes").setAttribute("aria-pressed", S.check); if (S.selP >= 0) openProject(S.selP, S.navList, true); }


/* ================= data explorer: the left panel as a holographic, interactive breakdown of the projects =================
   Four views that cycle on their own while nobody touches them: sectors (radial), governorates and entities (bars stacked by
   sector / status), and the latest completions. Hovering any item lights its projects on the map and draws leader lines
   from the row to them; clicking selects. With a sector selected, the first view becomes that sector's facts. */
const XP = (() => {
  const host = $("ctx"), feedPane = $("feed"), insEl = $("ins");
  const pane = document.createElement("div"); pane.className = "pane xp"; pane.id = "xp";
  pane.innerHTML = `<div class="hh"><i class="dia"></i><span id="xpT">${T("توزيع المشروعات")}</span><button class="xfb" id="xpFb" type="button" aria-expanded="false" title="${T("معايير الفلترة")}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 5h18l-7 8v6l-4-2v-4z"/></svg><span>${T("فلترة")}</span><b id="xpFn" hidden>0</b></button><em id="xpY">2026</em></div>
    <div class="xtabs" role="tablist" aria-label="${T("عرض البيانات")}"></div><div class="xfs" id="xpFs" hidden></div><div class="xbody"><div class="xv" id="xvA"></div><div class="xv" id="xvB"></div><div class="xflt" id="xpFd" hidden></div></div><div class="xfoot" id="xpF"></div>`;
  host.insertBefore(pane, host.firstChild);
  feedPane.hidden = true; insEl.hidden = true;
  const tabsEl = pane.querySelector(".xtabs"), body = pane.querySelector(".xbody"), vA = $("xvA"), vB = $("xvB"), foot = $("xpF");
  const feedOl = $("feedL");
  /* leader lines from the panel to the map */
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", lk = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg"); lk.setAttribute("class", "xlink"); lk.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  stage.appendChild(lk);
  const TABS = {sec: T("القطاعات"), gov: T("المحافظات"), ent: T("الجهات"), feed: T("الأحدث"), facts: T("لمحات")};
  let tab = "sec", shown = null, hold = 0, cycleT = 0, hot = null, sig = "", useA = true, lastSec = -2, pinned = false, fOpen = false, fSig = "";
  const CYCLE = 9;
  function tabList(){ return S.sec >= 0 ? ["sec", "facts", "gov", "ent", "feed"] : ["sec", "gov", "ent", "feed"]; }   /* the sector buttons stay one tap away even inside a sector: they are the switcher */
  function buildTabs(){
    const l = tabList(); if (!l.includes(tab)) tab = l[0];
    tabsEl.innerHTML = l.map(t => `<button role="tab" data-t="${t}" aria-selected="${t === tab}">${TABS[t]}<i></i></button>`).join("");
    /* a clicked tab stays (pinned) until it is clicked again; untouched, the views keep cycling */
    tabsEl.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => { if (fOpen) fDrawer(false); if (b.dataset.t === tab && pinned) pinned = false; else { pinned = true; setTab(b.dataset.t); } tabsEl.classList.toggle("pin", pinned); }));
    tabsEl.classList.toggle("pin", pinned);
  }
  function setTab(t){ if (t === tab && shown === t) return; tab = t; tabsEl.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", b.dataset.t === t)); cycleT = 0; render(true); }
  pane.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => { hold = Math.max(hold, 6); });
  pane.addEventListener("pointermove", () => { hold = Math.max(hold, 6); });

  /* ---- data ---- */
  const visIds = () => { const o = []; for (let i = 0; i < NP; i++) if (stat.vis[i] && (S.sec < 0 || P[i].sc === S.sec)) o.push(i); return o; };
  function govData(){
    const m = {}; visIds().forEach(i => P[i].g.forEach(g => { const r = m[g] || (m[g] = {id: g, n: 0, sc: new Array(SECS.length).fill(0), ids: []}); r.n++; r.sc[P[i].sc]++; r.ids.push(i); }));
    return Object.values(m).sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n);
  }
  function entData(){
    const m = {}; visIds().forEach(i => { const p = P[i], k = p.mn; const r = m[k] || (m[k] = {id: k, nm: p.ms || p.mn, n: 0, st: [0, 0, 0], sc: p.sc, ids: []}); r.n++; r.st[p.kd === "e" ? 2 : p.kd === "p" ? 1 : 0]++; r.ids.push(i); });
    return Object.values(m).sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n);
  }
  const secIds = s => { const o = []; for (let i = 0; i < NP; i++) if (stat.vis[i] && P[i].sc === s) o.push(i); return o; };

  /* ---- views ---- */
  const nf = n => String(n);
  /* sectors as square buttons in the sector's own colour: a ring showing what is done against what is still to come, with the icon and the count inside it */
  function viewSec(){
    const R = 40, C = 2 * Math.PI * R;
    return `<div class="xsq">${SECS.map((sc, i) => { const st = stat.secSt[i], n = stat.secCnt[i], t = Math.max(1, n); let a0 = 0;
      const arcs = st.map((v, q) => { const len = Math.max(0, v / t * C - (v && v < n ? 2.5 : 0)), d = `<circle class="a${q}" cx="50" cy="50" r="${R}" stroke-dasharray="${q === 2 ? dashes(len) + " " : ""}${q === 2 ? "0 " + C.toFixed(1) : len.toFixed(1) + " " + C.toFixed(1)}" stroke-dashoffset="${(-a0).toFixed(1)}" style="--l:${len.toFixed(1)}"/>`; a0 += v / t * C; return v ? d : ""; }).join("");
      return `<button type="button" class="sq${S.sec === i ? " on" : ""}" data-s="${i}" style="--c:${SECC[i]};--i:${i}" aria-pressed="${S.sec === i}" aria-label="${esc(sc.n)}: ${n} ${T("مشروعًا، منها")} ${st[0]} ${T("منجز أو يعمل")}">
        <span class="rg"><svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" aria-hidden="true"><circle class="tk" cx="50" cy="50" r="${R}"/><g transform="rotate(-90 50 50)">${arcs}</g></svg><span class="in">${svgI(i)}<b>${n}</b></span></span>
        <span class="nm">${esc(sc.n)}</span><span class="dn">${EN ? `<i>${st[0]}</i> / <i>${n}</i> done` : `<i>${st[0]}</i> تم · <i>${n - st[0]}</i> جارٍ`}</span></button>`; }).join("")}</div>`;
  }
  const dashes = len => { let d = "", q = 0; while (q + 3 <= len) { d += (d ? " " : "") + "3 2.2"; q += 5.2; } return d || "0 0"; };
  /* a thumbnail of the country for each governorate row: the outline of Egypt, the governorate filled, and a dot on it so even the smallest one can be found */
  const EGT = (() => { let x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9; egRings.forEach(r => { for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i += 2) { x0 = Math.min(x0, r[i]); x1 = Math.max(x1, r[i]); y0 = Math.min(y0, r[i + 1]); y1 = Math.max(y1, r[i + 1]); } });
    const sz = Math.max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0), pd = sz * 0.05, gov = {}, at = {};
    /* Douglas-Peucker: keeps the corners of the long straight borders, drops the coast's fine wiggle */
    const dec = (r, n) => { const m = r.length / 2, tol = sz / n, keep = new Uint8Array(m), st = [[0, m - 1]]; keep[0] = keep[m - 1] = 1;
      while (st.length) { const [a, b] = st.pop(); if (b - a < 2) continue; const ax = r[a * 2], ay = r[a * 2 + 1], dx = r[b * 2] - ax, dy = r[b * 2 + 1] - ay, L = Math.hypot(dx, dy); let bi = -1, bd = tol;
        for (let i = a + 1; i < b; i++) { const px = r[i * 2] - ax, py = r[i * 2 + 1] - ay, dd = L > 1e-6 ? Math.abs(px * dy - py * dx) / L : Math.hypot(px, py); if (dd > bd) { bd = dd; bi = i; } }
        if (bi > 0) { keep[bi] = 1; st.push([a, bi], [bi, b]); } }
      let d = ""; for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) if (keep[i]) d += (d ? "L" : "M") + r[i * 2].toFixed(1) + " " + r[i * 2 + 1].toFixed(1); return d + "Z"; };
    D.govs.forEach(g => { gov[g.id] = g.rings.map(poly => dec(poly[0], 160)).join(""); at[g.id] = [g.lx, g.ly]; });
    return {vb: `${(x0 - pd).toFixed(1)} ${(y0 - pd).toFixed(1)} ${(x1 - x0 + pd * 2).toFixed(1)} ${(y1 - y0 + pd * 2).toFixed(1)}`, out: egRings.filter(r => r.length > 40).map(r => dec(r, 120)).join(""), gov, at, u: sz / 40}; })();
  const thumb = (id, c) => `<svg class="th" viewBox="${EGT.vb}" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${EGT.out}" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.05)" stroke="rgba(190,215,245,.55)" stroke-width="${(EGT.u * 0.9).toFixed(2)}" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="${EGT.gov[id] || ""}" fill="${c}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${(EGT.u * 0.6).toFixed(2)}"/>${EGT.at[id] ? `<circle cx="${EGT.at[id][0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${EGT.at[id][1].toFixed(1)}" r="${(EGT.u * 3.2).toFixed(2)}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${(EGT.u * 0.8).toFixed(2)}" opacity=".8"/>` : ""}</svg>`;
  function bars(rows, kind){
    const mx = Math.max(1, ...rows.map(r => r.n));
    return `<ol class="xbars">${rows.map((r, j) => {
      const segs = kind === "gov" ? r.sc.map((v, s) => v ? `<i style="flex:${v};background:${SECC[s]}"></i>` : "").join("") : r.st.map((v, s) => v ? `<i style="flex:${v};background:${SECC[r.sc]};opacity:${[1, .6, .32][s]}"></i>` : "").join("");
      const nm = kind === "gov" ? GN[r.id] : r.nm, c = kind === "gov" ? SECC[r.sc.indexOf(Math.max(...r.sc))] : SECC[r.sc];
      return `<li${kind === "gov" ? ' class="gv"' : ""} data-k="${kind}" data-id="${esc(r.id)}" style="--c:${c};--w:${(r.n / mx * 100).toFixed(1)}%;--d:${(j * 0.035).toFixed(3)}s">${kind === "gov" ? thumb(r.id, c) : ""}<span class="nm">${esc(nm)}</span><b>${r.n}</b><span class="tr"><span class="fl">${segs}</span></span></li>`; }).join("")}</ol>`;
  }
  function viewFacts(){ return `<div class="xfacts" style="--c:${SECC[S.sec]}">${SECS[S.sec].facts.map((f, j) => `<div class="fact" style="--i:${j}"><b>${esc(f[0])}</b><span>${esc(f[1])}</span><i>${T("المصدر:")} ${esc(f[2])}</i></div>`).join("")}</div>`; }
  let curV = null; const xq = id => (curV || pane).querySelector("#" + id) || {style: {}, set textContent(v) {}};
  function render(force){
    const s = tab + "|" + S.sec + "|" + stat.n + "|" + Math.floor(S.T) + fltSig;
    if (!force && s === sig) return; sig = s;
    const swap = force || shown !== tab || !curV, into = swap ? (useA ? vA : vB) : curV; if (swap) useA = !useA;
    let html = "", title = T("توزيع المشروعات");
    if (tab === "sec") { html = viewSec(); title = T("القطاعات"); foot.textContent = T("الحلقة: المصمت ما تم، والباهت ما زال جاريًا · اضغط لعرض القطاع"); }
    else if (tab === "facts") { html = viewFacts(); title = T("لمحات قطاع ") + SECS[S.sec].n; foot.textContent = T("أرقام من نبذات المشروعات مع رقم الصفحة"); }
    else if (tab === "gov") { const d = govData(); html = bars(d, "gov"); title = T("المشروعات حسب المحافظة"); foot.textContent = d.length + T(" محافظة · اضغط لعرضها"); }
    else if (tab === "ent") { const d = entData(); html = bars(d, "ent"); title = T("المشروعات حسب الجهة"); foot.textContent = FLT.mn ? T("اضغط على الجهة مرة أخرى لإلغاء فلترتها") : d.length + T(" جهة · اضغط على جهة لفلترة الخريطة بها"); }
    else { title = T("آخر ما تحقق"); foot.textContent = T("اضغط على المشروع لفتحه"); }
    $("xpT").textContent = title;
    if (tab === "feed") { if (feedOl.parentNode !== into) { into.innerHTML = ""; into.appendChild(feedOl); } } else into.innerHTML = html;
    if (!swap) into.classList.add("still");               /* a data refresh in place: no entrance animation */
    else { into.className = "xv in"; into.removeAttribute("aria-hidden"); if (curV && curV !== into) { curV.className = "xv out"; curV.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); } curV = into; }
    shown = tab; bindView(into);
  }
  function bindView(v){
    v.querySelectorAll("[data-s]").forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => setHot({kind: "sec", s: +el.dataset.s, el}));
      el.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => setHot(null));
      el.addEventListener("click", () => { setHot(null); hold = 30; pickSector(+el.dataset.s); });
    });
    v.querySelectorAll(".xbars li[data-k]").forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => setHot({kind: el.dataset.k, id: el.dataset.id, el}));
      el.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => setHot(null));
      el.addEventListener("click", () => { setHot(null); hold = 30; if (el.dataset.k === "gov") openGov(el.dataset.id); else { FLT.mn = FLT.mn === el.dataset.id ? null : el.dataset.id; fltTouch(); if (FLT.mn) openList("ent", FLT.mn); } });   /* an entity row filters the whole map to that entity (click again to release) */
    });
  }
  feedOl.addEventListener("pointerover", e => { const li = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("li.f"); if (li && (!hot || hot.el !== li)) setHot({kind: "proj", pi: +li.dataset.i, el: li}); });
  feedOl.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => setHot(null));

  /* ---- hover: map highlight + leader lines ---- */
  function setHot(h){
    hot = h; S.hl = null; S.hoverG = null; S.hoverP = -1;
    S.hotSec = h && h.kind === "sec" ? h.s : -1;                 /* the main ring answers with that sector's number and name */
    if (!h) { lk.innerHTML = ""; return; }
    if (h.kind === "sec") { S.hl = new Set(secIds(h.s)); h.ids = secIds(h.s); h.c = SECC[h.s]; }
    else if (h.kind === "gov") { S.hoverG = h.id; const r = govData().find(q => q.id === h.id); h.ids = r ? r.ids : []; S.hl = new Set(h.ids); h.c = getComputedStyle(h.el).getPropertyValue("--c"); }
    else if (h.kind === "ent") { const r = entData().find(q => q.id === h.id); h.ids = r ? r.ids : []; S.hl = new Set(h.ids); h.c = SECC[r ? r.sc : 0]; }
    else if (h.kind === "proj") { S.hoverP = h.pi; h.ids = [h.pi]; h.c = SECC[P[h.pi].sc]; }
    /* targets: the governorate's label point, or up to 16 located projects */
    if (h.kind === "gov") { const o = govs[h.id]; h.tg = [[o.lx, null, o.lz]]; }
    else h.tg = h.ids.filter(i => P[i].onMap).slice(0, 16).map(i => { const k = P[i].ins[0]; return [aPos[k * 3], k, aPos[k * 3 + 2]]; });
    lk.style.setProperty("--c", h.c);
    lk.innerHTML = h.tg.map(() => `<path class="ln" d=""/><rect class="dm" x="-4" y="-4" width="8" height="8" transform="translate(-99,-99) rotate(45)"/>`).join("");
  }
  function drawLinks(){
    if (!hot || !hot.tg || !hot.tg.length) return;
    const sr = stage.getBoundingClientRect(), r = hot.el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!r.width) { setHot(null); return; }
    const ax = r.right - sr.left + 2, ay = r.top - sr.top + r.height / 2, kids = lk.children;
    hot.tg.forEach((t, n) => {
      const k = t[1], x = t[0], z = t[2], y = k == null ? govTopY(govs[hot.id], x, z) + 0.25 : aHeadPos[k * 3 + 1];
      const s = screenOf(x, y, z), p = kids[n * 2], d = kids[n * 2 + 1];
      if (s[2] > 1 || s[0] < ax + 10) { p.setAttribute("d", ""); d.setAttribute("transform", "translate(-99,-99)"); return; }
      const mx = ax + 22 + n * 1.5;
      p.setAttribute("d", `M${ax.toFixed(1)} ${ay.toFixed(1)} H${mx.toFixed(1)} L${s[0].toFixed(1)} ${s[1].toFixed(1)}`);
      d.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${s[0].toFixed(1)},${s[1].toFixed(1)}) rotate(45)`);
    });
  }

  /* ---- filters: a drawer of toggle chips with live counts, and a summary strip while any filter is on ---- */
  const fb = $("xpFb"), fd = $("xpFd"), fs = $("xpFs"), fn = $("xpFn");
  const FG = [["st", T("حالة المشروع"), [["a", T("منجز أو يعمل")], ["p", T("مستمر")], ["e", T("قيد التنفيذ أو مستهدف")]]],
    ["tr", T("التكلفة المعلنة"), [["3", T("أكثر من 10 مليار")], ["2", T("1 – 10 مليار")], ["1", T("100 مليون – 1 مليار")], ["0", T("أقل من 100 مليون")], ["x", T("غير محددة بالملف")]]],
    ["loc", T("الظهور على الخريطة"), [["x", T("على الخريطة بموقع ومجسم مؤكدين")], ["a", T("في القوائم فقط: لا موقع مؤكد")]]]];
  const fKey = {st: "fS", tr: "fT", loc: "fL"};
  function fCounts(g){ const c = {}; for (let i = 0; i < NP; i++) { const p = P[i]; if (S.T < p.y + p.sg || (S.sec >= 0 && p.sc !== S.sec) || !fpass(p, g)) continue; const k = p[fKey[g]]; c[k] = (c[k] || 0) + 1; } return c; }
  function fDrawer(on){ fOpen = on; fd.hidden = !on; fb.setAttribute("aria-expanded", on); pane.classList.toggle("fopen", on); if (on) { hold = 9999; fSig = ""; fRender(); fd.classList.remove("in"); void fd.offsetWidth; fd.classList.add("in"); } else hold = 4; }
  function fRender(){
    const sg = fltSig + "|" + S.sec + "|" + Math.floor(S.T) + "|" + fOpen; if (sg === fSig) return; fSig = sg;
    const n = fltCount(); fn.hidden = !n; fn.textContent = n; fb.classList.toggle("act", n > 0);
    let all = 0; for (let i = 0; i < NP; i++) { const p = P[i]; if (S.T >= p.y + p.sg && (S.sec < 0 || p.sc === S.sec)) all++; }
    fs.hidden = !n; if (n) { fs.innerHTML = `<span>${T("معروض")} <b>${stat.n}</b> ${T("من")} <b>${all}</b>${FLT.mn ? ` · <i>${esc((P.find(p => p.mn === FLT.mn) || {}).ms || FLT.mn)}</i>` : ""}</span><button type="button" id="xpFr">${T("مسح الفلاتر ✕")}</button>`; $("xpFr").addEventListener("click", () => { fltReset(); }); }
    if (!fOpen) return;
    fd.innerHTML = `<div class="fg fp"><div class="fc">${Object.keys(FPRE).map(k => `<button type="button" data-g="pre" data-k="${k}" aria-pressed="${fltIs(k)}"><span>${FPRE[k][0]}</span></button>`).join("")}</div></div>` + FG.map(([g, title, opts]) => { const c = fCounts(g); return `<div class="fg"><h4>${title}</h4><div class="fc">${opts.map(([k, t]) => `<button type="button" data-g="${g}" data-k="${k}" aria-pressed="${!!FLT[g][k]}"${g === "st" ? ` class="s-${k}"` : ""}><span>${t}</span><b>${c[k] || 0}</b></button>`).join("")}</div></div>`; }).join("") +
      `<div class="fg"><h4>${T("الجهة")}</h4><div class="fc">${FLT.mn ? `<button type="button" data-g="mn" aria-pressed="true"><span>${esc((P.find(p => p.mn === FLT.mn) || {}).ms || FLT.mn)}</span><b>✕</b></button>` : `<button type="button" data-g="pick"><span>${T("اختر جهة من قائمة «الجهات»")}</span><b>›</b></button>`}</div></div>
       <div class="fa"><button type="button" data-g="reset">${T("إعادة الضبط")}</button><button type="button" data-g="close" class="pri">${T("عرض")} ${stat.n} ${T("مشروعًا")}</button></div>`;
    fd.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => { const g = b.dataset.g;
      if (g === "reset") fltReset(); else if (g === "pre") fltPreset(b.dataset.k); else if (g === "close") fDrawer(false); else if (g === "mn") { FLT.mn = null; fltTouch(); } else if (g === "pick") { fDrawer(false); pinned = true; setTab("ent"); tabsEl.classList.add("pin"); } else fltToggle(g, b.dataset.k); }));
  }
  fb.addEventListener("click", () => fDrawer(!fOpen));

  /* ---- per frame ---- */
  function frame(dt){
    const on = !pane.hidden && innerWidth > 900;
    if (S.sec !== lastSec) { const fromSq = tab === "sec" && panelHover; lastSec = S.sec; if (S.sec >= 0 && !fromSq) tab = "facts"; buildTabs(); render(true); }
    if (!on) { if (hot) setHot(null); return; }
    $("xpY").textContent = Math.min(2030, Math.floor(S.T));
    fRender();
    hold = fOpen ? 9999 : Math.max(0, hold - dt); if (!hot && hold <= 0 && !pinned && !ptrOnPanel()) { cycleT += dt; if (cycleT > CYCLE) { const l = tabList(); setTab(l[(l.indexOf(tab) + 1) % l.length]); } }
    const bar = tabsEl.querySelector('[aria-selected="true"] i'); if (bar) bar.style.transform = `scaleX(${hold > 0 || pinned ? 1 : Math.min(1, cycleT / CYCLE).toFixed(3)})`;
    render(false); drawLinks();
  }
  let panelHover = false; pane.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => panelHover = true); pane.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { panelHover = false; });
  const ptrOnPanel = () => panelHover;
  bindView(document.getElementById("gArcs")); bindView(document.getElementById("gIcons"));
  buildTabs(); render(true);
  return {frame, setTab: t => { hold = 0; pinned = false; tabsEl.classList.remove("pin"); if (fOpen) fDrawer(false); setTab(t); }, pane};
})();


/* ================= trail: where you are and the way back =================
   A pill under the mode switch that appears the moment anything is opened: back, home, then one crumb per level (mode, sector, governorate, project).
   Any crumb jumps to its level, its ✕ drops that level and everything under it. Esc, Backspace and Alt+← do the same as "back". */
const trailEl = document.getElementById("trail"); let trailSig = null;
function navLevels(){
  const l = [];
  if (S.mode !== "surface") l.push({k: "mode", t: S.mode === "layers" ? T("الطبقات") : T("الكثافة"), c: "#ffc98a"});
  if (S.sec >= 0) l.push({k: "sec", t: SECS[S.sec].n, c: SECC[S.sec], ic: S.sec});
  if (FLT.mn) l.push({k: "ent", t: FLT.mn, c: "#ffc98a"});
  if (S.selG) l.push({k: "gov", t: GN[S.selG], c: "#ffc98a"});
  if (S.selP >= 0) l.push({k: "proj", t: P[S.selP].n, c: SECC[P[S.selP].sc]});
  return l;
}
function navDrop(k){            /* remove level k and everything deeper */
  if (S.show) stopShow();
  if (k === "proj" || k === "gov") closeCard(true);
  else if (k === "ent") { if (S.selP >= 0 || S.selG || S.listK) closeCard(false); FLT.mn = null; fltTouch(); }
  else if (k === "sec") { if (S.selP >= 0 || S.selG || S.listK) closeCard(false); setSector(-1); if (S.mode === "surface" && !userMoved) flyTo(homeView(), 1400); }
  else if (k === "mode") { if (S.selP >= 0 || S.selG || S.listK) closeCard(false); setMode("surface"); }
}
/* panels that sit on top of the map (search, the year panel, the project preview) register here: back closes the one opened last, before it climbs any level */
const NAV_OVER = []; function navOver(o){ NAV_OVER.push(o); }
function navOpenOver(){ for (let i = NAV_OVER.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (NAV_OVER[i].open()) return NAV_OVER[i]; return null; }
function dockCloseOver(except){ NAV_OVER.forEach(o => { if (o.id !== except && o.open()) o.close(); }); }
function navCanBack(){ return !!navOpenOver() || !!S.show || navLevels().length > 0; }
function navBack(){ const o = navOpenOver(); if (o) { o.close(); return true; }
  if (S.show) { stopShow(); return true; }
  const l = navLevels(); if (!l.length) return false; navDrop(l[l.length - 1].k); return true; }
function navHome(){ dockCloseOver(); if (S.show) stopShow(); if (S.selP >= 0 || S.selG || S.listK) closeCard(false); if (FLT.mn) { FLT.mn = null; fltTouch(); } if (S.sec >= 0) setSector(-1); if (S.mode !== "surface") setMode("surface"); prevView = null; flyTo(homeView("surface"), 1500); }
function navGo(k){              /* jump to level k: drop only what is deeper than it */
  const l = navLevels(), i = l.findIndex(x => x.k === k); if (i < 0 || i === l.length - 1) return; navDrop(l[i + 1].k); }
function updateTrail(){
  const l = navLevels(), sig = l.map(x => x.k + ":" + x.t).join("|") + (S.show ? "|show" : "");
  if (sig === trailSig) return; const first = trailSig === null; trailSig = sig;
  trailEl.hidden = !!S.show;                        /* during the show its place is taken by the running caption */
  if (first) trailEl.innerHTML = `<div class="tb"><button type="button" class="bk" data-a="back" title="${T("رجوع خطوة (Esc)")}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg><span>${T("رجوع")}</span></button>
    <button type="button" class="hm" data-a="home" title="${T("العودة إلى خريطة مصر كلها")}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 11l8-7 8 7M6 10v9h12v-9"/></svg><span>${T("مصر كلها")}</span></button></div><div class="crs"></div>`;
  const on = l.length > 0 && !S.show, crs = trailEl.querySelector(".crs"), show = on ? l.filter(x => x.k !== "mode") : [];      /* the mode is already the switch above, so it gets no crumb */
  trailEl.classList.toggle("on", on); trailEl.querySelectorAll(".tb button").forEach(b => { b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; b.setAttribute("aria-disabled", !on); });
  /* keep the crumbs that are still valid in place (no re-animation), drop the rest, add the new ones */
  const keep = new Set(show.map(x => x.k + ":" + x.t)); [...crs.children].forEach(e => { if (!keep.has(e.dataset.id)) e.remove(); });
  show.forEach((x, i) => { const id = x.k + ":" + x.t; let e = [...crs.children].find(q => q.dataset.id === id);
    if (!e) { e = document.createElement("span"); e.className = "cr sxg"; e.dataset.id = id; e.style.setProperty("--c", x.c);
      e.innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="go" data-a="go" data-k="${x.k}" title="${esc(x.t)}">${x.ic != null ? `<i class="sxi">${svgI(x.ic)}</i>` : ""}<span>${esc(x.t)}</span></button><button type="button" class="x" data-a="drop" data-k="${x.k}" aria-label="${T("إغلاق")} ${esc(x.t)}">✕</button>`; crs.appendChild(e); }
    e.style.setProperty("--n", i); e.classList.toggle("cur", i === show.length - 1); });
  setTimeout(reserve, 480);
}
trailEl.addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return; const a = b.dataset.a;
  if (a === "back") navBack(); else if (a === "home") navHome(); else if (a === "go") navGo(b.dataset.k); else if (a === "drop") navDrop(b.dataset.k); });
addEventListener("keydown", e => { const tg = e.target && e.target.tagName; if (tg === "INPUT" || tg === "TEXTAREA") return;
  if ((e.key === "Backspace" || (e.altKey && e.key === "ArrowLeft")) && !S.show) { if (navBack()) e.preventDefault(); } });


/* ================= settings page (الإعدادات) =================
   A full-screen admin overlay: edit / hide / add projects, build a 3D model from an image outline, back up and restore.
   Everything is kept in localStorage "eg-admin-v1" and applied at boot in b_data.js (ADM, ADM_SRC, ADM_GEO0, admApply).
   Functions called from other files (sim.js, c_ui.js) are plain declarations so they are hoisted: admSimNote, admNoteLi, admModelSize, admModelParts. */
SIM_NAME.custom = T("مجسم مرسوم من محيط صورة"); SIM_M.custom = 600;
const ADM_KEY = "eg-admin-v1";
const ADM_KD = {a: T("منجز أو يعمل"), p: T("مستمر"), e: T("قيد التنفيذ أو مستهدف")};
const admE = s => String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;"}[c]));
const admR = (v, n) => { const k = Math.pow(10, n); return Math.round(v * k) / k; };

/* ---- provenance texts used by the project card and the data notes ---- */

  if (p.admLoc) return T("الموقع من إحداثيات مُدخلة من صفحة الإعدادات: لا مجسم له");
  return "";
}

/* ---- model from an image outline: stored as normalised rings + parameters, rebuilt as an extrusion ---- */
/* m = {mode: "front" | "plan", w: metres across, h: depth (front) or height (plan) in metres, rot: degrees, asp: outline height / width, shapes: [[outer, hole, ...], ...] with flat x,y in units of the outline width} */
function admModelDims(m){ const asp = m.asp || 1; return m.mode === "plan" ? {w: m.w, d: m.w * asp, h: m.h} : {w: m.w, d: m.h, h: m.w * asp}; }
function admModelSize(m){ const d = admModelDims(m); return Math.max(8, 1.12 * Math.max(Math.hypot(d.w, d.d), d.h * 1.25)); }
function admModelGeo(m, k){
  const asp = m.asp || 1, W = m.w * k, plan = m.mode === "plan", shapes = [];
  const ring = fl => { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i + 1 < fl.length; i += 2) pts.push(new THREE.Vector2((fl[i] - .5) * W, plan ? -(fl[i + 1] - asp / 2) * W : (asp - fl[i + 1]) * W)); return pts; };
  (m.shapes || []).forEach(sh => { if (!sh || !sh[0] || sh[0].length < 6) return; const s = new THREE.Shape(ring(sh[0]));
    for (let j = 1; j < sh.length; j++) if (sh[j] && sh[j].length >= 6) s.holes.push(new THREE.Path(ring(sh[j]))); shapes.push(s); });
  if (!shapes.length) return null;
  const dep = Math.max(.002, m.h * k), g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shapes, {depth: dep, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 1});
  if (plan) g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); else g.translate(0, 0, -dep / 2);      /* plan: image top is north, the footprint rises; front: the silhouette stands upright */
  if (m.rot) g.rotateY(-m.rot * Math.PI / 180);
  return g;
}
/* sim.js asks for the parts in model units: the pedestal (4.6 units across) spans sizeM metres, so the hologram is at true metric scale on the map */
function admModelParts(m, sizeM){ let g = null; try { g = admModelGeo(m, 4.6 / sizeM); } catch (e) {} return g ? [{geo: g, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, tn: 1, gr: "y"}] : []; }

/* image -> mask -> outline (marching squares) -> simplified rings (Douglas-Peucker) */
function admTrace(cv, sens){
  const w = cv.width, h = cv.height, d = cv.getContext("2d").getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data, W2 = w + 2, H2 = h + 2, mask = new Uint8Array(W2 * H2);
  let na = 0; for (let i = 3; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] < 200) na++;
  const alpha = na > w * h * 0.01, cor = [0, w - 1, (h - 1) * w, h * w - 1].map(i => [d[i * 4], d[i * 4 + 1], d[i * 4 + 2]]);
  let cnt = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) { const i = (y * w + x) * 4; let ins;
    if (alpha) ins = d[i + 3] > 110;
    else { let md = 1e9; for (const c of cor) { const dr = d[i] - c[0], dg = d[i + 1] - c[1], db = d[i + 2] - c[2], q = dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db; if (q < md) md = q; } ins = md > sens * sens; }
    if (ins) { mask[(y + 1) * W2 + x + 1] = 1; cnt++; } }
  if (!cnt) return {shapes: [], asp: 1, n: 0, alpha, cover: cnt / (w * h)};
  /* marching squares: every cell between four samples links the edge where its rim goes out->in to the next edge where it goes in->out */
  const next = new Map(), KX = 4096;
  for (let y = 0; y < H2 - 1; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W2 - 1; x++) {
    const v = [mask[y * W2 + x], mask[y * W2 + x + 1], mask[(y + 1) * W2 + x + 1], mask[(y + 1) * W2 + x]], s = v[0] + v[1] + v[2] + v[3]; if (s === 0 || s === 4) continue;
    const mid = [2 * x + 1 + 2 * y * KX, 2 * x + 2 + (2 * y + 1) * KX, 2 * x + 1 + (2 * y + 2) * KX, 2 * x + (2 * y + 1) * KX];
    for (let e = 0; e < 4; e++) if (!v[e] && v[(e + 1) % 4]) { for (let q = 1; q < 4; q++) { const f = (e + q) % 4; if (v[f] && !v[(f + 1) % 4]) { next.set(mid[e], mid[f]); break; } } }
  }
  const seen = new Set(), loops = [];
  for (const k0 of next.keys()) { if (seen.has(k0)) continue; const pts = []; let k = k0, guard = 0;
    while (k !== undefined && !seen.has(k) && guard++ < 400000) { seen.add(k); pts.push([(k % KX) / 2 - 1, Math.floor(k / KX) / 2 - 1]); k = next.get(k); }
    if (pts.length >= 6) loops.push(pts); }
  const area = r => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0, j = r.length - 1; i < r.length; j = i++) a += r[j][0] * r[i][1] - r[i][0] * r[j][1]; return Math.abs(a) / 2; };
  const dp = (pts, tol) => { const n = pts.length, keep = new Uint8Array(n), st = [[0, n - 1]]; keep[0] = keep[n - 1] = 1;
    while (st.length) { const [a, b] = st.pop(); if (b - a < 2) continue; const ax = pts[a][0], ay = pts[a][1], dx = pts[b][0] - ax, dy = pts[b][1] - ay, l = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1e-9; let mx = 0, mi = -1;
      for (let i = a + 1; i < b; i++) { const q = Math.abs((pts[i][0] - ax) * dy - (pts[i][1] - ay) * dx) / l; if (q > mx) { mx = q; mi = i; } }
      if (mx > tol && mi > 0) { keep[mi] = 1; st.push([a, mi], [mi, b]); } }
    return pts.filter((p, i) => keep[i]); };
  const simp = (r, tol) => { let far = 0, fd = -1; for (let i = 1; i < r.length; i++) { const q = Math.hypot(r[i][0] - r[0][0], r[i][1] - r[0][1]); if (q > fd) { fd = q; far = i; } }
    const a = dp(r.slice(0, far + 1), tol), b = dp(r.slice(far).concat([r[0]]), tol); return a.concat(b.slice(1, -1)); };
  const minA = Math.max(10, w * h * 0.0015); let rings = [], tol = 0.85;
  const big = loops.map(r => ({r, a: area(r)})).filter(o => o.a >= minA).sort((p, q) => q.a - p.a).slice(0, 40);
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 6; pass++) { rings = big.map(o => ({r: simp(o.r, tol), a: o.a})).filter(o => o.r.length >= 3); if (rings.reduce((s, o) => s + o.r.length, 0) <= 420) break; tol *= 1.5; }
  const inside = (p, r) => { let ins = false; for (let i = 0, j = r.length - 1; i < r.length; j = i++) { const xi = r[i][0], yi = r[i][1], xj = r[j][0], yj = r[j][1]; if ((yi > p[1]) !== (yj > p[1]) && p[0] < (xj - xi) * (p[1] - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) ins = !ins; } return ins; };
  rings.forEach((o, i) => { o.par = -1; o.dep = 0; rings.forEach((q, j) => { if (i !== j && q.a > o.a && inside(o.r[0], q.r)) { o.dep++; if (o.par < 0 || q.a < rings[o.par].a) o.par = j; } }); });
  const outers = rings.filter(o => o.dep % 2 === 0); if (!outers.length) return {shapes: [], asp: 1, n: 0, alpha, cover: cnt / (w * h)};
  let x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9; outers.forEach(o => o.r.forEach(p => { x0 = Math.min(x0, p[0]); y0 = Math.min(y0, p[1]); x1 = Math.max(x1, p[0]); y1 = Math.max(y1, p[1]); }));
  const bw = x1 - x0, bh = y1 - y0; if (bw < 2 || bh < 2) return {shapes: [], asp: 1, n: 0, alpha, cover: cnt / (w * h)};
  const flat = r => { const f = []; r.forEach(p => f.push(admR((p[0] - x0) / bw, 4), admR((p[1] - y0) / bw, 4))); return f; };
  let n = 0; const shapes = outers.map(o => { const sh = [flat(o.r)]; n += o.r.length; rings.forEach(q => { if (q.dep % 2 === 1 && rings[q.par] === o) { sh.push(flat(q.r)); n += q.r.length; } }); return sh; });
  return {shapes, asp: admR(bh / bw, 4), n, alpha, cover: cnt / (w * h)};
}

/* ---- the file's own values and the current values of one project, in form shape ---- */
function admLL0(o){ const g = ADM_GEO0[o.i]; if (g && g.lat === +g.lat && g.lon === +g.lon && !(o.nat && g.ln)) return [g.lat, g.lon];
  if (!o.nat && o.a && o.a.length) return [D.proj.lat0 - o.a[0][1] / K, D.proj.lon0 + o.a[0][0] / CXK]; return null; }
function admBase(o){ const ll = admLL0(o);
  return {n: o.n, sc: o.sc, gov: ll ? (o.g && o.g[0]) || "" : "NAT", mn: o.mn || "", y: o.y, kd: o.kd, ct: o.ct || "", sm: o.sm || "", lat: ll ? admR(ll[0], 5) : "", lon: ll ? admR(ll[1], 5) : "", simT: ""}; }
const ADM_EMPTY = () => ({n: "", sc: 0, gov: "", mn: "", y: NOW_Y, kd: "a", ct: "", sm: "", lat: "", lon: "", simT: ""});
function admCur(i){ const add = ADM.added.find(e => e.i === i); if (add) return Object.assign(ADM_EMPTY(), add);
  const o = ADM_SRC.find(p => p.i === i); return o ? Object.assign(admBase(o), ADM.edits[i] || {}) : null; }
function admRows(){ const hid = new Set(ADM.hidden.map(Number));
  return ADM_SRC.map(o => { const c = admCur(o.i); return {i: o.i, n: c.n, sc: c.sc, ed: !!ADM.edits[o.i], add: false, hid: hid.has(o.i), mod: !!ADM.models[o.i]}; })
    .concat(ADM.added.map(e => ({i: e.i, n: e.n, sc: e.sc, ed: false, add: true, hid: hid.has(e.i), mod: !!ADM.models[e.i]}))); }
function admStore(){ try { localStorage.setItem(ADM_KEY, JSON.stringify(ADM)); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } }
function admClean(a){ if (!a || typeof a !== "object" || a.v !== 1) return null; const obj = v => (v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v)) ? v : {};
  return {v: 1, edits: obj(a.edits), added: Array.isArray(a.added) ? a.added.filter(e => e && e.i === +e.i && e.i >= 1000 && typeof e.n === "string" && e.n.trim()) : [],
    hidden: Array.isArray(a.hidden) ? a.hidden.map(Number).filter(n => n === n) : [], models: obj(a.models)}; }

admEl.innerHTML = `<div class="adm-hd"><h2>${T("الإعدادات")} <small>${T("تعديل بيانات العرض على هذا الجهاز")}</small></h2>
  <div class="adm-tabs" role="tablist">${[["proj", T("المشروعات")], ["add", T("إضافة مشروع")], ["bak", T("نسخ احتياطي")]].map(([k, n]) => `<button type="button" role="tab" data-tab="${k}" aria-selected="false">${n}</button>`).join("")}</div>
  <button type="button" class="adm-x" id="admX" aria-label="${T("إغلاق الإعدادات")}">✕</button></div>
 <div class="adm-bd">

const admPickBar = document.createElement("div"); admPickBar.className = "adm-pick"; admPickBar.hidden = true; admPickBar.innerHTML = `<span>${T("اضغط على الخريطة لتحديد موقع المشروع")}</span><button type="button">${T("إلغاء")}</button>`; document.body.appendChild(admPickBar);

/* two-step confirmation built into the button itself (alert / confirm are not available) */
function admConfirm(btn, label, fn){ btn.addEventListener("click", () => { if (btn.classList.contains("arm")) { clearTimeout(btn._t); btn.classList.remove("arm"); btn.textContent = btn._l; fn(); return; }
  btn._l = btn.textContent; btn.classList.add("arm"); btn.textContent = label; btn._t = setTimeout(() => { btn.classList.remove("arm"); btn.textContent = btn._l; }, 6000); }); }
function admReload(text){ const m = admQ("#admMsg"); m.hidden = false; m.firstElementChild.textContent = text || T("تم الحفظ — جارٍ إعادة التحميل لتطبيق التغييرات");
  setTimeout(() => { try { location.reload(); } catch (e) {} }, 400); setTimeout(() => { m.firstElementChild.textContent = T("أعد فتح الصفحة لتطبيق التغييرات"); }, 2400); }
function admSave(text){ if (!admStore()) { return false; } admReload(text); return true; }

/* ---- the project form (shared by "edit" and "add") ---- */
function admFormHTML(v, kind, row){
  const opt = (val, txt, cur) => `<option value="${admE(val)}"${String(val) === String(cur) ? " selected" : ""}>${admE(txt)}</option>`;
  const src = kind === "edit" && !row.add ? ADM_SRC.find(p => p.i === row.i) : null, multi = src && !src.nat && src.a && src.a.length > 1 ? src.a.length : 0;
  return `<h3 class="adm-ttl">${kind === "add" ? T("مشروع جديد") : admE(v.n)}${kind === "edit" ? (row.add ? T("<em>مُضاف من الإعدادات</em>") : row.ed ? T("<em>معدَّل</em>") : "") + (row.hid ? T("<em>مخفي</em>") : "") + (row.mod ? T("<em>له مجسم من صورة</em>") : "") : ""}</h3>
  <div class="adm-note" data-note></div>
  <div class="adm-grid">
   <div class="adm-f w4" data-w="n"><label>${T("الاسم")}</label><input type="text" data-f="n" value="${admE(v.n)}" maxlength="200"><span class="err"></span></div>
   <div class="adm-f w2" data-w="sc"><label>${T("القطاع")}</label><select data-f="sc">${SECS.map((s, i) => opt(i, s.n, v.sc)).join("")}</select></div>
   <div class="adm-f w2" data-w="mn"><label>${T("الجهة")}</label><input type="text" data-f="mn" value="${admE(v.mn)}" maxlength="160"></div>
   <div class="adm-f" data-w="y"><label>${T("سنة الانتهاء أو التشغيل")}</label><input type="number" data-f="y" value="${admE(v.y)}" min="2013" max="2035" step="1" inputmode="numeric"><span class="err"></span></div>
   <div class="adm-f" data-w="kd"><label>${T("الحالة")}</label><select data-f="kd">${Object.keys(ADM_KD).map(k => opt(k, ADM_KD[k], v.kd)).join("")}</select></div>
   <div class="adm-f w2" data-w="ct"><label>${T("التكلفة (تُعرض كما وردت)")}</label><input type="text" data-f="ct" value="${admE(v.ct)}" maxlength="120"></div>
   <div class="adm-f w4" data-w="sm"><label>${T("النبذة")}</label><textarea data-f="sm" maxlength="900">${admE(v.sm)}</textarea></div>
   <div class="adm-f w2" data-w="gov"><label>${EN ? "Governorate" : "المحافظة"}</label><select data-f="gov">${opt("", T("تُحدَّد تلقائيًا من الإحداثيات"), v.gov)}${Object.keys(GN).map(k => opt(k, GN[k], v.gov)).join("")}${opt("NAT", T("على مستوى الجمهورية (بلا موقع على الخريطة)"), v.gov)}</select></div>
   <div class="adm-f" data-w="lat"><label>${T("خط العرض")}</label><input type="number" data-f="lat" value="${admE(v.lat)}" min="21.5" max="32" step="any" inputmode="decimal" dir="ltr"><span class="err"></span></div>
   <div class="adm-f" data-w="lon"><label>${T("خط الطول")}</label><input type="number" data-f="lon" value="${admE(v.lon)}" min="24.5" max="37.5" step="any" inputmode="decimal" dir="ltr"><span class="err"></span></div>
   <div class="adm-f w2"><span class="adm-lbl">${T("تحديد الموقع")}</span><button type="button" data-a="pick">⌖ ${T("اختر من الخريطة")}</button>${multi ? `<span class="adm-hint">${T("لهذا المشروع")} ${multi} ${T("مواقع في الملف؛ تعديل الإحداثيات يستبدلها بموقع واحد.")}</span>` : ""}</div>
   <div class="adm-f w2" data-w="simT"><label>${T("نوع المجسم")}</label><select data-f="simT">${opt("", T("تلقائي (من اسم المشروع ونبذته)"), v.simT)}${Object.keys(SIM_NAME).filter(k => k !== "custom").map(k => opt(k, SIM_NAME[k], v.simT)).join("")}</select></div>
   <div class="adm-f w4"><span class="adm-lbl">${T("الصور والفيديو (تظهر في القائمة المدارية حول المشروع، وتُحفظ في هذا المتصفح فقط)")}</span>
     <div class="adm-row"><label class="abtn">＋ ${T("إضافة صور أو فيديو")}<input type="file" data-a="media" accept="image/*,video/*" multiple></label><div class="adm-media" data-media></div></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="adm-row" style="margin-top:.4rem">
   <button type="button" class="pri" data-a="save">${kind === "add" ? T("إضافة المشروع وحفظه") : T("حفظ")}</button>
   ${kind === "edit" && !row.add ? `<button type="button" data-a="undo"${row.ed ? "" : " disabled"}>${T("تراجع عن التعديلات")}</button>` : ""}
   ${kind === "edit" ? `<button type="button" data-a="hide">${row.hid ? T("إظهار المشروع") : T("إخفاء المشروع")}</button>` : ""}
   ${kind === "edit" && row.add ? `<button type="button" class="dng" data-a="del">${T("حذف المشروع")}</button>` : ""}
  </div>
  <p class="adm-hint">${kind === "add" ? T("المشروع المُضاف ليس من الملف المصدر، ويظهر في بطاقته أنه مُدخل من صفحة الإعدادات.") : T("أي تعديل يُحفظ على هذا الجهاز فقط، ويظهر في بطاقة المشروع أنه مُدخل من صفحة الإعدادات. «تراجع عن التعديلات» يعيد قيم الملف المصدر.")}</p>`;
}
function admFormRead(host){ const g = f => host.querySelector(`[data-f="${f}"]`).value, num = s => (String(s).trim() === "" ? "" : Number(s));
  return {n: g("n").trim(), sc: +g("sc"), gov: g("gov"), mn: g("mn").trim(), y: num(g("y")), kd: g("kd"), ct: g("ct").trim(), sm: g("sm").trim(), lat: num(g("lat")), lon: num(g("lon")), simT: g("simT")}; }
function admValidate(host, v){ const er = {};
  if (!v.n) er.n = T("اسم المشروع مطلوب");
  if (v.y === "" || v.y !== v.y || Math.round(v.y) !== v.y || v.y < 2013 || v.y > 2035) er.y = T("أدخل سنة صحيحة بين 2013 و2035");
  if (v.gov !== "NAT") {
    if (v.lat === "" || v.lat !== v.lat) er.lat = T("خط العرض مطلوب (أو اختر «على مستوى الجمهورية»)"); else if (v.lat < 21.5 || v.lat > 32) er.lat = T("خط العرض يجب أن يكون بين 21.5 و32");
    if (v.lon === "" || v.lon !== v.lon) er.lon = T("خط الطول مطلوب (أو اختر «على مستوى الجمهورية»)"); else if (v.lon < 24.5 || v.lon > 37.5) er.lon = T("خط الطول يجب أن يكون بين 24.5 و37.5"); }
  host.querySelectorAll("[data-w]").forEach(w => { const m = er[w.dataset.w] || "", e = w.querySelector(".err"); w.classList.toggle("bad", !!m); if (e) e.textContent = m; });
  const first = host.querySelector(".adm-f.bad input, .adm-f.bad select"); if (first) { try { first.focus(); first.scrollIntoView({block: "center"}); } catch (e) {} }
  return !Object.keys(er).length; }
function admNote(host, text, bad){ const n = host.querySelector("[data-note]"); if (!n) return; n.textContent = text || ""; n.classList.toggle("bad", !!bad); }
function admMediaList(host, pid, pending){
  const box = host.querySelector("[data-media]"); if (!box) return; box.innerHTML = "";
  const tile = (blob, type, del) => { const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); admUrls.push(url); const d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "mi";
    d.innerHTML = (/^video/.test(type) ? `<video src="${url}" muted playsinline preload="metadata"></video>` : `<img src="${url}" alt="">`) + `<button type="button" aria-label="${T("حذف")}">✕</button>`; d.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", del); box.appendChild(d); };
  if (pending) { pending.forEach((f, k) => tile(f, f.type, () => { pending.splice(k, 1); admMediaList(host, pid, pending); })); return; }
  boDbAll(pid).then(rows => { box.innerHTML = ""; rows.forEach(r => tile(r.blob, r.type, () => { boDbDel(r.id); setTimeout(() => admMediaList(host, pid), 150); })); if (!rows.length) box.innerHTML = `<span class="adm-hint">${T("لا توجد وسائط مضافة لهذا المشروع.")}</span>`; });
}
function admBindForm(host, kind, row){
  const pending = [], pid = row ? row.i : -1;
  if (kind === "edit") admMediaList(host, pid); else admMediaList(host, pid, pending);
  host.querySelector('[data-a="media"]').addEventListener("change", e => { const fs = [...e.target.files].filter(f => /^(image|video)\//.test(f.type)); e.target.value = "";
    if (kind === "add") { fs.forEach(f => pending.push(f)); admMediaList(host, pid, pending); }
    else Promise.all(fs.map(f => boDbAdd({pid, type: f.type, name: f.name, blob: f}))).then(r => { admMediaList(host, pid); if (r.some(x => x == null)) admNote(host, T("تعذّر حفظ بعض الملفات في هذا المتصفح"), true); }); });
  const govS = host.querySelector('[data-f="gov"]'), llI = ["lat", "lon"].map(f => host.querySelector(`[data-f="${f}"]`));
  govS.addEventListener("change", () => { if (govS.value === "NAT") llI.forEach(i => { i.value = ""; }); });                  /* a national project has no point on the map */
  llI.forEach(i => i.addEventListener("input", () => { if (govS.value === "NAT" && i.value !== "") govS.value = ""; }));      /* typing a coordinate gives it one */
  host.querySelector('[data-a="pick"]').addEventListener("click", () => admStartPick(h => { host.querySelector('[data-f="lat"]').value = admR(zLat(h.z), 5); host.querySelector('[data-f="lon"]').value = admR(xLon(h.x), 5);
    govS.value = h.id && GN[h.id] ? h.id : ""; admNote(host, T("تم تحديد الموقع من الخريطة") + (h.id && GN[h.id] ? " · " + GN[h.id] : "") + T(". اضغط «حفظ» لتطبيقه.")); }));
  host.querySelector('[data-a="save"]').addEventListener("click", () => {
    const v = admFormRead(host); if (!admValidate(host, v)) { admNote(host, T("راجع الحقول المحددة بالأحمر"), true); return; }
    if (v.gov === "NAT") { v.lat = ""; v.lon = ""; }
    if (kind === "add" || (row && row.add)) {
      const rec = {i: kind === "add" ? Math.max(999, ...ADM.added.map(e => e.i)) + 1 : row.i, n: v.n, sc: v.sc, mn: v.mn, y: v.y, kd: v.kd, ct: v.ct, sm: v.sm, simT: v.simT, gov: v.gov};
      if (v.gov !== "NAT") { rec.lat = v.lat; rec.lon = v.lon; }
      if (kind === "add") ADM.added.push(rec); else ADM.added[ADM.added.findIndex(e => e.i === row.i)] = rec;
      const done = () => { if (!admSave()) admNote(host, T("تعذّر الحفظ في هذا المتصفح (التخزين المحلي غير متاح)"), true); };
      if (pending.length) Promise.all(pending.map(f => boDbAdd({pid: rec.i, type: f.type, name: f.name, blob: f}))).then(done, done); else done();
      return; }
    const base = admBase(ADM_SRC.find(p => p.i === row.i)), e = {};
    const llSame = v.lat === base.lat && v.lon === base.lon; if (v.gov === "" && llSame && base.gov !== "NAT") v.gov = base.gov;
    ["n", "sc", "mn", "y", "kd", "ct", "sm", "simT", "gov"].forEach(k => { if (v[k] !== base[k]) e[k] = v[k]; });
    if (!llSame && v.gov !== "NAT") { e.lat = v.lat; e.lon = v.lon; if (v.gov) e.gov = v.gov; else delete e.gov; }
    if (Object.keys(e).length) ADM.edits[row.i] = e; else delete ADM.edits[row.i];
    if (!admSave()) admNote(host, T("تعذّر الحفظ في هذا المتصفح (التخزين المحلي غير متاح)"), true);
  });
  const un = host.querySelector('[data-a="undo"]'); if (un) un.addEventListener("click", () => { delete ADM.edits[row.i]; if (!admSave(T("تمت استعادة قيم الملف المصدر — جارٍ إعادة التحميل لتطبيق التغييرات"))) admNote(host, T("تعذّر الحفظ في هذا المتصفح"), true); });
  const hd = host.querySelector('[data-a="hide"]'); if (hd) hd.addEventListener("click", () => { const k = ADM.hidden.map(Number).indexOf(row.i); if (k >= 0) ADM.hidden.splice(k, 1); else ADM.hidden.push(row.i); if (!admSave()) admNote(host, T("تعذّر الحفظ في هذا المتصفح"), true); });
  const dl = host.querySelector('[data-a="del"]'); if (dl) admConfirm(dl, T("تأكيد حذف المشروع نهائيًا"), () => { ADM.added = ADM.added.filter(e => e.i !== row.i); ADM.hidden = ADM.hidden.filter(n => +n !== row.i); delete ADM.models[row.i];
    boDbAll(row.i).then(rows => rows.forEach(r => boDbDel(r.id))); if (!admSave(T("تم حذف المشروع — جارٍ إعادة التحميل لتطبيق التغييرات"))) admNote(host, T("تعذّر الحفظ في هذا المتصفح"), true); });
}

/* ---- tab 1: projects ---- */
function admRenderList(){
  const q = admQ("#admQ").value.trim(), sec = admQ("#admSec").value, rows = admRows().filter(r => (sec === "" || (sec === "x" ? (r.ed || r.add || r.hid || r.mod) : r.sc === +sec)) && (!q || r.n.indexOf(q) >= 0));
  admQ("#admCnt").textContent = `${rows.length} ${T("مشروعًا")}`;
  admQ("#admL").innerHTML = rows.map(r => `<li data-i="${r.i}" tabindex="0" class="${r.i === admSel ? "on" : ""}${r.hid ? " hid" : ""}" style="--c:${SECC[r.sc]}"><i></i><span>${admE(r.n)}</span>${r.add ? T("<em>مُضاف</em>") : r.ed ? T("<em>معدَّل</em>") : ""}${r.hid ? T("<em>مخفي</em>") : ""}${r.mod ? T("<em>مجسم</em>") : ""}</li>`).join("") || `<li><span>${T("لا نتائج مطابقة")}</span></li>`;
}
function admOpenProject(i){ admSel = i; const row = admRows().find(r => r.i === i), host = admQ("#admF"); if (!row) return;
  admQ("#admL").querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li => li.classList.toggle("on", +li.dataset.i === i));
  host.innerHTML = admFormHTML(admCur(i), "edit", row); host.scrollTop = 0; admBindForm(host, "edit", row); }
admQ("#admSec").innerHTML = `<option value="">${T("كل القطاعات")}</option>${SECS.map((s, i) => `<option value="${i}">${admE(s.n)}</option>`).join("")}<option value="x">${T("المعدَّلة والمُضافة والمخفية فقط")}</option>`;
admQ("#admQ").addEventListener("input", admRenderList); admQ("#admSec").addEventListener("change", admRenderList);
admQ("#admL").addEventListener("click", e => { const li = e.target.closest("li[data-i]"); if (li) admOpenProject(+li.dataset.i); });
admQ("#admL").addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { const li = e.target.closest("li[data-i]"); if (li) { e.preventDefault(); admOpenProject(+li.dataset.i); } } });

/* ---- pick a coordinate on the map ---- */
function admStartPick(cb){ admPick = {cb, x: 0, y: 0, down: false}; admEl.hidden = true; admPickBar.hidden = false; admPickBar.firstElementChild.textContent = T("اضغط على الخريطة لتحديد موقع المشروع"); }
function admEndPick(){ admPick = null; admPickBar.hidden = true; admEl.hidden = false; }
admPickBar.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", admEndPick);
/* a tap anywhere on the map counts (the canvas or a label floating over it), a tap on an interface panel or button does not */
const admOnMap = e => { const t = e.target; if (t === canvas) return true; if (!t || !t.closest || t.closest("button,a,input,select,textarea,.adm-pick,.top,.rail,.tl,.tpad,.camhud,.dcard,.chooser,.notes,.bolb")) return false; const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); return e.clientX >= r.left && e.clientX <= r.right && e.clientY >= r.top && e.clientY <= r.bottom; };
addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { if (!admPick) return; admPick.down = admOnMap(e); admPick.x = e.clientX; admPick.y = e.clientY; }, true);
addEventListener("pointerup", e => { if (!admPick || !admPick.down) return; admPick.down = false; if (!admOnMap(e) || Math.hypot(e.clientX - admPick.x, e.clientY - admPick.y) > 8) return;   /* a drag still moves the map */
  e.stopPropagation(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), rc = new THREE.Raycaster(); rc.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * 2 - 1, -((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 2 + 1), camera);
  const h = groundHit(rc), la = h ? zLat(h.z) : NaN, lo = h ? xLon(h.x) : NaN;
  if (QS.has("test")) window.__admPickDbg = {hit: !!h, la, lo, tgt: e.target.tagName + "." + e.target.className};
  if (!h || !(la >= 21.5 && la <= 32 && lo >= 24.5 && lo <= 37.5)) { admPickBar.firstElementChild.textContent = T("هذه النقطة خارج حدود الخريطة، اضغط على موقع داخلها"); return; }
  const cb = admPick.cb; admEndPick(); cb(h); }, true);

/* models are read live by sim.js: refresh the open simulation if it shows this project */
function admLive(id){ try { if (sim.on && sim.pi >= 0 && P[sim.pi] && P[sim.pi].i === id) showSim(sim.pi); } catch (e) {} }
function admDraw2(cv, m){ const c = cv.getContext("2d"), W = cv.width, Hh = cv.height; c.clearRect(0, 0, W, Hh); if (!m) { c.fillStyle = "#6f8788"; c.font = "16px sans-serif"; c.textAlign = "center"; c.fillText("—", W / 2, Hh / 2); return; }
  const asp = m.asp || 1, k = Math.min((W - 40) / 1, (Hh - 40) / asp), ox = (W - k) / 2, oy = (Hh - k * asp) / 2;
  c.beginPath(); m.shapes.forEach(sh => sh.forEach(r => { for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i += 2) { const x = ox + r[i] * k, y = oy + r[i + 1] * k; if (i) c.lineTo(x, y); else c.moveTo(x, y); } c.closePath(); }));
  c.fillStyle = "rgba(70,215,207,.22)"; c.fill("evenodd"); c.strokeStyle = "#46d7cf"; c.lineWidth = 2; c.stroke();
  c.fillStyle = "#ffc98a"; m.shapes.forEach(sh => sh.forEach(r => { for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i += 2) c.fillRect(ox + r[i] * k - 2, oy + r[i + 1] * k - 2, 4, 4); })); }
function admDraw3(cv, m){
  const G = admMS; clearInterval(G.tm); G.tm = 0;
  try {
    if (!G.gl || G.gl.cv !== cv) { if (G.gl) { try { G.gl.r.dispose(); G.gl.r.forceContextLoss(); } catch (e) {} } const r = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas: cv, antialias: true, alpha: true}); r.setPixelRatio(1); r.setSize(cv.width, cv.height, false); r.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
      const sc = new THREE.Scene(), cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(36, cv.width / cv.height, 0.1, 100), grp = new THREE.Group(); sc.add(grp);
      const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(2.26, 2.3, 72).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0x46d7cf, transparent: true, opacity: .6, side: THREE.DoubleSide})); sc.add(ring);
      G.gl = {cv, r, sc, cam, grp, mat: mkSimMat(.55), line: new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: .9})}; }
    const g = G.gl; while (g.grp.children.length) { const o = g.grp.children.pop(); o.traverse(q => { if (q.geometry) q.geometry.dispose(); }); }
    if (m && m.w > 0 && m.h > 0) { const row = admRows().find(r => r.i === G.pid), col = new THREE.Color(SECC[row ? row.sc : 0]); g.mat.color.copy(col).multiplyScalar(.75); g.mat.emissive.copy(col).multiplyScalar(.2); g.line.color.copy(col).lerp(new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), .5);
      const geo = admModelGeo(m, 4.6 / admModelSize(m)); if (geo) { const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, g.mat); mesh.add(new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geo, 28), g.line)); g.grp.add(mesh); } }
    const draw = () => { if (admEl.hidden || admTab !== "model" || !cv.isConnected) { clearInterval(G.tm); G.tm = 0; return; } G.ang += 0.035; g.cam.position.set(Math.sin(G.ang) * 7.4, 3.6, Math.cos(G.ang) * 7.4); g.cam.lookAt(0, 1.1, 0); g.r.render(g.sc, g.cam); };
    draw(); if (g.grp.children.length) G.tm = setInterval(draw, 120);
  } catch (e) { const c = admQ("#admC3c"); if (c) c.textContent = T("المعاينة ثلاثية الأبعاد غير متاحة على هذا الجهاز"); }
}

/* ---- open / close / tabs ---- */
function admShowTab(k){ if (admTab === "ws" && k !== "ws") wsStop(); admTab = k; admEl.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", b.dataset.tab === k)); admEl.querySelectorAll("[data-p]").forEach(p => { p.hidden = p.dataset.p !== k; });
  admUrls.forEach(u => { try { URL.revokeObjectURL(u); } catch (e) {} }); admUrls = [];
  if (k === "proj") { admRenderList(); if (admSel >= 0) admOpenProject(admSel); } else if (k === "add") admRenderAdd(); else if (k === "model") admRenderModel(); else if (k === "ws") wsRender(); else if (k === "show") scRender(); else admRenderBak(); }
function admOpen(tab){ if (S.show) { try { stopShow(); } catch (e) {} } try { setPlaying(false); } catch (e) {} admEl.hidden = false; $("bAdmin") && $("bAdmin").setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"); admShowTab(tab || admTab); try { admQ("#admX").focus(); } catch (e) {} }
function admClose(){ wsStop(); admEl.hidden = true; clearInterval(admMS.tm); admMS.tm = 0; $("bAdmin") && $("bAdmin").setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false"); }
admEl.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => admShowTab(b.dataset.tab)));
admQ("#admX").addEventListener("click", admClose);
if ($("bAdmin")) $("bAdmin").addEventListener("click", () => admOpen());
/* while the page is open (or a point is being picked) the keyboard belongs to it: the map's shortcuts never fire */
addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (admPick) { if (e.key === "Escape") { e.stopPropagation(); admEndPick(); } return; } if (admEl.hidden) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); admClose(); return; } if (!admEl.contains(e.target)) e.stopPropagation(); }, true);
["keydown", "keyup", "wheel", "pointerdown", "pointermove", "pointerup", "click", "dblclick", "contextmenu", "touchstart", "touchmove", "touchend"].forEach(t => admEl.addEventListener(t, e => e.stopPropagation()));
if (QS.has("test")) window.__adm = {ADM, open: admOpen, close: admClose, tab: admShowTab, openProject: admOpenProject, trace: admTrace, rows: admRows, startPick: admStartPick, el: admEl, MS: admMS};


/* ================= model workshop inside Settings (ورشة المجسمات) =================
   The workshop page (every project with its model status, a turntable viewer and the dimension sheet) as a tab of the settings page, in the map's own look.
   Data: EGM_WS (holo3/ws/egm-reg.js, a snapshot of the workshop's registry taken by ws_sync.py) + window.EGM.models (the models themselves).
   Names, sectors, status and places come from the map's own project data, so they are the approved (and translated) ones.
   Thumbnails are drawn here on demand from the models, not shipped as pictures. */
const WS = (typeof EGM_WS !== "undefined" && window.EGM) ? (() => {
  const byId = new Map(P.map(p => [p.i, p]));
  const rows = EGM_WS.rows.map(([i, c, g2, pct, ok, wip, lat, lon, open, fix]) => ({i, c, g2, pct, ok, wip, lat, lon, open: open || [], fix: fix || "", p: byId.get(i)})).filter(r => r.p);

function wsRender(){
  if (!WS) return; wsCloseView(true);
  const host = admQ("#admW"), R = wsView(), ready = R.filter(wsReady), sites = R.filter(r => r.c !== "c"), all = Math.round(sites.reduce((a, r) => a + wsPct(r), 0) / Math.max(1, sites.length)), wip = R.filter(r => r.wip && !wsReady(r)).length;
  const secs = SECS.map((s, k) => ["s:" + k, s.n, R.filter(r => r.p.sc === k).length]).filter(q => q[2]);
  const items = WS.view === "l" ? [["all", T("الكل"), R.length], ...["h", "b", "s", "g"].map(k => ["k:" + k, T(LMK[k].n), R.filter(r => r.p.k === k).length]).filter(q => q[2]), ["m", T("على الخريطة"), R.filter(wsOnMap).length]] : [["all", T("الكل"), R.length], ["r", T("متاح للمعاينة"), ready.length], ["p", T("جارٍ البناء"), wip], ["m", T("على الخريطة"), R.filter(wsOnMap).length], ["a", T("مواقع فعلية مؤكدة"), R.filter(r => r.c === "a").length], ["l", T("حُدِّد موقعها"), R.filter(wsLoc).length], ["u", T("لم يُحدَّد موقعها"), R.filter(r => r.c === "b" && !wsLoc(r)).length], ["c", T("برامج قومية"), R.filter(r => r.c === "c").length]].concat(secs);
  host.innerHTML = `<div class="ws">
   <div class="ws-top"><div><h3 class="adm-ttl">${T("ورشة المجسمات")} <em>${T("آخر مزامنة مع الورشة:")} <span dir="ltr">${admE(EGM_WS.t || "")}</span></em></h3>
     <p class="adm-hint">${WS.view === "l" ? T("المعالم التراثية والمباني المشهورة والميادين والكباري المعروف مكانها. ليست من مشروعات الملف: لكل منها مجسم مبني بالكود من محيطه الحقيقي، ونسبة اكتمال صادقة، وتقف على الخريطة بحجمها الحقيقي.") : T("كل مشروعات الملف هنا بحالتها. المشروع الذي له منشأة يُبنى له مجسم بالكود من محيطه الحقيقي واتجاهه وأبعاده، ولكل مجسم نسبة اكتمال. المتاح يُفتح ويُدار باللمس، والباقي يظهر فور بنائه.")}</p></div>
    <div class="ws-tally" aria-label="${T("حالة المجسمات")}"><div class="o"><b>${all}%</b><span>${T("الإنجاز الكلي")}</span></div><div class="r"><b>${ready.length}</b><span>${T("متاح للمعاينة")}</span></div><div class="p"><b>${wip}</b><span>${T("جارٍ البناء")}</span></div><div><b>${sites.length}</b><span>${(WS.view === "l" ? T("معلم مبني") : T("مشروع له منشأة"))}</span></div></div></div>
   <div class="ws-prog" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:${all}%"></i></div>
   <div class="ws-meta"><span>${T("الدفعة الحالية:")} <b>${admE(EGM_WS.batch || "")}</b></span></div>
   ${wsSwitch()}
   <div class="ws-filters" id="wsF" role="group" aria-label="${T("تصفية المجسمات")}">${items.map(([k, n, c]) => `<button type="button" data-f="${k}" aria-pressed="${WS.filt === k}">${admE(n)}<b>${c}</b></button>`).join("")}</div>
   <div class="ws-grid" id="wsG"></div>
   <div class="ws-foot"><div><b>${T("طريقة العمل:")}</b> ${T("المحيط والاتجاه من بيانات OpenStreetMap عبر OpenFreeMap (نفس مصدر الخريطة)، والارتفاعات والأبعاد من مصادر منشورة. كل رقم في بطاقة المجسم عليه علامة «مؤكد» أو «تقديري».")}</div>
    <div><b>${T("المشروعات تحت التنفيذ:")}</b> ${T("الجزء غير المكتمل يظهر كهيكل مفتوح حوله رافعات، حسب قاعدة الخريطة.")}</div>
    <div><b>${T("على الخريطة:")}</b> ${T("كل مجسم جاهز هنا يقف على الخريطة نفسها بالحجم الحقيقي في موقعه (ما عدا ما لم يُبنَ بعد أو لم يثبت موقعه)، ويظهر أيضًا في محاكاة المشروع بوضع الطبقات. الورشة هي مصدر مجسمات الخريطة.")}</div>
    <div><b>${T("النطاق:")}</b> ${admE(EGM_WS.scope || "")}</div></div></div>`;
  host.querySelector("#wsF").addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest("button[data-f]"); if (!b) return; WS.filt = b.dataset.f; host.querySelectorAll("#wsF button").forEach(q => q.setAttribute("aria-pressed", q === b)); wsGrid(); });
  const swv = host.querySelector("#wsV"); if (swv) swv.addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest("button[data-v]"); if (!b || b.dataset.v === WS.view) return; WS.view = b.dataset.v; WS.filt = "all"; wsRender(); });
  host.querySelector("#wsG").addEventListener("click", e => { const c = e.target.closest("button.ws-card"); if (c) wsOpenView(+c.dataset.id); });
  wsGrid();
}
function wsGrid(){
  const host = admQ("#wsG"), f = WS.filt; if (!host) return;
  const list = wsView().filter(r => f === "all" || (f === "r" && wsReady(r)) || (f === "p" && r.wip && !wsReady(r)) || (f === "m" && wsOnMap(r)) || f === r.c || (f === "l" && wsLoc(r)) || (f === "u" && r.c === "b" && !wsLoc(r)) || f === "s:" + r.p.sc || f === "k:" + r.p.k)
    .sort((a, b) => (wsPct(b) - wsPct(a)) || (a.c < b.c ? -1 : a.c > b.c ? 1 : 0) || (a.i - b.i));
  host.innerHTML = list.length ? list.map(r => { const rd = wsReady(r), tag = rd ? "button" : "div", st = wsStage(r), pc = wsPct(r), th = WS.thumbs.get(r.i);
    return `<${tag} class="ws-card" ${rd ? `type="button" data-id="${r.i}" aria-label="${T("افتح مجسم")} ${admE(wsN(r))}"` : ""}>
      <div class="ws-im"${rd && !th ? ` data-tid="${r.i}"` : ""}>${rd ? `<div class="ph">${WS_PH}</div><img data-th="${r.i}" alt="" ${th ? `src="${th}"` : "hidden"}>` : `<div class="ph">${WS_PH}</div>`}<span class="ws-pill ${st[0]}">${st[1]}</span>${rd && wsOnMap(r) ? `<span class="ws-map">${T("على الخريطة")}</span>` : ""}<span class="ws-num">#${r.i}</span></div>
      <div class="ws-tx"><h4>${admE(wsN(r))}</h4><div class="ws-pc"><div class="tr"><i style="width:${pc}%"></i></div><b>${pc}%</b><small>${wsStageTxt(r)}</small></div>
       <div class="ws-sub" style="--c:${wsSC(r)}"><i>${admE(wsSN(r))}</i><span>${admE(wsPlace(r))}</span><span>${admE(r.p.lm ? "" : STATUS_AR[r.p.st] || "")}</span></div></div></${tag}>`; }).join("") : `<div class="ws-empty">${T("لا توجد مجسمات في هذا التصنيف الآن.")}</div>`;
  /* thumbnails: drawn from the model the first time its card comes into view */
  if (WS.io) WS.io.disconnect(); const todo = [...host.querySelectorAll(".ws-im[data-tid]")];      /* the picture itself is hidden until drawn, so its frame is what is watched */
  if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "function") { WS.io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { WS.io.unobserve(e.target); wsThumbAsk(+e.target.dataset.tid); } }), {root: admQ("#admW"), rootMargin: "200px"}); todo.forEach(im => WS.io.observe(im)); }
  else todo.slice(0, 12).forEach(im => wsThumbAsk(+im.dataset.tid));
  setTimeout(wsSpinInit, 0);
}

/* ---- drawing a model: one stage for the thumbnails and the viewer, coloured from the map's panel palette ---- */
function wsCss(name){ const v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim().split(",").map(Number); return v.length === 3 && v.every(n => n === n) ? new THREE.Color(v[0] / 255, v[1] / 255, v[2] / 255) : new THREE.Color(0x0b1a3c); }
function wsScene(id){
  const b = window.EGM.build(id), sc = new THREE.Scene(); sc.add(b.group); const st = window.EGM.stage(sc, b.box), own = [];
  sc.children.forEach(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const g = o.geometry && o.geometry.type; if (g === "CylinderGeometry") { o.material.color.copy(wsCss("--pl")).convertSRGBToLinear(); own.push(o.material); } else if (g === "TorusGeometry") { o.material.color.set(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--teal").trim() || "#46d7cf"); own.push(o.material); } });
  return {sc, st, dispose(){ sc.traverse(o => { if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); if (o.isLight && o.shadow && o.shadow.map) o.shadow.map.dispose(); }); own.forEach(t => t.dispose()); }};
}
function wsThumbAsk(id){ if (WS.thumbs.has(id) || WS.q.includes(id)) return; WS.q.push(id); wsThumbRun(); }
function wsThumbRun(){
  if (WS.busy || !WS.q.length) return; if (admEl.hidden || admTab !== "ws") { WS.q.length = 0; return; }
  WS.busy = true; const id = WS.q.shift();
  setTimeout(() => { let url = "";
    try {
      if (!WS.tr) { const cv = document.createElement("canvas"), r = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas: cv, antialias: true, alpha: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true}); window.EGM.setupRenderer(r); r.setClearColor(0x000000, 0); r.setPixelRatio(1); r.setSize(512, 288, false); WS.tr = {r, cv, cam: new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 16 / 9, 1, 1e5)}; }
      const s = wsScene(id); window.EGM.frameCam(WS.tr.cam, s.st, 0.65, 0.5, 1); WS.tr.r.render(s.sc, WS.tr.cam); s.dispose();
      /* a JPEG has no transparency: paint the panel colour under the picture */
      { const c2 = document.createElement("canvas"); c2.width = 512; c2.height = 288; const x = c2.getContext("2d"), g = x.createRadialGradient(256, 122, 10, 256, 122, 330), a = wsCss("--ph"), d = wsCss("--pd"); g.addColorStop(0, "#" + a.getHexString()); g.addColorStop(1, "#" + d.getHexString()); x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 288); x.drawImage(WS.tr.cv, 0, 0); url = c2.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.86); }
    } catch (e) { url = ""; }
    if (url) { WS.thumbs.set(id, url); admEl.querySelectorAll(`img[data-th="${id}"]`).forEach(im => { im.src = url; im.hidden = false; }); }
    WS.busy = false; wsThumbRun(); }, 24);
}

  /* own pointer handling: the settings page keeps pointer events to itself, so the stock orbit controls (which listen on the document) would never see a drag */
  cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { try { cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (x) {} V.pts.set(e.pointerId, [e.clientX, e.clientY]); stopAuto(); if (V.pts.size === 2) { const a = [...V.pts.values()]; V.pd = Math.hypot(a[0][0] - a[1][0], a[0][1] - a[1][1]); } });
  cv.addEventListener("pointermove", e => { const p = V.pts.get(e.pointerId); if (!p) return; const dx = e.clientX - p[0], dy = e.clientY - p[1]; p[0] = e.clientX; p[1] = e.clientY;
    if (V.pts.size === 1) { V.az -= dx * 0.006; V.el += dy * 0.005; } else if (V.pts.size === 2) { const a = [...V.pts.values()], d = Math.hypot(a[0][0] - a[1][0], a[0][1] - a[1][1]); if (V.pd > 0 && d > 0) V.k *= V.pd / d; V.pd = d; } });
  const up = e => { V.pts.delete(e.pointerId); V.pd = 0; }; cv.addEventListener("pointerup", up); cv.addEventListener("pointercancel", up);
  cv.addEventListener("wheel", e => { e.preventDefault(); stopAuto(); V.k *= Math.exp(e.deltaY * 0.0012); }, {passive: false});
  const act = {l: () => { V.az -= 0.05; }, r: () => { V.az += 0.05; }, u: () => { V.el += 0.03; }, d: () => { V.el -= 0.03; }, i: () => { V.k *= 0.96; }, o: () => { V.k *= 1.04; }};

    if (act[a]) { let tm = 0; const stop = () => { clearInterval(tm); tm = 0; }; b.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { e.preventDefault(); stopAuto(); act[a](); stop(); tm = setInterval(act[a], 40); }); ["pointerup", "pointerleave", "pointercancel"].forEach(ev => b.addEventListener(ev, stop)); b.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); stopAuto(); act[a](); } }); V.stops = (V.stops || []).concat(stop); }

}
function wsGoLm(id){ const m = MODELS3D.find(q => q.key === "wsm" + id); if (!m) return; tmpS.setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(controls.target)); const v = model3dLow(m, tmpS.theta + .12); flyTo({p: v.p, t: v.t}, 2400); }
function wsCloseView(quiet){
  if (!WS) return; const V = WS.v; WS.v = null; const host = admQ("#admWV"), list = admQ("#admW");
  if (V) { cancelAnimationFrame(V.raf); (V.stops || []).forEach(f => f()); if (V.ro) V.ro.disconnect(); if (V.s) V.s.dispose(); if (V.r) { try { V.r.dispose(); V.r.forceContextLoss(); } catch (e) {} } }
  if (host) { host.hidden = true; host.innerHTML = ""; } if (list) list.hidden = false;
  if (V && !quiet) wsThumbRun();
}
/* leaving the tab or the settings page: the viewer and the thumbnail renderer give their graphics contexts back */
function wsStop(){ if (!WS) return; wsSpinStop(); wsCloseView(true); WS.q.length = 0; if (WS.io) { WS.io.disconnect(); WS.io = null; } if (WS.tr) { try { WS.tr.r.dispose(); WS.tr.r.forceContextLoss(); } catch (e) {} WS.tr = null; } }
if (QS.has("test")) window.__ws = {WS, render: wsRender, open: wsOpenView, close: wsCloseView, stop: wsStop};
/* ---- turntable thumbnails inside the settings workshop tab: cards in view turn slowly (one shared renderer, max 9 live at once) ---- */
const WSPIN = {r: null, cv: null, items: new Map(), io: null, raf: 0, t0: performance.now(), last: 0, max: matchMedia("(max-width:700px)").matches ? 3 : 6, off: matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)").matches};
function wsSpinInit(){
  if (WSPIN.off || !window.EGM || typeof WS === "undefined" || !WS) return;
  if (!WSPIN.r) { try { WSPIN.cv = document.createElement("canvas"); WSPIN.r = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas: WSPIN.cv, antialias: true, alpha: true}); window.EGM.setupRenderer(WSPIN.r); WSPIN.r.setClearColor(0x000000, 0); WSPIN.r.setPixelRatio(1); WSPIN.r.setSize(512, 288, false); } catch (e) { WSPIN.off = true; return; } }
  wsSpinClear();
  const root = admQ("#admW"); if (!root || typeof IntersectionObserver !== "function") return;
  WSPIN.io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(en => { const im = en.target; if (en.isIntersecting) { if (!WSPIN.items.has(im)) WSPIN.items.set(im, {id: +im.closest(".ws-card").dataset.id, s: null, cv: null}); } else wsSpinDrop(im); }), {root, rootMargin: "60px"});
  root.querySelectorAll("button.ws-card .ws-im").forEach(im => WSPIN.io.observe(im));
  if (!WSPIN.raf) WSPIN.raf = requestAnimationFrame(wsSpinLoop);
}
function wsSpinDrop(im){ const q = WSPIN.items.get(im); if (!q) return; if (q.cv) q.cv.remove(); if (q.s) q.s.dispose(); WSPIN.items.delete(im); }
function wsSpinClear(){ if (WSPIN.io) { WSPIN.io.disconnect(); WSPIN.io = null; } [...WSPIN.items.keys()].forEach(wsSpinDrop); }
function wsSpinStop(){ wsSpinClear(); if (WSPIN.raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(WSPIN.raf); WSPIN.raf = 0; } }
function wsSpinLoop(now){
  WSPIN.raf = requestAnimationFrame(wsSpinLoop);
  if (document.hidden || admEl.hidden || admTab !== "ws" || !WS || WS.v || now - WSPIN.last < 60) return; WSPIN.last = now;
  const t = (now - WSPIN.t0) / 1000; let n = 0;
  for (const [im, q] of WSPIN.items) {
    if (++n > WSPIN.max) { if (q.cv) q.cv.style.display = "none"; continue; }
    try {
      if (!q.s) { q.s = wsScene(q.id); q.cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 16 / 9, 1, 1e5); }
      if (!q.cv) { q.cv = document.createElement("canvas"); q.cv.width = 512; q.cv.height = 288; q.cv.style.cssText = "position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none"; const pill = im.querySelector(".ws-pill"); im.insertBefore(q.cv, pill || null); }
      q.cv.style.display = "";
      window.EGM.frameCam(q.cam, q.s.st, 0.65 + t * 0.42 + q.id, 0.5, 1.16); WSPIN.r.render(q.s.sc, q.cam);
      const c2 = q.cv.getContext("2d"), g = c2.createRadialGradient(256, 122, 10, 256, 122, 330), a = wsCss("--ph"), d = wsCss("--pd"); g.addColorStop(0, "#" + a.getHexString()); g.addColorStop(1, "#" + d.getHexString()); c2.fillStyle = g; c2.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 288); c2.drawImage(WSPIN.cv, 0, 0);
    } catch (e) { wsSpinDrop(im); }
  }
}

/* ================= show scenario (settings tab «سيناريو العرض») =================
   The presenter builds the show himself: which scenes, sectors, places (governorates, landmarks) and projects, in which order, and how long each one holds.
   Kept in this browser (localStorage "eg-show-v1"); buildShow() in d_loop.js plays it instead of the automatic scenario while it is switched on.
   Projects are flown to as one continuous drone line: consecutive project steps make one flight, each stop holding for its own seconds.
   Only projects that stand on the map with a confirmed place and a real model can be chosen (the confirmed-data rule). */
const SC_KEY = "eg-show-v1", SC_DEF = {intro: 13, density: 8, layers: 10, sec: 10, proj: 10, gov: 8, lm: 9, tally: 13}, SC_RATES = [0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4], SC_FLY = 6;
const scLm = () => (typeof EGM_LM !== "undefined" ? EGM_LM : []).filter(r => MODELS3D.some(q => q.key === "wsm" + r[0]));
function scClean(j){
  if (!j || typeof j !== "object" || !Array.isArray(j.steps)) return null;
  const steps = j.steps.map(s => { if (!s || typeof s !== "object" || !(s.t in SC_DEF)) return null; const o = {t: s.t, d: clamp(Math.round(+s.d || SC_DEF[s.t]), 3, 120)};
    if (s.t === "proj") { o.i = +s.i; if (!P.some(p => p.i === o.i)) return null; } else if (s.t === "gov") { o.g = String(s.g); if (!GN[o.g]) return null; }
    else if (s.t === "lm") { o.i = +s.i; if (!(o.i > 0)) return null; } else if (s.t === "sec") { o.s = +s.s; if (!SECS[o.s]) return null; }
    return o; }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 200);
  return {v: 1, on: !!j.on, rate: SC_RATES.includes(+j.rate) ? +j.rate : 1, steps};
}
let SHOWCFG = {v: 1, on: false, rate: 1, steps: []};
try { const c = scClean(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SC_KEY) || "null")); if (c) SHOWCFG = c; } catch (e) {}
function showCfgActive(){ return SHOWCFG.on && SHOWCFG.steps.length ? SHOWCFG : null; }
function scStore(){ let ok = true; try { localStorage.setItem(SC_KEY, JSON.stringify(SHOWCFG)); } catch (e) { ok = false; } const n = admQ("#scSaved"); if (n) { n.textContent = ok ? T("محفوظ على هذا الجهاز") : T("تعذّر الحفظ في هذا المتصفح"); n.classList.toggle("bad", !ok); } return ok; }

const SC_TYPE = {intro: [T("مشهد"), "#ffc98a"], density: [T("مشهد"), "#ffc98a"], layers: [T("مشهد"), "#ffc98a"], tally: [T("مشهد"), "#ffc98a"], sec: [T("قطاع"), null], proj: [T("مشروع"), null], gov: [T("محافظة"), "#46d7cf"], lm: [T("مَعلم"), "#b388ff"]};
const SC_SCENE = {intro: T("رحلة السنين: من 2014 إلى اليوم"), density: T("أين تتركّز المشروعات (الكثافة)"), layers: T("القطاعات الثمانية (الطبقات)"), tally: T("الحصيلة حتى 2030")};
function scName(s){
  if (s.t === "proj") { const p = P.find(q => q.i === s.i); return p ? p.n : "—"; }
  if (s.t === "gov") return GN[s.g] || "—";
  if (s.t === "sec") return SECS[s.s].n;
  if (s.t === "lm") { const r = scLm().find(q => q[0] === s.i); return r ? (EN ? (r[3] || r[2]) : r[2]) : "—"; }
  return SC_SCENE[s.t];
}
function scColor(s){ if (s.t === "proj") { const p = P.find(q => q.i === s.i); return p ? SECC[p.sc] : "#fff"; } if (s.t === "sec") return SECC[s.s]; return SC_TYPE[s.t][1]; }
const scTime = sec => { const m = Math.floor(sec / 60), s = Math.round(sec % 60); return m + ":" + String(s).padStart(2, "0"); };
function scTotal(){ return SHOWCFG.steps.reduce((a, s) => a + s.d + (s.t === "proj" ? SC_FLY : 0), 0); }
/* the automatic scenario written out as steps, so it can be edited instead of started from nothing */
function scAuto(){
  const st = [{t: "intro", d: SC_DEF.intro}, {t: "density", d: SC_DEF.density}, {t: "layers", d: SC_DEF.layers}];
  SECS.forEach((sec, s) => { st.push({t: "sec", s, d: SC_DEF.sec}); let pts = []; try { pts = tourPoints(s, 3); } catch (e) {} pts.forEach(q => st.push({t: "proj", i: P[q.pi].i, d: SC_DEF.proj})); });
  st.push({t: "tally", d: SC_DEF.tally}); return st;
}

const SCU = {lib: "proj", q: "", sec: -1};
function scLibRows(){
  const q = SCU.q.trim().toLowerCase(), hit = n => !q || String(n).toLowerCase().includes(q);
  if (SCU.lib === "scene") return [...["intro", "density", "layers"].map(t => ({st: {t}, n: SC_SCENE[t], c: "#ffc98a"})), ...SECS.map((s, i) => ({st: {t: "sec", s: i}, n: T("شاشة قطاع ") + s.n, c: SECC[i]})), {st: {t: "tally"}, n: SC_SCENE.tally, c: "#ffc98a"}].filter(r => hit(r.n));
  if (SCU.lib === "gov") return Object.keys(govs).filter(g => GN[g]).map(g => ({st: {t: "gov", g}, n: GN[g], c: "#46d7cf", e: (P.filter(p => p.g.includes(g)).length) + " " + T("مشروعًا")})).filter(r => hit(r.n)).sort((a, b) => a.n.localeCompare(b.n, EN ? "en" : "ar"));
  if (SCU.lib === "lm") return scLm().map(r => ({st: {t: "lm", i: r[0]}, n: EN ? (r[3] || r[2]) : r[2], c: "#b388ff"})).filter(r => hit(r.n));
  return P.filter(p => pvMap(p) && pvHas(p) && (SCU.sec < 0 || p.sc === SCU.sec) && hit(p.n)).map(p => ({st: {t: "proj", i: p.i}, n: p.n, c: SECC[p.sc], e: p.g[0] ? GN[p.g[0]] : ""}));
}
const scSame = (a, b) => a.t === b.t && a.i === b.i && a.g === b.g && a.s === b.s;
function scDrawLib(){
  const host = admQ("#scL"), rows = scLibRows(), ul = host.querySelector("#scLib");
  host.querySelectorAll("#scSeg button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.l === SCU.lib)));
  host.querySelector("#scSec").hidden = SCU.lib !== "proj";
  host.querySelector("#scCnt").textContent = SCU.lib === "proj" ? rows.length + " " + T("مشروعًا له موقع ومجسم مؤكدان على الخريطة · اضغط للإضافة") : rows.length + " · " + T("اضغط للإضافة إلى آخر السيناريو");
  ul.innerHTML = rows.map((r, k) => `<li data-k="${k}" style="--c:${r.c}" class="${SHOWCFG.steps.some(s => scSame(s, r.st)) ? "in" : ""}"><span>${esc(r.n)}</span>${r.e ? `<em>${esc(r.e)}</em>` : ""}<b aria-hidden="true">${SHOWCFG.steps.some(s => scSame(s, r.st)) ? "✓" : "+"}</b></li>`).join("") || `<li><span>${T("لا نتائج")}</span></li>`;
  ul.querySelectorAll("li[data-k]").forEach(li => li.addEventListener("click", () => { const r = rows[+li.dataset.k]; SHOWCFG.steps.push(Object.assign({d: SC_DEF[r.st.t]}, r.st)); scStore(); scDrawSteps(true); scDrawLib(); }));
}
function scDrawSteps(toEnd){
  const host = admQ("#scM"), ol = host.querySelector("#scSteps"), st = SHOWCFG.steps;
  host.querySelector("#scOn").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(SHOWCFG.on)); host.querySelector("#scOn").textContent = SHOWCFG.on ? T("السيناريو المخصص: يعمل") : T("السيناريو المخصص: متوقف (العرض آلي)");
  host.querySelectorAll("#scRate button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(+b.dataset.r === SHOWCFG.rate)));
  host.querySelector("#scTot").textContent = scTime(scTotal() / SHOWCFG.rate); host.querySelector("#scN").textContent = st.length + " " + T("خطوة");
  ol.innerHTML = st.map((s, n) => { const fl = s.t === "proj" && n > 0 && st[n - 1].t === "proj";
    return `<li data-n="${n}" style="--c:${scColor(s)}" class="${fl ? "fl" : ""}"><span class="n">${n + 1}</span><span class="tp">${SC_TYPE[s.t][0]}</span><span class="nm">${esc(scName(s))}</span>
      <span class="du"><button type="button" data-a="dm" aria-label="${T("مدة أقل")}">−</button><output>${s.d} ${T("ث")}</output><button type="button" data-a="dp" aria-label="${T("مدة أطول")}">+</button></span>
      <span class="mv"><button type="button" data-a="up" aria-label="${T("تحريك لأعلى")}"${n ? "" : " disabled"}>▲</button><button type="button" data-a="dn" aria-label="${T("تحريك لأسفل")}"${n < st.length - 1 ? "" : " disabled"}>▼</button><button type="button" data-a="rm" aria-label="${T("حذف الخطوة")}">✕</button></span></li>`; }).join("");
  host.querySelector("#scEmpty").hidden = st.length > 0;
  const io = host.querySelector("#scIO"); if (io && document.activeElement !== io) io.value = JSON.stringify(SHOWCFG);
  if (toEnd) host.scrollTop = host.scrollHeight;
}

      <input type="search" id="scQ" placeholder="${T("بحث بالاسم")}" aria-label="${T("بحث بالاسم")}" autocomplete="off"><select id="scSec" aria-label="${T("تصفية بالقطاع")}"><option value="-1">${T("كل القطاعات")}</option>${SECS.map((s, i) => `<option value="${i}">${s.n}</option>`).join("")}</select>
      <div class="adm-hint" id="scCnt"></div><ul class="adm-scroll sc-lib" id="scLib"></ul>`;

    L.querySelector("#scQ").addEventListener("input", e => { SCU.q = e.target.value; scDrawLib(); });
