      <p class="adm-hint">${T("اختر المشاهد والأماكن والمشروعات من القائمة، ورتّبها بالأسهم، وحدّد مدة كل خطوة بالثواني. المشروعات المتتالية تُعرض كرحلة طيران واحدة متصلة. يُحفظ السيناريو على هذا الجهاز فقط.")}</p>
      <div class="sc-bar"><button type="button" class="sc-on" id="scOn" aria-pressed="false"></button>
        <div><div class="adm-lbl">${T("سرعة العرض")}</div><div class="sc-seg" id="scRate" role="group">${SC_RATES.map(r => `<button type="button" data-r="${r}" aria-pressed="false">${r}×</button>`).join("")}</div></div>
        <div class="sc-tot"><b id="scTot">0:00</b><span id="scN"></span></div></div>
      <div class="adm-row"><button type="button" id="scTry">${T("جرّب العرض الآن")}</button><button type="button" id="scFill">${T("ابدأ من السيناريو الآلي")}</button><button type="button" id="scClr">${T("مسح كل الخطوات")}</button></div>
      <div class="sc-empty" id="scEmpty">${T("السيناريو فارغ. أضف خطوات من القائمة، أو اضغط «ابدأ من السيناريو الآلي» ثم عدّل عليه.")}</div>
      <ol class="sc-steps" id="scSteps"></ol>
      <details class="sc-io"><summary class="adm-hint">${T("نقل السيناريو إلى جهاز آخر (نسخ ولصق)")}</summary><textarea id="scIO" spellcheck="false" aria-label="${T("نص السيناريو")}"></textarea>
        <div class="adm-row"><button type="button" id="scCopy">${T("نسخ")}</button><button type="button" id="scApply">${T("تطبيق النص الملصوق")}</button></div><div class="adm-note" data-note></div></details>`;
    M.querySelector("#scOn").addEventListener("click", () => { SHOWCFG.on = !SHOWCFG.on; scStore(); scDrawSteps(); });
    M.querySelectorAll("#scRate button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => { SHOWCFG.rate = +b.dataset.r; scStore(); scDrawSteps(); }));
    M.querySelector("#scTry").addEventListener("click", () => { if (!SHOWCFG.steps.length) return; SHOWCFG.on = true; scStore(); admClose(); startShow(); });
    admConfirm(M.querySelector("#scFill"), T("تأكيد: استبدال الخطوات الحالية"), () => { SHOWCFG.steps = scAuto(); scStore(); scDrawSteps(); scDrawLib(); });
    admConfirm(M.querySelector("#scClr"), T("تأكيد: مسح كل الخطوات"), () => { SHOWCFG.steps = []; scStore(); scDrawSteps(); scDrawLib(); });
    M.querySelector("#scSteps").addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest("button[data-a]"); if (!b) return; const n = +b.closest("li").dataset.n, st = SHOWCFG.steps, a = b.dataset.a, top = M.scrollTop;
      if (a === "dm") st[n].d = clamp(st[n].d - 1, 3, 120); else if (a === "dp") st[n].d = clamp(st[n].d + 1, 3, 120);
      else if (a === "up" && n > 0) st.splice(n - 1, 0, st.splice(n, 1)[0]); else if (a === "dn" && n < st.length - 1) st.splice(n + 1, 0, st.splice(n, 1)[0]); else if (a === "rm") st.splice(n, 1);
      scStore(); scDrawSteps(); M.scrollTop = top; if (a === "rm") scDrawLib(); });
    M.querySelector("#scCopy").addEventListener("click", () => { const io = M.querySelector("#scIO"); io.value = JSON.stringify(SHOWCFG); io.select(); let ok = false; try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (e) {} try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(io.value).catch(() => {}); ok = true; } catch (e) {} admNote(M.querySelector(".sc-io"), ok ? T("تم النسخ") : T("حدِّد النص وانسخه يدويًا")); });
    M.querySelector("#scApply").addEventListener("click", () => { let c = null; try { c = scClean(JSON.parse(M.querySelector("#scIO").value)); } catch (e) {} if (!c) { admNote(M.querySelector(".sc-io"), T("النص غير صالح"), true); return; } SHOWCFG = c; scStore(); scDrawSteps(); scDrawLib(); admNote(M.querySelector(".sc-io"), T("تم تطبيق السيناريو")); });
  }
  scDrawLib(); scDrawSteps();
}

/* text is compared in a folded form: no diacritics, one alef, ة as ه, ى as ي, Latin digits, lower case, punctuation as a space. map[i] = index in the original of folded character i */
function srFold(s){
  let out = "", map = []; s = String(s || "");
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { let c = s[i]; const k = c.charCodeAt(0);
    if ((k >= 0x64B && k <= 0x652) || k === 0x670 || k === 0x640) continue;
    if (c === "أ" || c === "إ" || c === "آ" || c === "ٱ") c = "ا"; else if (c === "ى" || c === "ئ") c = "ي"; else if (c === "ة") c = "ه"; else if (c === "ؤ") c = "و";
    else if (k >= 0x660 && k <= 0x669) c = String(k - 0x660); else if (k >= 0x6F0 && k <= 0x6F9) c = String(k - 0x6F0); else c = c.toLowerCase();
    if (!/[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(c)) { if (!out.length || out[out.length - 1] === " ") continue; c = " "; }
    out += c; map.push(i); }
  if (out.endsWith(" ")) { out = out.slice(0, -1); map.pop(); }
  return {t: out, map};
}
function srBuildIndex(){
  const tr = (PJEN && PJEN.p) || {};
  SR.idx = P.map((p, pi) => { const ar = p.n0 || p.n, en = EN ? p.n : (tr[p.i] && tr[p.i].n) || "";
    const place = [p.lc || "", (p.g || []).map(g => GN[g] || "").join(" "), EN ? "" : (p.g || []).map(g => GN_EN[g] || "").join(" "), p.mn || "", SECS[p.sc].n, (() => { try { return yearLabel(p); } catch (e) { return ""; } })()].join(" ");      /* the year shown on the result can be typed too */
    return {pi, a: srFold(ar).t, e: srFold(en).t, x: srFold(place).t}; });
}
function srFind(q){
  const f = srFold(q).t; if (!f) return {list: [], total: 0}; if (!SR.idx) srBuildIndex();
  const tk = f.split(" "), hits = [];
  for (const d of SR.idx) { let sc = 0, ok = true, inName = 0;
    for (const t of tk) { const na = d.a.indexOf(t), ne = d.e.indexOf(t);
      if (na >= 0 || ne >= 0) { inName++; const wp = (na === 0 || d.a[na - 1] === " ") || (ne === 0 || (ne > 0 && d.e[ne - 1] === " ")); sc += wp ? 14 : 8; }
      else if (d.x.indexOf(t) >= 0) sc += 3; else { ok = false; break; } }
    if (!ok) continue;
    if (d.a.startsWith(f) || d.e.startsWith(f)) sc += 100; else if ((" " + d.a).includes(" " + f) || (" " + d.e).includes(" " + f)) sc += 60; else if (d.a.includes(f) || d.e.includes(f)) sc += 40; else if (inName === tk.length) sc += 20;
    hits.push({pi: d.pi, sc: sc - d.a.length * 0.02}); }
  hits.sort((p, q) => q.sc - p.sc || p.pi - q.pi);
  return {list: hits.slice(0, 6).map(h => h.pi), total: hits.length};
}
/* the name as shown, with the typed part lit */
function srMark(name, q){
  const fq = srFold(q).t, n = srFold(name); let at = -1, len = 0;
  for (const t of [fq, ...fq.split(" ")]) { if (!t) continue; const i = n.t.indexOf(t); if (i >= 0) { at = i; len = t.length; break; } }
  if (at < 0) return esc(name);
  const a = n.map[at], b = n.map[at + len - 1] + 1;
  return esc(name.slice(0, a)) + "<mark>" + esc(name.slice(a, b)) + "</mark>" + esc(name.slice(b));
}

function srDraw(){
  const tx = SR.el.querySelector("#srTx"), r = SR.el.querySelector("#srR"), n = SR.el.querySelector("#srN"), go = SR.el.querySelector("#srGo");
  tx.innerHTML = SR.q ? `<b>${esc(SR.q)}</b><i></i>` : `<i></i><em>${T("اكتب اسم المشروع أو المكان أو الجهة")}</em>`;
  const f = srFind(SR.q); SR.res = f.list.slice(0, innerWidth <= 900 ? 3 : 5); SR.total = f.total; if (SR.sel >= SR.res.length) SR.sel = 0;
  n.textContent = SR.q.trim() ? (f.total ? f.total + " " + T("نتيجة") : "") : P.length + " " + T("مشروعًا");
  if (go) go.disabled = !SR.res.length;
  if (!SR.q.trim()) { r.innerHTML = `<div class="sr-hint">${T("الاقتراحات تظهر هنا وأنت تكتب")}</div>`; return; }
  if (!SR.res.length) { r.innerHTML = `<div class="sr-hint">${T("لا يوجد مشروع بهذا الاسم. جرّب كلمة أقصر أو اسم المحافظة.")}</div>`; return; }
  r.innerHTML = SR.res.map((pi, i) => { const p = P[pi], pl = p.lc || (p.g && p.g[0] ? GN[p.g[0]] : "") || "";
    return `<button type="button" class="sr-it${i === SR.sel ? " on" : ""}" data-pi="${pi}" style="--c:${SECC[p.sc]};--i:${i}" tabindex="-1"><i></i><b>${srMark(p.n, SR.q)}</b><small>${esc(SECS[p.sc].n)}${pl ? " · " + esc(pl) : ""} · ${esc(yearLabel(p))}</small></button>`; }).join("");
}
function srKey(k){
  act();
  if (k === "lang") { SR.lay = SR.lay === "ar" ? "en" : "ar"; srDrawKeys(); return; }
  if (k === "bs") SR.q = SR.q.slice(0, -1); else if (k === "clr") SR.q = ""; else if (k === "go") { if (SR.res.length) srPick(SR.res[SR.sel] != null ? SR.res[SR.sel] : SR.res[0]); return; }
  else if (k.startsWith("c:")) { const c = k.slice(2); if (SR.q.length < 60 && !(c === " " && (!SR.q || SR.q.endsWith(" ")))) SR.q += c; }
  SR.sel = 0; srDraw();
}
function srOpen(){
  if (SR.open) return; if (S.show) { try { stopShow(); } catch (e) {} } if (typeof admEl !== "undefined" && !admEl.hidden) admClose(); if (S.check) toggleNotes(false); dockCloseOver("search");
  SR.open = true; SR.q = ""; SR.sel = 0; SR.el.hidden = false; try { document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur && document.activeElement.blur(); } catch (e) {}      /* the keys go to the panel, not to the button that opened it */
   document.querySelector(".app").classList.add("srch-on"); $("bSearch").setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
  srDrawKeys(); srDraw(); updateDock(); reserve(); setTimeout(() => { if (SR.open) reserve(); }, 650);      /* the free part of the screen now ends at the panel: the map moves up to stay centred in it (measured again once the panel has landed) */
}
function srClose(){
  if (!SR.open) return; SR.open = false; clearTimeout(SR.rep); clearInterval(SR.rep); SR.el.hidden = true; document.querySelector(".app").classList.remove("srch-on"); $("bSearch").setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false"); updateDock(); reserve();
}
function srPick(pi){ srClose(); if (S.T < P[pi].y + P[pi].sg) { S.T = Math.min(2030.95, P[pi].y + P[pi].sg + 0.05); compute(); }      /* a project dated after the year on the timeline: the timeline moves to it so that it is on the map */
  openProject(pi); }

/* a physical keyboard types into the same field; nothing else reads the keys while the panel is open */
addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  const tg = e.target && e.target.tagName, typing = tg === "INPUT" || tg === "TEXTAREA" || tg === "SELECT" || (e.target && e.target.isContentEditable);
  if (!SR.open) { if (e.code === "Slash" && !typing && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey && (typeof admEl === "undefined" || admEl.hidden)) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); srOpen(); } return; }
  if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
  let used = true;
  if (e.key === "Escape") srClose(); else if (e.key === "Enter") srKey("go"); else if (e.key === "Backspace") srKey("bs");
  else if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp" || e.key === "Tab") { if (SR.res.length) { SR.sel = (SR.sel + (e.key === "ArrowUp" || (e.key === "Tab" && e.shiftKey) ? -1 : 1) + SR.res.length) % SR.res.length; srDraw(); } }
  else if (e.key.length === 1) srKey("c:" + e.key); else used = false;
  if (used) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }
}, true);

/* ================= the year stage: press the timeline and the map makes room for the year =================
   Pressing the timeline (a tap on its bars, the year, or the key at its end) opens a glass stage above the bottom row; the map slides up into what stays free,
   exactly as it does for search. The stage shows one year at a time: the year turns like an odometer, the figures count up, the eight sectors show their share,
   and that year's projects arrive as cards one after the other, each lighting its own beam on the map as it lands. Tapping a card opens the project.
   The year is simply Math.floor(S.T), so the bars, the arrow keys, the playhead and the journey button all drive it; nothing here keeps its own clock.
   "Journey" plays the years 2014 -> 2030 slowly (about 4.5 s a year) so every year gets its reveal. */

    [...el.children].forEach((c, i) => { c.style.setProperty("--f", (cnt[i] / mx).toFixed(3)); c.classList.toggle("z", !cnt[i]); c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", S.sec >= 0 ? S.sec === i : TLS.sec === i); c.disabled = (S.sec >= 0 && S.sec !== i) || !cnt[i]; tlsNum(c.lastElementChild, cnt[i]); }); }
  /* the cards, best first; the year's flagship is the large one */
  const sec = S.sec >= 0 ? S.sec : TLS.sec, list = pool.filter(i => sec < 0 || P[i].sc === sec).sort((a, b) => tlsScore(b) - tlsScore(a) || a - b);

      <span class="tp"><em>${esc(SECS[p.sc].n)}</em><small>${esc(yearLabel(p))}</small></span><b class="nm">${esc(p.n)}</b>

    : `<div class="tls-none">${T("لا مشروعات في هذه السنة بالفلاتر الحالية")}</div>`;

}

function pvLayout(){

  let top = 0; { const hd = $("top"), tr = $("trail"); if (hd) top = hd.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - sr.top;
    if (tr && !tr.hidden && tr.getClientRects().length) top = Math.max(top, tr.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - sr.top); else top += 3.3 * rem; }      /* the trail chip with the project's name lands under the header a moment later: its place is kept */
  top = Math.max(top, 5 * rem) + 0.7 * rem;
  const rr = $("railR"), tp = $("tpad"); let bot = sr.height - 8 * rem; const e = tp && tp.getClientRects().length ? tp : rr; if (e && e.getClientRects().length) bot = e.getBoundingClientRect().top - sr.top - 0.7 * rem;
  const h = Math.max(22 * rem, bot - top); pvEl.style.setProperty("--pvT", top + "px"); pvEl.style.setProperty("--pvH", Math.min(h, sr.height - top - 6.5 * rem) + "px");
}

/* ---- the renderer: one for the session, drawn only while the screen is open ---- */
function pvRenderer(){
  if (PV.r) return PV.r;
  const r = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas: pvCv, antialias: true, alpha: true, powerPreference: "high-performance"});
  if (window.EGM && window.EGM.setupRenderer) window.EGM.setupRenderer(r); else { r.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding; r.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping; r.shadowMap.enabled = true; }
  r.setClearColor(0x000000, 0); r.shadowMap.autoUpdate = false; r.toneMappingExposure = 1.1;
  PV.r = r; return r;
}
function pvSize(){ const w = pvSt.clientWidth, h = pvSt.clientHeight; if (!w || !h || !PV.r) return; PV.r.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, coarse ? 1.5 : 2)); PV.r.setSize(w, h, false); if (PV.cam) { PV.cam.aspect = w / h; PV.cam.setViewOffset(w, h, 0, 0, w, h); PV.cam.updateProjectionMatrix(); } }
const pvLin = x => new THREE.Color(x).convertSRGBToLinear();

/* ---- building what is shown ---- */
function pvFree(){
  const B = PV.B; PV.B = null; if (!B) return;
  B.sc.traverse(o => { if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); if (o.isLight && o.shadow && o.shadow.map) o.shadow.map.dispose(); });
  B.own.forEach(t => { try { t.dispose(); } catch (e) {} }); if (B.h && B.h.dispose) { try { B.h.dispose(); } catch (e) {} }
  if (PV.r) PV.r.clear();
}
function pvBox(h){
  h.group.updateMatrixWorld(true); const box = new THREE.Box3(), tb = new THREE.Box3();
  if (h.box) box.copy(h.box); else (function walk(o){ if (!o.visible) return; if (o.geometry) { if (!o.geometry.boundingBox) o.geometry.computeBoundingBox(); box.union(tb.copy(o.geometry.boundingBox).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld)); } o.children.forEach(walk); })(h.group);
  return box;
}
/* a code-built site model (workshop or single building): its own materials ("real") or glass with cyan edges ("holo", the map's own hologram look) */
function pvBuildModel(B, am, tint){
  const h = am.lib.create(THREE, Object.assign({landscape: false}, am.opts || {})), g = h.group, box = pvBox(h); B.h = h; B.kind = "model"; B.root = g; B.sc.add(g);
  const st = window.EGM.stage(B.sc, box), wm = typeof wsModelOf === "function" ? wsModelOf(B.p.i) : null, core = wm && wm.core;
  /* a site of many buildings is framed on its built mass, not on all the ground the model carries */
  B.st = core ? {R: Math.max(core.r * 1.12, 14), c: new THREE.Vector3(core.x, 0, core.z), size: new THREE.Vector3(Math.max(core.r * 2.24, 28), Math.max(core.h, 8), Math.max(core.r * 2.24, 28))} : st;
  { const old = B.sc.children.filter(o => o.isMesh && o.geometry && (o.geometry.type === "CylinderGeometry" || o.geometry.type === "TorusGeometry")); old.forEach(o => { B.sc.remove(o); o.geometry.dispose(); o.material.dispose(); }); }
  const R0 = B.st.R, c0 = B.st.c, baseG = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(R0 * 1.32, R0 * 1.35, R0 * .04, 96), ringG = new THREE.TorusGeometry(R0 * 1.32, R0 * .005, 8, 128).rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
  const baseRealM = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: pvLin(0x0c3f4a), roughness: .95}), ringRealM = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0x46d7cf});
  const base = new THREE.Mesh(baseG, baseRealM), ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringG, ringRealM); base.position.set(c0.x, -R0 * .02 - .05, c0.z); ring.position.set(c0.x, .02, c0.z); base.receiveShadow = true; B.sc.add(base, ring); B.own.push(baseRealM, ringRealM);
  const lights = B.sc.children.filter(o => o.isLight);
  const uT = {value: 0}, uH = {value: Math.max(10, st.size.y)}, tintOn = HOLO.mode === "tint";
  const fill = holoGlass(pvLin(0x2a78e8).lerp(tint.clone().convertSRGBToLinear(), .1), .3, null, uH, uT, true);
  const line = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: pvLin(0x6fd6ff).lerp(tint.clone().convertSRGBToLinear(), .06), transparent: true, opacity: .9, depthWrite: false});
  const bFill = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: tint.clone().convertSRGBToLinear().multiplyScalar(.5), transparent: true, opacity: .16, depthWrite: false}), bRing = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: tint.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), .3).convertSRGBToLinear(), transparent: true, opacity: .7, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false});
  B.own.push(fill, line, bFill, bRing);
  /* the same coloured glass as the digital map: each part keeps its own colour through the hologram */
  const items = [], lines = [line], cache = {}; let seg = 0;
  const pair = mat => { if (!tintOn) return {fill, line}; const t = holoTint(mat); if (!cache[t.key]) { const f = holoGlass(t.fill, .66, null, uH, uT, false), l = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: t.line, transparent: true, opacity: .9, depthWrite: false}); B.own.push(f, l); lines.push(l); cache[t.key] = {fill: f, line: l}; } return cache[t.key]; };
  g.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh || !o.visible) return; let ls = null; const gm = o.geometry, pr = pair(o.material);
    if (!o.isInstancedMesh && gm && gm.attributes.position && gm.attributes.position.count < 150000) { ls = new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(gm, 26), pr.line); ls.renderOrder = 4; ls.frustumCulled = false; ls.visible = false; o.add(ls); seg += ls.geometry.attributes.position.count / 2; }
    items.push({o, orig: o.material, ls, glass: pr.fill}); });
  { const lo = .9 * Math.min(1, Math.max(.3, Math.sqrt(22000 / Math.max(1, seg)))); lines.forEach(l => { l.opacity = lo; }); }       /* a district of hundreds of blocks draws tens of thousands of edges: thinned out so the whole does not turn into one bright patch */
  const baseOrig = baseRealM, ringOrig = ringRealM;
  B.look = mode => { const hl = mode === "holo";
    items.forEach(q => { q.o.material = hl ? q.glass : q.orig; if (q.ls) q.ls.visible = hl; q.o.renderOrder = 3; });
    if (base) base.material = hl ? bFill : baseOrig; if (ring) ring.material = hl ? bRing : ringOrig; lights.forEach(l => { l.visible = !hl; });
    if (PV.r) PV.r.shadowMap.needsUpdate = true; };
  B.tick = (dt, t, k) => { uT.value = t; const e = clamp((k - .06) / .8, 0, 1), s = e * e * (3 - 2 * e); g.scale.y = Math.max(.002, s); if (B.mode === "real" && (k < 1.4 || B.shot)) { PV.r.shadowMap.needsUpdate = true; B.shot = 0; } };
  B.scan = true; B.hasLook = true;
}
/* the illustrative model of the project's kind: the same parts and glass the map builds at a sector plate, lit by the sector colour */
function pvBuildParts(B, p, type, tint){
  const custom = type === "custom" && ADM.models[p.i], list = custom ? admModelParts(ADM.models[p.i], simSizeM(p, type)) : simParts(type), n = list.length;
  B.kind = custom ? "custom" : "parts"; B.type = type;
  const mats = SIM_O.map(o => mkSimMat(o * 1.2)), ghosts = SIM_GO.map(o => mkSimMat(o * 1.3, true)), matsD = mats.map(m => { const d = mkSimMat(0, false, m.uniforms); d.side = THREE.DoubleSide; return d; });
  const r = new THREE.Color(SECC[p.sc]), w = new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), c = col(SECC[p.sc]);
  const tone = [[r.clone().multiplyScalar(.5), r.clone().multiplyScalar(.16)], [r.clone().lerp(w, .12).multiplyScalar(.85), r.clone().multiplyScalar(.2)], [r.clone().multiplyScalar(.16), new THREE.Color(0, 0, 0)], [r.clone().lerp(w, .3), r.clone().multiplyScalar(.22)]];
  [mats, ghosts].forEach(set => set.forEach((m, i) => { m.color.copy(tone[i][0]); m.emissive.copy(tone[i][1]); }));
  const mkL = o => new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: o, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false});
  const lines = [mkL(1), mkL(1), mkL(.4)]; lines[0].color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .3)); lines[1].color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .7)); lines[2].color.copy(c.clone().lerp(w, .25));
  B.own.push(...mats, ...ghosts, ...matsD, ...lines);
  const root = new THREE.Group(); B.sc.add(root); B.root = root; B.st = {R: 2.4, c: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), size: new THREE.Vector3(4.6, 2.7, 4.6)};
  const plate = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.3, 2.42, .12, 6), mats[0]); plate.position.y = -.06; plate.add(new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(plate.geometry, 20), lines[0])); plate.renderOrder = 2; root.add(plate);
  const ringM = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: c.clone().lerp(w, .3), transparent: true, opacity: .55, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide}); B.own.push(ringM);
  const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(2.46, 2.5, 6, 1).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), ringM); ring.position.y = .02; ring.rotation.y = Math.PI / 6; root.add(ring);
  const ghostFrom = p.kd === "e" ? Math.max(2, Math.round(n * .58)) : 9999;
  const parts = list.map((pt, i) => {
    const ghost = i >= ghostFrom, mesh = new THREE.Mesh(pt.geo, (ghost ? ghosts : pt.ds || custom ? matsD : mats)[pt.tn]);
    if (pt.fc && !pt.geo.attributes.aF) { const nn = pt.geo.attributes.position.count, f = new Float32Array(nn * 2); for (let q = 0; q < nn; q++) { f[q * 2] = pt.fc[0]; f[q * 2 + 1] = pt.fc[1]; } pt.geo.setAttribute("aF", new THREE.BufferAttribute(f, 2)); }
    const ln = new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(pt.geo, 28), ghost ? lines[2] : lines[pt.tn === 3 ? 1 : 0]); ln.renderOrder = 5; mesh.add(ln);
    mesh.position.set(pt.x, pt.y, pt.z); if (pt.q) mesh.quaternion.copy(pt.q); else mesh.rotation.set(pt.rx || 0, pt.ry || 0, pt.rz || 0);
    const bs = pt.sc || [1, 1, 1]; mesh.scale.set(bs[0], 1e-3, bs[2]); pt.geo.computeBoundingBox();
    mesh.renderOrder = ghost ? 4.5 : pt.geo.boundingBox.max.y - pt.geo.boundingBox.min.y < .07 && pt.y < .09 && !pt.mv ? 3.6 : 4; root.add(mesh);
    return {pt, mesh, bs, ghost, d: i === 0 ? 0 : .05 + i / Math.max(1, n - 1) * .66}; });
  B.tick = (dt, t, k) => {
    for (const s of parts) { const pt = s.pt, m = s.mesh, q = clamp((k - s.d) / .3, 0, 1), e = q * q * (3 - 2 * q); m.visible = q > .002;
      if (pt.gr === "y") m.scale.set(s.bs[0], Math.max(1e-3, s.bs[1] * e * (pt.flick ? 1 + .3 * Math.sin(t * 17) : 1)), s.bs[2]); else m.scale.setScalar(Math.max(1e-3, e));
      if (q >= 1 && !s.ghost) { if (pt.spin) m.rotation[pt.spin[0]] = t * pt.spin[1]; if (pt.mv) { const o = pt.mv(t); m.position.set(pt.x + o[0], pt.y + o[1], pt.z + o[2]); if (o.length > 3) { m.scale.setScalar(Math.max(1e-3, o[3])); m.rotation.z = o[4] || 0; } } } }
    const f = .95 + .05 * Math.sin(t * 31); mats.forEach((m, i) => { m.opacity = SIM_O[i] * 1.2 * f; m.emissiveIntensity = p.kd === "p" ? 1 + .35 * Math.sin(t * 2.4) : 1; }); ghosts.forEach((m, i) => { m.opacity = SIM_GO[i] * 1.3 * (.8 + .4 * Math.sin(t * 2 + i)); });
    ring.rotation.y = Math.PI / 6 - t * .08; };
  B.scan = false; B.hasLook = false;
}
function pvBuild(pi){
  pvFree(); const p = P[pi], type = simType(p), tint = new THREE.Color(SECC[p.sc]), B = {sc: new THREE.Scene(), own: [], p, type, h: null, k: 0, mode: "holo", tick: null, look: null, st: null, root: null, kind: "parts", scan: false, hasLook: false};
  const am = type === "custom" ? null : model3dFor(p.i);
  if (am && window.EGM && window.EGM.stage) pvBuildModel(B, am, tint); else pvBuildParts(B, p, type, tint);
  /* a pulsing ring that rises through the model, in the sector colour */
  { const c = tint.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), .3), m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: c, transparent: true, opacity: 0, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide}); B.own.push(m);
    const sc = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(.97, 1, 72, 1).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), m); sc.visible = false; B.sc.add(sc); B.scanM = sc; }
  B.mode = B.hasLook ? (S.theme === "sand" ? "real" : "holo") : "holo"; if (B.hasLook && PV.look) B.mode = PV.look;
  if (B.look) B.look(B.mode); pvSt.classList.toggle("holo", B.mode === "holo");
  PV.B = B; pvCapText(B); PV.cam = PV.cam || new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 1, 1e5); pvSize();
  pvEl.querySelector("#pvLk").hidden = !B.hasLook; pvSyncCt();
  PV.k0 = B.kind === "model" ? 1.22 : .98; PV.el0 = B.kind === "model" ? .55 : .5; PV.k = PV.k0; PV.el = PV.el0; PV.az = .7; B.t0 = performance.now(); B.k = 0;
}
function pvFrame(){
  if (PV.sr && PV.B && PV.B.car) return srFrame(); if (PV.cam.fov !== 32) { PV.cam.fov = 32; }
  const B = PV.B, st = B.st, cam = PV.cam, d = (Math.max(st.R * .86, st.size.y * 1.1)) / Math.tan(cam.fov * Math.PI / 360) * PV.k;
  const t = new THREE.Vector3(st.c.x, Math.min(st.size.y * .35, st.R * .3), st.c.z);
  cam.position.set(t.x + d * Math.cos(PV.el) * Math.sin(PV.az), t.y + d * Math.sin(PV.el), t.z + d * Math.cos(PV.el) * Math.cos(PV.az));
  cam.near = d / 200; cam.far = d * 24; cam.lookAt(t); cam.updateProjectionMatrix(); return t;
}
function pvLoop(now){
  PV.raf = requestAnimationFrame(pvLoop);
  if (document.hidden || !PV.B || !PV.on) return;
  if (now - PV.last < 22) return; const dt = Math.min(.1, (now - PV.last) / 1000); PV.last = now; PV.t += dt;
  const B = PV.B; if (PV.auto && !PV.pts.size) PV.az += dt * .16; else if (!PV.auto && PV.userAuto && !PV.pts.size && now - PV.idle > 6000) PV.auto = true, pvSyncCt();
  B.k = Math.min(1.4, B.k + dt / (B.kind === "model" ? 1.5 : 3.4));
  PV.el = clamp(PV.el, .03, 1.5); PV.k = clamp(PV.k, .12, 3.2);
  const t = pvFrame(); if (B.tick) B.tick(dt, PV.t, B.k); if (PV.sr && B.car) srTick(dt);
  /* the scan ring rises through the model while it grows, then once more every few seconds */
  { const m = B.scanM, ph = (PV.t * .22) % 1, grow = B.k < 1.05 ? clamp(B.k / 1.0, 0, 1) : -1, u = grow >= 0 ? grow : ph, hy = Math.max(B.st.size.y, 1) * (B.kind === "model" ? 1.05 : 1.2);
    m.visible = B.mode === "holo" || B.kind !== "model"; m.position.set(B.st.c.x, u * hy, B.st.c.z); m.scale.setScalar(Math.max(B.st.R * 1.25, 1)); m.material.opacity = .7 * Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp(u, 0, 1)) * (grow >= 0 ? 1 : .55); }
  PV.r.render(B.sc, PV.cam);
  const ld = pvEl.querySelector("#pvLd"); if (!ld.classList.contains("off")) ld.classList.add("off");
}
function pvBuildSafe(pi){
  if (!PV.on || PV.pi !== pi) return;
  try { pvRenderer(); pvSize(); pvBuild(pi); if (PV.sr) srBuild(PV.B); if (!PV.raf) PV.raf = requestAnimationFrame(pvLoop); }
  catch (e) { try { console.warn("preview", e); } catch (x) {} pvFree(); pvEl.querySelector("#pvLd").innerHTML = `<span>${T("المعاينة ثلاثية الأبعاد غير متاحة على هذا الجهاز")}</span>`; pvEl.querySelector("#pvLd").classList.remove("off"); }
}

/* ---- open / close ---- */
function pvOverview(pi){      /* where it stands: the map flies to the region round the beam (never closer than the region: the model is on the screen, the true-scale dive is the key) */
  const p = P[pi]; if (!p.onMap || S.mode !== "surface" || inShow()) return; const q = INST[p.ins[0]]; rememberView(); flyTo(focusView(q.x, q.z, 11), 1500);
}
function pvOpen(pi){
  if (inShow()) return; pvEl.classList.toggle("sr", !!PV.sr); pvEl.classList.toggle("resv", !PV.sr); const was = PV.on; PV.on = true; PV.pi = pi; clearTimeout(PV.closeT); clearTimeout(PV.bt);
  if (!was) { dockCloseOver("pv"); pvEl.hidden = false; pvEl.classList.remove("out"); pvEl.style.animation = "none"; void pvEl.offsetWidth; pvEl.style.animation = ""; PV.userAuto = true; PV.auto = !reduce; PV.idle = 0; }
  pvText(pi); pvLayout(); pvFree(); const ld = pvEl.querySelector("#pvLd"); ld.innerHTML = `<i></i><span>${T("جارٍ بناء المجسم")}</span>`; ld.classList.remove("off");
  reserve(); setTimeout(reserve, 80); setTimeout(reserve, 760);
  PV.bt = setTimeout(() => pvBuildSafe(pi), was ? 50 : reduce ? 60 : 420);
  const go = pvEl.querySelector(".pv-go"); if (!reduce && !go.disabled) { go.classList.remove("pulse"); void go.offsetWidth; go.classList.add("pulse"); }
  pvCardSync();
}
function pvClose(){
  if (!PV.on) return; PV.on = false;
  if (PV.sr) { PV.sr = false; pvEl.classList.add("resv"); setTimeout(() => { if (!PV.sr) pvEl.classList.remove("sr"); }, reduce ? 0 : 330); } clearTimeout(PV.bt); pvEl.classList.add("out"); reserve(); pvCardSync();
  PV.closeT = setTimeout(() => { if (PV.on) return; pvEl.hidden = true; if (PV.raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(PV.raf); PV.raf = 0; } pvFree(); reserve(); }, reduce ? 0 : 340);
}
/* a preview exists only where there is a real model to turn: the workshop's site model, a single-building module, or a model typed in the settings page */
/* the model may also stand on the map (the dive and the simulation): only where the site is confirmed and the workshop did not hold the model back because its ground or scale does not match the flat map */
/* ================= the photo showroom =================
   «الصور» on the wheel opens it: the model alone, turning in the middle, and the project's photos on a curved wall that runs round it.
   Twelve curved panels share the wall; each one takes the next photo while it passes behind the viewer, so any number of photos flows round.
   Until the real photos arrive the wall shows numbered stand-ins («image 0» … «image 19»). */
const SR_N = 12, SR_PH = 20;
function srOpen(pi){ if (pi < 0 || inShow()) return; act(); PV.sr = true; pvOpen(pi); }
function srList(p){
  const real = (typeof OH !== "undefined" ? OH.media : []).filter(m => m && !m.isVideo && m.url);
  if (real.length) return real.map((m, i) => ({url: m.url, n: i}));
  return Array.from({length: SR_PH}, (_, i) => ({ph: true, n: i}));
}
function srMirror(tex, rx, ox){ tex.repeat.x = -rx; tex.offset.x = rx + ox; }      /* the wall is seen from inside the cylinder: flip each picture so it reads the right way */
function srPlaceholder(i, p){
  const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = 1024; cv.height = 576; const g = cv.getContext("2d"), c = SECC[p.sc] || "#46d7cf";
  const fh = (getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--f-head") || "sans-serif").trim();
  const bg = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 1024, 576); bg.addColorStop(0, "#06173a"); bg.addColorStop(1, "#020a1c"); g.fillStyle = bg; g.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 576);
  const glow = g.createRadialGradient(512, 300, 20, 512, 300, 520); glow.addColorStop(0, c + "55"); glow.addColorStop(1, "transparent"); g.fillStyle = glow; g.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 576);
  g.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.06)"; g.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = 0; x <= 1024; x += 64) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, 0); g.lineTo(x, 576); g.stroke(); } for (let y = 0; y <= 576; y += 64) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, y); g.lineTo(1024, y); g.stroke(); }
  g.strokeStyle = c; g.globalAlpha = .9; g.lineWidth = 6; g.strokeRect(3, 3, 1018, 570); g.globalAlpha = 1;
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.08)"; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(380, 330); g.lineTo(470, 230); g.lineTo(540, 300); g.lineTo(590, 250); g.lineTo(680, 330); g.closePath(); g.fill();
  g.beginPath(); g.arc(610, 205, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();
  g.fillStyle = "#fff"; g.textAlign = "center"; g.textBaseline = "middle"; g.font = `700 112px ${fh}`; g.fillText("image " + i, 512, 410);
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.55)"; g.font = `500 30px ${fh}`; g.direction = "rtl"; g.fillText(T("صورة افتراضية") + " · " + (i + 1) + " / " + SR_PH, 512, 500);
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv); t.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding; t.anisotropy = 4; srMirror(t, 1, 0); return t;
}
function srTex(car, it){
  if (car.tex[it.n]) return car.tex[it.n];
  let t;
  if (it.ph) t = srPlaceholder(it.n, car.p);
  else { t = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(it.url, tx => { const im = tx.image, ia = im && im.width ? im.width / im.height : 16 / 9, pa = 16 / 9; let rx = 1, ox = 0;
      if (ia > pa) { rx = pa / ia; ox = (1 - rx) / 2; } else { tx.repeat.y = ia / pa; tx.offset.y = (1 - tx.repeat.y) / 2; } srMirror(tx, rx, ox); tx.needsUpdate = true; });
    t.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding; srMirror(t, 1, 0); }
  car.own.push(t); car.tex[it.n] = t; return t;
}
function srBuild(B){
  const st = B.st, R0 = Math.max(st.R, 1), H = Math.max(st.size.y, R0 * .6), p = B.p;
  const car = {g: new THREE.Group(), slots: [], list: srList(p), next: 0, tex: [], own: B.own, p, rot: 0, d: R0 * 3.3, R: R0 * 5.1, H};
  const N = SR_N, slot = Math.PI * 2 / N, w = slot - .05, ph = car.R * w * 9 / 16, yC = Math.max(H * .62, ph * .55 + R0 * .08);
  car.y = yC; car.ph = ph; car.g.position.set(st.c.x, 0, st.c.z); B.sc.add(car.g);
  const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(car.R, car.R, ph, 28, 1, true, -w / 2, w), c = new THREE.Color(SECC[p.sc] || "#46d7cf");
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const it = car.list[i % car.list.length], m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map: srTex(car, it), side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, toneMapped: false, depthWrite: false});
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, m); mesh.position.y = yC; mesh.rotation.y = i * slot; mesh.renderOrder = 1; car.g.add(mesh); B.own.push(m);
    car.slots.push({mesh, a: i * slot, armed: false}); }
  car.next = N % car.list.length;
  /* a thin lit rule under and over the wall, and a faint ring on the floor where the wall stands */
  const lm = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: c.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), .35), transparent: true, opacity: .55, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, toneMapped: false}); B.own.push(lm);
  [yC - ph / 2 - ph * .05, yC + ph / 2 + ph * .05].forEach(y => { const r = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(car.R, car.R, ph * .012, 160, 1, true), lm); r.position.y = y; car.g.add(r); });
  const fm = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: c, transparent: true, opacity: .22, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, toneMapped: false}); B.own.push(fm);
  const fl = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(car.R * .985, car.R, 160).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), fm); fl.position.y = .02; car.g.add(fl);
  /* the band over the wall carries the project's name, like a gallery's tabs */
  { const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = 2048; cv.height = 64; const g = cv.getContext("2d"), fh = (getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--f-head") || "sans-serif").trim();
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(4,18,44,.85)"; g.fillRect(0, 0, 2048, 64); g.fillStyle = "#fff"; g.font = `600 30px ${fh}`; g.textAlign = "center"; g.textBaseline = "middle"; g.direction = "rtl";

function srFrame(){
  const B = PV.B, st = B.st, cam = PV.cam, car = B.car; if (cam.fov !== 46) { cam.fov = 46; }
  const d = Math.min(car.R - st.R * .7, car.d * clamp(PV.k, .6, 1.5)), el = clamp(PV.el, .04, .55);
  const t = new THREE.Vector3(st.c.x, Math.min(car.H * .4, car.y * .7), st.c.z);
  cam.position.set(t.x + d * Math.cos(el) * Math.sin(PV.az), t.y + d * Math.sin(el), t.z + d * Math.cos(el) * Math.cos(PV.az));
  cam.near = Math.max(.05, d / 120); cam.far = car.R * 8; cam.lookAt(t.x, t.y + car.ph * .2, t.z); cam.updateProjectionMatrix(); return t;
}
function srTick(dt){
  const car = PV.B.car, TAU = Math.PI * 2; car.rot -= dt * .055; car.g.rotation.y = car.rot;
  for (const s of car.slots) {
    let df = (s.a + car.rot - PV.az) % TAU; if (df > Math.PI) df -= TAU; if (df < -Math.PI) df += TAU; const ad = Math.abs(df);
    if (ad < .32 && s.armed) { const it = car.list[car.next]; car.next = (car.next + 1) % car.list.length; s.mesh.material.map = srTex(car, it); s.mesh.material.needsUpdate = true; s.armed = false; }
    else if (ad > .9) s.armed = true;
    s.mesh.material.opacity = clamp((ad - .35) / .5, 0, 1); }
}

/* A view for a chosen sector, solved rather than guessed: lean toward where the sector's projects are, as close as possible,
   but only as far as its whole screen on the far rim (with its floating layers) still fits inside the clear part of the picture,
   between the left panel and the block under the title. It also returns the ring angle that puts the screen in the middle of that clear part. */
const svCam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(), svV = new THREE.Vector3(), svRay = new THREE.Raycaster();
function sectorFitRect(){ const nb = document.querySelector(".navgrp"), tb = document.querySelector(".tools"), r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x1 = nb && innerWidth > 900 ? nb.getBoundingClientRect().left - r.left - 18 : W - 12, y0 = (tb ? tb.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - r.top : 44) + 10;
  return {x0: FREE.x0 + 18, x1: Math.max(FREE.x0 + 240, x1), y0, y1: FREE.y1}; }
function sectorView(s){
  /* look the way you are already looking, turned a little toward where this sector's projects are, so they lie on the map under its screen */
  const xs = [], zs = []; for (let k = 0; k < NI; k++) { const q = INST[k]; if (!q.show || P[q.pi].sc !== s || !stat.vis[q.pi]) continue; xs.push(q.x); zs.push(q.z); }
  const med = a => { const b = a.slice().sort((p, q) => p - q); return b[b.length >> 1]; };
  let az = Math.atan2(controls.target.x - camera.position.x, controls.target.z - camera.position.z);
  if (xs.length) { const cx = med(xs) - EC.x, cz = med(zs) - EC.z; if (Math.hypot(cx, cz) > 4) { let d = Math.atan2(cx, cz) - az; d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d)); az += clamp(d, -0.7, 0.7); } }
  const dx = Math.sin(az), dz = Math.cos(az), R = ORB.R, fit = sectorFitRect(), px = (fit.x0 + fit.x1) / 2, sp = ORB.span / 2 + 0.02, fw = fit.x1 - fit.x0; let best = null;
  svCam.copy(camera);
  const tryView = ([back, ch, fwd, th0]) => {
    const p = new THREE.Vector3(EC.x - dx * R * back, ORB.y0 + ch, EC.z - dz * R * back), t = new THREE.Vector3(EC.x + dx * R * fwd, ORB.y0 + th0, EC.z + dz * R * fwd);
    svCam.position.copy(p); svCam.lookAt(t); svCam.updateMatrixWorld(true); svCam.updateProjectionMatrix();
    /* the ring angle seen at the middle of the clear area: far crossing of that sight line with the screens' cylinder */
    svRay.setFromCamera({x: px / W * 2 - 1, y: 0.3}, svCam); const o = svRay.ray.origin, d = svRay.ray.direction, ox = o.x - EC.x, oz = o.z - EC.z, Rc = R + ORB.lean * 0.5;
    const A = d.x * d.x + d.z * d.z, B = 2 * (ox * d.x + oz * d.z), C = ox * ox + oz * oz - Rc * Rc, disc = B * B - 4 * A * C; if (disc <= 0 || A < 1e-9) return null;
    const tt = (-B + Math.sqrt(disc)) / (2 * A), th = Math.atan2(ox + d.x * tt, oz + d.z * tt);
    /* project the screen and the layers that float off it, and measure any spill outside the clear area */
    let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y0 = 1e9, y1 = -1e9;
    for (const a of [th - sp, th, th + sp]) for (const [r, y] of [[R + ORB.lean, ORB.y0 + ORB.h + 1.0], [R, ORB.y0 - 0.2], [R - 5.8, ORB.y0 - 0.9], [R - 5.8, ORB.y0 + ORB.h * 0.6]]) {
      svV.set(EC.x + Math.sin(a) * r, y, EC.z + Math.cos(a) * r).project(svCam); const sx = (svV.x + 1) / 2 * W, sy = (1 - svV.y) / 2 * Hh; x0 = Math.min(x0, sx); x1 = Math.max(x1, sx); y0 = Math.min(y0, sy); y1 = Math.max(y1, sy); }
    const spill = Math.max(0, fit.x0 - x0) + Math.max(0, x1 - fit.x1) + Math.max(0, fit.y0 - y0) + Math.max(0, y1 - (fit.y0 + (fit.y1 - fit.y0) * 0.62));
    return {p, t, th, spill, size: (x1 - x0) / fw};
  };
  /* from the closest reading distance outward [camera back from the centre, camera height, target toward the screen, target height]:
     the first framing that shows the whole screen wins, so it is always as large as the clear area allows and never cropped */
  const C = [[-0.12, 9.5, 0.95, 2.8], [-0.02, 10.5, 0.92, 2.6], [0.1, 12, 0.88, 2.4], [0.22, 13.5, 0.8, 2.2], [0.36, 15.5, 0.68, 2.2], [0.5, 17.5, 0.55, 2.4], [0.62, 19, 0.42, 2.5], [0.8, 22, 0.32, 2.5], [1.0, 26, 0.25, 2.5]];
  for (const c of C) { const v = tryView(c); if (!v) continue; if (v.spill < 1) return v; if (!best || v.spill < best.spill) best = v; }
  return best || Object.assign(homeView("surface"), {th: az});
}

/* picking: the glowing head of a beam wins over the beam line, and when several heads sit on the same spot
   the viewer gets a small chooser instead of a guess */
function pickCands(mx, my){
  const R = (ptr.touch ? 30 : 15) * clamp(KP, 0.85, 1.7), Rh = R * 0.95, out = new Map();
  for (let k = 0; k < NI; k++) {
    const pi = INST[k].pi; if (!INST[k].show || !stat.vis[pi] || ap[k] < 0.6 || dimK[k] < 0.3) continue;
    if (sim.on && pi === sim.pi) continue;
    const bx = aPos[k*3], by = aPos[k*3+1], bz = aPos[k*3+2], hy = aHeadPos[k*3+1];
    if (behindCam(bx, by, bz)) continue; v3.set(bx, by, bz).project(camera); if (v3.z > 1) continue; const x0 = (v3.x + 1) / 2 * W, y0 = (1 - v3.y) / 2 * Hh;
    v3.set(bx, hy, bz).project(camera); const x1 = (v3.x + 1) / 2 * W + aOff[k * 2], y1 = (1 - v3.y) / 2 * Hh + aOff[k * 2 + 1];
    const hd2 = (mx - x1) * (mx - x1) + (my - y1) * (my - y1);
    let sc;
    if (hd2 < Rh * Rh) sc = hd2;
    else { const dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, l2 = dx * dx + dy * dy; let t = l2 > 1e-6 ? ((mx - x0) * dx + (my - y0) * dy) / l2 : 0; t = clamp(t, 0, 1);
      const ex = mx - (x0 + dx * t), ey = my - (y0 + dy * t), d2 = ex * ex + ey * ey; if (d2 >= R * R) continue; sc = d2 + Rh * Rh; }
    const o = out.get(pi); if (!o || sc < o.sc) out.set(pi, {pi, k, sc, hx: x1, hy: y1});
  }
  return [...out.values()].sort((a, b) => a.sc - b.sc);
}
function pickProject(mx, my){ const c = pickCands(mx, my); return c.length ? c[0].pi : -1; }
/* candidates that are too close to tell apart on screen */
function pickCluster(c){
  if (c.length < 2) return c.slice(0, 1);
  const a = c[0], lim = Math.max(64, a.sc * 2.2);
  return c.filter((q, i) => i === 0 || (q.sc < lim && Math.hypot(q.hx - a.hx, q.hy - a.hy) < 12 * clamp(KP, 0.85, 1.7))).slice(0, 7);
}
/* is the point inside the hologram that is currently shown? clicks there should not fall through to the beams behind it */
function overSim(mx, my){
  if (!sim.on || sim.vis < .3 || !sim.site) return false;
  const c = screenOf(sim.site.x, sim.baseY + 1.2, sim.site.z), e = screenOf(sim.site.x + 2.6 * SIM_S, sim.baseY + 1.2, sim.site.z);
  return Math.hypot(mx - c[0], my - c[1]) < Math.max(60, Math.hypot(e[0] - c[0], e[1] - c[1])) * 0.92;
}

function stepZoom(){
  if (Math.abs(zoomV) < 0.0005) { zoomV = 0; return; }
  const step = zoomV * 0.25; zoomV -= step; const f = Math.exp(step), d1 = camera.position.distanceTo(controls.target) * f;

  camera.position.sub(zoomP).multiplyScalar(f).add(zoomP); controls.target.sub(zoomP).multiplyScalar(f).add(zoomP);
}

function padPan(jx, jy, dt){
  const dx = controls.target.x - camera.position.x, dz = controls.target.z - camera.position.z, l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1, fx = dx / l, fz = dz / l;
  const d = camera.position.distanceTo(controls.target), v = d * 0.5 * dt, mx = (-fz * jx - fx * jy) * v, mz = (fx * jx - fz * jy) * v;
  const nx = clamp(controls.target.x + mx, EC.x - 34, EC.x + 34), nz = clamp(controls.target.z + mz, EC.z - 34, EC.z + 34), ax = nx - controls.target.x, az = nz - controls.target.z;
  controls.target.x += ax; controls.target.z += az; camera.position.x += ax; camera.position.z += az;
}
function padAct(k, dt){
  if (k === "zi" || k === "zo") { zoomP.copy(controls.target); zoomV = clamp(zoomV + (k === "zi" ? -1 : 1) * 1.1 * dt, -0.9, 0.9); return; }
  const s = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(controls.target));
  if (k === "rl") s.theta += 1.5 * dt; else if (k === "rr") s.theta -= 1.5 * dt; else if (k === "tu") s.phi -= 0.8 * dt; else if (k === "td") s.phi += 0.8 * dt;
  s.phi = clamp(s.phi, 0.12, 1.34); camera.position.setFromSpherical(s).add(controls.target);
}
function padStep(dt){
  if (PAD.jx || PAD.jy) { if (fly) fly = null; userMoved = true; act(); padPan(PAD.jx, PAD.jy, dt); }
  if (PAD.hold && performance.now() - PAD.t0 > 180) { if (fly) fly = null; userMoved = true; act(); padAct(PAD.hold, dt); }
}

/* tour stops for a sector: projects whose real buildings are on the map first, then exactly located ones, then the rest; ordered as a short route */
/* Which projects a sector shows on its flight: the ones with the most to look at. Real buildings, airports with their aircraft, terminals with their cranes,
   lines with their trains and traffic, and sites still under construction with their cranes come first; then size and declared cost.
   Sectors with nothing matched to the map get their largest declared project, shown at city scale with its card. */
function stopScore(p){
  const g = GEO[p.i]; if (!g) return p.tr * 1.5 + (p.kd === "a" ? 1 : 0);
  const ty = simType(p); let v = 12 + p.tr * 1.5;
  if (simIsReal(p)) v += 10 + Math.min(6, (g.b || 0) / 40);
  if (ty === "air") v += 10; else if (ty === "port") v += 8; else if (g.ln && ty === "rail") v += 9; else if (g.ln && ty !== "water") v += 5;
  if (p.kd === "e" && !g.ln) v += 8;                      /* scaffold and tower cranes */
  if (g.pl && !(g.b >= 1)) v += 2;
  return v;
}
function tourPoints(s, n){
  const c = []; P.forEach((p, i) => { if (p.sc !== s || !pvMap(p) || p.y > 2027) return; const st = simSite(p), g = GEO[p.i];
    c.push({pi: i, x: st.x, z: st.z, exact: !!g, sc: stopScore(p)}); });
  c.sort((a, b) => b.sc - a.sc); const out = [], nExact = c.filter(q => q.exact).length, want = nExact >= n ? n : Math.max(1, Math.min(n, nExact + 1));
  while (out.length < want && c.length) { let best = -1, bv = -1e9;
    c.forEach((q, j) => { const dmin = out.length ? Math.min(...out.map(o => Math.hypot(o.x - q.x, o.z - q.z))) : 9; const v = q.sc + Math.min(dmin, 6) * 0.4 - (dmin < 0.25 ? 40 : 0); if (v > bv) { bv = v; best = j; } });   /* never two stops on the same site (three projects share Cairo airport) */
    out.push(c.splice(best, 1)[0]); }
  const route = []; let cur = {x: EC.x, z: EC.z};
  while (out.length) { let bi = 0, bd = 1e9; out.forEach((q, j) => { const d = Math.hypot(q.x - cur.x, q.z - cur.z); if (d < bd) { bd = d; bi = j; } }); cur = out.splice(bi, 1)[0]; route.push(cur); }
  return route;
}

/* the drone tour, Google Earth style: rise, travel, sink into a slow low orbit over each stop.
   Exactly located projects with real buildings are flown down to street level, where their buildings rise in the sector colour;
   the others are framed at city scale with their card. Distance moves on a log scale with a lift in the middle of each hop. */
const relAtD = d => lerp(1 / 15, 1, sstep(0.45, 12, d)) * ZS.tk;
const angDiff = (a, b) => Math.atan2(Math.sin(a - b), Math.cos(a - b));
const m3LowPhi = (B, d) => Math.PI / 2 - M3_EL;   /* a model on the map is held in the bird view all through the push-in */
function stopPose(q, from){
  const p = P[q.pi], g = GEO[p.i], ty = simType(p), sz = simSizeM(p, ty), wow = !!g && (simIsReal(p) || ty === "air" || ty === "port" || !!g.ln || p.kd === "e");
  const d = g ? clamp(sz * M2U * 2.35, 0.03, 0.55) : 0.42;
  const dx = q.x - from.x, dz = q.z - from.z, l = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  const th = l > 1e-3 ? Math.atan2(-dx / l, -dz / l) + 0.5 : from.th + 0.6;          /* arrive from behind the line of travel, a little off-axis */
  const m3 = g ? model3dOfProject(q.pi) : null;
  if (m3) { const v = model3dLow(m3, th); return {x: v.t.x, z: v.t.z, d: v.d, phi: v.phi, th: v.th, real: true, wow, pi: q.pi, lift: v.lift, low: true}; }   /* a model on the map: the drone holds at 50 m above the ground while it pushes in */
  return {x: q.x, z: q.z, d, phi: g ? 1.08 : 0.95, th, real: !!g, wow, pi: q.pi, lift: g ? simRealS(sz) * 1.3 : 0};      /* lift: look at the middle of the card ring, not the ground, so the cards stay in frame */
}
function droneScene(s, pts){
  const st = {legs: [], total: 0};
  return {d: 0, drone: true, init(){
      const sp = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(controls.target));
      let cur = {x: controls.target.x, z: controls.target.z, ty: controls.target.y, d: sp.radius, phi: sp.phi, th: sp.theta};   /* ty: the look-at height we start from (the sector screen is high above the ground) */
      st.legs = []; st.total = 0; st.cur = -1;
      pts.forEach(q => { const B = stopPose(q, cur); const L = Math.hypot(B.x - cur.x, B.z - cur.z);
        const T = clamp(3.4 + 1.1 * Math.log2(1 + L / 1.2) + 0.35 * Math.abs(Math.log(cur.d / B.d)), 4.2, 8.5), DW = q.dw != null ? q.dw : B.wow ? 11 : B.real ? 8 : 5.5;      /* a stop of the presenter's own scenario holds for the seconds he gave it */
        st.legs.push({A: cur, B, T, DW, t0: st.total, lm: Math.log(Math.max(Math.sqrt(cur.d * B.d), L * 0.55)), dth: angDiff(B.th, cur.th)});
        st.total += T + DW;
        cur = {x: B.x, z: B.z, d: B.d * 0.84, phi: B.low ? m3LowPhi(B, B.d * 0.84) : B.phi, th: B.th + 0.11 * DW, lift: B.lift, low: B.low}; });
      this.d = st.total + 0.5;
    },
    tick(k){
      const el = k * this.d; let leg = st.legs[st.legs.length - 1], li = st.legs.length - 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < st.legs.length; i++) if (el < st.legs[i].t0 + st.legs[i].T + st.legs[i].DW) { leg = st.legs[i]; li = i; break; }
      const t = el - leg.t0, A = leg.A, B = leg.B; let x, z, d, phi, th, dwell = false, frac = 0;
      if (t < leg.T) {
        const u = clamp(t / leg.T, 0, 1), e = u * u * u * (u * (u * 6 - 15) + 10), um = clamp((u - 0.1) / 0.8, 0, 1), em = um * um * um * (um * (um * 6 - 15) + 10);
        x = lerp(A.x, B.x, em); z = lerp(A.z, B.z, em);
        /* altitude on a log scale through a mid-flight height that lets both ends be seen: smooth (C1) Hermite through three keys */
        const la = Math.log(A.d), lb = Math.log(B.d), lm = leg.lm, mt = (lb - la) * 0.5, v = u < 0.5 ? u * 2 : u * 2 - 1, h00 = 2 * v * v * v - 3 * v * v + 1, h10 = v * v * v - 2 * v * v + v, h01 = -2 * v * v * v + 3 * v * v, h11 = v * v * v - v * v;
        d = Math.exp(u < 0.5 ? h00 * la + h10 * 0 + h01 * lm + h11 * mt : h00 * lm + h10 * mt + h01 * lb + h11 * 0);
        phi = lerp(A.phi, B.phi, e) - 0.22 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u); th = A.th + leg.dth * e;
      } else {
        dwell = true; frac = clamp((t - leg.T) / leg.DW, 0, 1);
        const fe = frac * frac * (3 - 2 * frac); x = B.x; z = B.z; d = B.d * (1 - 0.16 * fe); phi = B.low ? m3LowPhi(B, d) : B.phi + 0.1 * Math.sin(Math.PI * frac); th = B.th + 0.11 * (t - leg.T);       /* slow orbit: push in and dip toward the site, then ease back out */
      }
      const yg = H + relH(x, z) * relAtD(d), ue = clamp(t / leg.T, 0, 1), ee = ue * ue * ue * (ue * (ue * 6 - 15) + 10), y = (A.ty != null ? lerp(A.ty, yg, ee) : yg) + lerp(A.lift || 0, B.lift || 0, ee);   /* glide the look-at point down from the screen to the ground: no jump */
      controls.target.set(x, y, z); sphA.set(Math.max(controls.minDistance * 1.05, d), clamp(phi, 0.25, B.low || A.low ? M3_POLAR : 1.35), th); camera.position.setFromSpherical(sphA).add(controls.target); fly = null;
      /* arriving: prefetch, show the stop, raise the buildings */
      if (li !== st.cur) { st.cur = li; cityPrefetch(B.x, B.z); if (sim.on) hideSim(); showDCard(-1); st.shown = false;
        const p = P[B.pi]; caption(SECS[p.sc].n, p.n.length > 84 ? p.n.slice(0, 82) + "…" : p.n, esc(p.lc || (p.g[0] ? GN[p.g[0]] : "")) + (p.cd && p.cd !== "—" ? " · " + esc(p.cd) : "") + `<small>${esc(stLabel(p))}${p.yd === 0 ? " · " + p.y : ""}</small>`); }
      if (dwell && !st.shown) { st.shown = true; const p = P[B.pi]; selFXTarget = INST[p.ins[0]]; setSelColor(p.sc); if (B.real) showSim(B.pi); }   /* B.real: matched to the map, so its site, cards and whatever moves there come up */
      S.hoverP = dwell ? B.pi : -1;
      showDCard(dwell && !B.real ? B.pi : -1, dwell && frac > 0.04 && frac < 0.96); if (dwell && !B.real) placeDCard(B.pi);
    },
    out(){ showDCard(-1); S.hoverP = -1; selFXTarget = null; if (sim.on) hideSim(); },
    /* each stop of the flight is one step of the show */
    nLegs(){ return st.legs.length; }, legT0(i){ return st.legs[i].t0; }, reset(){ st.cur = -1; },
    /* stepping to a stop: fly there from wherever the camera is now, never a cut */
    goLeg(i){ const leg = st.legs[i], sp = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(controls.target)), B = leg.B;
      const A = {x: controls.target.x, z: controls.target.z, ty: controls.target.y, d: sp.radius, phi: sp.phi, th: sp.theta}, L = Math.hypot(B.x - A.x, B.z - A.z);
      leg.A = A; leg.lm = Math.log(Math.max(Math.sqrt(A.d * B.d), L * 0.55)); leg.dth = angDiff(B.th, A.th); st.cur = -1; return leg.t0; },
    legOf(el){ for (let i = 0; i < st.legs.length; i++) if (el < st.legs[i].t0 + st.legs[i].T + st.legs[i].DW) return i; return st.legs.length - 1; }};
}
/* a slow turn round the look-at point while a scene holds, so no shot ever stands still */
function showDrift(sc, rate){ const dtt = Math.min(0.1, tAbs - (sc.lt == null ? tAbs : sc.lt)); sc.lt = tAbs; if (fly || !dtt) return; sphA.setFromVector3(v3.copy(camera.position).sub(controls.target)); sphA.theta += rate * dtt; camera.position.setFromSpherical(sphA).add(controls.target); }
function buildShowAuto(){
  const out = [];

  out.push({k: "intro", d: 13, in(){ this.lt = null; setMode("surface"); selSector(-1); closeCard(false); ringTw = null; S.T = 2013.6; flyTo(homeView(), 2200); caption(T("مسيرة التنمية"), T("من 2014 إلى اليوم"), ""); XP.setTab("feed"); },
    tick(k){ S.T = lerp(2013.6, 2026.95, k * k * (3 - 2 * k)); capS.textContent = Math.max(2014, Math.floor(S.T)) + " · " + stat.n + T(" مشروعًا"); showDrift(this, 0.035); }});

  SECS.forEach((sec, s) => {
    /* the sector: the ring brings its screen round and it opens into its layers, framed whole by the same solver the buttons use */

        if (k >= 0.3) capS.innerHTML = esc(f[fi][0]) + " — " + esc(f[fi][1]) + T("<small>المصدر: ") + esc(f[fi][2]) + "</small>"; }});
    /* its flagships: a drone line down to the two sites with the most to see */
    const strong = P.filter(p => p.sc === s && pvMap(p) && GEO[p.i] && stopScore(p) >= 26).length, pts = tourPoints(s, strong >= 4 ? 3 : 2);
    if (pts.length) { const dsc = droneScene(s, pts); dsc.in = function(){ S.T = 2026.95; setMode("surface"); selSector(s); closeCard(false); ringTw = null; this.init(); XP.setTab("gov"); showTotal = showScenes.reduce((a, q) => a + q.d, 0); }; dsc.still = true; dsc.d = pts.length * (6 + 10); out.push(dsc); }

    tick(k){ S.T = lerp(2026.95, 2030.95, clamp(k * 2.2, 0, 1)); if (k > 0.4) capS.textContent = stat.nA + T(" منجز أو يعمل · ") + stat.nP + T(" مستمر · ") + stat.nE + T(" قيد التنفيذ أو مستهدف"); showDrift(this, 0.04); }});

/* the presenter's own scenario (settings › «سيناريو العرض»): the same scenes, in his order and at his pace; places are governorates and landmarks;

function buildShow(){ const cfg = typeof showCfgActive === "function" ? showCfgActive() : null; if (cfg) { const o = showCustom(cfg); if (o.length) return o; } return buildShowAuto(); }
function showCustom(cfg){
  const auto = buildShowAuto(), out = []; let run = [];
  const flush = () => { const pts = run.map(st => { const pi = P.findIndex(p => p.i === st.i); if (pi < 0 || !pvMap(P[pi])) return null; const sp = simSite(P[pi]); return {pi, x: sp.x, z: sp.z, exact: !!GEO[P[pi].i], dw: st.d}; }).filter(Boolean); run = [];
    if (!pts.length) return; const ss = [...new Set(pts.map(q => P[q.pi].sc))], s = ss.length === 1 ? ss[0] : -1, yT = Math.max(2026.95, ...pts.map(q => P[q.pi].y + P[q.pi].sg + 0.5));

    dsc.still = true; dsc.d = pts.reduce((a, q) => a + 6 + q.dw, 0); out.push(dsc); };
  cfg.steps.forEach(st => {
    if (st.t === "proj") { run.push(st); return; } flush();
    if (st.t === "gov") { const id = st.g; if (!govs[id]) return;
      out.push({d: st.d, in(){ this.lt = null; S.T = 2026.95; setMode("surface"); selSector(-1); closeCard(false); ringTw = null; compute(); openGov(id, true); flyTo(govView(id), 2600); caption(T("محافظة"), GN[id], (stat.govCnt[id] || 0) + T(" مشروعًا")); XP.setTab("gov"); },
        tick(){ showDrift(this, 0.04); }, out(){ closeCard(false); }}); }
    else if (st.t === "lm") { const L = (typeof EGM_LM !== "undefined" ? EGM_LM : []).find(r => r[0] === st.i), m = MODELS3D.find(q => q.key === "wsm" + st.i); if (!L || !m) return;
      out.push({d: st.d, in(){ this.lt = null; S.T = 2026.95; setMode("surface"); selSector(-1); closeCard(false); ringTw = null; tmpS.setFromVector3(camera.position.clone().sub(controls.target)); flyTo(model3dLow(m, tmpS.theta + 0.5), 3200);

    else { const sc = auto.find(q => q.k === (st.t === "sec" ? "sec" + st.s : st.t)); if (sc) out.push(Object.assign({}, sc, {d: st.d})); } });

function nextScene(){ const prev = showScenes[showI]; if (prev && prev.out) prev.out(); showI++; if (showI >= showScenes.length) { showI = 0; showDone = 0; } showT0 = tAbs; showScenes[showI].in(); }
function startShow(){
  stopIntro(true); toggleNotes(false); closeCard(false); setPlaying(false); fltReset(); S.show = {rate: 1, paused: false, hold: false}; SHOW_RATE = 1; showScenes = buildShow();
  { const c = typeof showCfgActive === "function" ? showCfgActive() : null; if (c && c.rate && c.rate !== 1) { S.show.rate = c.rate; SHOW_RATE = c.rate; } }
  showTotal = showScenes.reduce((a, s) => a + s.d, 0); showI = -1; showDone = 0; nextScene();
  $("bShow").setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"); $("bShowT").textContent = T("إيقاف العرض"); showUi();
}
function stopShow(){ if (!S.show) return; const cur = showScenes[showI]; if (cur && cur.out) cur.out(); S.show = null; SHOW_RATE = 1; capEl.classList.remove("on"); $("bShow").setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false"); $("bShowT").textContent = T("وضع العرض"); controls.autoRotate = false; }
function tickShow(){ const sc = showScenes[showI], el = tAbs - showT0; if (sc.tick) sc.tick(clamp(el / sc.d, 0, 1));
  capP.style.width = ((showDone + Math.min(el, sc.d)) / showTotal * 100).toFixed(2) + "%"; if (el >= sc.d) { showDone += sc.d; nextScene(); } }

const SHOW_RATES = [0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4], showCtl = $("showCtl");

function showRate(r){ if (!S.show) return; S.show.rate = r; if (!S.show.paused) SHOW_RATE = r; showUi(); }
function showRateBy(d){ if (!S.show) return; const i = SHOW_RATES.indexOf(S.show.rate); showRate(SHOW_RATES[clamp((i < 0 ? 1 : i) + d, 0, SHOW_RATES.length - 1)]); }
function showHold(){ if (!S.show || S.show.hold) return; S.show.hold = true; fly = null; showUi(); }
function showPause(on){ if (!S.show) return;
  if (S.show.hold) { S.show.hold = false; S.show.paused = on === true; }          /* from a hold the button resumes, at the same scene and the same second */
  else S.show.paused = on == null ? !S.show.paused : !!on;
  SHOW_RATE = S.show.paused ? 0 : S.show.rate; showUi(); }
function showGoScene(i, back){
  const n = showScenes.length, prev = showScenes[showI]; if (prev && prev.out) prev.out();
  showI = ((i % n) + n) % n; showDone = 0; for (let q = 0; q < showI; q++) showDone += showScenes[q].d; showT0 = tAbs; showScenes[showI].in();
  const sc = showScenes[showI]; if (back && sc.drone && sc.nLegs() > 1) showT0 = tAbs - sc.goLeg(sc.nLegs() - 1) - 0.02;      /* stepping back into a flight lands on its last stop */
}
function showStep(dir){
  if (!S.show) return; if (S.show.paused || S.show.hold) showPause(false);           /* a step always plays: a frozen camera could not show the new step */
  const sc = showScenes[showI], el = tAbs - showT0;
  if (sc.drone && sc.nLegs()) { const ti = sc.legOf(el) + dir; if (ti >= 0 && ti < sc.nLegs()) { showT0 = tAbs - sc.goLeg(ti) - 0.02; return; } }
  showGoScene(showI + dir, dir < 0);
}

    if (hit) { e.preventDefault(); const ae = document.activeElement; if (ae && ae !== document.body && ae.blur) ae.blur(); return; } }      /* drop the focus so the key's release cannot press a button */

  else if (c === "KeyH" || c === "Digit0") { closeCard(false); prevView = null; setSector(-1); flyTo(homeView(), 1500); }

  else used = false;
  if (used) { e.preventDefault(); if (S.show) stopShow(); }
});

/* ================= quality ================= */
const DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
function setQuality(q){
  quality = q; PR = q >= 2 ? Math.min(DPR, coarse ? 1.5 : 2) : q === 1 ? Math.min(DPR, 1.25) : 1;
  if (q >= 1 && !composer) { renderer.setPixelRatio(PR); renderer.setSize(W, Hh, false); buildComposer(); } else if (q < 1) { if (composer) { try { composer.renderTarget1.dispose(); composer.renderTarget2.dispose(); if (bloom && bloom.dispose) bloom.dispose(); } catch (e) {} } composer = null; }
  resize();
}

const RB = [[nileGlowMat, 0.5], [nileCoreMat, 0.6], [canalMat, 0.85], [minorMat, 0.42]];

/* the ring turns to its goal on the same clock and the same quintic ease as the camera flight, so the two arrive together with no snap */
let ringTw = null, tyMax = 8;
function ringTo(goal, dur){ let d = goal - ringRot; d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d)); ringTw = {from: ringRot, d, st: flyNow(), dur: dur || 1900}; ringSpd = 0; }      /* and it holds exactly where it lands: no creep after arrival */
let last = performance.now(), prevTF = S.T, ringRot = 0, ringSpd = 1, feedAcc = 0, pickAcc = 0, arcAlpha = SECS.map(() => 1), arcHot = SECS.map(() => 0);
const ease3 = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
function recolor(){
  for (let k = 0; k < NI; k++) { const p = P[INST[k].pi], c = SECF[p.sc], sel = S.selP === INST[k].pi ? 0.4 : 0;
    aCol[k*3] = lerp(c[0], 1, sel); aCol[k*3+1] = lerp(c[1], 1, sel); aCol[k*3+2] = lerp(c[2], 1, sel); }
  beams.geometry.attributes.iCol.needsUpdate = true; rings.geometry.attributes.iCol.needsUpdate = true; headGeo.attributes.aCol.needsUpdate = true; colorDirty = false;
}
function frame(now){
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  const rms = Math.max(0, now - last); let dt = Math.min(0.1, rms / 1000); last = now; if (dt <= 0) dt = 0.001;
  /* the show has its own speed: everything timed (scenes, flights, the simulation, whatever moves on the map) runs faster, slower, or stands still when paused */
  const rdt = dt, rate = S.show && !S.show.hold ? SHOW_RATE : 1; FLYT += rms * rate; dt = Math.max(1e-5, dt * rate);
  bootT += dt; tAbs += dt; U.uTime.value = tAbs;
  if (document.visibilityState === "visible" && bootT > 3.5) { ema += (rdt - ema) * 0.05; slowT = ema > 0.05 ? slowT + rdt : 0;
    if (slowT > 2.6 && quality > 0 && !qLocked) { setQuality(quality - 1); slowT = 0; ema = 0.016; } }
  if (S.show) { if (S.show.hold) showT0 += dt; else tickShow(); }       /* held: the scene clock stands still while the viewer drives the camera */
  if (intro) { const k = clamp((bootT - intro.t0) / intro.dur, 0, 1); S.T = lerp(2013.6, 2026.95, 0.5 * k + 0.5 * (1 - (1 - k) * (1 - k))); if (k >= 1) intro = null; }
  if (S.playing) { S.T += dt * S.speed; if (S.T >= 2030.95) { S.T = 2030.95; setPlaying(false); } }
  if (kiosk && !S.show && !S.check && performance.now() - lastAct > 75000) startShow();
  if (kiosk && S.show && S.show.hold && performance.now() - lastAct > 75000) showPause(false);
  stepFree(dt);
  padStep(Math.min(dt, 0.1));
  if (fly) stepFly(); else stepZoom();
  controls.autoRotate = !fly && !ptr.down && !S.check && inShow() && SHOW_RATE > 0 && !(showScenes[showI] && showScenes[showI].still); controls.autoRotateSpeed = 0.45 * (S.show ? SHOW_RATE : 1);
  { const tg = fly || S.show ? M3_POLAR : lerp(1.34, M3_BIRD, ZS.close), c = controls.maxPolarAngle;      /* zooming in always ends as a bird view: the nearer the ground, the more the camera is held above it */
    controls.maxPolarAngle = tg > c ? tg : c + (tg - c) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.5); }   /* a model on the map is seen from drone height, so the camera may look level or up there; elsewhere it eases back */
  controls.update(); updateZoomScale(); updateRoads(); updateCity(dt); updateModels3d(dt); updateGeoHud(dt); updateOrbit(dt);
  controls.target.x = clamp(controls.target.x, EC.x - 34, EC.x + 34); controls.target.z = clamp(controls.target.z, EC.z - 34, EC.z + 34); { const tg = mL > 0.4 ? 56 : (S.sec >= 0 || S.show || fly) ? 16 : 8; tyMax = tg > tyMax ? tg : tyMax + (tg - tyMax) * Math.min(1, dt * 2); controls.target.y = clamp(controls.target.y, 0, tyMax); }   /* a sector's screen is looked at above the map: the ceiling opens for it at once and closes gently, never cutting a flight short */
  if (mL < 0.5) { const gy = H + relH(camera.position.x, camera.position.z) * TU.uRel.value + groundClear(); if (camera.position.y < gy) camera.position.y = gy; }

  compute();
  const dT = S.T - prevTF; prevTF = S.T; const jump = Math.abs(dT) > 2.2;
  const km = Math.min(1, dt * 2.6); mD += (tMD - mD) * km; mL += (tML - mL) * km; if (Math.abs(mD - tMD) < 0.002) mD = tMD; if (Math.abs(mL - tML) < 0.002) mL = tML;
  ringSpd += (((S.show && showScenes[showI] && showScenes[showI].face) || (S.sec >= 0 && !S.show) ? 0 : 1) - ringSpd) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.5); if (ringTw) { const rk = clamp((flyNow() - ringTw.st) / ringTw.dur, 0, 1); ringRot = ringTw.from + ringTw.d * rk * rk * rk * (rk * (rk * 6 - 15) + 10); if (rk >= 1) ringTw = null; } else ringRot += dt * 0.04 * ringSpd;   /* the ring holds still while the camera faces a sector's screen */ const k6 = Math.min(1, dt * 6), k10 = Math.min(1, dt * 10);
  if (colorDirty) recolor();

  /* hover picking */
  if (ptr.in && !ptr.down && !ptr.touch && !fly && now - ptr.lastPick > 45) { ptr.lastPick = now;
    boHover = boPick(ptr.x, ptr.y); canvas.style.cursor = boHover && boHover.kind !== "info" ? "pointer" : "";
    const oh = orbitPick(ptr.x, ptr.y); orbHover = oh;
    const over = oh >= 0 || overSim(ptr.x, ptr.y), cl = over ? [] : pickCluster(pickCands(ptr.x, ptr.y)), pi = cl.length ? cl[0].pi : -1;
    S.hoverP = pi; S.hoverG = pi >= 0 || over ? null : pickGov(ptr.x, ptr.y);
    canvas.classList.toggle("hov", pi >= 0 || !!S.hoverG || oh >= 0);
